I am not aware that Somali status holders move with the aim of avoiding prosecution for cutting their daughters.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Somalische statushouders verhuizen met als doel om strafvervolging voor het besnijden van hun dochters te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de oproep tot een continuïteitspakket voor jonge wetenschappers in de knel

MP Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she acknowledged the hardship of young researchers during the coronavirus crisis and whether she would fund a €350 million continuity package requested by three organisations. The minister acknowledged the impact, said universities as employers bear primary responsibility, created up to €20 million extra room via a NWO policy rule for affected researchers, and declined the full package while agreeing to continue talks.
I consider it important that universities and research institutes, where possible, offer researchers on temporary contracts room for extension
Ik vind het van belang dat universiteiten en onderzoeksinstituten waar mogelijk onderzoekers op een tijdelijk contract ruimte voor verlenging bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over een incident in een AZC waarbij een lesbische vrouw met kokend water werd overgoten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an incident in an asylum centre where a lesbian woman was scalded with boiling water, whether she received proper medical care and aftercare, whether LHBTI asylum seekers face higher risk and why no data exists, what protections exist, and whether a separate centre should be created. The State Secretary said the case was handled correctly and the victim got immediate care, that no LHBTI-specific incident figures are recorded, describes existing protection measures, and rejected separate LHBTI accommodation.
I cannot go into detail on the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet gedetailleerd ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Ngo’s: hele modewereld betrokken bij dwangarbeid Oeigoeren'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports that the fashion industry is linked to forced labour of Uyghurs in China, including what concrete steps were taken, whether companies should be mapped, and whether further international reactions would follow. The ministers answered that the Netherlands raises Xinjiang human rights bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council, that companies bear primary due diligence responsibility, that no overview of linked companies exists, and that further raising of the issue is planned.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked through their supply chain to the situation in Xinjiang.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over psychische mishandeling

Three MPs (Bergkamp, Van den Hul, Özütok) asked the ministers about how the government addresses psychological abuse, its criminal-law treatment, registration, and compliance with the Istanbul Convention and children's rights treaty. Minister De Jonge replied that existing law and the GHNT programme already allow action, that police and courts do not register psychological abuse separately, and that no specific problems are reported in prosecution.
It therefore cannot be determined from police registration how often a report of psychological abuse has been filed, whether or not combined with other forms of abuse.
Het is daarom niet uit de politieregistratie te halen hoe vaak aangifte is gedaan van psychische mishandeling, al dan niet in combinatie met andere vormen van mishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat Polen zich wil terugtrekken uit het verdrag dat geweld tegen vrouwen bestrijdt

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they share concern over Poland's reported plan to withdraw from the Istanbul Convention on violence against women, whether they will contact Polish counterparts, and whether they will support Polish civil society groups. The government answered that it shares the concern, that no withdrawal decision yet exists in Poland, that a joint démarche was made on 7 August, that the Netherlands will not withdraw, and that support for Polish organisations will be considered if warranted.

The cabinet will continue to follow the matter and, after the ruling of the Polish Constitutional Court and a possible decision by the Polish government, will assess whether and what further action is appropriate and most effective.

Het kabinet blijft de zaak volgen en zal na de uitspraak van het Pools Constitutioneel Hof en een mogelijk besluit van de Poolse regering bezien of en welke verdere actie opportuun is en het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Van den Hul en Voordewind over de rapportering van de bedrijven aangesloten bij het textiel convenant

MPs Alkaya, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the minister about a SOMO and Schone Kleren Campagne report finding weak public CSR reporting by textile covenant firms, including on access to remedy and living wage. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, outlined steps via the SER secretariat and steering group, and largely deferred to the covenant's own monitoring.
Companies themselves are responsible for the content and form of their reporting.
Bedrijven zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en vorm van hun rapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Ellemeet en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Minister Van Engelshoven eindigt subsidie op de MBO card’

Three GroenLinks and PvdA MPs asked the education minister why she ended the MBO Card culture subsidy despite the Berenschot evaluation recommending strengthening it, and how this fits her culture policy ambitions. The minister answered that the subsidy goal was not met, so continuing state funding is not appropriate, and she will instead provide 500,000 euro yearly to a general cultural education scheme, while stating she remains committed to integrated culture education.
If the subsidy objectives of the MBO Card have not been achieved, I do not think it makes sense to then continue the MBO Card with government subsidies.
Als de subsidiedoelstellingen van de MBO Card niet zijn behaald, vind ik het niet geheel in de rede liggen om vervolgens met overheidssubsidies het voortbestaan van de MBO Card te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een wetswijziging in Roemenië waarmee het recht om te zijn wie je bent wordt ondermijnd

Two MPs asked the government about a Romanian amendment banning the teaching of gender as a concept separate from biological sex, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the amendment awaits presidential approval and a Constitutional Court ruling, and listed EU-level and Dutch efforts to support LHBTI rights, without announcing a concrete sanction.
The ongoing legislative process, as well as the public debate about it in Romanian society, are therefore of concern to the cabinet.
Het nog lopende wetstraject, alsmede de maatschappelijke discussie daarover in de Roemeense samenleving, hebben daarom de aandacht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Tunisia: Two-Year Sentence for Homosexuality’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign ministers about a Tunisian court sentence of two years for homosexuality, including whether the Netherlands had raised concerns, condemned forced anal examinations as torture, and what the Tunisian LGBTI equality commission's stalling means for the relationship. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the case, the Netherlands opposes criminalisation and forced anal examinations and raises LGBTI rights in bilateral and multilateral fora, and that progress on the equality commission has been slow, with the Netherlands continuing to press for implementation.

The embassy is in close contact with the NGO supporting the two convicted men with legal advice and will decide in consultation with those involved whether contact with the Tunisian authorities is desirable.

De ambassade staat in nauw contact met de NGO die de twee veroordeelden bijstaat met juridisch advies en zal in samenspraak met betrokkenen besluiten of contact met Tunesische autoriteiten wenselijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul  over ongeveer 14.000 leerlingen met een migratieachtergrond, kinderen van laagopgeleide ouders en kinderen van ouders met een laag inkomen die volgens het Centraal Planbureau z

An MP asked whether the cancellation of the primary school final test during the corona crisis means pupils with migrant backgrounds and from low-income or low-educated families will more often miss a higher secondary school recommendation, and whether existing measures suffice. The minister acknowledges the risk, points to guidance to schools, a transfer form and an extra evaluation in first-year secondary, and promises to keep monitoring the group and take further measures if needed.

I trust that secondary schools will take their responsibility here and, as I have promised, I will continue to follow this group of pupils in the coming period and take additional measures where necessary.

Ik vertrouw erop dat vo-scholen hier hun verantwoordelijkheid in zullen nemen en zal, zoals ik heb toegezegd, deze groep leerlingen de komende tijd blijven volgen en waar nodig aanvullende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Roemenië schrapt seksuele voorlichting’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about Romania dropping mandatory sex education under church pressure, its effect on women and LGBTI rights, and whether the government will raise concerns with Romania. The minister replied that the law is under review by the Constitutional Court, that the government monitors such developments closely, and that the embassy works with civil society on women's and LGBTI rights, without committing to a new concrete step toward Romania.
The cabinet appreciates the involvement of the various Romanian actors in this and considers it at this stage up to them to set the course for Romania.
Het kabinet waardeert de betrokkenheid van de diverse Roemeense spelers hierin en acht het in dit stadium aan hen om de koers voor Roemenië te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

Two MPs asked the minister how rejecting homosexuality as contrary to God's word fits with a safe school climate for gay pupils, and whether the inspectorate has been asked to ensure this, and whether the planned sexual-diversity kerndoelen in the coalition agreement will still be realised this term. The minister replied that schools must take responsibility for a safe climate, that the inspectorate already supervises this and will intervene on signals of insecurity, and that the sexual-diversity goals will be reviewed alongside the integral curriculum revision from autumn 2020.
The inspectorate therefore already supervises this.
De inspectie houdt dus al toezicht hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dak- en thuisloze LHBTI-jongeren driedubbel kwetsbaar zijn

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary how the government will respond to calls for safe crisis shelter for homeless LHBTI youth, whose vulnerability was documented by Movisie research. The State Secretary replied that the broad homelessness approach prioritises own housing and short shelter stays, that shelter quality on sexual and gender diversity needs improvement through training and smaller units, and that concrete steps include a national platform and further talks with stakeholders.
I am in further discussion with Valente, VNG and interest organisations to determine what should be organised at regional level for this.
Ik ben met Valente, VNG en belangenorganisaties nader in gesprek om te bepalen wat hiervoor op regionaal niveau georganiseerd dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over beperkingen opgelegd aan studenten in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Van den Hul asked the Secretary of State for Infrastructure and Water Management about restrictions on students using public transport during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether students were being barred from peak hours, consultation with student unions, and alternatives for students. The government answered that no specific restrictions apply to students, that a general call to avoid peak hours applies to all travellers, and that agreements on school and university start and end times were made with education bodies and carriers, while promising to consider involving student unions in future agreements.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, no restrictions apply to students in public transport.
Zoals in antwoord op vraag 3 is aangegeven gelden geen beperkingen voor studenten in het OV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld  en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dertig leerlingen uit het speciaal basisonderwijs noodgedwongen ondergebracht worden bij reguliere scholen

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether a school board could unilaterally move 30 pupils from a special primary school to regular schools without parental consent, and how the Inspectorate handled complaints about the school. Minister Slob answered that the law does not expressly regulate this, that parents were individually consulted and given school visits, that the Inspectorate received 12 complaints and a repair inspection is under way, and that no further action is needed.
The legislation does not expressly regulate this.
In de wetgeving is dit niet uitdrukkelijk geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van den Hul en Alkaya over het opstappen van de CEO van ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs asked the government about the reported toxic work culture at development bank FMO, the use of confidentiality agreements, and the departure of its CEO, including the selection of a successor. The minister replied that the state, as majority shareholder, has no direct supervisory role over FMO's work culture, that the supervisory board oversees the management board, and that the government is monitoring the situation closely while promising to follow up on the evaluation and the appointment process.
The government has no supervisory relationship with FMO and therefore also does not (directly) supervise a healthy work environment within FMO.
De regering heeft geen toezichtsrelatie met FMO en houdt dus ook geen (direct) toezicht op een gezonde werkomgeving binnen FMO.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Van den Hul, Van Meenen, Westerveld en Kwint over selectief aanmeldbeleid bij basisscholen

MPs asked the minister how government and the Education Inspectorate responded to research showing Utrecht primary schools operated pre-registration practices that breached the law and harmed equal access, including for children with migrant backgrounds. The minister said the inspectorate can intervene, that the municipality and school boards are drafting an improvement plan due in October, and that a broader study of admission policy and a policy agenda on segregation will follow.
If it becomes apparent that this is not being complied with, the Education Inspectorate can intervene.
Als blijkt dat daaraan niet wordt voldaan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van den Hul over de doorvoer van ruim 10 miljoen kogelpatronen naar Turkije

Opposition MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a transit of over 10 million cartridges from Czechia through Rotterdam to Turkey despite Dutch restrictions, and about prior assurances on Czech export checks. The minister confirmed the transit without transhipment, said no Dutch licence was required, explained that end-use details are confidential and not held in the Netherlands, and said the government would not require standard customs checks on Czech consignments.

Since the goods require a licence in Czechia rather than in the Netherlands, and given the confidential nature of the information, the cabinet cannot provide additional information on the end use of the goods.

Aangezien de goederen niet in Nederland maar in Tsjechië vergunningplichtig zijn, en gelet op de vertrouwelijke aard van de informatie kan het kabinet geen aanvullende informatie verstrekken aangaande het eindgebruik van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het lerarentekort in Rotterdam

MPs asked the minister about the teacher shortage in Rotterdam, including the doubled shortfall under a new measurement method, the disadvantage faced by schools with many pupils at risk of educational disadvantage, the adequacy of funding, and the use of unqualified teachers for up to 22 hours a month. The minister answered that the shortage is being tackled through regional and G5 emergency plans with funding, that a better measurement method is under study with a report expected in December, and that the qualification requirements are not being changed.
I expect to be able to inform your House further about these methods in December.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in december nader te kunnen informeren over deze methodes.
Antwoord op vragen van van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why the Hoenderloo College is closing by 1 August 2020, whether Pluryn is meeting its duty of care, and whether the ministers can intervene or place the foundation under curatorship. The ministers replied that the closure date is only a target, the institution closes only once every young person has a suitable follow-up placement, the inspectorate is monitoring this and has tightened supervision, and curatorship of a private foundation is not possible outside bankruptcy.
It has been agreed, however, that the Hoenderloo Group will only close once a suitable and sustainable follow-up place has been found for every young person.
Afgesproken is, echter, dat de Hoenderloo Groep pas sluit als er voor iedere jongere een passende en duurzame vervolgplek is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Nederlandse ambassadeur in Nigeria informatie lekte naar Shell

MPs asked whether the former Dutch ambassador to Nigeria leaked confidential information about a corruption investigation into Shell, and about the integrity investigation, handling and reasons for replacing him. The ministers refused to disclose the integrity findings and related documents citing privacy and integrity-reporting concerns, rejected the claim that he favoured Shell, and gave a limited account of the Niger Delta cleanup.
The answers to questions 1 through 7 and question 9 will be sent to your House on a confidential basis.
De antwoorden op vraag 1 t/m 7 en vraag 9 zullen uw Kamer vertrouwelijk toegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Van den Hul over de verslechterende positie van LHBT+ mensen als gevolg van de COVID-19 pandemie

Two MPs asked the foreign trade and development minister and the foreign affairs minister how COVID-19 has worsened the position of LGBT+ people in developing countries, what the government knows of the situation, and what it is doing to protect them. The ministers answered that LGBTI people are especially vulnerable during the pandemic, describe support for local LGBTI organisations and advocacy through the Equal Rights Coalition and multilateral fora, while noting that public criticism is not always effective.
The Netherlands nevertheless remains, publicly or behind the scenes, a vocal advocate for equal rights for LGBTI people.
Nederland blijft echter, voor of achter de schermen, een vocale pleitbezorger voor gelijke rechten van LHBTI’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht “13.000 mbo’ers hebben geen stageplek of leerbaan: ‘Mogelijk voorbode van werkloosheid’”

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked how the government will ensure a sound internship (beroepspraktijkvorming) approach in vocational education given a shortage of 13,000 placements, and whether affected students will avoid study delays and whether the shortage signals future unemployment. The Minister answered that SBB is acquiring new placements with extra funds, that schools may assess learning goals without full placement hours, and that the labour market risk is acknowledged with a progress letter promised before the summer recess.
The shortage of internship places and apprenticeships may indeed be an indication of labour market problems for school leavers.
Het tekort aan stageplaatsen en leerbanen kan inderdaad een indicatie zijn van knelpunten op de arbeidsmarkt voor schoolverlaters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

MPs Van den Hul and Van Dijk asked whether reformed schools that describe homosexuality as contrary to God's word, and state that sexuality belongs only in a man-woman marriage, will be held to the legal duties on safety and citizenship, and whether the 2009 motion against such staff declarations is respected. The ministers answered that schools' freedom is bounded by fundamental rights, that the Inspectorate monitors safety and will intervene, that the employment exception no longer allows discrimination on sexual orientation, and that the attainment targets on sexual diversity will be sharpened as part of curriculum reform.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions and to intervene if it does not.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet en om in te grijpen als dat niet het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Leeuwarden stopt met inkoop van specialistische hulp voor vrouwen in opvang voor 43 gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the minister about Leeuwarden ending its role as national purchaser of specialist women's shelter care for 43 municipalities, and whether this threatens care continuity and signals an unsustainable system. The minister answered that responsibility lies with municipalities under the Wmo2015, the Leeuwarden contract runs to 31 December 2020, the VNG and centre municipalities are arranging an orderly handover, and he sees no reason for national action at this point.
It is up to municipalities to set quality requirements for this provision and, based on those requirements, to decide which organisation to contract the care to.
Het is daarmee aan gemeenten om eisen te stellen aan de kwaliteit van deze voorziening en – op basis van deze eisen – te beslissen bij welke organisatie zij deze zorg beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de manier waarop corona de kansenongelijkheid in het onderwijs vergroot

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether corona is widening educational inequality, including under-advising of children from lower-educated families, and what structural measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the widening gap and the need for extra support, pointing to a 244 million euro catch-up fund, continued equity programmes and the handreiking schooladvisering, but did not commit to new structural changes beyond existing measures.
The cabinet is allocating 244 million euros to make up for the disadvantages that children in vulnerable positions suffered in education during the corona lockdown.
Het kabinet trekt 244 miljoen euro uit om de achterstanden weg te werken die kinderen in een kwetsbare positie tijdens de corona-lockdown in het onderwijs hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over gedupeerde studenten van niet-erkende beroepsopleidingen in de zorg

MPs asked why UWV referred students to non-accredited care training run by Quadrant, whether UWV and the government will prevent this and whether they will help affected students. The minister answered that UWV only checked accreditation and that the contract was ended, promised tighter voucher rules and periodic talks with trainers, but said no diploma can be issued outside accredited schools and offered only a conversation with affected students.
UWV is working on an adjustment of the procurement framework that sets out the contractual obligations of a trainer.
UWV werkt aan een aanpassing van het inkoopkader waarin de contractuele verplichtingen van een opleider zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het bericht ‘Amsterdams homokoppel uitgescholden en bespuugd’

MPs Bergkamp, Van den Hul and Özütok asked the Justice Minister about a reported homophobic attack in Amsterdam, underreporting of hate crime, the use of specialised discrimination detectives, and the training of police officers on discrimination. Minister Grapperhaus said such discrimination is unacceptable, announced a publicity campaign and a national police coordination function, but rejected creating specialised hate crime units and left the police training curriculum largely unchanged.
I intend to conclude this process with a public campaign aimed at the willingness of LHBTI people to report and file complaints.
Ik ben voornemens dit traject af te ronden met een publiekscampagne gericht op de meldings- en aangiftebereidheid van LHBTI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Wereld op rand van hongerpandemie'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report warning of a global hunger pandemic, including whether the Netherlands would front-load WFP funding and support local food production and reaching marginalised groups. The minister answered that the core WFP contribution of EUR 36 million was already paid in early 2020, an additional EUR 15 million goes to the UN CERF, and the government will keep advocating for reaching the most vulnerable and supporting local agriculture.
I have no information about the position of other countries.
Over de positie van andere landen heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het onderschatten van leerlingen uit gezinnen met een lagere sociaaleconomische status

An MP asks the minister how the government responds to reports that children from lower-SES families are underrated by teachers, and what is done about regional under- and over-advising. The minister says he trusts school-advice professionals, will publish a school-advice handbook, is aware of the bias risks, and points to a bill on a single enrolment moment and publication of advice procedures.
At present, a school advice handbook is being developed in cooperation with SLO and the education sector.
Op dit moment wordt, in samenwerking met SLO en het onderwijsveld, een handreiking schooladvisering ontwikkeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over consequenties van de corona-crisis voor examenkandidaten in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs bij de slaag-zakregeling die via een staatsexamen hun diploma moeten behalen

An MP asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about the consequences of the corona crisis for special secondary education exam candidates taking state exams, including children out of sight, laptop provision, exam fairness and retake options. The minister answered that about 500 special secondary pupils are out of sight, that exam requirements are the same as in regular secondary education with tailored adjustments, and that a third retake option was added.
Following the debate in the House on 29 April, I agreed with the College voor Toetsen en Examens that a third retake will be added.
Naar aanleiding van het debat in de Kamer op 29 april heb ik met het College voor Toetsen en Examens afgesproken dat hier een derde herkansing aan wordt toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education about unclear COVID-19 rules for students in shared houses, the consequences of study delay for student finance and fees, the support available from student welfare funds, and the protection of young researchers. The minister answered that shared student houses are not treated as one household under the emergency ordinance, that DUO and institutions offer flexibility on loans and fees, and that she is monitoring the effects with education bodies.
I am monitoring this closely and remain in discussion with student and youth organisations about it.
Ik houd dit scherp in de gaten en blijf hierover in gesprek met de studenten- en jongerenorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over de verhuisbewegingen en onderwijs aan minderjarige asielzoekers

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether frequent relocations of minor asylum seekers harm their Dutch-language learning and school access, and whether the coalition goal of minimising moves is being met. Minister Slob acknowledges the negative effect of moves, points to mitigation measures (a COA relocation checklist, summer relocations, the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme with implementation planned 2020–2024), says data on move trends are not yet conclusive, and rejects reports of schools refusing children, while noting the two-year funding period.
That is why the focus is mainly on medium-term measures.
Daarom wordt vooral ingezet op middellange termijn maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Futselaar over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie bij studenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about pregnancy discrimination against students, including whether pregnant higher-education students should have maternity leave and individual exam programmes as mbo students now do. The minister acknowledged pregnancy can delay studies, said higher education lacks a statutory attendance duty so institutions handle this case by case, and committed to report after the summer on a parliamentary motion about maternity leave in higher education.
Following this debate, a motion was also adopted requesting the government to map out what is needed to make maternity leave possible in higher education.
Naar aanleiding van dit debat is ook een motie aangenomen die de regering verzoekt in kaart te brengen wat ervoor nodig is om zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de corona-crisis op kwetsbare kinderen en kansengelijkheid

An MP asked the education minister about vulnerable children during the COVID-19 crisis, including how to identify and reach them, care arrangements for children of essential workers, device access via SIVON, and long-term inequality. The minister said municipalities and schools are identifying vulnerable children, that monitoring is in place, that SIVON applications will be accepted beyond the deadline, and that he expects widening inequality and will inform parliament later.
I will inform you in due course about how we will, together with schools and municipalities, offer extra education and support to these children
Ik zal u te zijner tijd informeren over de manier waarop we samen met scholen en gemeenten deze kinderen extra onderwijs en begeleiding aan zullen bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de onveilige situatie voor homo’s en transgenders in Iran

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government had correctly assessed the safety of gay and transgender people in Iran, and whether it had used relevant reports and a letter from 6Rang in its country report. The State Secretary answered that the country report relies on source-verified information, that a supplementary analysis confirmed the March 2019 assessment and found no essential change, and that there is no reason to revise the policy, with a further update planned for 2021.
The conclusion of the investigation is that the situation as described in the March 2019 country report is confirmed.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is dat de situatie zoals deze beschreven is in het ambtsbericht van maart 2019 bevestigd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de coronamaatregelen op geweld achter de voordeur

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about rising domestic violence during COVID-19 lockdowns, including French-style emergency measures, a safe code word, SMS reporting, outreach to victims and reopening schools for children in unsafe homes. The Minister replied only by referring to a general COVID-19 update letter to parliament, without answering the individual questions.
The written questions from MP Van den Hul (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van den Hul (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over corona en de vele andere levensbedreigende risico’s in vluchtelingenkampen op Griekse eilanden

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government shares concern about COVID-19 and other life-threatening conditions in Greek island migrant camps, and whether it will take in unaccompanied children from there. The State Secretary says the government shares the concerns, lists Greek and EU measures and humanitarian support, and rejects ad hoc relocation of unaccompanied minors as a structural solution, while favouring structural improvements.
The government does not consider the ad hoc admission of unaccompanied minors a structural solution.
Het ad hoc opnemen van AMV's vindt het kabinet geen structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de coronamaatregelen op geweld achter de voordeur

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the effects of COVID-19 measures, such as school closures and stay-at-home advice, on domestic violence and child abuse, and how institutions like Veilig Thuis and women's shelters are prepared. The minister answered by referring to the general COVID-19 update letter to the House rather than addressing the questions individually.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Oeigoeren slachtoffer van dwangarbeid voor bekende merken‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether the government would investigate Dutch companies using Uyghur forced labour, press China for access and act in the EU and UN. The ministers say the government is raising Uyghur rights bilaterally and multilaterally, expects firms to conduct due diligence under OECD guidelines without government investigation, and plans a business information session postponed due to coronavirus.
It is the responsibility of these companies to map whether they are linked to companies where Uyghurs are employed. The cabinet does not investigate this.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van deze bedrijven om in kaart te brengen of zij gelinkt zijn aan bedrijven waar Oeigoeren tewerkgesteld worden. Het kabinet doet hier geen onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bijna een miljoen Syriërs zitten als ratten in de val in Idlib – of is er nog hoop?‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Idlib, Syria, and what it is doing to protect displaced civilians and secure aid access. The minister outlined Dutch humanitarian funding channels, EU and UN diplomacy, and the Turkey-Russia ceasefire arrangements, without committing to new national measures beyond existing funding.
The Netherlands provides humanitarian aid in several ways to alleviate the needs of the refugees in Idlib.
Nederland levert op verschillende manieren humanitaire hulp om de noden van de vluchtelingen in Idlib te lenigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de noodklok die WO in actie, FNV en AOb luiden over structureel overwerk op universiteiten

MPs asked the minister about reports that university staff work unpaid overtime and whether the labour inspectorate and the government will act on it, and about workload and grant-application pressure. The minister said the labour inspectorate has taken WO in Actie's complaint into its planned inspections of 14 universities, and pointed to a strategic agenda and an action plan on application pressure, promising a response.
The labour inspectorate has taken WO in Actie's complaint into consideration.
De inspectie SZW heeft de melding van WO in Actie in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht VN publiceert lijst van bedrijven met banden Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asked the government about the UN list of companies linked to Israeli settlements, the consequences for Dutch firms, whether they comply with responsible business guidelines, what steps could be taken, and whether the UN would be asked to explain its findings. The government reiterated its opposition to the database and its view that settlements are contrary to international law, while stating that companies themselves decide their partners and that it would not comment on specific cases or contact the UN.
The cabinet does not comment on specific cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraak over specifieke casussen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat niemand precies weet hoeveel nieuwe leraren de zware opleiding tot juf of meester op de basisschool voor zij-instromers heeft opgeleverd

MP Van den Hul asked the minister about reports that nobody knows how many career-changer teachers the primary-school teacher training has produced, about estimated 20% dropout, the role of the ministry in monitoring this, and whether the 20,000-euro subsidy per career changer should be doubled. The minister answered that DUO has limited data on post-training retention, commissioned an evaluation and an inspectorate study, stated that supervision is the schools' and training institutes' responsibility, and said the subsidy is meant as a supplement, not to cover all costs.
For that reason I am having an evaluation study carried out on career-changer entry into primary, secondary and vocational education.
Om die reden laat ik een evaluatie-onderzoek uitvoeren naar zij-instroom in het po, vo en het mbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de 5-daagse sluiting van zestien basisscholen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister why sixteen Amsterdam primary schools closed for a week due to teacher shortages, and how the government monitors the shortage's impact on education quality. The Minister said the inspectorate was informed in advance, pointed to a letter on teacher registration, and outlined regional emergency plans and extra funding for affected cities.
Given the complexity of this issue, we are choosing a combination of measures to arrive at as clear a picture as possible.
Vanwege de complexiteit van dit vraagstuk kiezen wij voor een combinatie van maatregelen om tot een zo helder mogelijk beeld te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de salarissen in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about how a gross monthly teacher salary figure of about 4,400 euro was calculated, why holiday and year-end pay were included, and what the actual salary distribution and cost of closing the pay gap with secondary education would be. The minister defended the methodology, gave salary and total-pay figures per scale, reported cost estimates, and committed to answering before the next debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het slechter presteren van kinderen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

MP Van den Hul asked whether the Inspectorate would investigate links between the teacher shortage and pupils' vocabulary, Cito scores and school advice, and what role the minister takes in countering the resulting inequality. Minister Slob answered that the Inspectorate does not investigate that direct link but considers teacher shortages in its supervision, and that tackling inequality is a shared responsibility supported by funding, regional measures, and teacher training.
The inspectorate does not conduct research into a direct link between the teacher shortage and vocabulary, Cito scores and school recommendations.
De inspectie voert geen onderzoek uit naar een direct verband tussen het lerarentekort en woordenschat, cito-scores en schooladviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de besnijdenis van Nederlandse meisjes in het buitenland

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the cutting of Dutch girls abroad and what measures it takes to prevent and detect it. The minister answers that FGM is strictly prohibited and that prevention, reporting via Veilig Thuis, and an action agenda are being pursued, while noting that outcomes are not known and that Kenya has been raised with its authorities.
I will continue to invest in tackling FGM over the coming years together with my colleague for Legal Protection.
Ik blijf de komende jaren samen met mijn collega voor Rechtsbescherming investeren in de aanpak van VGV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht dat jongeren met een beperking te vroeg van school worden gestuurd

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister whether young people with disabilities are being removed from special secondary education too early, whether school boards can decide this unilaterally, and whether oversight and legal protection are adequate. The minister answered that the age limit is not absolute, decisions must be based on the pupil's development plan agreed with parents, the inspectorate has been asked to supervise, and existing appeal routes and legal protection are sufficient.
I have asked the Inspectorate to ensure that the partnerships comply with the statutory provisions in this regard.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd er op toe te zien dat de samenwerkingsverbanden zich aan de wettelijke bepalingen in deze houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over mogelijke inzet van derdejaars pabo-studenten als zzp’er

The MP asked whether schools using third-year teacher-training (pabo) students as self-employed freelancers, who set their own fees and are cheaper than certified teachers, is acceptable for education quality and cost-effectiveness. The minister answered that third-year pabo students may not teach independently, only as interns, that fourth-year students may be employed as LIO trainee teachers under the law and collective agreement, and that the undesirable practice is already blocked without a new ban.
A third-year pabo student may not yet teach independently.
Een derdejaars pabo-student mag nog niet zelfstandig les geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over de stevige impact van armoede op leerlingen in het basisonderwijs

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister, with the social affairs state secretary, how poverty affects primary school pupils and whether schools should take specific measures, such as referring parents to helpers and creating funds for school trips. The minister agreed equal opportunities matter and described existing municipal poverty funding, a school handbook and a forthcoming handreiking for schools, while stating schools cannot solve poverty alone.
Together with the state secretary of SZW, I am focusing on supporting schools in dealing with poverty at schools.
Met de Staatssecretaris van SZW zet ik in op ondersteuning van scholen in het omgaan met armoede op scholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Paternotte en Van den Hul over het manifest van de beurspromovendi

MPs Van den Berge, Paternotte and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the manifesto of PhD candidates on scholarships, who lack employee rights, face pressure to teach, and receive weaker protections than employed PhD students. The minister largely defended the experiment, saying promotion students have no teaching duty and that the RUG has been urged to better inform supervisors, while promising an independent review and an evaluation in 2021.
In the policy response to the interim evaluation I have therefore already called on the RUG to continue focusing on informing the supervisors.
In de beleidsreactie op de tussenevaluatie heb ik daarom de RUG reeds opgeroepen om onverminderd in te zetten op het informeren van de supervisors.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de aanpak van seksuele intimidatie in het openbaar vervoer

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about sexual harassment on public transport, its prevalence, treatment of offenders to prevent escalation, and whether revising the sex-offence provisions of the Criminal Code would address this. The minister answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers last year (likely incomplete), that early treatment via existing criminal-law tools and risk assessment is available, and that a new criminal offence for sexual intimidation in public space is planned, with an evaluation of earlier measures due in spring 2020.

In my letter to the House of 22 May 2019, I therefore announced, also on behalf of the Minister for Legal Protection, my intention to include sexual intimidation in the Criminal Code as a new criminal offence.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 22 mei 2019 heb ik dan ook, mede namens de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, mijn voornemen aangekondigd om seksuele intimidatie in het Wetboek van Strafrecht als nieuwe strafbaarstelling op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten slavenarbeid verrichten op Italiaanse tomatenplantages

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of exploitative, near-slavery labour conditions for migrant workers on Italian tomato farms and whether such products reach Dutch shelves. The ministers answered that exploitation is condemned, that enforcement in Italy is for Italian authorities, that companies bear due diligence responsibility, and that sector parties under the food convenant will investigate and report back.
The steering group agreed that the sector parties that signed the convenant will investigate further the possible involvement of their members
In de stuurgroep is afgesproken dat de branchepartijen die het convenant hebben getekend nader onderzoek doen naar mogelijke betrokkenheid van hun leden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over gebrek aan coördinatie bij de bestrijding van geweld tegen vrouwen

An MP asks whether the government considers coordination of efforts against violence against women adequate, given the number of femicide victims, and whether it will appoint a national coordinator as proposed by UN Women Netherlands. The minister answers that municipalities are primarily responsible, that the national programme Geweld hoort nergens thuis is centrally coordinated, and that existing inter-ministerial coordination is sufficient, so no national coordinator is planned.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is sufficiently organised with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat vrouwen meer kans hebben om bij een auto-ongeluk te overlijden

Labour MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a US study showing women face higher injury risk in car crashes applies to the Netherlands, and whether crash tests should be adapted to women. The minister answered that the US study cannot be directly applied to the Dutch situation, that existing tests already represent average women and smaller persons, and that the RDW is involved in regulation and dummy development.
The study is based on accident figures from the United States. That the conclusions are directly applicable to the Dutch situation cannot be said on the basis of this single American study.

Het onderzoek is gebaseerd op ongevalscijfers uit de Verenigde Staten. Dat de conclusies één op één toepasbaar zijn voor de Nederlandse situatie kan op basis van dit enkele Amerikaanse onderzoek niet worden gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul en Bergkamp over de gemeentelijke basisadministratie voor kinderen van transgenders

MPs asked whether a transgender parent's gender change should also be reflected in their child's birth certificate and what children can do about the discrepancy with the BRP. The minister replied that the birth certificate is not amended after a parent's change, that the BRP may show the parent's new first name, and pointed to documentary and BRP-based ways to show the link.
Following these parliamentary questions, the government website information has been expanded to address these options.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is in de informatie op de website van de rijksoverheid aandacht besteed aan deze mogelijkheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over discriminatie op de woningmarkt

Two MPs asked the government about ongoing discrimination against housing seekers on the Utrecht housing market, including licensing for estate agents, fines, and ACM or Public Prosecution action. The minister said the problem is not surprising, outlined an approach of awareness, mystery-guest testing and local pilots, but declined new fines or a licensing law for now.
I have no intention of amending the law on this point.
Ik heb geen voornemen de wet op dit onderdeel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Regenwoudmaffia’ vermoordt en bedreigt inwoners Amazone’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul ask the ministers how the government responds to reports of violence and threats against Amazon forest defenders by illegal logging networks, and to Bolsonaro's criticism of conservation groups. The ministers say they have raised deforestation and rights concerns with Brazil, note that the legal framework exists but enforcement and political will fall short, and describe trade and sustainability initiatives.
It must be noted that the legal framework to act against criminal organisations exists, but the financial resources and political will to enforce that framework are lacking.
Geconstateerd moet worden dat het wetgevend kader om op te treden tegen criminele organisaties aanwezig is, maar de financiële middelen en de politieke wil om dat kader te handhaven tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de aardbeving op de Molukken

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about the humanitarian situation after the earthquake and aftershocks on the Moluccas, and whether Indonesia had requested international aid. The minister answered that Indonesia made no international aid request, that local authorities lead relief, and that the Netherlands supports EU satellite mapping and standing humanitarian channels if requested.
However, he confirmed to me that the Indonesian provincial and local governments have themselves taken up the relief efforts, together with local organisations.
Wel heb ik van hem bevestigd gekregen dat de Indonesische provinciale en lokale overheden zelf de hulpverlening ter hand hebben genomen, samen met lokale organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de onzekerheid bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

MP Van den Hul asked the minister whether the public broadcaster NPO can absorb falling advertising revenue without harming makers and programming, and about the basis for the proposed savings on support activities. The minister answered that the NPO and broadcasters must make structural savings, that the government gave a one-off extra budget this year, and that he will request options and report to parliament in the first quarter of 2020.
I will ask the NPO and the College of Broadcasters to inform me about this in the first quarter of 2020.
Ik zal de NPO en het College van Omroepen vragen om in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over “schoolboeken en ander lesmateriaal waarin veel minder vrouwen dan mannen staan en relatief weinig personages met een niet-westerse naam”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would pursue publishers over gender and ethnic underrepresentation and stereotyping found in school textbooks, and whether publishers should act more decisively. The ministers replied that content of teaching materials is for schools to judge given freedom of education, that publishers voluntarily cooperated with the Leiden research and will discuss findings with authors, and that the government will not assess teaching materials.
Given freedom of education and expression, the autonomy of schools and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het uitvallen van studenten aan de lerarenopleiding

MP Van den Hul asks the Education Minister about high dropout among teacher-training students, citing a Parool report, and whether this worsens the teacher shortage and what the government will do. The minister confirms higher dropout in second-degree teacher training, lists causes such as extra work in schools and later-life career choices, announces a practice-oriented action research project with the institutions, and says the shortage projections already account for past dropout trends.
Based on the discussions, and with the agreement and cooperation of all institutions, we are now preparing a study together with the second-degree teacher training institutions.
Op grond van de gesprekken, en met instemming en medewerking van alle opleidingen, bereiden we nu samen met de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen een onderzoek voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht over de peperdure opleiding die het mensen moeilijk maakt om voor de klas te gaan staan (Omroep Brabant, 13 november 2019)

An MP asks the education minister how she views a case where a former healthcare worker starting a second-degree teacher training faces high tuition fees, and whether tailored solutions can be created given the teacher shortage. The minister acknowledges the problem but points to existing routes (zij-instroom, school subsidies) and says tailored arrangements are already possible, without committing to new measures.
As far as can be gathered from the report, the person in question does not seem to have secured an appointment as a teacher/zij-instromer, and is therefore looking for an alternative training option.

Voor zover op te maken uit het bericht, lijkt het echter alsof de betreffende persoon geen aanstelling als leraar/zij-instromer heeft weten te bemachtigen, en daarom een alternatieve opleidingsmogelijkheid zoekt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Diks, Bouali en Van de Hul over de moord op de Braziliaanse activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara

Four MPs asked the government about the murder of Brazilian indigenous activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara, whether Brazil's environment and indigenous rights are deteriorating under Bolsonaro, and what concrete action the Netherlands will take. The government said illegal loggers likely were involved but could not confirm it, said violence against indigenous people appears to have grown, and outlined diplomatic dialogue, EU-Mercosur review and support for rights defenders without committing to a new concrete measure.
It seems very likely that illegally operating loggers were involved in his death, although we cannot confirm that.
Het lijkt zeer waarschijnlijk dat illegaal opererende houthakkers betrokken waren bij zijn dood, hoewel wij dat niet kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verwoesting van de Amazone in Brazilië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the destruction of the Amazon under President Bolsonaro, including the role of Dutch and EU trade and whether Dutch companies are linked to deforestation. The minister answered that the government pressures Brazil on enforcement and sustainability, expects Dutch firms to follow OECD guidelines without active supervision of Amazon-specific links, and will assess the Mercosur deal once impact studies are available.
Active supervision of the application of the guidelines by Dutch companies, and specifically regarding possible involvement in deforestation of the Amazon, is not provided for.
Actief toezicht op de toepassing van de richtlijnen door Nederlandse bedrijven, en specifiek met betrekking tot eventuele betrokkenheid bij ontbossing van de Amazone, is niet voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van den Hul over misstanden bij projecten mede gefinancierd door FMO

MPs Diks and Van den Hul asked the minister about alleged misconduct in FMO-cofinanced projects, including inadequate due diligence on the Feronia land titles, the murder of activist Imbangola Lunea, weak complaint procedures, and unpaid or sub-living wages. The minister answered that FMO's due diligence and policies have been strengthened, that the Feronia land issue was handled by DEG and found acceptable at the time, that the Lunea investigation is complete with findings to follow, and that a new evaluation covering 2013-2018 is expected in Q2 2020.
In the case of serious incidents, the cabinet presses for independent investigation.
In het geval van ernstige incidenten dringt het kabinet aan op onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Ploumen en Van den Hul over de rechten van LHBTI-gemeenschap en persvrijheid in Polen

MPs Asscher, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about anti-LGBTI rhetoric by Poland's ruling PiS party, local 'LGBT-free' declarations, and press freedom in Poland. The minister acknowledged concern about the rhetoric, noted the gap between campaign rhetoric and concrete policy, and described Dutch diplomatic engagement and support for Polish civil society, while saying the press remains diverse and Poland's rule-of-law developments are monitored.

The cabinet follows developments in Poland that could affect this diversity and includes them in concerns Netherlands already actively raises bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally about the rule of law.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in Polen die deze diversiteit kunnen raken en betrekt die bij zorgen die Nederland nu al actief uit in bilateraal, EU- en multilateraal verband over de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het slechter presteren van kinderen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister about a survey claiming teacher shortages cause children to perform worse, and about measures, pay and oversight. The minister said the inspectorate has no data confirming a direct link, pointed to pay rises and regional measures, and promised a letter on teacher policy in December.
The inspectorate, however, has no research data confirming a direct link between the teacher shortage and vocabulary, Cito scores and school recommendations.
De inspectie heeft echter geen onderzoeksgegevens die een direct verband tussen het lerarentekort en woordenschat, cito-scores en schooladviezen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van het aantal kinderen dat in een crisisopvang woont

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the government about the rising number of children living in crisis shelters, including whether gezinnen should get priority for housing and whether the issue will be addressed in an upcoming homelessness action plan. The minister answered that children should not grow up in shelters, that no recent data exists so a study will be commissioned, that housing allocation is a municipal responsibility, and that a homelessness action plan is being prepared.
There are no recent substantiated figures on the number of children currently living in women's or social shelters.
Er zijn geen recente onderbouwde cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat momenteel in de vrouwen- of maatschappelijke opvang woont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Oeganda komt opnieuw met wet voor doodstraf homoseksualiteit’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch ministers whether they condemn Ugandan statements and the reported new bill on the death penalty for homosexuality, and what Dutch action is taken. The government condemns the statements, says Uganda's foreign minister assured EU ambassadors no such bill is planned, and describes Dutch LGBTI rights support without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het speciaal onderwijs dat de massale toestroom van leerlingen niet aankan

An MP asked the education minister about waiting lists at special schools reported by LECSO, the number of children affected, whether teacher shortages and school referrals are to blame, and what will be done about staffing. The minister said no national data exist on waiting-list numbers or consequences, attributed the causes to a mix of factors, and committed to a meeting with LECSO and to measures under the teacher-shortage approach.
No national information is kept on this, as you know.
Hierover wordt, zoals bij u bekend, geen landelijke informatie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over seksuele intimidatie op de werkvloer bij universiteiten

The MP asks whether universities adequately handle sexual and scientific harassment complaints, whether they will engage with university boards, and whether a national independent body or better data is needed. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to VSNU statements, ongoing university measures, an ombudsperson pilot with evaluation in December, and talks with KNAW and LNVH, but declines to commit to a national institute.
I am already in discussion with the VSNU about this.
Ik ben hierover al in gesprek met de VSNU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een racistische uiting bij de Universiteit Leiden

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a racist slogan written at Leiden University, whether the university imposed real consequences, why such incidents recur, and whether she would make a public statement or discuss the issue with the university. The minister said the university held talks, a student apologised, participants were required to take a training programme, and no further talks were needed.
I see no reason to enter into further discussion.
Ik zie geen reden om nader in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya , van den Hul, Ouwehand en Diks over de bosbranden in het Amazonewoud en het Mercosur-verdrag

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdA-adjacent PvdD and GroenLinks asked whether the Netherlands would side with France and Ireland in opposing ratification of the EU-Mercosur agreement while Amazon fires continue, and whether it would support G7 aid for the Amazon. The minister replied that the government will take a position only once all texts and the Sustainability Impact Assessment are available, expected late 2019, with the Commission expecting a Council decision no earlier than November 2020, and that it will press Brazil bilaterally and within the EU on sustainable forest policy and will report separately on a possible Dutch contribution.
The cabinet will take a position once all necessary texts on the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement are available.
Kabinet zal een standpunt innemen als alle daarvoor noodzakelijke teksten over het EU-Mercosur-Associatieverdrag beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat transgenderzorg wordt belemmerd door een monopolie

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about reports that a monopoly position of Amsterdam UMC hinders transgender care and about waiting times exceeding two years. The minister acknowledges the waiting times, points to a care coordinator's efforts to reduce them and expand capacity, and says he sees no evidence of deliberate discouragement by Amsterdam UMC.
I agree that everyone in the Netherlands is entitled, within the existing norms, to the care included in the basic package of the Health Insurance Act.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat iedereen in Nederland binnen de daarvoor bestaande normen recht heeft op de zorg die in het basispakket van de Zorgverzekeringswet zit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het stagnerende aantal vrouwen in adviescolleges van het Rijk

An MP asked the ministers why the number of women and people with a migration background in government advisory councils is stagnating, why the statutory goal of balanced representation has not been reached since 1997, and whether a binding quota should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the government will respond substantively to the Court of Audit report on diversity in advisory councils, taking these questions into account, likely only after the cabinet response to the SER advice on diversity at the top.

As the Minister of the Interior promised your House during the committee meeting of 3 July on the functioning of the civil service, I, as the minister responsible for the Framework Act on advisory councils, will respond substantively on behalf of the cabinet to that report.

Zoals de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het algemeen overleg van 3 juli jl. over het functioneren van de Rijksdienst aan uw Kamer heeft toegezegd, zal ik, als verantwoordelijke voor de Kaderwet adviescolleges, namens het kabinet inhoudelijk reageren op dat rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over absurde uitzendtarieven in het onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about excessive temp-agency rates in education, how much school staffing money goes to agencies, and whether the government will ban such agencies or engage the sector. The minister says the spending is undesirable, DUO is piloting better data on non-employed staff, schools are making collective agreements, and a ban on high rates is not possible since agencies set their own tariffs.
I do not know the exact spending on temp agencies in primary education.
De exacte uitgaven aan uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs ken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het schenden van mensenrechten door een Nederlands bedrijf bij de sloop van een schip

An MP asked the minister whether a Dutch company, SBM Offshore, breached OECD guidelines and human rights in a ship-breaking project in India, and whether the government would act and suspend its support. The minister said the company was engaged in talks and internal review, that the OECD National Contact Point is the proper channel, that no government funding was involved in the India project, and that the company is not currently applying for trade missions.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs itself cannot investigate working conditions abroad.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan zelf geen onderzoek doen naar arbeidsomstandigheden in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de wachtlijsten bij het speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about waiting lists in special primary and secondary education, teacher shortages, and whether these teachers should fall under the secondary-education collective agreement. The minister said no waiting-list data exists but will explore collecting it, gave enrolment trends, outlined teacher-shortage measures, and costed moving teachers to the secondary cao.
No information is available on the number of pupils on a waiting list for special primary education (sbo) and (secondary) special education (v)so.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar van het aantal leerlingen dat op een wachtlijst voor het speciaal basis onderwijs (sbo) en (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs (v)so staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den  Hul en Asscher over extra geld voor leraren dat mogelijk slechts de loonbijstelling betreft

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked whether the 285 million euro for teachers announced by the minister is merely the regular wage adjustment rather than new money, and how the government will address teacher shortages, school closures and the primary-education salary gap. The minister confirmed the funds are available and that solving the shortage needs a broad, shared effort, offering incidental extra money for 2020 only if social partners quickly conclude a collective agreement using the existing 285 million.
It is up to employers and employees to make agreements about this money.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om afspraken te maken over dit geld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Kwint over de subsidiepot voor zijinstroom in het onderwijs

MPs asked why the subsidy pot for career changers (zij-instroom) in education hit its ceiling for a second year, why DUO sent letters saying applications were on hold, and whether the scheme should become open-ended. The minister says the ceiling has been raised, unfunded applications will be reallocated after the October deadline, the letter wording will be corrected, and budgets will be monitored and reset annually.
The content of the letter will be adjusted.
De inhoud van de brief wordt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over onvoldoende draagvlak voor het verduurzamen van goud

An MP asked the trade and development minister why Dutch gold industry lacks support for fairtrade gold certification and what the government's role is. The minister answered that the gold agreement contains no commitments on fairtrade, that the government regards the withdrawal of the label as regrettable, and that she will ask the steering group to discuss it with Max Havelaar.
Therefore I will ask the steering group of the gold agreement to discuss this with Stichting Max Havelaar.
Daarom zal ik de stuurgroep van het goudconvenant vragen hierover in gesprek te gaan met Stichting Max Havelaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over een  slachtoffer van homofobe bedreigingen dat  zelf de dader moest opsporen

MPs asked the Justice Minister how police could ignore long-running homophobic threats even after the victim supplied the offender's details, and what policy will raise reporting and prosecution of discrimination and strengthen the Roze in Blauw network and LHBTI training. The minister agreed the case should have been handled more carefully, said he cannot comment on individual cases, and listed an action plan, a WODC study on hate crime, and planned police training measures.
I am of the view that this case should have been handled more carefully; the police share this view.
Ik ben van mening dat deze zaak zorgvuldiger had moeten worden behandeld, de politie deelt deze mening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het wegpesten van een transgenderstel in Heerlen
