MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government whether local authorities and police have enough tools to stop harassment of LGBTI people, as in the Heerlen case of a transgender couple who moved out, and whether further action or consultation is planned. The minister answered that existing tools are sufficient, that Heerlen used a range of measures including an area ban, and that no additional instruments or consultation are needed, while pointing to the existing Action Plan.
Yes, local administrators and police have sufficient powers to address and tackle persons who harass LGBTI people to the point of driving them out.
Ja, de lokale bestuurders en politie beschikken over voldoende mogelijkheden om personen, die LHBTI's lastig vallen tot wegpesten aan toe, aan te spreken en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van den Hul over sancties tegen bedrijven die gelieerd zijn aan het militaire regime in Myanmar

An MP asked whether Dutch companies such as Shell, linked to Max Energy Myanmar, could be sanctioned for ties to the Myanmar military and the Rakhine atrocities, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the government backs targeted sanctions against responsible individuals, will examine the UN fact-finding report, will raise Shell's exposure with the company, and that no Dutch public money went to Max Energy Myanmar.
Companies are not obliged to report to the Dutch government in which countries and with which parties they do business.
Bedrijven zijn niet verplicht om bij de Nederlandse overheid te melden in welk land en met welke partijen zij zakendoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een verboden lhbti-manifestatie op de Westoever

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed that the Palestinian police banning an LGBTI event on the West Bank and calling on citizens to report activists of Al-Qaws was unacceptable, and whether he would raise concerns with the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that the police statement had been withdrawn, that the Netherlands urges the PA to respect freedoms of expression and assembly and has raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister, and has expressed support to Al-Qaws.
The Dutch representative in Ramallah immediately raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister.
De Nederlandse vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah heeft de zaak terstond opgebracht bij de PA, waaronder de premier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de ontbossing van het Braziliaanse Amazonegebied

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they share concern over rising Amazon deforestation under Bolsonaro, whether the Netherlands has raised it, and whether Germany's suspension of environmental aid should be matched. The government says it shares the concern, has raised deforestation with Brazil through several channels, will keep doing so, but declines to match Germany's aid suspension and is still deliberating on further steps.
The Netherlands expresses its concern about the increasing deforestation at every suitable opportunity, both when it is in the news and when it is not.
Nederland uit bij alle in aanmerking komende gelegenheden zijn zorgen over de toenemende ontbossing, zowel wanneer dit in het nieuws is, als wanneer dit niet in het nieuws is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over interne chaos bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

An MP asked the minister about internal turmoil at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including staff distrust, high turnover, the departure of the director and chair, suspension of a board member, and the chair's severance arrangement. The minister answered that the body is not leaderless, that interim measures keep routine operations running, that a new chair is expected soon, and that the severance rules and the suspended member's dismissal were justified, though the framework will be revised.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is in a phase requiring extra attention due to several causes.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: Commissariaat) verkeert door verschillende oorzaken in een fase die extra aandacht vergt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Diks over het door de Chinese autoriteiten oppakken van activist(en) die zich onder meer inzetten voor hiv-/aidspatiënten

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Diks asked the ministers whether they would seek clarity on the charge against Chinese NGO workers detained for alleged subversion, and how this relates to China's UNAIDS chairmanship. The ministers answered that the embassy follows the case, raises it through the EU and the bilateral human rights dialogue, and that the chair is performing correctly, while concerns about NGO pressure will continue to be raised.
Concerns about individual cases, such as the arrest of Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze and Xiao Wu, are raised through the bilateral human rights dialogue or in meetings of the UN Human Rights Council.

Zorgen over individuele gevallen, zoals de arrestatie van Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze en Xiao Wu, worden via de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog overgebracht of in vergaderingen van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over de grote klappen voor de werkgelegenheid in Groningen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the ministers about reported job losses in Groningen (about 180 jobs at the RUG) and healthcare access caused by the revised higher-education funding model. The minister answered that there is no forced internal reallocation, that RUG funding changes are small (0.0% in 2020-2021, -1.1% in 2022, -0.9% in 2023), that healthcare access is unaffected, and that the government is committed to Groningen's employment and liveability.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to allocate the government contribution internally.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling om de rijksbijdrage intern te verdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de leegloop van oudere leraren in het onderwijs en de effecten op het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister about older teachers leaving early and its effect on teacher shortages, citing a survey that half of older teachers want to stop sooner due to workload. The Minister said forecasts are unchanged, pointed to workload measures and a planned legal requirement for strategic personnel policy, and declined to commit to a teacher retention bonus, leaving it to the sector.
I trust that in most situations a solution can be found, but the teacher shortage remains a concern.
Ik vertrouw erop dat het in de meeste situaties lukt om een oplossing te vinden, maar het lerarentekort blijft zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de start van het nieuwe schooljaar van basisscholen en scholen voor voortgezet speciaal onderwijs met  meer vacatures dan vorig jaar

An MP asked the minister about teacher vacancies at the start of the school year, the teacher shortage projections, its effect on educational inequality, the salary gap between sectors, and when a national registration of the shortage will be available. The minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to existing support measures and promised to report on the registration in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform the House of the outcome.
In het najaar informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het  toenemend aantal basisschoolleerlingen dat  bijlessen volgt als gevolg  van het  lerarentekort

An MP asked whether the rise in primary pupils taking private tutoring is caused by teacher shortages, and when results on measuring the shortage would be shared. The minister said a study on tutoring motives is under way with results due in September, that the shortage is not a stated motive in earlier research, and that the registration of the shortage will be reported in autumn.
At present I am having in-depth research carried out into the scope of supplementary education provision and parents' motives for choosing it.
Op dit moment laat ik verdiepend onderzoek uitvoeren naar de omvang van het aanbod van aanvullend onderwijs en de motieven van ouders om voor aanvullend onderwijs te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council  of Europe’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether Hungary's treatment of asylum seekers, reported as food deprivation, also breaches international law such as the Refugee Convention, whether this has been raised in other fora, and whether Hungary has a duty of care and what aid options exist. The government answered that parts of Hungarian asylum policy conflict with international obligations, that the Commission has started infringement procedures and the Article 7 process covers fundamental rights, that it will keep raising concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that it awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before further steps, with no specific aid discussed in the Council of Europe.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before taking any new steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van de inbreukprocedures af alvorens nieuwe stappen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over leefbaar loon in de kledingindustrie

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Schone Kleren Campagne finding that major fashion brands cannot show their workers earn a living wage, whether the government is pushing living wages in producing countries, whether living wages are enforceable under the textile covenant, and how garment prices would be affected. The minister acknowledged the problem, described cooperation with the ILO and other partners and the textile covenant's living wage goal for 2020 with monitoring and a complaints mechanism, said the covenant evaluation will inform possible further measures, and noted that a living wage need not raise retail prices significantly.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no reason to change the course of its policy.
Het kabinet ziet daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om de koers van haar beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een verdienmodel van een uitzendbureau met een wurgcontract voor docenten

An MP asked the minister about a staffing agency contract that reportedly blocks schools from hiring a teacher directly for about half to a full year unless a buyout fee of about 8,000 euros is paid, and what this means for the teaching profession. The minister called such practices undesirable, said school boards are responsible for hiring and that parties should know the conditions in advance, but did not commit to a concrete intervention.
School boards are responsible for appointing sufficient staff to deliver education.
Schoolbesturen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van voldoende personeel om het onderwijs vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het inzichtelijk maken van (de gevolgen van) het lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister whether schools should be required to report the effects of the teacher shortage to the inspectorate, and how the government guarantees every child receives good teaching every day, including whether it tracks students sent home or missing subjects. The minister said he opposed mandatory registration, that a parliamentary motion to register the shortage is now adopted and will be implemented, that the inspectorate intervenes case by case, and largely referred the registration questions to the answer to question 1 without giving a concrete overview.
Meanwhile, your motion, together with Mr Kwint and Ms Westerveld, on registration of the teacher shortage by OCW has been adopted. I will therefore look into how to implement it in the coming period.
Inmiddels is de motie van u, de heer Kwint en mevrouw Westerveld over registratie van het lerarentekort door OCW aangenomen. Ik ga daarom de komende tijd kijken hoe ik hier uitvoering aan kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over achtergehouden informatie van mogelijke fouten met examens

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that a school's exam results were delayed and whether parents and pupils had been kept uninformed, and whether the minister would contact the school. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Inspectorate handles contact with the school, acknowledged the need for transparency and the confusion caused, and promised to keep parliament informed.
As I promised in my letter of 14 June, I will also keep your House informed of the state of affairs.
Zoals ik heb toegezegd in mijn brief van 14 juni zal ik ook uw Kamer op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over problemen door het krimpend frequentiespectrum

MPs Moorlag and Van den Hul asked whether the government knows that shrinking radio spectrum, from 4G/5G expansion and the loss of the 700 MHz band for PMSE users from 2020, will harm media production, events and public broadcasting, and whether promised support for PMSE was delivered. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, described coordination measures, a joint action plan with the sector, alternative frequency bands and a licensed shared access pilot, while stating that the consequences are being managed in ongoing consultation.
On possible consequences and solutions, my ministry and Agentschap Telecom are in ongoing consultation with the sector.
Over mogelijke gevolgen en oplossingen zijn mijn ministerie en Agentschap Telecom in voortdurend overleg met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over hartinfarcten die voor vrouwen bijna dubbel zo vaak fataal zijn dan voor mannen

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister whether women's heart attacks and cardiac arrests are more often fatal than men's, and what measures are taken on reanimation, symptom recognition and research funding. The minister disputed the framing, attributed the poorer survival to cardiac-arrest rhythm differences, and listed existing campaigns, guidelines and research programmes, without committing to new measures.
A cardiac arrest in women is also less quickly recognised because the symptoms are less clear.
Ook wordt een hartstilstand bij vrouwen minder snel herkend omdat de symptomen minder duidelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Nigerian fishers hit by criminals, imports and climate change’

An MP asked the government about reports of Nigerian fishers being hit by criminals, imports and climate change, including whether the Netherlands or the EU has fisheries agreements with Nigeria or Sao Tome and Principe, the scale of Dutch fish exports to Nigeria, the consequences of possibly illegal overfishing, and whether a Dutch company owns a Nigerian shrimping venture. The minister answered that there is no Dutch or EU fisheries agreement with Nigeria, gave details of the Sao Tome protocol and export figures, and confirmed a joint venture by Cornelis Vrolijk without committing to any new action.
The company Atlantic Shrimpers is a joint venture of the Dutch company Cornelis Vrolijk.
Het bedrijf Atlantic Shrimpers is een joint venture van het Nederlandse bedrijf Cornelis Vrolijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council of Europe’

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the ministers whether the government was aware of, and shocked by, the Council of Europe Commissioner's report on Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food, and whether it had raised this with Hungary or the EU. The government answered that it knows the report, shares the concerns, raises them bilaterally and in the EU, notes Commission infringement procedures, and supports a formal Article 7 dialogue with Hungary.
The cabinet will continue to raise the concerns both bilaterally and at European level with the Hungarian authorities.
Het kabinet blijft de zorgen in zowel bilateraal als Europees verband uitspreken richting de Hongaarse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over schokkende verschillen tussen de schooladviezen die Friese kinderen in groep 8 krijgen

An MP asked the minister about large regional differences in secondary school advice given to Frisian pupils in group 8, with pupils in some northeastern municipalities scoring above their advice. The minister acknowledged the regional pattern of under-advice, said it is a concern, and referred to a forthcoming separate evaluation letter for measures.
I consider this a worrying development.
Ik vind dit een zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat de doorstroming vanuit de vrouwenopvang naar huurwoningen problematisch verloopt

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked about reports that women leaving shelters struggle to move into rental housing, and about the Ombudsman's findings on shelter bottlenecks and clawed-back rent allowance. The Minister acknowledges local housing shortages, points to existing priority rules for shelter residents and to ongoing working groups and a commitment to inform parliament, while stating there is no national picture of shelter place shortages and that municipalities are responsible.
There is no national picture of the (possible) shortages of shelter places in women's shelters.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van de (eventuele) tekorten aan opvangplekken in de vrouwenopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de gesprekken met de onderwijssector over het oplossen van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister about the government's talks with education sector partners on the teacher shortage, including the AOb union's withdrawal from national consultation and its threatened action over the spring budget. The Minister answered that the shortage is a top priority, that a multi-line plan is being pursued with other partners, and that a regional approach is being supported, but declined to meet the AOb bilaterally before the spring memorandum was sent to parliament.
As long as it has not been sent to the House, members of the cabinet do not enter into discussions about the spring memorandum.
Zolang deze niet naar de Kamer is gestuurd, gaan leden van het kabinet niet in gesprek over de voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de financiële gevolgen voor de Rijksbegroting van de ingetrokken wetswijziging van de rentemaatstaf voor de lening hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the budget consequences of withdrawing the interest-rate change for student loans, which would cost the state up to 226 million euro a year by 2060, and whether the cut would worsen education funding. The minister confirmed the lost interest income, said the treatment of the shortfall will be decided in the August budget process and reported to parliament on Budget Day, and declined to anticipate that decision.
How the lost income resulting from not changing the interest-rate benchmark will be handled is being considered in the August budget decision-making.
De wijze waarop wordt omgegaan met de gederfde inkomsten als gevolg van het niet wijzigen van de rentemaatstaf wordt in de augustusbesluitvorming bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leerlingen op basisscholen in achterstandswijken die massaal kampen met problemen bij taal en leren, concentratieproblemen en ouders die hun kinderen vaak niet kunnen helpe

An MP asked the minister whether a survey finding that most teachers in deprived neighbourhoods see language and concentration problems among pupils is accurate, what this means for equal opportunity, and what consequences follow. The minister said the survey's figures are hard to verify, that neighbourhood characteristics are not a significant predictor beyond family factors, and pointed to existing disadvantage funding, the Gelijke Kansen Alliantie and a planned programme, without committing to new measures.
The exact figures mentioned in the research are not known to me in such detail, and they are also difficult to verify.
De exacte cijfers die in het onderzoek worden genoemd zijn mij niet zodanig bekend en deze zijn ook lastig te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de VS een steeds steviger abortusbeleid voert

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about reports that the US is tightening anti-abortion funding rules abroad, asking for the government's reaction, diplomatic steps, and ways to offset the effects. The minister said the government regrets the measures, has raised concerns with US officials, and points to continued SRGR funding and several parliamentary amendments being implemented.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht ‘UNHCR evacueert honderden vluchtelingen uit kamp bij Tripoli’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNHCR evacuating hundreds of refugees from a camp near Tripoli, including the dangers in Libyan detention centres, Amnesty's call for an investigation into injuries to migrants, and whether Italy's EU request was received. The minister referred back to earlier answers on several points, expressed regret about the incident at Qasr Ben Ghasir and stressed the need for accountability, and said the government follows the situation closely without committing to a new concrete step.
I refer you to the answers given to your House's questions to the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Foreign Affairs on 23 April.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de beantwoording van gestelde vragen door uw Kamer aan de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken op 23 april jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kwint en Westerveld over examens van 38 eindexamenleerlingen van de Duin en Kruidbergmavo uit Driehuis aangetekend op weg waren naar de tweede correctie, maar niet op de plaat

MPs asked why exam scripts sent by registered post to second correctors went missing again, questioning the reliability of postal transport and the fairness to pupils who must retake exams. The minister said schools are responsible for dispatch under the protocol, that such losses are rare (six cases this year, mostly theft), that retakes are unnecessary once scores are established, and that scanning and emailing scripts carries fraud and hacking risks.
As a rule, sending exam work by registered post is reliable.
In de regel is verzending van het examenwerk per aangetekende post betrouwbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de te lange wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about long waiting lists in gender-affirming care, including Amsterdam UMC's waiting times, staffing shortages, a planned Radboud UMC youth service, and a priority scheme for trans youth. The minister acknowledged the waits are undesirable, pointed to a navigator (kwartiermaker) advisory process and capacity expansions, and left prioritisation largely to insurers and providers.
I too find the long waiting lists for gender-affirming care undesirable.
Ook ik vind de lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over instellingen voor hoger onderwijs die tentamens zonder meer door laten gaan op de dag van de openbaar vervoersstaking

MP Van den Hul asks whether students can reach exams held on the public transport strike day and what the minister will do about institutions that keep exams going regardless. The minister says it is up to institutions to decide, expects them to show coulance for students in genuine overmacht, and says she expects institutions to seek individual solutions with affected students.
It is up to universities of applied sciences and universities to decide whether they continue lessons and exams in connection with the public transport strike.
Het is aan hogescholen en universiteiten om te bepalen of zij in verband met de openbaar vervoerstaking lessen en tentamens al dan niet doorgang laten vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Voordewind over het bericht ‘De jezidi’s zijn hun familie en cultuur kwijt’

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Yazidi women and children remain missing or enslaved, the role of Yazidi support organisations, Syrian regime action, aid withdrawal from Duhok and psychosocial programmes. The ministers answered that about 3,083 Yazidis were still held or missing as of late 2018, outlined existing Dutch and EU support, and committed to no new concrete steps beyond ongoing programmes and an October 2019 conference.
The Netherlands has no diplomatic relations with the Assad regime and the cabinet has no independent information on regime actions to free possibly enslaved Yazidis.
Nederland onderhoudt geen diplomatieke betrekkingen met het Assad-regime en het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over regime-acties om mogelijke tot slaaf gemaakte jezidi’s te bevrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Mozambique: Cyclone Victims Forced to Trade Sex for Food’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that cyclone victims in Mozambique were forced to trade sex for food, with local leaders abusing their power over aid distribution, and asked about protection, UN oversight and gender participation in distribution. The minister answered that the abuse is unacceptable, that the embassy and UN raised it with Mozambican authorities, that the UN tightened PSEA rules, and that the ambassador will raise it bilaterally and revisit the affected regions.
Abuse by local community leaders of their position of power in food distribution is wholly unacceptable.
Misbruik door lokale gemeenschapsleiders van hun machtspositie bij voedseldistributie is volstrekt onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bowing to U.S. demands, UN waters down resolution on sexual violence in conflict’

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about reports that the UN Security Council watered down a resolution on sexual violence in conflict under US veto pressure, including the removal of sexual and reproductive health language and the weakened reference to the ICC. The government said it regrets the US threat, supports reproductive health language and the French position, sees no direct consequences for victim assistance or UNFPA funding, and explained the ICC reference change as a compromise.
The Netherlands explicitly spoke out for sexual and reproductive health and rights during its intervention in the open debate.
Nederland heeft zich tijdens de interventie in het open debat expliciet uitgesproken voor seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over een breed plan voor technisch onderwijs dat volgens ondernemersorganisatie Techniek Nederland nu nodig is

Two PvdA MPs asked the education and economic affairs ministers how they view Techniek Nederland's call for a broad technical education plan, including hybrid teachers and hybrid programmes. The minister acknowledged the need for technical skills, said youth unemployment is low, welcomed hybrid teaching in principle, referred to existing measures and the Techniekpact, and said the ministry would keep talking with industry without committing to adopt the proposals.
This cabinet therefore considers it important to support schools by improving the transitions between primary education, secondary education, secondary vocational education and higher education.

Dit kabinet vindt het dan ook van belang om scholen te ondersteunen door het verbeteren van de overgangen tussen primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Bangladesh: Rohingya Refugee Students Expelled'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Bangladesh bars Rohingya refugee children from formal education and aid groups struggle to provide schooling. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government raises access to education with Bangladesh and donors, and pointed to Dutch funding for Education Cannot Wait.
I raised the lack of access to education with the authorities and asked them to be more open to solutions that offer Rohingya children the necessary education.
Ik heb het gebrek aan toegang tot onderwijs aan de orde gesteld en de autoriteiten gevraagd meer open te staan voor oplossingen die Rohingya-kinderen noodzakelijk onderwijs bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over geweld tegen vrouwen in Vietnamese textielfabrieken

An MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about a Fair Wear Foundation and Care study finding that 43% of female garment workers in Vietnam faced violence or intimidation at work, and whether Dutch brands sourcing from such factories could be identified and held responsible. The minister acknowledged the problem, said brands should investigate their own sourcing practices and that the textile convenant and union cooperation are the channels for improvement, but gave no factory or brand identification.
The cabinet will soon inform the House of the Dutch position on the proposed convention.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer binnenkort informeren over de Nederlandse opstelling ten aanzien van de voorgestelde conventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over doodstraf voor homo’s in Brunei

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the Syariah Penal Code phases 2 and 3 in Brunei, including death by stoning, would take effect and what Dutch and international pressure could prevent this. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns, issued statements and pressed Brunei, that a moratorium on the death penalty was announced, and that Dutch support for civil society and LGBTI rights continues.
The cabinet has taken note with great concern of Brunei's decision to introduce phases 2 and 3 of the Syariah Penal Code.
Het kabinet heeft met veel zorg kennisgenomen van het besluit van Brunei om fase 2 en 3 van de Syariah Penal Code in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Karabulut over vervolging van de Palestijnse mensenrechtenverdediger Issa Amro

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the government about prosecutions of Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian and Israeli authorities, including criticism of Amnesty and Front Line Defenders reports and whether the EU and the Netherlands support him. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concern over shrinking civic space, urges both authorities to respect free expression and drop charges covered by that right, and that the EU and member states have attended hearings, with the next hearing set for 22 May.
The EU and the Netherlands both follow the two legal cases against Amro closely, including by attending hearings.
De EU en Nederland volgen beide rechtszaken tegen Amro nauwgezet, onder andere door het bijwonen van hoorzittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over scholen die hun eigen regels voor aantallen toetsen op één dag aan hun laars lappen

An MP asked the minister about schools exceeding their own limits on the number of tests per day, and about student stress and how students can enforce school rules. The minister said schools must set test limits in their student statutes, that schools should monitor compliance, and that students can complain via student councils, the works council, or LAKS, but gave no concrete new measure.
I am not familiar in detail with the situation the student describes in NOS Stories.
Ik ken de situatie waarover de leerling in de NOS Stories spreekt niet in detail.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Niger, part 1: At the centre of a brewing militant storm’

Two Dutch MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising displacement, violence and instability in Niger's Tillabéri and Tahoua regions and the Dutch response. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, is supporting UNHCR and Niger with EUR 100 million for 2019–2022, and is focusing on stability, youth and governance, without any institutional or oversight change.
The Netherlands supports UNHCR with an unearmarked contribution of EUR 33 million.
Nederland steunt UNHCR met een ongeoormerkte bijdrage van EUR 33 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Gitarist en oud-student UvA zucht in Egyptische cel'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Rami Sidky, a former University of Amsterdam student held in Egypt, including contacts with Egyptian authorities, the grounds for his pre-trial detention and whether the Netherlands will press for his release. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case with Egypt and requested the grounds for detention, but declined to demand immediate release, citing Egyptian sovereignty.
Egypt is a sovereign state with its own judiciary in which the Netherlands cannot interfere.
Egypte is een soevereine staat met een eigen rechtspraak waar Nederland zich niet in kan mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether the government would refuse entry to a preacher whose statements about LGBTI people and the Holocaust they condemned, and what legal powers exist to deny or expel him. The Secretary of State answered that hate speech has no place in the Dutch rule of law, referred to the earlier integrated approach to extremist speakers and the LGBTI safety action plan, and stated that measures have been taken to prevent the person's entry into the Schengen zone.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het voortbestaan van het Bangladesh Akkoord voor veilige textielfabrieken

An MP asked the minister whether the Bangladesh Accord on factory fire and building safety could keep operating after its funds were blocked, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister replied that a payment had been received and the problem was resolved, that building safety remains a problem in other sectors, and that Dutch efforts continue, including a gradual handover to the Bangladeshi labour inspectorate.
The Netherlands is making every effort to keep the Accord operating effectively in Bangladesh for the time being.
Nederland spant zich maximaal in om het Akkoord voorlopig op effectieve wijze in Bangladesh te laten voortbestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over meldingen van bedreiging door journalisten

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked whether journalists find it hard to file complaints about threats and violence, and how many reports and complaints were made. The minister replied that a 2018 accord with police and prosecutors gives journalists priority protection, that complaints are indicatively counted at about 21 in 2018, and that the government will not comment on individual cases.
These figures are indicative, because the police do not record the victim's profession.
Deze cijfers zijn indicatief, omdat de politie het beroep van het slachtoffer niet registreert.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van lesbiennes, homoseksuelen, biseksuelen, transgenders en mensen met een intersekse-conditie (LHBTI’s) in Tsjetsjenië

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government what it has done since April 2018 to raise persecution, torture and killings of LGBTI people in Chechnya, including follow-up with Benedek, the Equal Rights Coalition, UN bodies and the question of quiet diplomacy. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue through the OSCE Vienna and Moscow mechanisms, the EU, the Human Rights Council and the Equal Rights Coalition, that violence has not structurally decreased, and that quiet diplomacy has no general criteria but depends on context.
The Netherlands regularly raises the gross human rights violations in Chechnya, including violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and intersex persons (LGBTI), with Russia in various ways.

Nederland brengt de grove mensenrechtenschendingen in Tsjetsjenië, waaronder het geweld tegen lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, trans en intersekse personen (LHBTI's), op diverse manieren regelmatig onder de aandacht bij Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mensenrechten in Iran gruwelijk geschonden’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating human rights situation in Iran, including executions, harsh crackdowns, the morality police and the appointment of Ebrahim Raisi as head of the judiciary. The minister answered that the government shares concerns, raises them multilaterally, bilaterally and through the EU, but does not comment on appointments in other countries.
The cabinet does not concern itself with appointments in other countries.
Het kabinet gaat niet over benoemingen in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verschillen in onderzoekstijd tussen vrouwelijke en mannelijke wetenschappers met kinderen

An MP asked the minister whether small gender gaps in research time and resources for academics with children, and a 3 percent lower chance of a private office for women, are a concern for representativeness in Dutch science and whether further research is needed. The minister shares the concern, points to planned actions such as a national action plan and a new approach to valuing academics, and says the existing LNVH study is sufficient without further research.
I do not consider further research necessary at this time.
Ik acht verder onderzoek op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over twee Groningse scholen voor speciaal onderwijs die zich door het lerarentekort gedwongen zien om over te gaan tot invoering van een vierdaagse lesweek

An MP asked the minister about two Groningen special-education schools that adopted four-day school weeks due to teacher shortages, and whether oversight is adequate. The minister confirmed the schools' four-day weeks, said the inspectorate monitors them under the handreiking and may request a plan of action, and called the situation worrying while stating that lesson loss must be prevented.
The inspectorate supervises regular primary education and (secondary) special education. There is no separate or more intensive supervision of special education.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op het regulier basisonderwijs en op het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs. Er is geen apart of intensiever toezicht op speciaal onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Kabinet komt afspraken hervestiging kwetsbare vluchtelingen niet meer na'

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about reports that the cabinet would not honour resettlement commitments for vulnerable refugees, including a shortfall of 610 against 750 selected in 2018 and whether this breaks agreements. The State Secretary answered that resettlement is voluntary, that the shortfall in 2018 will not be compensated, that the claimed backlog is based on a misreading of arrival versus selection figures, that UNHCR expressed concern, and that the national quota of 500 per year is maintained.
Resettlement is a humanitarian programme that countries carry out on a voluntary basis; it is not an obligation.
Hervestiging is een humanitair programma dat landen op vrijwillige basis uitvoeren, het betreft geen verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het opdoeken van groep 8 als gevolg van het lerarentekort in Leiden

An MP asked the minister about the closure of a group 8 class at a Leiden primary school due to teacher shortage, including the school's contact with the inspectorate, the impact on the 15 pupils and whether other classes were closed. The minister answered that the inspectorate is handling the case, that pupils were redistributed without missing lessons, and that the inspectorate monitors the solutions and reports the Haarlem case as the only comparable one.
I find the situation undesirable – especially because it concerns a group 8 – but it is for the inspectorate to assess the case substantively.
Ik vind de situatie onwenselijk – temeer omdat het hier een groep 8 betreft – maar het is aan de inspectie om de casus inhoudelijk te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over honderden miljoenen die volgens de SER Overijssel nodig zouden zijn om de klappen van de veranderende arbeidsmarkt voor mbo’ers op te vangen

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the ministers whether SER Overijssel's claims about job losses from digitalisation and the hundreds of millions needed to retrain mbo graduates are accurate. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that jobs both disappear and emerge, cannot confirm the 230 million euro estimate, and pointed to joint government-business efforts and a forthcoming Leven Lang Ontwikkelen letter.
The amount of 230 million euro that is mentioned is an estimate that I cannot confirm.
Het bedrag van 230 miljoen euro dat wordt genoemd is een schatting die ik niet kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het overhevelen van 150 miljoen euro van geesteswetenschappen naar technische universiteiten

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Van Rijn committee will advise moving 150 million euro from humanities to technical universities, and about the impact on staff workload and education quality. The minister answers that the committee's advice has not yet been received, a decision will follow by 21 June, the budget must stay neutral under the coalition agreement, and humanities are essential.
After receiving the committee's advice, I will decide which changes to the funding system will be implemented.
Na ontvangst van het advies van de commissie zal ik besluiten welke wijzigingen in de bekostigingssystematiek worden doorgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat een uitgezette asielzoeker in Bahrein levenslang kreeg

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the deteriorating human rights situation in Bahrain, and reports that a deported asylum seeker received a life sentence there, should change asylum policy toward Bahrainis and whether the discretionary power should have been used. State Secretary Harbers answered that the IND takes the worsened situation into account in individual asylum assessments, that refoulement is excluded where a real risk exists, and that the discretionary power was not applicable because protection law governs such cases.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Booking.com om aanbieden van bedden in Israëlische nederzettingen’

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the government whether Booking.com's listing of accommodations in Israeli settlements contributes to rights violations, whether the company meets the UN Guiding Principles, and what sanctions apply to misleading information. The government answered that businesses bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines, that the ACM supervises misleading-practice rules, and that Booking.com has committed to labelling settlement accommodations as 'Israeli settlement'.
It is up to companies themselves to decide which activities they undertake and to account for them.
Het is aan bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Recordaantal migranten: Griekenland bezwijkt opnieuw onder grote toestroom’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of record migrant arrivals in Greece, the CPT's criticism of camp conditions, and whether Europe should relocate people from the Greek islands. The State Secretary answered that the government urges Greece and the Commission for structural solutions via faster asylum and return procedures, rejects further transfers or relocations as a fix, and sees some improvements in Greek camp conditions.
More transfers to the mainland or new efforts to relocate asylum seekers from Greece do not contribute to that.
Meer transfers naar het vasteland of nieuwe inspanningen om asielzoekers vanuit Griekenland te herplaatsen, dragen daar niet aan bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het ontslag van textielarbeiders in Bangladesh

An MP asked the minister whether H&M and Zara suppliers in Bangladesh dismissed thousands of textile workers after protests, what buyers should do, and how the government responded to the protests and crackdown. The minister answered that H&M suppliers did dismiss workers while Zara's did not appear to, that buyers should seek reversal or compensation if dismissals were wrongful, that the embassy sought clarification on police and employer conduct, and that she hopes to meet her Bangladeshi counterpart.
The cabinet takes these signals seriously and has asked the government for clarification.
Het kabinet neemt deze signalen serieus en heeft opheldering gevraagd bij de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Duitse wetgeving ten aanzien van bindende ketenverantwoordelijkheid

An MP asked the minister about reported German draft legislation on mandatory supply-chain due diligence, whether the government knew of it, and what it means for Dutch firms and EU-level harmonisation. The minister said the draft was an internal German document not previously known to her, that the Netherlands prefers a harmonised European approach, and that Dutch firms are assessed against voluntary OECD guidelines with a 2023 target, without committing to new legislation.
The cabinet advocates a European approach to International Responsible Business Conduct (IRBC).
Het kabinet pleit voor een Europese aanpak voor Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen (IMVO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Bendes stropen Oeganda af om vrouwen genitaal te verminken'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about reports of female genital mutilation in eastern Uganda, its rising numbers, and the government's response with the Ugandan authorities, UNFPA, Equality Now, Reach and a trade mission. The ministers answered that the government takes the reports seriously, is engaged with Ugandan authorities, UNFPA and NGOs, and will brief trade mission participants on responsible business including eastern Uganda.
The cabinet takes the reporting, on the practice of genital mutilation as well as the cited numbers of girls and women, very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de berichtgeving, over de praktijk van genitale verminking maar ook over de genoemde aantallen meisjes en vrouwen, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de IND nauwelijks asielaanvragen van oorlogsvluchtelingen behandelt

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the IND rarely processes asylum applications from war refugees, whether this is deliberate deterrence, and what waiting times are. The State Secretary answered that war refugees are not a registered category, that priority goes to Dublin and safe-country cases, that waiting times are tracked only as processing times, and that extra staff are being recruited to shorten delays.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Bergkamp en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bestuurder reformatorische school tekende Nashville-verklaring’

MPs asked whether a board member of a reformed school signing the Nashville Statement, which denies LGBT identities, is acceptable and whether the government would act on school discrimination duties. The minister distanced the cabinet from the statement, said schools are assessed on citizenship and social safety duties, noted the hoger onderwijs discrimination rule does not apply to primary and secondary schools, and said the board was consulted and the school will keep working on an open climate.
The cabinet has distanced itself from the Nashville Statement.
Het kabinet heeft afstand genomen van de Nashville-verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van LHBTI’s in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they condemn the persecution, torture and killing of LGBTI people in Chechnya, how they will act toward Russia, and what diplomatic steps are taken. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, OSCE, Council of Europe and Equal Rights Coalition, and will bring it to the UN Human Rights Council, while keeping some diplomatic steps non-public.
For effective influence, the Netherlands and like-minded countries will also need to use quiet diplomacy, where it is crucial that steps are taken outside the public domain.
Ten behoeve van effectieve beïnvloeding zullen Nederland en gelijkgezinden ook gebruik moeten maken van stille diplomatie, waarbij het cruciaal is dat stappen worden gezet buiten het publieke domein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over bancaire investeringen in fossiele energie

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked whether banks should speed up green investment, how the government monitors fossil versus renewable financing, and whether a complaint was filed with the OECD National Contact Point over bank human rights concerns in oil and gas. The minister said DNB monitors financial sector exposure to CO2-intensive sectors, the sector committed to measuring and reporting CO2 emissions from 2020, no OECD complaint has been filed, and an oil and gas value chain analysis under the banking IMVO covenant is in preparation.
No, following the Eerlijke Bankwijzer research no complaint has been filed with the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Nee, er is naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer geen klacht ingediend bij het Nationaal Contact Punt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van decentrale selectie op de samenstelling van studentenpopulaties bij universitaire opleidingen

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she assesses the ResearchNed findings that decentralised selection in university programmes produces less diverse, more homogeneous student populations that disadvantage students with non-Western backgrounds and from lower socioeconomic groups, and what she will do about it. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says she will review the instrument in the Strategic Agenda due end 2019, consult institutions and students, and keep monitoring its effects.
If decentralised selection leads to a less diverse composition of the student population, then I believe the instrument must be critically examined.
Als decentrale selectie tot een minder diverse samenstelling van de studentenpopulatie leidt, dan vind ik dat het instrument kritisch moet worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de training van politieagenten op het gebied van geweld tegen vrouwen

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police training on violence against women, domestic violence statistics, ex-partner stalking and whether new approaches are needed. The minister answered that police training on domestic violence is being intensified in 2019-2020, that the Veiligheidsagenda and the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme address the issue, and that reliable stalking figures cannot be given because registrations are not unambiguous.
This means that police registrations of harassment by (ex-)partners are not always unambiguous and it is not possible to provide reliable figures on this phenomenon.
Dit maakt dat de registraties van de politie over het lastigvallen door (ex-)partners niet altijd eenduidig zijn en het niet mogelijk is om betrouwbare cijfers op dit fenomeen te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de veroordeling in Egypte van Amal Fathy

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government about the conviction in Egypt of women's rights defender Amal Fathy and whether it would press for her release and a presidential pardon. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands follows the case closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within EU channels, will keep doing so, and that Fathy can still appeal to the Court of Cassation or seek a pardon, but did not commit to specific further steps beyond consultation with EU partners.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about this.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om hierover informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Leraren vinden moeilijk een woning op plekken waar werk is'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and Education whether teachers can realistically find affordable homes in big cities, and what the government will do about it. The minister says housing supply is a municipal responsibility, describes existing national and municipal instruments and initiatives, and states the government is stimulating housing construction without committing to specific new measures for middle-income teachers.
Data on the size of the shortage in these cities is not available to central government.
De gegevens over de omvang van het tekort in deze steden zijn niet bij het Rijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van DUO Onderwijsonderzoek & Advies naar de sociale veiligheid van docenten

An MP asked the minister about DUO survey results showing a quarter of secondary school teachers face abuse or violence from pupils, the handling of specific incidents, whether such incidents are concealed, teacher training and involving teachers in solutions. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained the monitoring method, said schools generally work hard on safety, and pointed to training and sector-partner initiatives.
I am not aware which school this concerns or when this took place.
Mij is niet bekend om welke school het hier gaat of wanneer zich dit heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over veel lhbt-leerlingen die het volgens de Amerikaanse Columbia University nog altijd zwaar hebben op Nederlandse middelbare scholen

An MP asked the education ministers about the Columbia University survey finding that many LGBT pupils in Dutch secondary schools suffer negative remarks and inadequate teacher responses, and whether all schools should mandatorily address LGBT topics in lessons and anti-bullying programmes. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing GSA support and curriculum revisions, and promised to raise the issue with school leaders and teacher training, without committing to new mandatory rules.
That is why I would like to call on school leaders to sit down with teachers to discuss this.
Daarom zou ik schoolleiders op willen roepen om samen met docenten om tafel te gaan om hierover te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul op de vragen over de Monitor Vrouwelijke Hoogleraren 2018

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the slow growth in female professors, the decline in the share of female PhD candidates, unequal pay for female professors, and whether the Westerdijk Talent Impuls scheme should continue. The minister calls the 1.6 point rise the largest ever, says the pace is slow but universities are working on their targets, notes the PhD share fell only slightly, will wait for full pay-gap research before acting, and points to the coming science letter for further diversity policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Asscher over seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in de cultuursector

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked the minister about the Brandpunt+ survey showing widespread sexual misconduct in the cultural sector, including at arts academies, and about complaint handling, action plans and an independent investigation. The minister responded that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to Arbowet obligations and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and announced a meeting with sector parties on 20 December, while declining a separate investigation of the academies or funding an independent study.
I see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Hul, Westerveld en Futselaar over de toename van studenten die ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit van universiteiten

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that rapid student growth at some universities is eroding teaching quality, including overcrowded lectures and shortfalls in facilities and assessment. The minister disputed a general quality decline, pointed to institution-level choices under the quality agreements, and said there are no targets for maximum lecture size.
I do not recognise the picture of a negative quality trend caused by strong growth.
Het beeld van een negatieve kwaliteitstrend door forse groei herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over onderzoek van Sociaal Werk Nederland waaruit blijkt dat meer ouders peuters thuishouden

Two MPs asked whether administrative burden of the childcare allowance application is causing parents to keep toddlers out of playgroup-type care, with consequences for language delay, and proposed free preschool. The state secretary answered that research shows no national trend of parents dropping out, that a verbetertraject for the allowance and a new study are underway, and that a precise cost estimate for free preschool is difficult but a rough figure of about 850 million euro was given.
That is why I will again examine at the beginning of 2019 what the effects of the harmonisation are.
Daarom zal ik begin 2019 opnieuw onderzoeken wat de effecten van de harmonisatie zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat part time werken voor vrouwen lang niet altijd een vrije keuze is

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether part-time work by women is truly a free choice, given reports that social norms and institutions steer them toward it, and what role men and government policy should play. The minister acknowledged social norms and institutional pressure shape the choice, pointed to parental leave extension, the WerkZorg calculator, tax changes and an interdepartmental policy review (IBO Deeltijdwerk), without committing to a new structural measure.
The cabinet does not want to diminish the possibility of working part-time.
Het kabinet wil niets afdoen aan de mogelijkheid om in deeltijd te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het vastlopen van het landelijk overleg lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister about the collapse of national talks on the teacher shortage after primary-school unions walked out and the AOb withdrew, and how the government will still pursue a pact with municipalities and businesses. The minister regrets the walkouts, says cooperation continues with other parties, and refers the motion's pact to regional approaches and existing projects.
That does not stop me from continuing with the other organisations to tackle the shortages.
Het weerhoudt mij er echter niet van om met de andere organisaties verder te gaan om de tekorten aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat Nederlandse grootbanken miljarden uitleenden aan bedrijven die betrokken zijn bij ernstige mensenrechtenschendingen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers whether Dutch banks lend billions to firms implicated in serious human rights abuses, and what rules and enforcement apply. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that complaints go to bank grievance mechanisms or the National Contact Point, and that enforcement under the IMVO banking covenant relies on joint monitoring and voluntary dialogue rather than sanctions.
Banks generally do not inform third parties about the amount and conditions under which they agree financing with individual clients.
Banken informeren doorgaans geen derde partijen over de omvang en voorwaarden waaronder zij financiering met individuele klanten overeenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over verschillen in schooladviezen tussen inkomensgroepen

Two MPs (Westerveld and Van den Hul) asked why school-advice revisions appear to differ by parental income and education level, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister says revision rates are misquoted, that the link with parental education is not linear, that causes will be studied, and that the inspectorate's simulation tool and evaluation will address objectivity.
I am having the causes investigated, and these results will be included in the final evaluation of the Primary School Final Test Act.
Ik laat de oorzaken hiervan onderzoeken en deze resultaten zullen worden meegenomen in de eindevaluatie van de Wet eindtoetsing po.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bestuur van het Venlose OGVO dat in verband met financiële problemen leraren meer laat werken voor hetzelfde salaris

An MP asked the minister about reports that the board of the Venlo school group OGVO, facing financial problems, is making teachers work more hours for the same pay, and about a reported climate of fear among staff. The minister replied that school boards are responsible for personnel policy, that the supervisory body can intervene, that the Inspectorate will investigate OGVO this school year as already planned, and that the sector's collective agreement, to be interpreted by its social partners, caps teaching hours.
This school year the Inspectorate will conduct an investigation at OGVO.
Dit schooljaar zal de Inspectie onderzoek doen bij OGVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een alarmerende daling van studentenaantallen voor Nederlandse Taal en Cultuur

The MP asked whether the reported collapse in student numbers for Dutch language and culture is accurate, what it means for the shortage of Dutch teachers in upper secondary education, and how the minister assesses proposals to reverse the trend. The minister confirmed a roughly 60% fall in intake over ten years that has levelled off but still gives cause for concern, pointed to sector initiatives such as a Delta plan for languages and a KNAW analysis, and said curriculum reform will be examined.
In addition, I have asked the KNAW to produce a problem analysis and possible solutions for the Dutch studies programme.
Daarnaast heb ik de KNAW gevraagd om tot een probleemanalyse en eventuele oplossingsrichtingen te komen voor de studie Nederlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van den Hul over de berichten over het niet uitkomen met de financiële middelen bij een scholenkoepel in Zeist

An MP asked the education minister about reports that school federation Wereldkidz in Zeist would not have enough funds after offsetting workload-reduction money against cuts, and whether this affects other schools. The minister said the federation's calculation cannot be traced to the cited items, that a new disadvantage-funding model is pending, that salary funding was increased structurally, and that he will keep talking with social partners.
No, I do not have this overview.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over loverboypraktijken in jeugdinstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers about alleged loverboy practices in youth institutions, including a suspect formerly employed by Hoenderloo Groep and unsafe situations at several facilities. The government answered that the criminal case is pending, that the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care is investigating the signals and monitoring Juzt, and that it has no other current signals beyond these institutions, while the national rapporteur reports on trafficking and a programme against trafficking is forthcoming.
Because the case is still before the court, I cannot make further statements about this case.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik over deze zaak geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de uitsluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de Pakistaanse overheid

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Pakistan's refusal to re-register eighteen civil society organisations, including ActionAid and Plan, and what the Netherlands would do about shrinking civic space and GSP+ leverage. The minister answered that the government is in contact with the four Dutch-linked organisations, has raised the issue bilaterally and in EU channels, and will use GSP+ monitoring, but could not yet confirm whether the organisations may re-register.
Until these talks have taken place, it is too early to confirm whether the affected civil society organisations will be eligible for new registration within the sixty days.

Totdat deze gesprekken hebben plaatsgevonden, is het te vroeg om te kunnen bevestigen of gedupeerde maatschappelijke organisaties binnen de zestig dagen in aanmerking komen voor een nieuwe registratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Nederlandse investeerders die amper geld steken in start-ups van vrouwen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the very low share of venture capital going to women-led start-ups is simply accepted as part of the free market, what levers exist, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that this is not accepted as a given, that institutional investors play a limited role, and that a round-table with stakeholders will be organised before deciding on further measures.
I will consider this after the round-table discussion, where I hope to gain more insight into why female-led start-ups obtain so little capital and the options available to address it.

Dit zal ik na het rondetafelgesprek bezien, waar ik hopelijk meer inzicht zal opdoen over de redenen waarom vrouwelijke start-ups zo weinig kapitaal verkrijgen en de mogelijkheden die er zijn om hier wat aan te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Alkaya over het stopzetten van het Bangladesh Akkoord voor Brand- en Gebouwveiligheid in Bangladesh

Two MPs asked the minister why the Bangladesh Accord on fire and building safety may end on 30 November 2018 despite the assumed continuation to 2020, and what Dutch government and industry can do to keep it running and protect union freedom. The minister says diplomatic pressure, a joint EU/US/Canada letter, a planned personal push in Bangladesh, ILO capacity support and a call on the textile sector to act are aimed at keeping the Accord operational.
I will personally push the government of Bangladesh on this, both before and during my trip to Bangladesh in November.
Ik zal mij hier persoonlijk voor inzetten bij de overheid van Bangladesh, zowel voorafgaand aan als tijdens mijn reis naar Bangladesh in november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over terugloop aantal kinderen in Amsterdamse voorscholen

An MP asks the minister whether the reported drop in toddlers attending Amsterdam pre-schools due to parental costs and difficulties with childcare allowance applications is recognised, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledges the problem may exist, points to information provision and a forthcoming study on harmonisation effects, and says the existing budget is sufficient while declining to fund full fee coverage in Amsterdam.
State Secretary Van Ark will conduct research early next year into the state of affairs of the harmonisation.
Staatssecretaris Van Ark zal begin volgend jaar onderzoek doen naar de stand van zaken van de harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leraren meer laten werken voor hetzelfde salaris

An MP asked the minister whether a school board's plan to have teachers work 30 extra hours a year without extra pay breaches the collective labour agreement, and how the minister would ensure schools honour their agreements amid the teacher shortage. The minister answered that compliance with the CAO is a matter for the social partners and the parties to the agreement, declined to engage directly with the board, and noted the 750-hour cap for 2018 and 720 hours from 2019.
This is a question that must be answered by those who concluded this CAO, namely the social partners.
Dit is een vraag die beantwoord moet worden door degenen die deze cao gesloten hebben, nl. de sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over seksueel overschrijdend gedrag bij het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reprimanded ministry official who remained active in women's rights, the basis for the disciplinary measure, why external organisations hesitated to report, and transparency on sanctions and a cross-government reporting point. The minister confirmed awareness, said six complaints were upheld and a disciplinary measure imposed, acknowledged reporting hesitancy, said transparency is being examined, and said a reporting point for external organisations is being set up as quickly as possible.
That is why I am having it examined how transparency about the follow-up to boundary-crossing behaviour can be increased in the future.
Daarom laat ik onderzoeken hoe de transparantie over de opvolging van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de toekomst kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over verouderde techniekapparatuur in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether vocational colleges using outdated technical equipment hinder labour-market alignment and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that the ministry has no overview of equipment per institution, that schools are responsible for their own investments, and pointed to funding factors, the Regionaal investeringsfonds mbo and the Techniekpact as existing measures.
No, the Ministry of OCW does not have an overview of the equipment present at all individual educational institutions.
Nee, het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over een overzicht van de apparatuur die bij alle afzonderlijke onderwijsinstellingen aanwezig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de brute werkwijze van de Libische kustwacht jegens bootvluchtelingen

An MP asked the minister whether Libyan coast guard units abandoned three boat migrants at sea and destroyed their boat, whether the EU funds this conduct, and what safeguards exist. The minister could not confirm the incident, said the coast guard does not systematically act brutally, and described monitoring mechanisms and efforts to improve detention centres.
On the basis of our information, it therefore cannot be concluded that the incident actually took place.
Op basis van onze inlichtingen kan dus niet geconcludeerd worden dat het incident ook daadwerkelijk heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over plannen van het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR) om studieschulden van studenten officieel te gaan registreren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether BKR plans to officially register student loans and whether this would undermine the social character of the student finance system and harm ex-students' mortgage access. The minister replied that the government does not intend to register student debt, since DUO already records it and it is accessible, that lenders must already account for student debt under the Wft, and that BKR cannot register it unilaterally.
The government does not intend to proceed with registration, because study debts are already recorded at DUO and are easily accessible to former students.
De regering is niet voornemens om tot registratie over te gaan, omdat studieschulden al geregistreerd staan bij DUO en hier eenvoudig toegankelijk zijn voor oud-studenten.
