Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over het voortgezet onderwijs in met name Groningse en Drentse krimpregio’s dat bij de nieuwe rijksbekostiging op het hakblok gaat

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked whether the new funding model for secondary education would force school closures and cut vmbo support in Groningen and Drenthe shrinkage regions, and whether a 'krimpcheck' proposed by northern provinces would be adopted. The minister answered that the funding simplification has only limited redistribution effects, that closures stem from pupil decline and regional planning by school boards, that vmbo pupils receive a higher amount so schools are not disadvantaged, and that the provinces' letter was addressed in a separate letter.
This will apply to all types of boards in future, both narrow vmbo schools and broad school communities.
Dit geldt straks voor alle soorten besturen, zowel smalle vmbo-scholen als brede scholengemeenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over seksuele uitbuiting in een jeugdzorginstelling

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked about sexual exploitation of girls in a closed youth care institution in Zetten and whether the inspectorate's assessment framework is adequate. The minister said the case is before court, that the inspectorates have requested an in-depth independent investigation by the foundation, and that the framework will be reflected on after that investigation.
The inspectorates want to be informed about the facts and any shortcomings in the care provided to the young people concerned.
De inspecties willen geïnformeerd worden over de feiten en eventuele tekortkomingen in de hulp aan zowel de betreffende jeugdigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de loonkloof tussen primair en voortgezet onderwijs, en de om die reden stukgelopen cao-onderhandelingen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the salary gap between primary and secondary teachers, the teacher shortage, and the stalled collective bargaining, and whether dialogue with the sector would resume. The minister answered that salaries in primary education have risen substantially, that the gap has narrowed, that additional measures and funding for workload are being taken, and that talks with employer and employee organisations on the teacher shortage are ongoing, while noting PO in Actie no longer wishes to participate.
I am currently in talks with the employer and employee organisations about the approach to the teacher shortage.
Ik ben op dit moment in gesprek met de werkgevers- en werknemersorganisaties over de aanpak van het lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Groningse basisschoolleraren die hun leerlingen vaker onderschatten dan hun collega’s in rest van Nederland

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked why Groningen primary teachers give lower secondary school advice more often than elsewhere in the Netherlands, and what this means for pupils' opportunities, while also raising the role of parental pressure, school-level agreements and the research of Bosker. The minister confirmed more Groningen advice is revised downward, said no research has yet explained the gap, pointed to Drenthe research and an Inspectorate game, and promised to return to the topic in the 2018 results report and the final evaluation of the eindtoets law.

No substantiated statements can be made about the province of Groningen, since no research has yet been conducted in that province into the cause of the difference between school advice and test advice.

Er kunnen over de provincie Groningen geen onderbouwde uitspraken worden gedaan, aangezien er in die provincie nog geen onderzoek gedaan is naar de oorzaak van het verschil in schooladvies en toetsadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over studenten met een hiv-besmetting die niet worden behandeld

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they knew of international students with untreated HIV, how large the problem was, and whether they would help find a solution with insurers and universities. The minister said there is no registration of the group, that he will commission research into its size and nature, that private insurers' exclusions are their and the universities' responsibility, and that he will participate in talks if that helps.
I will therefore have research carried out into the scope and nature of the problem in order to gain insight into the risk to public health.
Ik zal daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de omvang en aard van de problematiek om zicht te krijgen op het risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over ‘Supermarkten doen te weinig tegen uitbuiting van boeren in ontwikkelingslanden’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch supermarkets should do more to stop exploitation of farmers in developing countries, and whether farmer incomes have fallen. The government replied that the IMVO covenant for the food sector addresses these risks, that its evaluation is due in late 2019, and that it will report yearly to parliament on the covenant.
Oxfam's findings will be discussed by the parties to the IMVO covenant for the food sector, including the government, in the steering group and relevant working groups.
De bevindingen van Oxfam zullen door de partijen van het IMVO-convenant van de voedingsmiddelensector – waaronder de overheid – in de stuurgroep en relevante werkgroepen worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over vrijstellingen van de leerplicht op grond van artikel 5a

MP Van den Hul asks whether exemptions from school attendance under article 5(a) of the Leerplichtwet for children with severe physical or psychological conditions are rising, and whether perverse incentives such as performance pressure and the passing of gifted children between regular and special education are behind this. Minister Slob confirms the rise, rejects the claim that cooperative bodies are excluding children, finds no evidence for the other suspicions, and promises a bill in the first half of 2019 to broaden the assessment before an exemption is granted.
I want to do this by involving the education sector in this procedure and strengthening the role of the municipality (in the form of the school attendance officer).
Ik wil dit doen door het onderwijsveld in deze procedure te betrekken en de rol van de gemeente (in de vorm van de leerplichtambtenaar) te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een immens lerarentekort op de Amsterdamse basisscholen

An MP asked the Minister about reported teacher shortages leaving thousands of Amsterdam primary school pupils without a teacher after summer, and whether the problem reflects salary gaps and what structural solutions are planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to a planned meeting with the alderman and to investments in salaries and workload, and referred to a separate letter on the teacher shortage for further measures.
I will therefore soon hold talks with the alderman about the situation in Amsterdam and combine this with a working visit.
Ik ga daarom binnenkort met de wethouder in gesprek over de situatie in Amsterdam en combineer dit met een werkbezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over miljoenen die zijn bedoeld voor onderwijs maar terecht komen bij commerciële bureaus

An MP asked whether schools facing teacher shortages spending public education money on commercial temp agencies, which offer high pay and perks, is acceptable and whether it harms teaching continuity. The minister called the trend undesirable but said hiring is a matter for school boards, that pay is often normal after costs, and that regional cooperation will be encouraged, with no generic measures against agencies planned.
Recruiting staff is a matter for school boards.
Het werven van personeel is een zaak van besturen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over conciërges en ander onderwijsondersteunend personeel die het moeten doen met een veel lagere loonsverhoging en die niet de forse bonus ontvangen die leerkrachten wel ontvan

An MP asked the minister why primary school support staff such as caretakers and classroom assistants received only a 2.5% pay rise and no bonus, while teachers received a larger increase and bonus, and whether this would reduce support staff availability and increase teachers' workload. The minister replied that the collective agreement gives all staff a 2.5% raise and a one-off payment of EUR 750, that the social partners negotiated it, that no shortage signals are known, and that workload funds allow schools to hire support staff.
Making collective agreements is a matter for the social partners, namely the PO-raad and the trade unions, who weigh the various interests against each other.
Het maken van cao-afspraken is een zaak van sociale partners in casu de PO-raad en de vakorganisaties, waarbij de verschillende belangen tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de arrestatie van Bobi Wine

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and alleged torture of Bobi Wine in Uganda, whether he had contacted his counterpart, and how pressure could be applied for his release. The minister condemned the arrest, described EU joint démarches, consular visits and contacts with Ugandan officials, and said Netherlands would continue to raise human rights concerns with Uganda.
I share the concerns about the human rights situation in Uganda and will continue to raise them with the Ugandan government in a European context.
Ik deel de zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Uganda en blijf die in Europees verband aan de orde stellen bij de Ugandese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over het tekort van de VN voor vluchtelingenopvang in de regio

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked the government about the UN funding shortfall for Syrian refugee support in the region, Jordanian schools, employment for refugees (including women), the rules of origin, and whether denying aid workers access can be a war crime. Minister Kaag answered that Nederland commits EUR 400 million over four years, contributes to education and job programmes, supports EU flexibilisation of the rules of origin, and that the Wet Internationale Misdrijven now covers starvation and blocking aid in non-international armed conflicts.
The cabinet will allocate at least EUR 400 million over the next four years to improve prospects for refugees and host communities in the Syria region.
Het kabinet trekt de komende vier jaar ten minste EUR 400 miljoen uit voor de verbetering van de perspectieven van vluchtelingen en gastgemeenschappen in de Syrië regio.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het teruglopend aantal vrouwen dat deelneemt aan het bevolkingsonderzoek baarmoederhalskanker

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why participation in the cervical cancer screening programme has fallen and which subgroups are missed. The state secretary answered that participation is monitored, an evaluation is planned for 2019, and lessons from other countries are limited.
In 2019 an evaluation will be carried out focusing in particular on participation by the different groups.
In 2019 wordt een evaluatie uitgevoerd die zich met name gaat richten op de deelname door de verschillende groepen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de voortdurende onduidelijkheid voor examenleerlingen van het VMBO Maastricht

An MP asked the Minister of Education about ongoing confusion for exam pupils at a Maastricht VMBO school over catch-up tests and communication with parents. The minister replied that the school has set up a helpdesk, answered about 70 questions that week, and that responsibility for individual questions lies with the school; a Frans summer-school lesson was missed once due to a teacher's sudden unavailability.
Because these are specific questions from individual pupils, responsibility for answering them lies with the school.
Omdat dit specifieke vragen van individuele leerlingen betreft ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de beantwoording hiervan bij de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het onderzoek van scholierenorganisatie LAKS over veiligheid op school

An MP asked the minister how to explain that only 56% of vmbo and 48% of praktijkonderwijs pupils feel safe at school according to the LAKS survey, why school safety rules are not producing better results, and what will be done to improve safety perception at vmbo schools. The minister acknowledges the gap, points to the Wet veiligheid op school and the monitoring duties that some schools failed to report, and promises further talks with the VO-raad on anti-bullying programmes and support.
Unfortunately, many schools did not do this in that school year.
Helaas hebben veel scholen dit in dat schooljaar niet gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘The summon of Feminist and Woman Human Right Defender Mozn Hassan to investigation within the Context of the NGO Foreign Funding Case’ dd 18 juni 2

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the government had raised concerns with Egypt over the summoning and questioning of human rights defender Mozn Hassan in the NGO foreign funding case, and about pressure on civil society. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, that concerns were raised bilaterally and at EU level, and that the embassy is monitoring it, without directly intervening in the court process.
The specific case of Mozn Hassan is still before the court, so direct political intervention is not opportune.
De specifieke zaak van Mozn Hassan is nog onder de rechter, waardoor directe politieke interventie niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over inhumaan optreden Franse grenspolitie jegens migrantenkinderen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government how it responds to reports of abuse of migrant children by French border police and whether it will raise child protection and EU burden-sharing at EU level. The State Secretary answered that the government monitors EU-acquis compliance, relies on the Commission to assess violations, and points to EU reform negotiations and existing child-specific safeguards, without committing to a new investigation.
The cabinet critically monitors both the implementation and compliance with the EU acquis, without assumptions, and uses bilateral and multilateral channels to raise our concerns where appropriate.

Het kabinet volgt, zonder aannames, zowel de implementatie als naleving van het EU-acquis kritisch, en maakt gebruik van bilaterale en multilaterale kanalen om onze zorgen, waar opportuun, over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat één op de acht universitaire masteropleidingen hbo-studenten weert

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that one in eight university master's programmes effectively bars HBO graduates, including through limited bridging (schakel) programmes. The minister said bridging tracks are a legal duty of institutions, cited research showing about 16 percent of university master's intake followed one, and agreed to clarify communication and ask the Inspectorate to look into it.
I will also ask the Inspectorate to look into this.
Ik zal de Inspectie ook vragen hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het te vroeg intreden van de zomerperiode voor het OV-studentenreisproduct van studenten in de regio Noord

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the summer period for the student public transport product, in which only discounted travel is allowed, should start later for students in the Noord region whose summer holiday begins later, and whether students should be compensated for extra travel costs. The Minister acknowledged the mismatch and that some students face extra costs, but declined to change the summer period or offer compensation, citing the generic nature of the product, administrative burden and contract changes needed with transport operators.

Providing financial compensation to students who still have to travel to their educational institution or internship address in the week of 16 to 20 July 2018 requires great implementation effort and entails administrative burdens.

Het verstrekken van een financiële compensatie aan studenten die in de week van 16 tot en met 20 juli 2018 nog naar hun onderwijsinstelling of stageadres moeten reizen, vergt uitvoeringstechnisch grote inspanningen en brengt administratieve lasten met zich mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op de werkvloer van artsen

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government views a Medisch Contact survey finding that many doctors and medical students experienced sexual boundary-crossing behaviour at work, and why it persists, and what consequences it draws. The minister replied that such behaviour is unacceptable, that employers must have policies and complaint procedures, that few victims take further steps, and that the government will work with the sector on additional measures.
I will discuss with the sector further steps to address and prevent unwanted behaviour.
Ik ga met de sector nader in gesprek over aanvullende stappen om ongewenst gedrag tegen te gaan en te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'News: Open letter for the release of Human Rights Defenders in Niger'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about arrests of human rights defenders in Niger, the closure of a television station, uranium-gate, press freedom and the Dutch embassy opening. The government answered that the EU monitors the court cases, that prisoner welfare projects exist, that it has no direct stake in uranium-gate, and that human rights can be raised in general terms.
The Netherlands and the various EU representations will continue to follow developments in this case closely.
Nederland en de verschillende EU-vertegen woordigingen blijven de ontwikkelingen van deze zaak op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het steunen van initiatieven die onder de ambities van het Bangladesh Akkoord duiken

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the LABS fire and building safety initiative in garment factories, its relation to the Bangladesh Accord, and whether Dutch firms and the government should support the Accord and engage unions. The minister answered that the Accord was important, that LABS works in new countries with similar commitment mechanisms, that the government urges Dutch firms to join the Accord, and that IDH is engaging unions and the ILO has an advisory role.
The cabinet calls on parties to the Convenant for Sustainable Clothing and Textiles, including new signatories purchasing in Bangladesh, to support the new Bangladesh Accord.
Het kabinet roept partijen van het Convenant voor Duurzame Kleding en Textiel, inclusief nieuwe ondertekenaars die in Bangladesh inkopen, op het nieuwe Bangladesh Akkoord te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over grote problemen bij ROC Top

An MP asked the education minister about reported serious problems at ROC TOP, a small vocational college in Amsterdam, and whether competition with ROC van Amsterdam and a planned reorganisation served students or the institution. The minister answered by relaying the college's denial of the press reports, stating that finances are secure and that the reorganisation aims to better prepare students, while calling for cooperation between colleges.
I have contacted the Executive Board of ROC TOP about this.
Ik heb hiervoor contact opgenomen met het College van Bestuur van ROC TOP.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat bijna de helft van alle mbo-scholieren zegt dat ze boeken en materiaal moeten kopen voor hun opleiding die ze daarna nooit meer gebruiken

An MP asks the minister about a survey showing that nearly half of mbo students must buy books and materials they never use, and whether the government will act on school costs. The minister points to a joint handreiking on school costs with the MBO Raad and JOB, Inspectorate oversight, and student council consent rights, agrees the practice is undesirable, and says institutions must be frugal, but offers no new binding measures.
I share that view. It is undesirable for an institution to prescribe books that remain unused.
Ik deel die mening. Het is ongewenst als een instelling boeken voorschrijft die ongebruikt blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en Van den Hul over de studentenstop bij zorgopleidingen terwijl er een personeelstekort is in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked why nursing schools impose an intake cap (studentenstop) while the care sector faces staff shortages, whether the vicious circle of shortages and too few placements is recognised, whether stipends for placement supervision are being negotiated, and whether trainees are used as full-time staff. The minister replied that hogescholen are dropping the numerus fixus for nursing from 2019/2020, that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds are the instruments used, that no negotiation on supervision fees is taking place, and that using trainees as full staff is undesirable and left to schools and care institutions to resolve.
I financially support this programme with the SectorplanPlus.
Dit programma ondersteun ik financieel met het SectorplanPlus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het asielbeleid voor LHBTI’s

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about IND asylum assessment of LGBTI applicants, including reliance on a 'self-acceptance' criterion and the treatment of photographic and witness evidence. The State Secretary said the emphasis on awareness and self-acceptance will be dropped, that sexually explicit imagery cannot be used but other imagery can, and that open questioning will be emphasised, though he could not say how many refusals rest on the criterion.
The IND does not record whether an asylum application is rejected on grounds of (lack of credibility of) sexual orientation.
De IND registreert niet of een asielverzoek wordt afgewezen op grond van (ongeloofwaardigheid van) seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een basisschool die homorollen schrapt uit de musical vanwege het geloof van een leerling

An MP asks the ministers how they judge a Hengelo primary school director who removed same-sex roles from a graduation musical because of a pupil's Jehovah's Witness background, and whether children must be prepared for the Dutch society's acceptance of homosexuality. The minister answers that school leaders have discretion within the kerndoelen on sexual diversity, does not assess this individual case, and considers the matter a debate for the school to resolve.
It is not for me to assess the conduct of the school leader in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over examenkandidaten van het Vreewijk Lyceum in Rotterdam die massaal zijn gezakt voor hun examen

MP Van den Hul asked the minister about the high failure rates at the Vreewijk Lyceum in Rotterdam and whether the school's lenient school exams and the inspectorate's oversight were adequate. The minister confirmed the pass rates, said it was too early to draw conclusions, noted the inspectorate had no reason for risk research before, and promised an external evaluation of the inspectorate's handling of the VMBO Maastricht case.
Over the past period there was no reason for the inspectorate to carry out risk research.
Er was de afgelopen periode voor de inspectie geen aanleiding om risico-onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat ‘Toelatingstoetsen niet zorgen voor betere leraren’

MP Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education whether research showing that admission tests for teacher training did not improve intake quality, and the teacher shortage, should change the government's stance on admission requirements. The minister called the research conclusions premature, said evaluation is due in 2019 and that she will decide on changes only after it, citing positive early signals.
Following the Trouw article, I committed to critically studying the underlying research and responding with a reaction.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van het artikel in Trouw toegezegd dat ik het onderliggende onderzoek kritisch zou bestuderen en met een reactie zou komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de dreigende terugloop van het aantal kinderen met een (leer)achterstand in de voorschoolse opvang

An MP asked whether the minister recognises reports that early-childhood education in Rotterdam is losing disadvantaged children due to income-dependent parental contributions after national harmonisation. The minister replied that Rotterdam sees no current drop in participation, a monitoring report shows no national trend, and gemeenten decide their own early-education design, with a commitment to keep monitoring and discuss with municipalities.
The municipality of Rotterdam reports seeing no decline in participation figures at this time.
De gemeente Rotterdam geeft aan op dit moment geen terugloop in de deelnamecijfers te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse overheid bij de aanleg van de Corredor Centro-Norte in het Amazonegebied

An MP asked whether Dutch government involvement in the Corredor Centro-Norte in the Amazon went beyond diplomacy, given subsidised studies, a 2016 lunch meeting and alleged environmental and human rights abuses. The minister answered that Dutch involvement was limited to a funded preliminary study and knowledge exchange, that the government does not fund the corridor's development, and that responsibility for enforcement and CSR lies with Brazil and the companies.
No Dutch government money has been used for the concrete development of the Corredor Centro-Norte.
Er is geen Nederlands overheidsgeld gebruikt voor de concrete ontwikkeling van de Corredor Centro-Norte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Transgenders ten einde raad: transitie stopt na faillissement instelling’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Medical Care about the bankruptcy of Psycho Informa Instellingen, which forced around 130 transgender patients to halt gender transition treatment, and asked about continuity of care, insurers' duty and protection of patient records. The Minister regrets the bankruptcy, says the matter was discussed in a VWS transgender care consultation where insurers advised patients to seek bemiddeling, confirms insurers have a duty of care, and points to professional record-keeping rules and curator obligations for patient files.
I regret that an institution has been declared bankrupt, as a result of which dozens of clients, including transgender people, cannot continue their treatment at this mental health institution.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat een instelling failliet is verklaard als gevolg waarvan tientallen cliënten, waaronder transgenders hun behandeling bij deze GGZ-instelling niet kunnen vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Amnesty: duizenden vrouwen en meisjes verkracht door leger Nigeria’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Amnesty's report on rape of women and girls by Nigerian soldiers in camps, and what it would do, including raising the matter at the UN Security Council and considering a thematic sanctions regime. The government said it is aware of the report, supports women's rights projects in Nigeria, will raise the allegations with the EU and in the EU-Nigeria human rights dialogue, and opposes a global thematic sanctions regime as ineffective.
Following Amnesty International's report, the EU plans to enter into dialogue with key actors in the federal government and security agencies.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van Amnesty International is de EU van plan een dialoog aan te gaan met belangrijke actoren in de federale regering en veiligheidsagentschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Ze vermoordde haar man toen hij haar verkrachtte. Nu krijgt Noura (19) de doodstraf’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the case of Noura, 19, sentenced to death in Sudan after killing her husband, whether she was a victim of sexual abuse acting in self-defence, and what he would do to stop the execution. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy found the facts plausible, that the appeal court must decide, and that the Netherlands made strong representations jointly with the EU, but that annulment was not yet an option while the appeal is pending.
Once it is clear what ruling the appeal court has made, the Cabinet will consider which follow-up steps are necessary and possible.
Nadat duidelijk is geworden welke uitspraak de rechter in hoger beroep heeft gedaan, zal het Kabinet bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Özütok en Van den Hul over de verkiezingsprocedure voor leden van het United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW)

Three MPs asked why the Netherlands did not nominate a candidate for the UN CEDAW committee and whether it would do so in future. The minister replied that suitable candidates were unavailable or did not meet the independence and expertise requirements, and that the government will reconsider a nomination in a future round.
On the basis of the criteria mentioned earlier, the cabinet will again consider nominating a candidate in a next round.
Op basis van eerdergenoemde criteria zal het kabinet een volgende ronde opnieuw overwegen een kandidaat te nomineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they would confront Facebook over reported privacy breaches, where citizens can complain, whether the Dutch data protection authority is investigating, and whether stricter oversight is warranted. The minister answered that Facebook must comply with privacy law, that the AP handles complaints and has wider powers from 25 May 2018, that an AP investigation concerns another matter while it is in contact with the UK regulator, and that the EU working party has made social media a key priority, and committed to discussing responsibility with Facebook and other providers.
I will engage with Facebook and other providers to remind them once again of their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government would contact Facebook after reports that data of about 89,000 Dutch users reached Cambridge Analytica, how affected users could trace their data, and whether government should inform the public about privacy risks. The minister answered that the Dutch DPA and EU regulators supervise Facebook under the GDPR, that the minister will talk with Facebook about its responsibility, explained the access and erasure rights, and said that the GDPR information duties and government guidance cover the risks.
I will engage in discussion with Facebook and other providers to point them once again to their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Van den Hul en Dijksma over pensioenfondsen die beleggen in Aurobindo, het omstreden geneesmiddelenbedrijf, dat mensenrechten en milieuregels aan zijn laars lapt

MPs Van Dijk, Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether pension funds investing in Aurobindo, a pharmaceutical company accused of human rights and environmental violations, should take steps, and what the government would do about ABP's investment. The minister answered that funds should follow OECD guidelines through engagement, that ABP decides its own investments and is accountable for them, and that the government is pursuing IMVO covenants with the financial sector.
No, I do not have that information, and furthermore ABP itself is responsible for its investment policy and investment choices.
Nee, die informatie heb ik niet en verder geldt dat het ABP zelf verantwoordelijk is voor het beleggingsbeleid en de beleggingskeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Poolse vrouwen geïntimideerd op Nederlandse werkvloer’

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FairWork research on sexual intimidation of Polish women in Dutch workplaces, including what steps will follow its recommendations, whether recruitment agencies will be held responsible, and whether large-scale research is needed. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to employer duties under the Working Conditions Act, Inspectorate SZW oversight, support for migrant-language information, and a forthcoming letter and study on confidential advisers, while rejecting large-scale research for now.
The Ministry of SZW will consult with FairWork to explore how a network of organisations supporting migrant workers in their own language can also give more attention to sexual intimidation.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal in overleg treden met FairWork om te kijken hoe een netwerk van organisaties die arbeidsmigranten ondersteunen in de eigen taal ook meer aandacht kan geven aan het onderwerp seksuele intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Fabrikant van Nederlandse medicijnen buit werknemers uit en vervuilt milieu’

Two MPs asked ministers whether Aurobindo Pharma violates OECD guidelines by underpaying workers and polluting, and what they will do about it. The ministers said they expect compliance with OECD guidelines, will raise antibiotic-residue wastewater discharge through EU and GMP channels, and plan an official-level meeting with the Dutch office and talks with procurers and insurers, without confirming any violation.
A meeting at official level with the Dutch office of Aurobindo Pharma is already planned.
Een gesprek op ambtelijk niveau met het Nederlandse kantoor van Aurobindo Pharma is reeds gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Dijksma over het tekort aan opvanglocaties voor slachtoffers van geweld achter de voordeur

MPs Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether extra funds for domestic violence and women's shelters were real or simply reallocated from the municipal fund, and how the funds would be monitored. The minister said the money is additional, added through the general municipal fund to the decentralisation grant, with the spending left to municipalities and monitoring to be requested from the VNG.
These are additional funds which were first added without earmarking to the general fund, and part of which was then specifically spent on Veilig Thuis.
Het gaat hier dus om extra middelen die zonder oormerk allereerst aan de algemene uitkering zijn toegevoegd en waarvan vervolgens een deel specifiek voor Veilig Thuis is ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over alweer een ernstige mishandeling bij het Groningse studentencorps Vindicat atque polit

An MP asked the education minister about a serious assault at the Groningen student corps Vindicat atque Polit, which failed to report it under the conduct code, and whether the university should cut ties with the corps. The minister said the corps breached its own code, that the university and hogeschool withdrew bestuursbeurzen, and that accreditation conditions and possible sanctions remain under review.
Vindicat atque Polit has therefore not adhered to the conduct code it signed itself.
Vindicat atque Polit heeft zich hiermee niet aan de, door hen zelf ondertekende, gedragscode gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de continuïteit van onderwijs van asielkinderen door de sluiting van het AZC Goes

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the State Secretary and Minister whether the closure of the Goes asylum reception centre, and the forced relocation of families with school-age children, was communicated in time and whether education continuity is protected. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a justified capacity decision, that schools and parents were informed promptly, and that COA plans relocations during school holidays to protect continuity, without committing to a new meeting with COA.
However, I do not consider this to outweigh the (societal) costs of maintaining too many reception places.
Ik vind dit echter niet opwegen tegen de (maatschappelijke) kosten die gepaard gaan met het in stand houden van teveel opvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Diks, Van den Hul en Kuik over buitenlandse investeringen in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about foreign investment in Ethiopia after a documentary on large-scale land grabs, and how Dutch investment, World Bank programmes and civil society support could prevent harm to people and the environment. The minister acknowledged the problems in large-scale projects, said Dutch investments are generally much smaller and that the embassy requires due diligence and IMVO compliance, and committed to pressing the World Bank on FPIC and civil society space.
Alleged violations of the OECD Guidelines can be reported to the National Contact Point for the OECD Guidelines (NCP).
Vermeende schendingen van de OESO-richtlijnen kunnen worden gemeld bij het Nationaal Contact Punt voor de OESO-richtlijnen (NCP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de ongelijke kansen voor kinderen met een migratieachtergrond in het Nederlandse onderwijssysteem

An MP asked the minister whether the OECD report showing unequal educational opportunities for students with an immigrant background is recognised, what causes it, and how the government will respond, including to proposals for broad first-year classes and the redistribution of disadvantage funding. The minister answered that the report shows Dutch immigrant-background students perform above OECD averages on resilience, cites the Gelijke Kansen programme, DUO mapping of broad brugklassen, and a new CBS indicator for redistributing disadvantage funds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de veiligheid van vrouwen op het internet

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about online safety for women, including whether complaints about sexism and threats to social media are recorded, whether platforms remove content as in France, whether platforms should proactively remove such content, and whether France's online sexual intimidation offence should be introduced in Dutch law. The Minister said such figures are not recorded, that the Netherlands lacks comparable removal data, that platforms bear responsibility under the voluntary Notice and Take Down code, and that a separate offence for misuse of sexual imagery will be proposed while the wider sex-offence review continues.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat in Limburg scholen miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld mislopen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether Limburg schools lose millions in disadvantage funding under the current allocation rules and what the minister will do about it. Minister Slob acknowledged problems with the current weighting scheme and administration, said a new CBS-based allocation system is being developed with a target of 2019–2020, and said additional structural funds are being added.
That is why I am currently working on a new allocation system.
Daarom werk ik momenteel aan een nieuwe verdeelsystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Rog over basisscholen die dreigen te verdwijnen uit de Gelderse dorpen Spijk en Lathum

Two MPs asked the minister about primary schools in Spijk and Lathum falling below the municipal closure threshold, and whether the Verenigde Zelfstandige Dorpsscholen experiment could be extended to save them. The minister said the closure decisions rest with the school boards, found no reason to doubt their care, and declined extension because the experiment is for testing a teaching concept, not keeping schools open.
I have no reason to doubt the care taken in the decision-making.
Ik heb geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de zorgvuldigheid van de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Vertrouwenspersonen #metoo-slachtoffers gedwarsboomd door werkgevers'

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that employers obstruct workplace confidential advisers (vertrouwenspersonen) supporting #metoo victims, and how the government will strengthen their position. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, stressed adviser independence under the Arbowet, and pointed to a forthcoming study and policy response before summer.
A confidential adviser must indeed be sufficiently independent to be able to support victims of unwanted behaviour in confidence.
Een vertrouwenspersoon moet immers in voldoende mate onafhankelijk zijn om in vertrouwen slachtoffers van ongewenst gedrag bij te kunnen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over de kwaliteit van zorg bij en de kennis over hart- en vaatziekten bij vrouwen

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about the quality of care for women with heart and vascular disease, gender-sensitive knowledge, and whether women are dying unnecessarily from missed diagnoses, and asked about the Dutch Heart Registry. The minister replied that scientific societies, not government, translate registry data into care, that a ZonMw gender-and-health programme will report on knowledge gaps, and that the government supports gender-sensitive care and women's presence in academic top positions.
Whether women are unnecessarily dying of heart and vascular disease due to missed diagnoses, I cannot assess.
Of vrouwen door gemiste diagnoses onnodig overlijden aan hart- en vaatziekten kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Dijksma over het tekort aan opvanglocaties voor slachtoffers van geweld achter de voordeur

MPs Van den Hul and Dijksma asked the minister about a shortage of shelter places for victims of domestic violence and whether funding is distributed fairly across the country. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for shelter, that funds were reallocated by objective criteria, that €11.9 million extra is added for Veilig Thuis, and that he will report on progress in autumn 2018.
It is the responsibility of the centre municipalities for women's shelter to adequately support victims of domestic violence with shelter and guidance.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de centrumgemeenten vrouwenopvang om slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld voldoende te ondersteunen met opvang en begeleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over maatschappijprofielen op vwo die niet aansluiten op de universiteit

MP Van den Hul asked whether the finding that vwo students with social-science profiles perform worse than science-profile students in alpha and gamma university programmes should be addressed, and whether social-science subjects could link more to academic research, and what consequences the minister draws for the curriculum development teams. The minister acknowledges the thesis's explanations, says social-science profiles adequately prepare most students, suggests links at school level, and states that curriculum renewal is led by the sector and the teams have been made aware of the thesis, without drawing direct consequences.
For that reason I currently refrain from drawing consequences myself from this thesis.
Daarom zie ik er op dit moment van af om zelf consequenties te verbinden aan dit proefschrift.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Rechten van meisjes blijven internationaal onderbelicht’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about a Plan International report finding girls' rights rarely named in international treaties. The minister answered that girls' rights are covered by existing conventions, that the government will push for explicit mention in new negotiations and UN resolutions, and that it will press states to withdraw reservations.
Therefore the cabinet will advocate explicit mention of girls' rights when negotiations take place on new binding treaties
Daarom zal het kabinet pleiten voor een expliciete vermelding van de rechten van meisjes wanneer onderhandelingen plaatsvinden over nieuwe bindende verdragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul inzake het bericht 'School wilde kinderen weren bij kerstdiner'

An MP asked the minister about a primary school that reportedly barred pupils from its Christmas dinner because parents had not paid the voluntary parental contribution, and whether this pressure was permissible. The minister answered that compulsion is not allowed, that the contribution must be voluntary, and that parents can turn to the school, the works council, the complaints committee or the inspectorate, while declining to take direct action with the school or parents.
No, that is not permissible. A parental contribution is always voluntary.
Nee, dat is niet geoorloofd. Een ouderbijdrage is altijd vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Noord-Koreaanse slaven die meewerken aan de bouw van Nederlandse schepen

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch ship-building supply chains use North Korean workers in conditions of exploitation, and what the government would do about the companies, the OECD guidelines and the workers. The minister acknowledged the reports, said companies bear primary responsibility under OECD due diligence, that officials contacted the companies and Poland was asked to enforce rules, and that involvement of North Korean workers is not banned under current sanctions while forced labour is.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies to adhere to the principles of corporate social responsibility as set out, among others, in the OECD guidelines for multinational enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij zich houden aan de principes van maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen zoals die onder meer zijn uitgewerkt in de OESO-richtlijnen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Chinese gevangenen die kleding voor westerse modemerken produceren

An MP asked the minister whether Chinese prison forced labour is being used to make clothing for Western brands such as C&A and H&M, and how responsibility in the supply chain should be enforced. The minister acknowledges the concern, says companies must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines, notes the SER secretariat monitors the textile covenant, and says the government will raise systematic abuse with the ILO and EU if confirmed.
If signals from clothing companies and human rights organisations were to show systematic labour exploitation of prisoners in China, the cabinet will urgently raise this with the ILO and the EU.

Indien zou blijken uit de signalen van kledingbedrijven en mensenrechtenorganisaties dat er sprake is van systematische arbeidsuitbuiting van gevangenen in China, zal het kabinet dit met urgentie onder de aandacht van de ILO en de EU brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de recente benoeming van een rechter die homo- en transgenderonvriendelijke uitspraken deed bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the appointment of Judge María Elósegui to the European Court of Human Rights, given her past statements questioning homosexuality as a disease and advocating psychiatric help for transgender people. The minister distanced the government from those statements, said LHBTI rights are protected by the ECHR and the Court, described the nomination process as confidential with the national government nominating and PACE deciding, and said no reason existed to doubt Spain's support for LHBTI rights.
The nomination of all judges to the ECtHR is a confidential process and not publicly transparent.
De kandidaatstelling van alle rechters voor het EHRM is een vertrouwelijk proces en niet publiek inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over piratenzenders

MPs Nijboer and Van den Hul asked about unlicensed pirate radio stations, rising fines, and whether the hobby could be tolerated or recognised as cultural heritage. The government defended enforcement by Agentschap Telecom on grounds of spectrum scarcity, safety and environmental harm, pointed to legal alternatives, and declined to endorse the heritage call.
The fining policy is aimed at stopping illegal activities or sharply reducing them.
Het boetebeleid is erop gericht om illegale activiteiten te doen stoppen dan wel sterk te doen verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over jonge en potentiële leraren die massaal afhaken doordat zij carrièreperspectief, uitdaging en salaris missen

An MP asked the minister how to respond to a Motivaction study showing young and potential teachers leaving or avoiding the profession, and whether existing policy suffices against the teacher shortage. The minister called the study a useful input for circular careers and hybrid teachers, pointed to existing career-changer schemes, retention efforts and cost support, and answered that current policy is sufficient alongside a six-line action plan.
Together with the social partners, teacher training institutions, school boards and municipalities, we are working to reduce the teacher shortage.
Samen met de sociale partners, de lerarenopleidingen, schoolbesturen en gemeenten werken we aan het terugdringen van het lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Te weinig cardiologen hebben verstand van het vrouwenhart’

MPs Dijksma and Van den Hul asked the minister about a report that too few cardiologists understand women's heart disease and about claims that women die weekly from missed diagnoses. The minister disputed the mortality claim, agreed knowledge of women's hearts is needed and is being built into training, but declined any new public awareness campaign and pointed to existing ZonMw programmes.
I do not see a role for me in starting additional public information campaigns.
Ik zie geen rol voor mij weggelegd om aanvullende voorlichtingcampagnes te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Amsterdamse ouders die hun kind van de voorschool halen nu die geld kost

An MP asked the minister whether Amsterdam parents are withdrawing children from pre-school now that it costs money, whether middle incomes are affected, whether this occurs elsewhere, and whether it is temporary or structural. The minister answers that about 3 percent of children in large providers have stopped attending due to costs, that municipalities have policy freedom to charge parent contributions, that the effect is expected to be temporary, and that Inspectorate monitoring and a study are planned.
Municipalities have policy freedom to require a parental contribution from parents for pre-school education.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid om een eigen bijdrage te vragen van ouders voor voorschoolse educatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 21 december 2017 over honderden oudere leerkrachten die graag nog  voor de klas hadden willen staan, maar die werkloos thu

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether older teachers forced into unemployment via settlement agreements contributed to primary-school staff shortages and whether the 2012-era dismissals and policy were sensible. The minister answered that no data exist to verify the claim, that school boards are responsible for staffing decisions, and that measures such as a return-to-work subsidy and a Participatiefonds plan to reintegrate the unemployed teachers are being pursued.
There is no data available on the basis of which this question can be answered.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar op grond waarvan deze vraag kan worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over incidenten tijdens de ontgroening bij het studentencorps in Rotterdam

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses abuses during hazing at the Rotterdam student corps RSC/RVSV, shown in a TV broadcast, and why the rector had not yet acted. The minister condemned all violence and noted that the Erasmus University suspended its relationship with the association, ending subsidies and its presence at official events, while stating that physical boundaries must never be crossed.
The rector magnificus of the Erasmus University decided, immediately after viewing the footage, to suspend the relationship with student association RSC/RVSV with immediate effect.
De rector magnificus van de Erasmus Universiteit heeft namelijk besloten om, direct na het zien van de beelden, de relatie met studentenvereniging RSC/RVSV met onmiddellijke ingang op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over incidenten tijdens de ontgroening bij het studentencorps voor vrouwen in Utrecht, UVSV

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether she supports the suspension of university and college funding to the women's student corps UVSV after hazing incidents, whether incidents were reported to the independent advisory committee, whether criminal offences occurred, and whether she will act against the UVSV or the institutions. The minister answered that she supports the suspension, that the events shown were not reported to the advisory committee, that criminality is unknown and left to investigation and courts, and that she considers the institutions acted correctly and that restoring trust is primarily the association's task.

I am of the view that the University of Utrecht and the University of Applied Sciences Utrecht have acted appropriately here, and I consider it up to the educational institution to act when unacceptable, humiliating incidents have occurred.

Ik ben van mening dat de Universiteit Utrecht en Hogeschool Utrecht hier op een juiste wijze hebben gehandeld en ik vind het aan de onderwijsinstelling om op te treden als er ontoelaatbare, vernederende incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Nog altijd kindhuwelijken in Nederland’

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that child marriages persist in the Netherlands despite the ban, and what measures were taken, including outreach to community key figures, an integrated action plan, and support for girls trapped in marriages. The minister answered that prior measures were implemented (a handbook, training, the LKHA knowledge centre, criminalisation of forced marriage, shelters) and that no new action plan would be started, while confirming outreach to boys follows the same chain.
Therefore no new action plan will be started.
Er zal derhalve geen nieuw actieplan worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over de mogelijke Amerikaanse import van jachttrofeeën uit Afrika

Two Dutch PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that the US planned to lift its ban on elephant trophy imports from Zimbabwe and Zambia, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed awareness, noted Trump had reportedly suspended the plan, and said the Netherlands keeps its own import ban and will raise illegal wildlife trade at EU and CITES level, without committing to specific country-level action.
In European and global CITES settings, the Netherlands will continue to call for adequate measures to combat illegal trade in wildlife products.
In Europees en mondiaal CITES-verband zal Nederland aandacht blijven vragen voor adequate maatregelen om illegale handel in wildlife producten tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de stijging van het aantal aangiften voor seksueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the Justice Minister about the rise in reports of sexual abuse following the #MeToo movement, whether police capacity is sufficient, and about low conviction numbers. The minister answered that reports and contacts rose in part, that police capacity is adequate, and that the link to #MeToo cannot be determined, and clarified conviction figures while disputing the one-in-eight statistic.
It cannot be determined how many reports, complaints and cases are directly related to the #MeToo movement.
Het is niet te duiden hoeveel meldingen, aangiften en zaken direct verband houden met de #MeToo-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Geweld tegen Rohingya: 'Massaslachtingen met honderden doden''

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports of mass killings and possible ethnic cleansing of Rohingya by the Myanmar army, including sexual violence, and about psychosocial aid and UN Security Council sanctions. The government expressed serious concern, called for cooperation with the UN Fact Finding Mission and humanitarian access, outlined funding for sexual violence support, and said thematic sanctions face substantial resistance in the Security Council.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about reports of human rights violations by the Myanmar army against Rohingya in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over berichten over mensenrechtenschendingen door het Myanmarese leger tegen Rohingya in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld en Van den Hul inzake het eindrapport van de Taskforce Voortgezet Onderwijs Zeeuws-Vlaanderen 'Gewoon goed onderwijs!'

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Zeeuws-Vlaanderen secondary education taskforce report, including OCW's role, the funding of about 3 million euro per year, eligibility for island-school status, passend onderwijs deficits and start groups. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that OCW funds only mandatory education and will contribute only one-off transition costs, that the schools do not qualify for the island regulation, and that other items fall to other ministries or to the regional partners.
The national government makes no contribution to the structural additional costs.
Het Rijk levert geen bijdrage aan de structurele extra kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een Rotterdamse school die zorgleerlingen weert

An MP asked the minister about a Rotterdam school reportedly refusing pupils with disabilities and care needs, including whether trial lessons are used to exclude them and whether the inspectorate will investigate. The minister said the school appears to meet its care duty, explained the legal limits on refusal, noted about 30 inspectorate signals this year, and said the inspectorate is in contact with the school to clarify its practice.
The inspectorate is in contact with the school's management and board. It has been agreed that the current lack of clarity about the practice will be resolved.
De inspectie heeft contact met schoolleiding en bestuur. Afgesproken is dat de huidige onduidelijkheid over de handelwijze wordt weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de grote zorgen van Uneto-VNI over schreeuwende tekorten aan mensen met technische opleidingen

An MP asked the education minister about Uneto-VNI's concerns over shortages of technically trained workers, including closures of technical vmbo programmes and teacher quality. The ministers acknowledge the mismatch, point to the Techniekpact and the EUR 100 million technical vmbo investment, and say they expect regional cooperation to address teacher shortages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kwint over het bericht 'Groot deel leerlingen locatie Zadkine Rotterdam volgt lessen niet'

MPs Van den Hul and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that many logistics students at ROC Zadkine Rotterdam rarely attend lessons, and how the institution, inspectorate and municipality respond. The Minister calls the attendance findings serious, says Zadkine must fix its absence policy with the municipality's help, notes a follow-up inspection check in January, and outlines the municipal truancy-supervision legal gap and planned legislation.
The management of the five examined courses can, however, as the Inspectorate report showed, do more to reduce absenteeism and dropout.
Het management van de vijf onderzochte opleidingen kan er echter, zo is uit het Inspectierapport gebleken, nog meer aan doen om verzuim en uitval terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het voortdurende conflict in Congo dat bij het uitblijven van hulp de komende maanden de levens kan eisen van duizenden kinderen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the worsening humanitarian crisis in the DRC and what the Netherlands would do about the funding gap, its role in aid and diplomacy, whether forgotten crises would be considered in country prioritisation, whether protracted conflict drives migration, and the role of mining. The minister answered that the Netherlands is in close contact with the UN and Congolese government, has contributed funds and will attend a donor meeting, is reviewing its country policy with forgotten crises in mind, and describes the mining sector as both revenue and conflict driver.
The cabinet will take so-called forgotten crises, such as the crisis in the DRC, into account in that consideration.
Het kabinet zal zogeheten vergeten crises, zoals de crisis in de DRC, meenemen in die overweging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Israëls aanval op Palestijns onderwijs: complete school weg'

An MP asked the government about the Israeli demolition of a Palestinian school at Jubbet adh Dhib, which was EU-funded, and the violence against residents, and asked what steps the EU and the Netherlands would take. The government condemned the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, said it would raise the issue through EU joint action and dialogue, but did not commit to specific new measures beyond considering further steps if asked by the EU.
The cabinet condemns the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, regardless of whether it was financed by the EU or not.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de sloop en confiscatie van Palestijnse bezittingen, ongeacht of deze door de EU zijn gefinancierd of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdamse werkgevers hun neus ophalen voor MBO’ers

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about a report that Amsterdam employers demand too high qualifications from MBO graduates, and whether this disadvantages low-educated and other groups. Minister Asscher answered that the labour market is improving, that the evidence on higher requirements is qualitative and contested, and pointed to existing policy instruments without committing to a new concrete step.
The UWV gives no quantitative substantiation here, so there is no indication of the size of this difference.
Het UWV geeft hierbij geen cijfermatige onderbouwing, waardoor er geen indicatie voorhanden is van de omvang van dit verschil.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van den Hul over het pleidooi van de militaire vakbond voor het instellen van een onafhankelijk meldpunt naar aanleiding van berichtgeving door de Volkskrant over een oud-militai

MPs Belhaj and Van den Hul asked the Defence Minister about a union call for an independent reporting point for sexual abuse in the armed forces, after a Volkskrant report on a former soldier abused in the 1980s, and about training, anonymity, time-barred cases and disciplinary action. The Minister answered that existing channels (COID, KMar, supervisors) are adequate and that fragmentation is undesirable, that anonymous reports are possible, and that a commission of inquiry is examining the specific case, with action depending on its outcome.
Defence has set up a commission of inquiry that specifically focuses on the case in question.
Defensie heeft een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld die zich specifiek richt op de casus in kwestie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het overdragen van sociale media data van gewone Nederlanders aan de Amerikaanse overheid, de Muslimban en de onderhandelingen over de Amerikaanse "preclearance"

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked about US handling of Dutch travellers' social media data, refusals of entry to dual nationals and Dutch citizens, the Muslim travel ban, and preclearance negotiations at Schiphol. The government answered that it is not actively informed when entry is refused, that the EU PNR court opinion does not affect US data exchange, and that preclearance talks continue under Dutch, EU and international law including human rights.
The Dutch government is not actively informed when Dutch nationals are denied entry to the US.
De Nederlandse regering wordt niet actief geïnformeerd indien Nederlanders de toegang tot de VS is ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul inzake het bericht dat een mbo-student vanwege een spoedkeizersnede haar examens niet kon maken en daardoor het hele studiejaar over moet doen

MPs Kwint and Van den Hul asked whether a mbo student who missed her exams after an emergency caesarean and must repeat the whole year reflects a gap in rules protecting pregnant and student-parent students, and whether the minister will act on the adopted motion calling for a right to pregnancy leave and individual exam programmes. The minister answered that institutions can already offer tailored support, that the student must repeat the year as she missed too much, that consultations with stakeholders are ongoing with a handreiking and a letter to parliament planned for autumn, and saw no reason to intervene in this case.
I still hold the view that the legal position of student mothers and pregnant students is well secured in laws and regulations.
Ik ben nog steeds van mening dat de rechtspositie van studerende moeders en zwangere studenten goed geborgd is in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over gebrekkig onderwijs t.a.v. sexting

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why pupils report little sexting education and how schools' teaching on sexting, sexual diversity and media matches the 'Seks onder je 25ste' findings. The ministers pointed to Inspectorate reports showing schools address sexual education variably, to Mediawijzer.net and curriculum reform, and gave no new concrete commitments beyond ongoing efforts.
The full report 'Seks onder je 25ste' has not yet been made public; that will happen in the autumn.
Het volledige rapport «Seks onder je 25 ste » is nog niet openbaar gemaakt; dat gebeurt in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'B’Tselem chief: Israel sabotaging fight against anti-Semitism to retain West Bank'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli government uses antisemitism accusations to deflect criticism of its West Bank policy, and whether the IHRA working definition of antisemitism blurs the line with criticism of Israel. The government answered that it sees no official Israeli policy of this kind, distinguishes criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism, and holds that the IHRA definition does not change the legal assessment of such statements for government bodies.
As far as is known, there is no official policy of the Israeli government aimed at this.
Voor zover bekend is er geen sprake van officieel beleid van de Israëlische regering dat hier op zou zijn gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (onderwijsinspectie) die geen bevoegdheid zou hebben "om toe te zien op de inhoudelijke kwaliteit van examens"

An MP asked why the Inspectorate of Education limits its review of the Frans vwo exam signal to procedure and whether it should assess exam validity, given a parliamentary motion from 2014. The State Secretary replied that the inspectorate supervises the functioning of the CvTE but does not judge exam content, and that the CvTE and inspectorate are tightening the supervisory framework.
It is not a task of the inspectorate to pass judgment on the content and quality of the central exams.
Het is niet een taak van de inspectie om een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud en kwaliteit van de centrale examens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van den Hul over ouders die zich blauw betalen aan slimme kinderen die extra lessen nodig hebben

An MP asked the state secretary about parents paying hundreds of euros monthly for external enrichment classes for gifted children because schools do not provide adequate support, and whether parents are afraid to complain. The state secretary answered that education must be free, that schools and special-education partnerships must provide needed support without parental payment, that the inspectorate will enforce this, and that the budgets are sufficient.
If the school does not comply with the regulations, the inspectorate will take enforcement action and can partially or fully suspend or withhold the school's funding.
Wanneer de school zich niet houdt aan de regelgeving zal de inspectie handhavend optreden en kan de inspectie de bekostiging van een school gedeeltelijk of geheel opschorten of inhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de onrustige situatie in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had raised concerns with Morocco about the unrest in the Rif and possible violations of the right to demonstrate, and what could be done bilaterally and multilaterally to prevent escalation. The minister answered that the embassy is in regular contact with Moroccan authorities and EU partners, monitors the situation including alleged abuses, and that Morocco has announced an investigation into mistreatment of detained demonstrators.
The cabinet closely follows the situation on the ground, including reports of possible violations of the right to demonstrate.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie ter plaatse nauwlettend, inclusief de berichten over mogelijke schendingen van het recht op demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over opleidingen die studenten nog steeds laten betalen voor verplichte excursies, educatieve games of andere onderdelen van het studieprogramma

An MP asked the minister how she would respond to reports that universities and universities of applied sciences still charge students for compulsory excursions and educational games without offering free alternatives, and whether inspectors should fine the institutions. The minister replied that the inspectorate has contacted the institutions, several have pledged to stop charging or improve information, remaining cases are under discussion, and the inspectorate can in the extreme case impose a fine.
If additional costs are attached to a part of the programme, the student must be offered a free alternative.
Als aan een onderdeel van de opleiding extra kosten zijn verbonden, moet de student een kosteloos alternatief worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Thieme en Van den Hul over een ter dood veroordeelde Amerikaan

MPs asked the minister whether he knows of claims that US inmate Clinton Lee Young was wrongly convicted and whether the government will contact the Texas governor to seek a stay of execution. The minister confirmed awareness, restated Dutch opposition to the death penalty, and said the EU ambassador and the Dutch ambassador in Washington will write to the Texas governor expressing objections.
In this case too, the European objections will be conveyed by a letter from the EU ambassador in Washington to the governor of Texas.
Ook in dit geval zullen de Europese bezwaren door middel van een brief van de EU-ambassadeur in Washington aan de gouverneur van Texas kenbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een regionaal kwalitatief, dekkend en toegankelijk aanbod van voortgezet onderwijs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MP Van den Hul asked the state secretary about the Inspectorate's plan to place Zwin College under adjusted financial supervision due to falling pupil numbers, the consequences, and the government's role in securing secondary education in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate may require a recovery plan, rejected the consultant's advice as unconvincing, and said a robust joint plan is expected by mid-October with ministry support.
I have already informed those involved in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen that I will support the taskforce, which will work on developing a plan over the coming weeks and months, where necessary and desired.
Ik heb de betrokkenen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen al laten weten dat ik de taskforce, die de komende weken en maanden bezig gaat om een plan te ontwikkelen, waar nodig en waar gewenst ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leraren die worden gekort op salaris voor deelname aan staking

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether a school foundation was docking teachers' pay for striking on 28 June 2017 and whether the school board would be held to account. The State Secretary answered that the employer and unions had talked and the strike days would be paid, and that the matter is for employers and employees.
Strikes and work stoppages are a matter for employers and employees.
Stakingen en werkonderbrekingen zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht "Niets ging goed bij fatale schietoefening commando’s"

An MP asks the Defence Minister about a fatal live-fire exercise involving commandos and the recurring safety lapses the Safety Board (OVV) described, and whether safety is now guaranteed. The Minister says safety must always be ensured, that shooting exercises were suspended and the KCT is reviewing procedures, and that OVV recommendations are being implemented, though she gives no definitive guarantee and a dedicated shooting facility will only be ready in 2019.
The findings of the OVV are leading in this matter.
De bevindingen van de OVV zijn hierbij leidend.
