Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Bouwmeester over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de zorg

MPs Oosenbrug and Bouwmeester asked whether the health sector is aware of new data-protection rules (the breach-notification duty effective 1 January 2016) and whether WhatsApp is secure enough for exchanging patient data. Minister Schippers answered that sector implementation is the responsibility of healthcare providers, that the CBP will issue guidance and oversee compliance, and that the government will promote awareness and proceed with its client-rights bill, without monitoring sector preparations directly.
I do not keep track of the preparations healthcare institutions are making, because it is up to the institutions themselves to comply with the regulations.
Ik houd geen zicht op de voorbereidingen die zorginstellingen treffen, omdat het aan de zorginstellingen zelf is om aan de regelgeving te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Verhoeven over het gebruik van software van het Hacking Team door de Nationale Politie (NP)

MPs Oosenbrug and Verhoeven asked whether the National Police had considered or used Hacking Team spyware, whether its hacking tools exceed what Dutch law allows, whether it has source-code access, and whether the government will reconsider such tools after the Hacking Team breach. The Secretary of State declined to give details on specific software, citing risks to investigative capability, stated that use is limited to lawful powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure with judicial authorisation, and said he sees no reason to change policy.
I therefore cannot provide information on this.
Ik kan hier derhalve geen informatie over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over gekaapte IP-adressen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

The MP asks whether the Foreign Ministry's hijacked IP addresses were misused, how the government ensures integrity of its networks, and whether security techniques and shared knowledge are adequate. The minister answers that the hijack lasted November 19-27 2014, misuse cannot be ruled out or fully investigated, no new technical measures were taken, and the network is managed in fragmented but coordinated fashion.
It is unknown whether and to what extent the hijacked IP addresses were actually misused during the period in question.
Het is onbekend of en in hoeverre de gekaapte IP-adressen in de bewuste periode daadwerkelijk zijn misbruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over het 06-bereik in de spoortunnel Delft

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked why no mobile coverage is planned in the new Delft rail tunnel, whether providers and ProRail have made concrete agreements, and whether the provider-initiated permit system is optimal. The Secretary of State confirms there is no coverage for now, says providers declined to invest on cost grounds, that ProRail offered to share costs and proactively approached providers, and that providers remain responsible for mobile infrastructure, which he does not consider a government responsibility.
In principle the providers remain responsible for the construction and investment in mobile infrastructure.
Ten principale blijven de providers verantwoordelijk voor de aanleg en investering in mobiele infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over de implementatie van het cookiebeleid op de websites van de Publieke Omroep

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether NPO websites respect users' cookie choices, whether settings are remembered, and what the government will do to make sites accessible without accepting privacy-sensitive cookies. The minister answered that the sites were reviewed, the NPO fixed a display error and a remembering problem, and enforcement rests with the ACM and CBP, which have already acted.
Whether the NPO complies with the legal requirements and continues to do so is of course for the ACM to assess.
Of de NPO aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en blijft voldoen is uiteraard aan de ACM om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van een softwarefout door de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten

An MP asked whether the NSA exploited the LogJam weakness in encryption protocols to intercept secure communications and how the Dutch government handles discovered vulnerabilities. The government declined to confirm or assess the NSA hypothesis, citing intelligence source protection, said it supports responsible disclosure and will inform stakeholders of significant vulnerabilities subject to legal and operational limits, and judged no major impact on government systems requiring further investigation.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Hoogland over het gebruik van RFID-chips in kentekens

MPs Oosenbrug and Hoogland asked about a planned RFID-chip trial in licence plates, including the technical design, data access, privacy safeguards and alternatives to combat plate fraud. The government described a test at a defence training centre, deferred decisions on data access and whether to adopt the chip until results are known, and promised a later government position and parliamentary debate.
Once the results of these tests are known, the cabinet will take a position on whether or not to introduce an RFID chip in licence plates.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van deze testen bekend zijn, zal het kabinet een standpunt innemen over de wenselijkheid van het al dan niet doorvoeren van een RFID-chip in kentekenplaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over het minder uitbetalen voor het gebruik van online muziek aan artiesten

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked why Buma/Stemra pays composers and lyricists less for online music streams and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the imbalance, blamed unlicensed competition and costly rights identification, and pointed to the forthcoming CRM implementation bill, a campaign and a planned congress.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Wolbert over universele beschikbaarheid van breedbandinternet

MPs Oosenbrug and Wolbert asked whether broadband should be a universal service and how to reach the roughly 330,000 addresses in rural areas lacking 30 Mbps access. Minister Kamp answered that a universal service obligation adds little for the Netherlands, pointed to facilitating measures and regional tailoring, and saw no legal obstacles or need for uniform rules.
For the Netherlands, I consider the added value of a universal service obligation for broadband internet to be small.
Voor Nederland acht ik de toegevoegde waarde van een universele dienstverplichting voor breedbandinternet gering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that few municipal websites meet the accessibility guidelines, and about the effectiveness of the new compliance model. The minister disputes the report's 7% figure as not reflecting his registers, notes progress with 166 municipal sites verified, admits too many bodies remain insufficiently accountable, and commits to new monitoring, supplier convenants and legislation expected mid-2016.
I published this application framework for the web guidelines and the accountability model for governments in 2013.
Ik heb dit toepassingskader voor de webrichtlijnen en het verantwoordingsmodel voor overheden in 2013 gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over de inhuur door gemeenten van externe bureaus op no cure no pay basis voor onderzoek naar uitkeringsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Oosenbrug asked about municipalities hiring external firms on a no-cure-no-pay basis to investigate benefit fraud, including the 'unpaid civil servant' arrangement and the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling. The State Secretary said she lacks data on how widely the practice is used, rejects it, holds that core benefit-investigation tasks cannot be outsourced, and promises a letter to municipalities and possible instructions under article 76 of the Participatiewet.
The implementation practice as addressed in the broadcast is something I reject.
De uitvoeringspraktijk zoals die in de betreffende uitzending aan de orde is gekomen wijs ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden en het lid Oosenbrug over het artikel 'Organisaties zijn banger voor reputatieschade bij schending privacy'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Oosenbrug asked about the Dutch data protection authority CBP's call for a statutory duty to publish its investigation findings, how often publication has been blocked, the CBP's publication policy, and which other supervisors have publication duties. The Secretary of State sympathised with the workload concerns, noted that only one publication has been temporarily blocked, pointed to the existing CBP policy rules, and listed sector supervisors with or proposed to have statutory publication duties.
A statutory publication duty will also be bound by (to be specified) conditions and restrictions.
Ook een wettelijke publicatieplicht zal aan (nader te benoemen) voorwaarden en beperkingen gebonden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Monasch over de dreigende 'digitale dementie' in het openbaar bestuur

MPs Oosenbrug and Monasch asked whether the government shares mayors' concerns about 'digital dementia' in public administration, meaning the risk that digital records of government action are poorly archived and lost, and what oversight and responsibility exist for archiving at all levels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described archiving initiatives (e-depot, Archief 2020, AIDO) and said provinces oversee municipalities' and water boards' archiving under the Gemeentewet, while the ministers' responsibility is limited to the legal framework.
The management of digital documents is not arranged in such a way that their findability is guaranteed.
Het beheer van digitale documenten is niet dusdanig geregeld dat de terugvindbaarheid daarvan gegarandeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de voortgang in het gebruik van open data door de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asked the Interior Minister about open data use by government, including broken links on data.overheid.nl, incomplete datasets, and plans to centralise publication and mandate open data. The minister replied that link problems were largely fixed, that centralisation is aimed for but limited by resources, that publication is facilitated rather than mandatory, and promised an inventory of open and closed datasets before summer.
I have agreed with your House to inventory government-wide which data is available, which of it can be actively made available and which will remain closed.
Ik heb met uw Kamer afgesproken om rijksbreed te inventariseren welke data er beschikbaar zijn, welke daarvan actief beschikbaar kunnen worden gesteld en welke daarvan gesloten zullen blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over extra administratiekosten door decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether the decentralisations in the social domain cause extra administrative costs of around 100-150 million euros, and what the government will do about standardising information flows. The minister says the figure is a VNG estimate without a substantiated calculation, that a temporary rise was partly foreseen, and points to ongoing work on standards and funding models with gemeenten and care providers.
The figure cited is an estimate by the VNG, based on signals from municipalities and care providers.
Het genoemde bedrag betreft een inschatting van de VNG, op basis van signalen vanuit gemeenten en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over achterblijvende digitalisering in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Harvard Business Review research ranking the Netherlands as the fastest receding digital economy among 51 countries is reliable and what policy follows. The minister answered that the index's data and methodology are only partly transparent and that other rankings show the Netherlands improving, and listed digitalisation initiatives such as ICT breakthrough projects and a startup envoy.

The usefulness of the index, especially where its conclusions differ from other indices based on the same sources, I cannot properly assess because the authors give only partial insight into the underlying data and methodology on which the conclusions are based.

De bruikbaarheid van de index, met name waar de conclusies afwijken van andere indexen die op dezelfde bronnen zijn gebaseerd, kan ik niet goed beoordelen omdat de auteurs maar gedeeltelijk inzicht geven in de onderliggende data en methodologie waarop conclusies gebaseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de bezoldiging van de directie van Buma/ Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked whether the government would ensure that Buma/Stemra's director pay is capped under the WNT, after reports that the director was trying to block a salary cut to a minister's level. The state secretary replied that the WNT applies via article 25a of the Wet toezicht, that the College van Toezicht Auteursrecht monitors pay and can issue directions or penalties, and saw no reason to revisit the cap.
Since 1 July 2013 the College closely monitors the remuneration of the board and other senior officials of Buma/Stemra and other collective management organisations.
Sinds 1 juli 2013 houdt het College nauwlettend toezicht op de hoogte van de bezoldiging van de directie en de overige topfunctionarissen van Buma/Stemra en andere collectieve beheersorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Oosenbrug over de slechte ontvangst van TV West en TV Utrecht

MPs Mohandis and Oosenbrug asked whether the government is aware of poor reception of TV West and TV Utrecht after the channels were re-tuned, and whether this is undesirable given their emergency-broadcasting role; they also asked about frequency choice and when Ziggo will resolve it. The Secretary of State confirmed awareness, noted that the regional radio stations (not TV) are formal emergency broadcasters, said frequency management is Ziggo's responsibility, and reported that Ziggo promised to fix complaints via a free cable and technician visit, with all complaints so far resolved.
The emergency broadcaster status applies only to radio, not to television and online media.
De status van calamiteitenzender geldt alleen voor de radio, niet voor televisie en online media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over langdurige onbereikbaarheid van overheidswebsites

An MP asked why rijksoverheid.nl and other government websites were unreachable for hours on 10 February 2015, what caused it, its impact, and what technical measures and actions are planned. The minister answered that a DDoS attack caused the outage, which lasted because the supplier first diagnosed it as a technical fault, and that a supplier improvement plan involving the NCSC is being prepared.
The supplier will draw up an improvement plan, with the Ministry of General Affairs and the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) closely involved.
De leverancier zal een verbeterplan opstellen, waarbij het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) nauw betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Oosenbrug over het doen van belastingaangifte door mensen met psychi(atri)sche, maatschappelijke en verslavingsproblemen

MPs Groot and Oosenbrug asked whether abolishing the electronic signature (pincode) for tax returns has made it harder for vulnerable citizens and the intermediary organisations helping them, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary says alternatives exist (commercial software, DigiD with proxy, Belastingdienst help) and that intermediaries have been advised, but commits to no new measures for this group.
For the group referred to in the question, in my judgement there are sufficient options to obtain (free) help with filing the tax return.
Voor de in de vraag bedoelde groep zijn er naar mijn oordeel voldoende mogelijkheden om (gratis) hulp te krijgen bij het doen van de belastingaangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een politieke reactie op het privacybeleid van Facebook

MP Oosenbrug asked whether the minister would respond to Belgian counterpart Tommelein's reaction to Facebook's new privacy terms, share the view that political statements can support privacy regulators, call for European joint action, and organise a meeting with Facebook. The Staatssecretaris answered that the independent privacy regulator CBP should assess Facebook's terms, that Netherlands actively defends data protection in the EU and Council of Europe, and that he will await the CBP investigation rather than contact Facebook directly.
A judgement on Facebook's privacy terms I must therefore leave to the CBP.
Een oordeel over de privacyvoorwaarden van Facebook moet ik dan ook aan het CBP laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over het artikel ‘Beveiligingslek banken maakte phishing mogelijk’

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked whether a web security flaw in major Dutch banks enabling phishing was known, whether victims would be fully compensated, and whether banks invest enough and share vulnerabilities. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that banks follow a responsible disclosure policy, that DNB has tightened IT-risk requirements, that banks say they know of no attacks exploiting the flaw, and that liability for victims applies unless gross negligence is involved.
Given the development of cyber threats, DNB has tightened the requirements it imposes on supervised institutions regarding the analysis and control of IT risks from this year onward.
Gezien de ontwikkeling van cyberdreigingen heeft DNB de eisen die zij stelt aan onder toezicht staande instellingen wat betreft de analyse en beheersing van IT-risico's vanaf dit jaar verzwaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het bericht “Koper breekijzer in regio Ede krijgt aandacht politie”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in the Ede region monitor camera footage and sales records at hardware stores to track buyers of tools that could be used for burglaries, and on what legal basis and with what proportionality. The minister replied that stores voluntarily report suspicious purchases, police assess these tips under their general preventive task, privacy is not violated, and effectiveness will be evaluated over time.
So the police do not request footage or data.
Het is dus niet zo dat de politie beelden of gegevens vordert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht “Alleen Duitsers straks nog baas op Facebook”

MPs asked the Minister whether Germans alone can sue Facebook over use of their name and photos, whether Facebook's European activities fall under Irish law, and whether the Netherlands will have its privacy watchdog examine Facebook's new terms. The Minister answered that the CBP (Dutch privacy regulator) is investigating the new terms, that it has jurisdiction over Facebook in the Netherlands, and that the CBP asked Facebook to delay the new policy pending the outcome.
The CBP is an independent supervisory body and itself determines what the investigation examines.
Het CBP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder en bepaalt zelf waarnaar het onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de houdgreep waarin makers van closed source software gemeenten houden

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the municipality of Arnhem was forced by a software vendor to pay 600,000 euros for licences as a fine for past unlicensed use, creating lock-in that deters open source migration. The minister answered that no fine was imposed; the cost arose from unbudgeted home-workstation licences and higher replacement costs, and that municipalities bear their own procurement responsibility while government promotes open standards.
There is no question of a fine having been imposed.
Er is geen sprake van een boete die zou zijn opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over criminaliteit veroorzaakt door “spookburgers”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the ministers about crime by 'ghost citizens' (unregistered residents) in Amsterdam and elsewhere, and about how to tackle it. The government answered that such crime exists in other municipalities, that the number of ghost citizens is at most 100,000 without indicating criminal involvement, that landlords have no duty to check registration, and that a RIEC Amsterdam project is being evaluated.
No (overview) information on this can be obtained from the existing registration systems.
Hierover is geen (overzichts-)informatie uit de bestaande registratiesystemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Oosenbrug over de uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens van miljoenen Nederlanders door de Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en Justitie

MPs Schouw and Oosenbrug asked why the Tax Administration's data exchange with AIVD, police and prosecution was only disclosed after a convenant was concluded, and questioned the shared ANPR camera use and retention periods. The ministers answered that a legal basis in art. 67 AWR and the Uitvoeringsregeling applies, that the Tax Administration keeps only fiscally relevant plate data, and pointed to existing privacy supervision and legal remedies, without committing to new measures.
There was therefore no reason to send these convenants to your House.
Er bestond dus geen aanleiding deze convenanten aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over de verplichte overstap van Cogas-klanten van Ziggo naar Caiway

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Cogas customers being forced to switch from Ziggo to Caiway, including lost services, higher costs, email portability and whether the ACM should investigate abuse of dominance. The minister answered that Cogas is upgrading its network to fibre and Ziggo declined to provide fibre services, that Caiway offers bundles that may or may not cost more, and that the ACM sees no reason to investigate.
Enquiries with the ACM show that it sees no reason to investigate whether there is a possible infringement of Article 24 of the Competition Act.
Navraag bij de ACM leert dat zij geen aanleiding ziet voor een onderzoek naar de vraag of er sprake is van een mogelijke overtreding van artikel 24 Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over de overname van Ziggo door Liberty Global (UPC)

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked the minister about the Liberty Global (UPC) takeover of Ziggo, its market effects, the EU conditions, and whether access regulation of KPN and cable networks is adequate. The minister answered that the EU Commission found no extra competition problems, that the ACM will keep regulating KPN's unbundled access, and that he will push at EU level to regulate both networks more easily.
I have asked the ACM to inform me one year after its final decision about developments in the internet, television and fixed telephony markets.
Ik heb de ACM verzocht mij een jaar na haar definitieve besluit te informeren over de ontwikkelingen in de internet-, televisie- en vaste telefoniemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over een lek in DigiD

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported security flaw in DigiD, including which municipalities were affected, how it arose, when it was discovered and fixed, whether citizens were informed, and whether certificates were outdated. The minister answered that no DigiD security breach occurred, that 12 municipalities had a potential risk patched without any evidence of compromise, that informing citizens is up to the organisations themselves, and that the certificate used is modern (SHA256).
Logius did not disclose the names of the municipalities and other organisations concerned, because it is up to those organisations themselves whether to make any statements about it.
Logius heeft de namen van de betrokken gemeenten en andere organisaties niet bekend gemaakt omdat het aan de betrokken organisaties zelf is om daar wel of geen mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het opvragen en het gebruik van het Burgerservicenummer door organisaties die daar niet bevoegd toe zijn

MP Oosenbrug asked the Minister of the Interior about organisations, such as schools, insurers and others, requesting citizens' BSN or ID copies without authority, and about sanctions and complaint routes. The minister admitted the official overview was outdated, pointed to alternative websites and the CBP, and said awareness campaigns and CBP sanctions are the response, while stating that the government has no obligation to disclose the BSN use of specific individuals.
There is therefore no obligation for the Minister of BZK to make available information about the use of a specific, person-identifiable BSN.
Er is dus géén sprake van een verplichting van de Minister van BZK om informatie ter beschikking te stellen over het gebruik van een specifiek, tot een persoon herleidbaar, BSN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over digitale dienstverlening bij decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipal digital service delivery for the 2015 social-domain decentralisations is lagging and whether residents risk inadequate service. The minister answered that digital information provision is not essential to the transition, pointed to VNG support programmes, a national information point and planned digital-government agreements, and said access arrangements are up to municipalities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat hackers boos zijn vanwege criminalisering door het Openbaar Ministerie(OM)

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about hacker groups' complaints that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) criminalises hacking through its public consultation and wording, and about the definition of hacking. The minister answered that the OM uses broad consultation for penalty guidelines, that the term hacker has a dual meaning, and that the OM engages with the hacker community while still treating unauthorised intrusion under article 138ab as criminal.
On the OM website a disclaimer will still explicitly indicate that hacking in this sense is meant.
Op de OM-site zal door middel van een disclaimer nog uitdrukkelijk worden aangegeven dat hacken in deze betekenis wordt bedoeld.
Vragen van het lid Oosenbrug (PvdA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken over schending van de Cookiewetgeving (ingezonden 17 september 2014).

An MP asked the ministers whether Apple's free U2 album placed on devices complied with the cookie rules requiring user consent, whether Apple used listening statistics for profiling, and whether the regulators would be asked to investigate. The minister answered that consent under article 11.7a Telecommunicatiewet is required, that the government does not know whether Apple complied (a matter for ACM), that enforcement against foreign firms is limited, and that investigations are primarily for the regulators themselves.
The government does not know whether Apple complied with the requirements of article 11.7a in this case; it is for the regulator ACM to assess this.
Het is de regering niet bekend of Apple in dit geval aan de eisen van artikel 11.7a heeft voldaan, het is aan toezichthouder ACM om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over het telecombedrijf Pretium en het schriftelijkheidsvereiste

MPs Mei Li Vos and Oosenbrug asked whether telecom company Pretium complies with the written-confirmation requirement for telephone sales in force since 13 June 2014, and asked the minister to ensure compliance. The minister said supervision lies with the ACM, which has informed businesses and consumers about the rules and will act against non-compliance.
It is up to her to assess whether individual companies comply with this requirement.
Het is aan haar om te beoordelen of individuele bedrijven zich aan dit vereiste houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebrek aan open data bij de overheid

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior about the poor state of open government data, including broken links and few new datasets on data.overheid.nl. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that dataset counts fluctuate and that many files are only available on request, and promised a fuller plan by end of September.
The Cabinet will inform you further about the approach at the end of September.
Het Kabinet zal u eind september over de aanpak nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik door politie en justitie van kentekengegevens die vastgelegd zijn door een particulier bedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecutors use licence-plate data collected by a private company (ARS Traffic & Transport Technology) along motorways, and about the legal basis, retention, privacy safeguards and Dutch ANPR practice. The minister confirmed such data can be requested by a public prosecutor under article 126nd Sv, explained the WBP basis and retention periods, and said the planned ANPR legislation will clarify the rules, with the bill pending at the Council of State.
These licence plates can be requested in criminal investigations by the public prosecutor under article 126nd of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Deze kentekens kunnen in strafrechtelijke onderzoeken worden gevorderd door de officier van justitie op grond van artikel 126nd van het Wetboek van Strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over het gebruik van open standaarden bij de doventolkdienst KPN Teletolk

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether new providers of Total Conversation software have entered the Dutch market for KPN Teletolk and whether KPN complies with open standards and the Telecommunications Act. The minister replied that no new providers have entered yet, that KPN is still resolving interoperability issues with some vendors, and that complaints can be brought to the regulator ACM, with a resolution expected within six months.
KPN thereby complies with the requirements set by the Telecommunications Act.
KPN voldoet daarmee aan de eisen die de Telecommunicatiewet stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid van 112 in het grensgebied

Two PvdA MPs asked whether mobile 112 emergency calls work reliably in border regions and whether full mobile coverage is required. The Minister acknowledges coverage complaints, says the extent is unknown and under study, explains that 112 calls are routed across networks, and rejects coverage requirements in licences while advising residents to use landlines and promising ongoing communication.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is researching the scope of mobile coverage.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken doet onderzoek naar de reikwijdte van de mobiele dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over wifi- en bluetooth tracking

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about wifi and bluetooth tracking of shoppers and passers-by under the Dutch data protection act, including how the legitimate-interest balancing test works, whether data subjects are informed, and whether iOS users are told when bluetooth is re-enabled. The state secretary answered that the controller must balance its interests against privacy, that the data protection regulator (CBP) holds that public-space tracking weighs more heavily toward individuals, that no legal duty exists to notify iOS users, and that device privacy settings are primarily the user's responsibility.
The College states that in the case of wifi tracking on the public road, article 8 of the Personal Data Protection Act applies, in particular subsections a and f.
Het College geeft aan dat in het geval van wifi-tracking op de openbare weg, artikel 8 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens van toepassing is, in het bijzonder onderdeel a en f.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Rebel over jongeren die identiteitskaarten vervalsen om aan alcohol te komen

MPs Oosenbrug and Rebel asked about young people forging or borrowing ID cards to buy alcohol, including whether scanners make forgery easy, whether prosecution occurs, and whether bar owners check authenticity. The minister said the Dutch ID card is hard to forge, that police act on reported cases, and that bars should check security features more carefully, while noting the survey's representativeness is unclear and committing to no new concrete measures.
The NOS report shows that more attention is needed in the hospitality sector here.
Het NOS-bericht laat zien dat hier in de horeca meer aandacht voor moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het aantal computers bij gemeenten die nog op basis van Windows XP werken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipal computers still running Windows XP, the security risks, and the government's responsibility for citizen cybersecurity. The Minister answered that responsibility lies with each government body, that partial inventory exists, that CSA arrangements and advisories were issued, and that the government is encouraging migration without committing to a firm mandatory deadline.
Central government bodies, municipalities, provinces and water boards are and remain themselves responsible for how they appropriately shape their ICT replacement policy.
Overheidsorganisaties bij het Rijk, gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen zijn en blijven zelf verantwoordelijk voor de wijze waarop zij passend invulling geven aan hun ICT- vervangingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Dutch telecom and data-protection rules, including the opt-in cookie provision, apply to data Samsung collects from smart TVs, and whether new rules are needed. The government answered that existing law is adequate, that opt-in consent already applies, that compliance is for the independent regulators ACM and CBP to assess, and that it will bring the case to their attention.
Whether Samsung complies with this provision is not for me to assess, but for the two independent regulators, the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the Data Protection Authority (CBP).

Of Samsung deze bepaling naleeft staat niet ter beoordeling aan mij, maar aan beide onafhankelijke toezichthouders, Autoriteit consument en markt (ACM) en het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het frequentiespectrum voor draadloze microfoons

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether reallocating radio spectrum (the 700 MHz band) could disrupt wireless microphones used in broadcasting, and what compensation or solutions would be offered. The minister answered that the 800 MHz reallocation was handled through consultation with the sector and a three-year transition, that no compensation is considered necessary, and that the 700 MHz decision will be handled similarly with flexible, sector-involved solutions.
Given these measures, in my view additional provisions such as compensation are not necessary.
Door deze maatregelen zijn in mijn ogen aanvullende voorzieningen in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld compensatie niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug over het afwijzen van een geboorteakte van het geadopteerde kind van een homostel

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked about a Florida birth certificate for an adopted child of a same-sex couple that omitted the biological mother, which the civil registry office Landelijke Taken did not register. State Secretary Teeven answered that there is no flaw in the law since the mother is the legal parent, that no formal application or refusal was made so no court appeal arose, and that the registry checks for conflict with Dutch public order.
In my view there is no flaw in the law.
Er is in mijn optiek geen sprake van een weeffout in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over de gebrekkige dekking van telefoonproviders in het spoor- en metronettunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked the State Secretary about poor mobile coverage in rail and metro tunnels, including whether ProRail and telecom providers can improve it and who is responsible for new tunnels. The State Secretary replied that providers initiate permit applications which ProRail assesses for safety and interference, that constructive talks are underway, that metro networks are primarily the responsibility of municipalities, and that he will raise the issue with local authorities.
ProRail has informed me that several permit applications are currently being processed and that constructive consultation is taking place on them.
ProRail heeft mij geïnformeerd dat er momenteel verschillende vergunning-aanvragen in behandeling zijn en dat hierover constructief overleg plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over wifi-tracking door winkels

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked whether shops may collect device identifiers via wifi or bluetooth from people inside and passing by their stores, and whether shops must disclose this and whether the data protection authority will be asked to investigate. The state secretary answered that tracking inside a shop may be justified as a legitimate interest under the Dutch data protection act if limited to visitor counts and movement, but collecting data from passers-by on the public road requires consent, and the minister will discuss the issue with the data protection authority.
The Minister of Economic Affairs indicated at the general consultation with your House on 12 February that he would discuss this issue with the Data Protection Authority (CBP).
De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft tijdens het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 12 februari j.l. aangegeven dit vraagstuk te zullen bespreken met het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Samsung smart TVs may track viewing behaviour under accepted terms, whether consent is explicit, and whether the TVs' terms of use are lawful, citing a CBP ruling. The State Secretary answered that consent or contract grounds under the Wbp could justify collection, that the Cbp is the independent supervisor and the government will not judge Samsung's lawfulness itself.
Supervision of compliance with the Wbp rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Het toezicht op de naleving van de Wbp berust bij het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over de gevoeligheid voor cyberaanvallen van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked about cyberattack vulnerability of Dutch banks, outages in online payments, the costs involved, reporting duties and information sharing. The minister answered that banks must report incidents to DNB under the Wft, that DNB supervises security and payment robustness, that a security-breach reporting duty to the NCSC is in consultation, and that information sharing via the NCSC is important.
The average outage duration is not known to me.
De gemiddelde storingsduur is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over ondertitelen van films als inbreuk op auteursrecht

An MP asked whether fan-made subtitling of films and the sites hosting it infringe copyright, and whether copyright law should be changed to favour such innovation. The State Secretary answered that translating dialogue into subtitles and making them public requires rightsholder consent, that sites facilitating infringement can be liable, and that he favours simplifying licensing and opposes illegal offerings, while committing to send a response to the European Commission consultation.
I am concerned that the legal market for music, films and e-books is being strongly hindered by large-scale, free offerings of illegal files.
Ik ben er beducht voor dat de legale markt voor muziek, films en e-boeken sterk wordt gehinderd door grootschalig en kosteloos aanbod van illegale bestanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat een computervirus kinderpornografie verspreidt

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ransomware 'police virus' that displays child pornography deters victims from reporting, how police distinguish planted from downloaded material, and whether voucher sellers bear responsibility. The minister acknowledged under-reporting is possible, said police can distinguish cases, noted voucher sellers are not assumed involved, and advised antivirus use and online guidance.
For that reason I cannot rule out that the number of people who reported the crime is lower than the number actually affected by this virus.
Ik kan mede daarom niet uitsluiten dat het aantal mensen dat aangifte heeft gedaan lager is dan het aantal mensen dat daadwerkelijk door dit virus getroffen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over angst bij de Rabobank om gegevens te delen met het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

An MP asked the Minister whether fear of Wob disclosure is deterring banks such as Rabobank from sharing cyber incident information with the NCSC, and whether a test case should be facilitated. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said information sharing already occurs, promised a letter before year-end clarifying how Wob exceptions apply to NCSC-shared information, and saw no need for a test case or an alternative legal structure.
With the aforementioned letter to your House I will provide clarity on how the Wob exception grounds, including those in article 10(1)(b) and (c), will be applied to information shared with the NCSC.

Met bovengenoemde brief aan uw Kamer zal ik duidelijkheid verschaffen over de toepassing die inzake de met het NCSC gedeelde informatie aan bepaalde uitzonderingsgronden in de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur, waaronder die in artikel 10, eerste lid, onder b en c, zal worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de vrijheid voor internetdienstverleners om geaggregeerde informatie over gegevensvorderingen openbaar te maken

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether internet providers may publish aggregated information about government data requests, and why an earlier civil-rights letter went unanswered. The State Secretary admitted the letter was mishandled, said providers need not report request numbers, and urged providers not to publish aggregated data because the Public Prosecution Service considers it harmful to investigations.
While respecting providers' own responsibility, the government can do nothing other than make an urgent appeal to providers not to disclose this kind of information.
Met inachtneming van de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieders kan de overheid niet anders dan een dringend appèl op de aanbieders doen om dit soort informatie niet te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘BTW-nummer moet wel op de website, ook voor de ZZP-er’

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the government about conflicting Tax Authority guidance on whether sole traders must publish their VAT number online, and about the use of the citizen service number (BSN) as the basis for VAT numbers. The State Secretary answered that no tax rule requires a VAT number on a website, but civil law (Article 3:15d BW) requires easy, direct and permanent access to it for online services, and that a motion asking for VAT numbers not linked to the BSN is being assessed with a letter to follow.
I am currently having the consequences of this motion mapped out and will inform the House about this in a separate letter.
Ik laat op dit moment in kaart brengen wat de consequenties van deze motie zijn en zal uw Kamer hierover bij separate brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over berichten inzake de vijandige overname van KPN door América Móvil

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the consequences of the proposed takeover of KPN by América Móvil for public interests such as service quality, investment and workers, and whether the government can block the deal. The minister answered that public interests are protected by telecom law and competition supervision, that no legal basis exists to block the takeover, and that binding commitments with América Móvil and a review of structural safeguards are being pursued.
No, there are no statutory provisions that make it possible for the State to block such a takeover.
Neen, er bestaan geen wettelijke bepalingen die het mogelijk maken een dergelijke overname tegen te houden door de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin Van Dijk over de nieuwe telefoonbemiddelingsdienst voor doven

MPs Van Laar, Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether the new relay service for deaf users, which requires Total Conversation software from a single provider, leaves analogue text-phone users without access and whether insurers cover the costs. The minister answered that TC is an open standard, insurers cover the software licence and equipment, and access is adequate, while acknowledging a small group may briefly lose service.
All insured persons known to have received a text phone in the past have received a letter from their health insurer.
Alle verzekerden van wie bekend is dat men in het verleden een teksttelefoon heeft gekregen, hebben van hun zorgverzekeraar een brief ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het efficiënt omgaan met Wob-verzoeken door gemeenten

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipalities can refuse Wob requests by pointing to already public information, whether requesters must first search themselves, and how the Hoogeveen request for all permits since 1988 (apparently aimed at collecting a dwangsom) will be addressed. Minister Plasterk answered that public information falls outside the Wob and can be referred to, that requesters should first search for it, and that the misuse of the Wob will be tackled on a short timeframe based on a study of recent administrative law instruments.
Based partly on the results of this study, I am considering how to curb, in the short term, improper use (also called abuse or manifestly unreasonable use) of the Wob.

Mede op basis van de resultaten van dit onderzoek bezie ik op welke wijze op korte termijn paal en perk kan worden gesteld aan oneigenlijk gebruik (ook wel misbruik of kennelijk onredelijk gebruik) van de Wob.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over privacyschendingen door middel van de bonuskaart van Albert Heijn

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Albert Heijn's loyalty card exposes customers' purchase histories to privacy risks, whether such data counts as personal data under the Wbp, and whether other retailers face similar risks. The state secretary answered that purchase data is personal only when traceable to a person, that the card number gives access only to purchase history without identifying details, that the first five digits are no longer printed on receipts, and that he lacks an overview of other retailers' safeguards, leaving the final legal judgement to the Data Protection Authority.

The final judgement on whether consumers' purchase data must be regarded as personal data and whether shops such as Albert Heijn must protect it accordingly rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Het finale oordeel over de vraag of aankoopgegevens van consumenten als persoonsgegevens moeten worden beschouwd en of winkels als Albert Heijn deze dienovereenkomstig moeten beschermen is aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over de onmogelijkheid om over te stappen bij glasvezel abonnementen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether fibre-optic internet customers can only switch providers when they have no other fibre subscription, causing gaps in service, and whether providers agreed to create switching barriers that may breach the cartel ban. The minister acknowledged operational problems, denied any agreement to create switching barriers, and declined to instruct the competition authority ACM to start an investigation, citing its independence.
However, I cannot instruct the ACM to start an investigation.
Ik kan de ACM echter niet opdragen om een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een mogelijke uitbreiding van de AMS-IX naar de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the ministers whether AMS-IX's planned US expansion risks exposing exchanged data to US surveillance laws (Patriot Act, FISA), whether it threatens data protection, and whether AMS-IX should be treated as vital infrastructure and advised on its structure. The government answered that US law applies to activities on US soil, that the EU-US expert group is discussing surveillance, that Dutch data-transfer rules apply, that AMS-IX is not classified as vital infrastructure but a review is underway, and that it will not advise the company on its structure.
Under this US legislation the provider can, after intervention by a US judge, be obliged to cooperate with requests from US authorities.
Op basis van deze Amerikaanse wetgeving kan de aanbieder, na tussenkomst van een Amerikaanse rechter, verplicht worden mee te werken aan verzoeken van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het  misbruiken van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob)

Two MPs asked the Interior Minister about abuse of the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) to claim penalty payments for late decisions, and whether the Wet dwangsom or the Wob itself should be changed. The minister acknowledged the abuse, said research on the 'versnellingsinstrumenten' is underway with results expected soon, and said the Wob itself needs no full revision, while promising to consider measures after that research.
I am of the view that something must be done quickly about the improper use of the Wob.
Ik ben van oordeel dat er snel iets moet gebeuren aan het oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat webwinkeliers zich verplichten om klantinformatie door te geven aan stichting BREIN

MP Oosenbrug asked whether webshops joining the eBoekhuis distribution platform can be forced to pass customer data to Stichting BREIN, how that fits privacy law, the legality of e-book resale, and whether the market is free given the Centraal Boekhuis position. The state secretary answered that consent under the Wbp is the main basis for such data sharing, that retention and cooperation are matters for businesses and the ACM, that resale of e-books is for the courts and the CJEU to settle, and that the NMa/ACM monitors non-discriminatory access to the platform.
Giving an authoritative interpretation on this is reserved for the judiciary and ultimately the Court of Justice of the European Union.
Het geven van een authentieke interpretatie dienaangaande is aan de rechtsprekende macht en daarbij uiteindelijk het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over de trage uitbetaling van rechthebbenden bij Buma/Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked about artist dissatisfaction with Buma/Stemra's royalty distribution, complaint numbers, reports of Spotify royalties being held too long, and the distribution norms. The Secretary of State answered that only one formal complaint was filed in 24 months, that the legal three-year distribution deadline is met, and that no further action with the oversight college is warranted.
Given that the payouts take place within the statutory deadline, I see no reason to bring the handling of distribution at Buma/Stemra to the attention of the Supervisory Board for Copyright.

Gelet op het feit dat de uitkeringen binnen de gestelde wettelijke termijn plaatsvinden, zie ik geen aanleiding de gang van zaken bij Buma/Stemra met betrekking tot de repartitie onder de aandacht te brengen van het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten.

Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos(beiden PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe publicatieregeling voor freelance journaliste

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about Sanoma Media's new exclusive licensing and resale terms for freelance journalists, the 30% fee share, possible abuse of market power, the Mededingingswet, and whether the Auteurscontractenrecht bill should apply retroactively. The state secretary answered that contract disputes are for civil courts, that the ACM handles abuse-of-dominance complaints, and that the bill's fair-remuneration rule will not apply retroactively to existing contracts.
It is also not for us to pronounce on a provision in a specific private-law relationship.
Het is ook niet aan ons om ons uit te spreken over een bepaling in een specifieke privaatrechtelijke rechtsverhouding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over becherming van persoonsgegevens in digitale patientendossiers

MPs Oosenbrug and Kuzu asked the health and justice ministers about privacy protection in digital patient records after the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found that none of the examined care institutions complied with the Wbp. The minister answered that institutions must improve access controls, that CBP will enforce if breaches continue, that NEN security norms will be made binding via an AMvB, and that IGZ is considering intensifying its supervision.
If the CBP finds that the institutions do not end the violations, the CBP will take enforcement action.
Als het CBP constateert dat de instellingen de overtredingen niet beëindigen, zal het CBP handhavend optreden.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Oosenbrug (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat providers niet-geanonimiseerde gegevens van Nederlandse burgers opslaan (i

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether Dutch telecom providers stored non-anonymised data on customers' website and app use, for what purpose, whether this breached the law, and whether broader investigation and new regulation are needed. The minister said the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found violations of the Wbp at KPN, Tele2, T-Mobile and Vodafone, that enforcement decisions are pending, and that no new legislation is needed because existing instruments suffice.
During the investigation, the CBP found violations of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp) at all companies.
Tijdens het onderzoek constateerde het CBP bij alle bedrijven overtredingen van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het aanbieden van overheidsinformatie

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would adopt the G8 Open Data Charter, including its open-by-default principle, a priority list of high-value datasets and data quality standards. The minister supports open-by-default in principle and cites the Open Data Next project and a forthcoming Open Government action plan, but declines to adopt the Charter integrally and sees no need for a general data quality benchmark.
I support the principle of open by default, open unless...
Ik ondersteun het principe « Open by default», open tenzij....

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gebruik van DigiD door bewindvoerders ten gu

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked whether professional guardians (bewindvoerders) routinely request clients' DigiD login credentials, whether this is desirable, and whether fraud is possible. The state secretary answered that DigiD is personal and should not be shared, that DigiD Machtigen is not yet connected to most agencies, that a review and consultation with the professional associations are underway, and that no evidence of fraud is known.
Because DigiD is a personal means of identification, it is not desirable for guardians to appeal to beneficiaries to hand over their login details.
Omdat DigiD een persoonsgebonden middel is, is het niet wenselijk dat bewindvoerders een appèl doen op rechthebbenden om hun inloggegevens te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heijnen en Oosenbrug over het verstrekken van een internationale huwelijksakte aan partners van hetzelfde geslacht

MPs Heijnen and Oosenbrug asked whether the existing international marriage extract model can be used for same-sex marriages and whether Dutch municipalities have a uniform document for this purpose. The state secretary answered that the ICBS revised convention (Convention 34) will include a model form for same-sex marriages, the NVvB has developed a uniform model, and EU-level work is at an early stage.
The intention is to adopt this revised convention at the ICBS General Assembly this coming autumn.
Het voornemen is om deze herziene conventie het komend najaar vast te stellen op de Algemene Vergadering van de ICBS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over regelgeving met betrekking tot drones

An MP asks the Justice and Infrastructure ministers whether the repeal of the aerial photography decree and the rules on drones and model aircraft adequately protect privacy against high-resolution camera drones. The state secretary answers that existing criminal and data protection law suffices, that tighter model-aircraft and drone rules are being drafted, and that operators need an exemption in the meantime.
I consider the current and forthcoming laws and regulations sufficiently equipped to take account of protecting private life in the civil use of cameras mounted on unmanned aircraft.

Ik acht de geldende en aanstaande wet- en regelgeving hiermee voldoende toegerust om rekening te houden met het beschermen van de persoonlijke levenssfeer als het gaat om het civiele gebruik van op een onbemand luchtvaartuig gemonteerde camera's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jadnanansing over de onnodige verstrekking van GBA-uittreksels voor de leerlingenadministratie op scholen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jadnanansing asked why schools still demand unnecessary GBA extracts from parents for enrolment, citing cost and municipal workload figures. The minister says the figures are a modelling exercise not verified by government, that some schools still ask for extracts, and that he will contact schools, accountants and parents and recheck with municipalities at year-end.
The government itself has not researched the number of GBA extracts issued for school enrolment, so the correct figures are not known to me.
Er is door de overheid zelf geen onderzoek gedaan naar het aantal verstrekte GBA-uittreksels ten behoeve van inschrijving in het onderwijs, derhalve zijn de juiste cijfers mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat in vergelijking met andere Europese landen het mobiele dataverkeer in Nederland het duurst is

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether mobile data prices in the Netherlands, reportedly the highest in Europe, indicate an insufficiently functioning market and what the minister will do about it. Minister Kamp disagrees that the market is failing, citing the report's narrow focus on premium data-only plans and difficulties in international comparison, but promises to study how to make a more meaningful price comparison and report in autumn.
I will investigate how we can arrive at a more meaningful international comparison of mobile telecommunications tariffs and will inform you of the outcomes of such a comparison this autumn.

Ik ga onderzoeken hoe we tot een betekenisvollere internationale vergelijking kunnen komen van mobiele telecommunicatietarieven en zal u over de uitkomsten van zo'n vergelijking dit najaar informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van onbemande vliegtuigjes

The MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the rules protecting privacy against camera-equipped drones and whether those rules are enforceable, citing a College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens concern that they are likely to be violated. The minister answered that existing criminal provisions and statutory safeguards for government use are adequate, and that no concrete signals of enforcement gaps or violations have reached him.
The statutory regime for the performance of government duties contains sufficient safeguards for respecting the private life of those to whom that performance relates.
Het wettelijke regime voor de taakuitoefening door de overheid bevat voldoende waarborgen voor het respecteren van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van degenen op wie die taakuitoefening betrekking heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het onzorgvuldig handelen van de overheid waar het gaat om het verzamelen en aan elkaar koppelen van persoonsgegevens

An MP asks the State Secretary and Interior Minister about government data linking and purpose limitation, citing the Dutch privacy regulator's warning of growing overreach and declining citizen transparency. The government answers that data linking is a deliberate choice within existing law, supports purpose limitation and the 'select before you collect' principle, points to MijnOverheid and access rights as transparency tools, and declines to give a substantive response to the regulator's annual report.
The cabinet therefore endorses the 'select before you collect' principle advised by the Advisory Committee on Security and Personal Privacy to avoid creating a 'digital haystack'.

Het kabinet onderschrijft dan ook het door de Adviescommissie veiligheid en persoonlijke levenssfeer gehanteerde uitgangspunt van «select before you collect» om te vermijden dat een «digitale hooiberg» ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de opslag van vingerafdrukken

Oosenbrug and Recourt (PvdA) asked the Justice Minister whether the ECtHR ruling M.K. v France on retaining fingerprints of acquitted persons affects Dutch law and practice, and whether it limits the planned retention rule under the Herziening ten nadele act. The minister answered that the ruling does not change Dutch rules since acquitted persons' fingerprints are destroyed, and that the planned rule includes restrictions absent in France, so it is compatible with Article 8 ECHR.

The ruling has no consequences for current Dutch regulations and practice, because under the Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden the fingerprints of a suspect are destroyed after an acquittal or dismissal.

Het arrest heeft geen gevolgen voor de Nederlandse geldende regelgeving en praktijk, reeds omdat op grond van het Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden de vingerafdrukken van de verdachte na een vrijspraak of sepot worden vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over de inzet door hun ouders van minderjarige kinderen voor het plegen van misdrijven

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Justice Minister about reports that parents from Roma families use their minor children to commit burglaries and thefts, and about related police, child protection, municipal registration and enforcement questions. The minister confirmed the problem is recognised, explained that children under 12 are not prosecuted while parents can be prosecuted for inciting offences though evidence is hard to gather in families, and outlined planned registration and multi-problem family measures.
I have no insight into numbers, neither for children in general nor for Roma children in particular.
Ik heb geen inzicht in aantallen, noch voor kinderen in het algemeen, noch voor Roma kinderen in het bijzonder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over mogelijke verspilling van belastinggeld door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether the Public Prosecution Service pays an IT provider for 11,000 accounts, including accounts with no employee attached, and whether other government bodies do the same. The minister replied that billing is currently a fixed price rather than per account, that talks are underway on per-account billing, and that no central register of accounts exists across government.
There is no central register of accounts within central government.
Er is binnen het Rijk geen centraal register van accounts.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht «Gemeenten vrezen toename verloedering door bezuinigingen Rijk»

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior whether the planned end to municipal reimbursement for enforcing nuisance fines (bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast, such as littering and illegal parking) would weaken local enforcement, and whether they had consulted the VNG. Minister Opstelten answered that consultations with the VNG on the reimbursement scheme are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed once more is known.
I am still in consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) about the reimbursement scheme for municipalities concerning the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de reactie op een grote botnet-infectie door het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police and the NCSC allegedly reacted slowly to a large Pobelka botnet infection, and about IP-address sharing, notice-and-take-down, investigation, vital-sector cooperation and the need for regulation. The minister rejected the claim of inaction, explained the data handling and legal limits, reported an ongoing criminal investigation, and promised an updated cyber security strategy and forthcoming incident-reporting legislation.
The NCSC had no legal basis to view and process the remaining substantive and possibly sensitive data.
Het NCSC had geen rechtsbasis om de resterende inhoudelijke en mogelijk gevoelige gegevens in te zien en te verwerken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat Mediamarkt zonder toestemming personeelsleden heeft gefilmd

An MP asked whether a report that Media Markt secretly filmed staff was accurate, whether privacy law was breached, what the Data Protection Authority (CBP) was doing and whether the apology was sufficient. The minister said the CBP is responsible for deciding whether the law was breached and any sanctions, declined to comment on ongoing investigations, and noted planned extension of CBP fining powers.
The CBP in principle makes no statements about possible or ongoing investigations.
Het CBP doet in beginsel geen uitspraken over mogelijke of lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hilkens, Oosenbrug en Ypma over de bescherming en de bewustwording van jongeren op internet

MPs Hilkens, Oosenbrug and Ypma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about youth protection and awareness on the internet, including the Digibewust finding that two-thirds of 12-16 year olds had a bad online experience, parental awareness, consent for minors' online profiles, the handling of grooming and the Meldknop website. The government disputed the two-thirds figure citing SCP research, pointed to existing criminal law, Mediawijzer.net, CBP guidance and EU strategy, and largely answered on substance without committing to new concrete steps.
I cannot confirm this conclusion from the YoungWorks research commissioned by Digibewust on the basis of my own data.
Deze conclusie uit het onderzoek van YoungWorks in opdracht van Digibewust kan ik niet op basis van eigen gegevens bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het verwisselen van identiteitspapieren

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked about a RamBam broadcast showing identity documents being swapped, enabling bank accounts, car rentals, Schiphol border passage and an ID card with another person's photo. The ministers confirm the facts, describe the Marechaussee's checks and planned training, and announce a review of the reisdocument application process.
This also applies if a photo of someone else is accepted when applying for an identity card.
Dit geldt ook als een foto van iemand anders wordt geaccepteerd bij de aanvraag van een identiteitskaart.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het verstrekken van gegevens van gedecoreerde inwoners aan gemeenten

An MP asked the Interior Minister why municipalities no longer receive data on decorated residents from the BPR agency, and whether this should be reversed. The minister explained the data transfer moved to a central facility and that a privacy balance was struck, then said that after reconsidering municipalities' legitimate interest, the data will be made available before Koninginnedag without a law change.
I will inform the municipalities of this and ensure that the necessary data is made available before the upcoming Koninginnedag.
Ik zal dit aan gemeenten berichten en zorgen dat vóór de aanstaande Koninginnedag de benodigde gegevens ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het stimuleren van innovatie en concurrentie bij aanbestedingen

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about a court ruling on a government ICT tender for SAP licences, the legal unity of the state in procurement, reuse of systems, vendor lock-in and openness to innovative suppliers. The minister answered that the ruling gives no reason to revise procurement policy, that the tender was lawfully split into two lots, that the state's procurement decision levels follow EU criteria, and that the government aims to avoid lock-in and engage the market.
The ruling in this case gives no reason to revise the Dutch central government's current procurement policy, whether or not for ICT.
De uitspraak in deze zaak geeft geen aanleiding het huidige aanbestedingsbeleid van de Rijksoverheid, al dan niet ten aanzien van ICT, te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een app die bewoners attendeert op vergunningaanvragen in hun buurt

MP Oosenbrug asked whether residents can better use their legal objection rights if they learn of permit applications in their area, and whether municipalities should be encouraged to publish these digitally and join the OmgevingsAlert app. Minister Plasterk answered that digital publication is the future and that he welcomes the app as a good development, while municipalities decide themselves whether to join.
Municipalities can themselves decide to join the initiative.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf besluiten om bij het initiatief aan te sluiten.
Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een lek bij Burgernet (ingezonden 3 december 2012).

MPs Oosenbrug and Marcouch asked whether citizens' data registered with Burgernet was inadequately secured, why the signup form lacked HTTPS, whether private data reached third parties, and how trust in the site is affected. Minister Opstelten answered that the signup page lost HTTPS after an update due to human error, was restored once discovered, that no third-party access signals exist, and that trust and participation remain high.
After installing a recent update, the security specifically for the registration form was not reactivated.
Na de installatie van een recente update is de beveiliging specifiek voor het aanmeldformulier niet opnieuw geactiveerd.
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug over het gebrek aan breedband in buitengebieden

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the lack of broadband in rural areas, including whether universal service obligations should cover broadband. The minister answered that nearly all households have broadband and that the market plus targeted government and provincial initiatives address remaining gaps, rejecting a change to universal service.
No, as indicated in question 4: broadband internet is in practice already available universally in the Netherlands.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in vraag 4: breedbandinternet is in Nederland in de praktijk al «universeel» beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug en Marcouch over de privacy van getuigen van misdrijven

MPs Oosenbrug and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a police appeal for witnesses to a severe assault on two gay men was publicised, and on what criteria privacy of witnesses is weighed against investigation needs. The Minister answered that public appeals for witnesses are used only in exceptional cases, that the prosecutor must approve footage that intrudes on privacy, and that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving is being updated with explicit safeguards.
Currently work is underway to update the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan actualisering van de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug over het bericht dat de overheid gegevens van miljoenen burgers aan de Mormonen heeft verstrekt

Oosenbrug asked whether the government unlawfully gave personal record cards of millions of deceased Dutch citizens to the Mormon Genealogical Society, whether privacy law was breached, and whether the data can be reclaimed. Minister Plasterk answers that the 1973 arrangement likely conflicted with the 1967 population registry decree, that current rules are stricter, that the CBG keeps the cards, and that he will verify and secure access with a letter in early 2013.
Against this background, it is plausible that the provision must be regarded as contrary to the Population Registry Decree of 1967 then in force.
Tegen deze achtergrond is het aannemelijk dat de verstrekking gezien moet worden als in strijd met het toenmalige Besluit bevolkingsboekhouding uit 1967.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over Amerikaanse toegang tot cloud-gegevens

The MP Oosenbrug asked whether US authorities can access Dutch cloud users' data more easily than assumed, whether Dutch users have limited legal protection under US law, and whether US constitutional safeguards apply to them. The state secretary answered that cloud users must be aware their data may be subject to US requests, that he cannot judge foreign law, and referred to earlier answers to similar questions without committing to new action.
It is not my role to give a judgment on the law of a third country.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel over het recht van een derde land te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over DigiD-gegevens die terecht zijn gekomen bij een reclamebureau en mensen die geen DigiD-code hebben

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a advertising agency holding thousands of DigiD login details, whether citizens' data is protected, the consequences of DigiD misuse, and whether the 1.6 million people without DigiD are being left behind. The minister could not confirm the numbers, said data protection cannot be guaranteed, announced steps to have the agency delete stored data and change its website, and said the government will keep promoting digital services while keeping alternatives for those without DigiD.
I will therefore ask the agency to set up its system in future so that the data of people who are not its customers are no longer stored.
Ik zal het bureau daarom vragen haar systeem naar de toekomst toe zodanig in te richten dat de gegevens van mensen die geen klant van haar zijn niet meer worden opgeslagen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de verplichte afname van vingerafdrukken voor de identiteitskaart en het paspoort

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the mandatory fingerprinting for ID cards and passports, the Raad van State's referral of questions to the EU Court of Justice, and the obstacles faced by people refusing fingerprints. The Minister confirmed the referral, said a bill will drop fingerprinting for ID cards, rejected issuing emergency documents to refusers, and said the government cannot speed up the Court's ruling.

The bill amending the Passport Act, approved by the Council of Ministers on 28 September 2012 and submitted to parliament, indeed provides that fingerprints will no longer be taken when applying for a Dutch identity card.

Het voorstel tot wijziging van de Paspoortwet waar de Rijksministerraad op 28 september 2012 mee heeft ingestemd en dat door Hare Majesteit de Koningin aan het parlement is aangeboden voorziet er inderdaad in dat bij de aanvraag van een Nederlandse identiteitskaart niet langer vingerafdrukken worden opgenomen.

te inventariseren waar de aanleg van kademuren vervoer van goederen via de binnenvaart mogelijk zou kunnen maken

requests the government to contribute to developing a monitoring plan for this pilot

requests the government, with provinces and social organisations, to arrange structural funding
verzoekt de regering, met provincies en maatschappelijke organisaties de structurele financiering te regelen

requests the government to include result obligations for medicines and microplastics in the water governance agreement
verzoekt de regering, in het overeen te komen bestuursakkoord water resultaatverplichtingen voor geneesmiddelen en microplastics op te nemen

financial incentives for private individuals regarding greening and water retention.
financiële prikkels voor particulieren waar het gaat om vergroening en het vasthouden van water
