requests the government, within the Delta Fund, to examine whether it is possible under the heading co-funding opportunities

requests the government, separately from the evaluation of the Water Governance Agreement, to consult with water boards and municipalities to draw up a plan
verzoekt de regering om, los van de evaluatie van het Bestuursakkoord Water, met de waterschappen en gemeenten in overleg te treden om een plan te maken
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over een eerlijke bekostiging voor traditionele schaapskuddes
Asks the government to pursue fair funding for traditional shepherd flocks and, with provinces, examine how their economic position can be improved.
requests the government to work for fair funding for traditional shepherd flocks in the Netherlands

requests the government to consider, using surplus water-quality budget funds up to 7 million euros in consultation with Natuurmonumenten, using these funds to finance the next phase of Marker Wadden

and to inform the House within a year which of these proposals will be adopted
en de Kamer binnen een jaar te informeren welk van deze voorstellen worden overgenomen

Asks the government not to start the MIRT exploration of the Varik-Heesselt flood channel until consulting the municipalities and province and leaving room for alternatives.
not to proceed with the MIRT exploration of the Varik-Heesselt flood channel until consultation has taken place with the municipalities and province concerned
niet eerder over te gaan tot de MIRT-verkenning naar de hoogwatergeul Varik-Heesselt dan nadat in overleg is getreden met betrokken gemeenten en de provincie

requests the government to come up with an action plan on water scarcity

requests the government, in further elaborating the Environment and Planning Act and its lower regulations, to anchor that water boards can take up innovations in the water chain
verzoekt de regering, bij de verdere uitwerking van de Omgevingswet en de daarop gebaseerde lagere regelgeving te verankeren dat waterschappen innovaties in de waterketen kunnen oppakken
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Smaling over de kwijtscheldingsregeling voor de afvalwaterzuiveringsheffing
Asks the government to address the remission scheme for wastewater levies in the evaluation of the water management agreement and include a social section in the new agreement.
include in the new Water Management Agreement a social section with clear agreements on implementing the remission scheme
in het nieuwe Bestuursakkoord Water een sociale paragraaf op te nemen met duidelijke afspraken over de uitvoering van de kwijtscheldingsregeling
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Hachchi over het aanwenden van vrijvallende middelen ten behoeve van de Marker Wadden
Asks the government to talk with Natuurmonumenten and use up to 7 million euro of freed-up water quality funds to finance the next phase of Marker Wadden.
Requests the government, if funds are freed up in the water quality budget up to 7 million, to talk with Natuurmonumenten.
verzoekt de regering om, bij vrijvallende middelen in de begroting voor waterkwaliteitsmaatregelen ter grootte van maximaal 7 miljoen in gesprek te gaan met Natuurmonumenten
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Dik-Faber over een actieplan Stedelijk Waterbeheer
Asks the government to produce an action plan on urban water management with municipalities and water boards and report progress to the House by August 2016.
requests the government, together with municipalities, water boards and other third parties, to produce a convincing urban water management action plan in 2016
verzoekt de regering, samen met gemeenten, waterschappen en andere derden in 2016 tot een overtuigend actieplan Stedelijk Waterbeheer te komen
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Hachchi over uniformering van het lozingenbeleid voor mestverwerkingsinstallaties
Asks the government, with the water boards, to harmonise the discharge policy for manure processing installations and report to the Chamber before summer 2016.
requests the government, together with the water boards, to achieve harmonisation of the discharge policy for manure processing installations
verzoekt de regering, samen met de waterschappen te komen tot een uniformering van het lozingenbeleid voor mestverwerkingsinstallaties
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Hachchi over de problematiek van micro- en nanoplastics
Asks the government to push in Europe for standards for measuring micro- and nanoplastics and for sector agreements to reduce them, and to report progress before summer 2016.
further requests the government to inform the House of progress before the 2016 summer recess
verzoekt de regering voorts, de Kamer over de voortgang hiervan voor het zomerreces 2016 te informeren
Motie van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de financieringsmogelijkheden voor een grotere sluis op Kornwerderzand
Asks the government to explore alternative and creative financing options, including EIB, Juncker funds, Waddenfonds and CEF, for a larger lock at Kornwerderzand and to inform the House.
requests the government to think along with the region in the search for alternative and creative financing options for a larger lock at Kornwerderzand
verzoekt de regering, mee te denken met de regio in de zoektocht naar alternatieve en creatieve financieringsmogelijkheden voor een grotere sluis op Kornwerderzand
Amendement van de leden Jacobi en Van Veldhoven ter vervanging van nr. 56 dat beoogt middelen vrij te maken voor het opzetten en implementeren van een nieuwe standaard voor nationale parken
Shifts 1 million euro within the budget from Natuurvisie to a new national parks post under article 18.
These funds will amount to 1 million euro in 2015.
Deze middelen zullen in het jaar 2015 1 miljoen euro bedragen.
Motie van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over het op het oude niveau krijgen van de sluisbediening
Asks the government to restore lock operation to its former level, including by remote operation of locks.
requests the government, through cooperation with other authorities and by operating locks remotely, to restore lock operation to the old level
verzoekt de regering om, via de samenwerking met andere overheden, en door middel van het bedienen van sluizen op afstand, de sluisbediening op het oude niveau te krijgen
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Hachchi over de middelen uit het Deltafonds die zijn gereserveerd voor de Kaderrichtlijn Water
Asks the government to actually spend Delta Fund money reserved for the Water Framework Directive on implementing measures in the area dossiers.
requests the government to actually allocate Delta Fund resources reserved for the Water Framework Directive
verzoekt de regering, middelen uit het Deltafonds gereserveerd voor de Kaderrichtlijn Water ook daadwerkelijk te bestemmen
Motie van de leden Jacobi en Visser over geen maatregelen nemen vóór de stresstest zoetwatervoorziening
Asks the government not to take no-regret measures on fresh water supply until the stress test of the main water system shows supply will stay adequate.
not to take no-regret measures before the stress test has shown that our fresh water supply remains adequate
geen «no regret»-maatregelen te nemen alvorens de stresstest heeft uitgewezen dat onze zoetwatervoorziening op peil blijft
Motie van het lid Hachchi c.s. over energieneutraal werken door de waterschappen
Asks the government, together with water boards, to inventory what is needed to make all water boards energy-neutral by 2025.
requests the government, together with the water boards, to inventory what is needed to make all water boards energy-neutral in 2025
verzoekt de regering, samen met de waterschappen te inventariseren wat er nodig is om alle waterschappen in 2025 energieneutraal te laten zijn
Motie van het lid Jacobi c.s. over een Deltaplan Zoet Water en Waterkwaliteit
Asks the government to produce a Deltaplan Zoet Water en Waterkwaliteit providing coordinated approach and independent coordination for fresh water and water quality.
requests the government to come up with a Deltaplan Zoet Water en Waterkwaliteit
verzoekt de regering, te komen met een Deltaplan Zoet Water en Waterkwaliteit
Motie van het lid Jacobi over traditioneel werkende herders
Asks the government to support the guild of traditional shepherds and find funds for the extra costs of heritage flocks.
requests the government to support this guild of traditionally working shepherds
verzoekt de regering om, dit gilde van de traditioneel werkende herders te steunen
Motie van de leden Van Veldhoven en Jacobi over nationale parken nieuwe stijl

Asks the government to research how the US, Canada and Australia use reservists, including operational deployment and costs, and report to the House.
requests the government to conduct research in countries with much experience using reservists within the armed forces: the US, Canada and Australia
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen in landen met veel ervaring met de inzet van reservisten binnen de krijgsmacht: de VS, Canada en Australië
Motie Koppejan c.s. over openstellen van meer zwemwateren in combinatie met stadsstranden
Asks the government to investigate opening more swimming waters combined with city beaches to the public and inform the House.
to investigate the possibilities of opening more swimming waters combined with city beaches
de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om meer zwemwateren in combinatie met stadsstranden open te stellen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Jacobi en Atsma ter vervanging van nr. 62 over extra uitgaven t.b.v. weidevogelbeheer
Shifts €5 million between budget articles to fund extra meadow-bird conservation spending and an akkervogel impulse.
This amendment aims to make extra spending possible for meadow bird management.
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd extra uitgaven mogelijk te maken ten behoeve van het weidevogelbeheer.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koppejan en Jacobi ter vervanging van nr. 20 om vissers certificeringsassessments te kunnen laten uitvoeren
Shifts 1 million euro within the sustainable business budget from existing fisheries subsidy schemes to support fishers' certification assessments.
to free up 1 million euro within the LNV budget to support Dutch fishers in carrying out certification assessments
om binnen de LNV-begroting € 1 mln. vrij te maken ter ondersteuning van de Nederlandse vissers om certificeringsassessments te kunnen laten uitvoeren
Motie Jacobi / Van Gent over publieke openstelling van ommetjes en (historische) paden

Asks the government to explore making subsidy conditions require recipients to cooperate in opening footpaths and historic paths to the public, and to promote opening field edges and watercourses to walkers.
to investigate to what extent it is possible to stipulate in subsidy conditions that subsidy recipients cooperate in public access to footpaths and historic paths

te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk is om in de subsidievoorwaarden voor landschap, natuur, landbouw en landinrichting vast te leggen dat subsidieontvangers in voorkomende gevallen medewerking verlenen aan de publieke openstelling van ommetjes en (historische) paden
Motie Cramer c.s. over de Regeling draagvlak natuur
Asks the government to keep the Regeling draagvlak natuur after 2009 and open it for applications in 2009.
requests the government to keep the Regeling draagvlak natuur after 2009 and open it for applications in 2009
verzoekt de regering de Regeling draagvlak natuur ook na 2009 te behouden en in 2009 open te stellen voor aanvragen
Motie Van Gent / Jacobi over knelpunten waardoor recreatief aantrekkelijke oeverpaden niet (kunnen) worden opengesteld
Asks the government to inventory obstacles faced by water boards in opening recreational riverside paths, agree solutions with them, and report to the House by June 2009.
to make an overarching inventory of the obstacles water boards face
een overkoepelende inventarisatie te maken van de knelpunten die waterschappen ondervinden
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over de "groen-blauwe" dooradering in de stedelijke netwerken
Asks the government to prioritise green-blue cycling and walking paths in urban networks and find funding across two ministries.
requests the government to give priority to the green-blue interweaving in urban networks
verzoekt de regering voorrang te geven aan de «groen-blauwe» dooradering in de stedelijke netwerken
Motie Snijder-Hazelhoff c.s. over het op elkaar afstemmen van doelen voor weidevogelbeheer
Asks the government to align objectives for meadow bird management across areas so that management becomes more effective.
requests the government to align the various objectives in the areas so that meadow bird management becomes more effective
verzoekt de regering om de verschillende doelstellingen in de gebieden zodanig op elkaar af te stemmen dat weidevogelbeheer effectiever wordt
Motie Van der Ham / Jacobi over het versnellen van de inrichting van nieuw verworven gronden ten behoeve van de ehs
Asks the government to speed up the development of newly acquired land for the ecological main structure and to develop the backlog of land.
to speed up the development of newly acquired land for the EHS and develop the backlog of land
de inrichting van nieuw verworven gronden ten behoeve van de ehs te versnellen en de achterstallige grond in te richten
Motie Atsma c.s. over het inzetten van middelen voor de implementatie van de leefgebiedenbenadering
Asks the government to use funds meant for species protection to implement the habitat-based approach (leefgebiedenbenadering).
requests the government to deploy the funds intended for species protection for the implementation of the habitat-based approach
verzoekt de regering om de middelen bestemd voor soortenbescherming in te zetten voor de implementatie van de leefgebiedenbenadering
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Jacobi en Atsma ter vervanging van nr. 58 over extra uitgaven t.b.v. weidevogelbeheer
Shifts 6 million euros within the budget from soil, water and reconstruction to nature to fund meadow bird management.
Coverage for this amendment is found in article 27, Soil, water and reconstruction of sand areas.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in artikel 27, Bodem, water en reconstructie zandgebieden.
Amendement van de leden Jacobi en Atsma over extra uitgaven ten behoeve van weidevogelbeheer
Shifts 6 million euro within the agriculture budget from the soil, water and sand area article to nature to fund meadow bird management.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 6,000 (x 1,000 euro)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 6 000 (x € 1 000)
Amendement van het lid Cramer c.s. over financiële impuls voor onderhoud en beheer van rietland in de Wieden en Weerribben door rietsnijders
Shifts EUR 3,000 (thousand-euro units) from landscape and recreation to nature budget for reed-cutter maintenance in the Wieden and Weerribben.
Coverage is found within article 24.14 General recreation.
Dekking wordt gevonden binnen het artikel 24.14 Recreatie algemeen.
Amendement van de leden Jacobi en Cramer over continuering van de succesvolle Regeling Effectgerichte maatregelen Natuur
Amendment shifting one thousand euro from sand-area soil and reconstruction funding to nature to continue the Regeling Effectgerichte maatregelen Natuur.
In article 23 Nature the commitment amount and the expenditure amount are increased by EUR 1,000
In artikel 23 Natuur worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 1 000
Motie Cramer/ Jacobi over een beloning voor vissers voor het verminderen van bijvangsten
Asks the government to develop a reward for fishers who actively reduce bycatch, such as extra sea days or fishing hours, and to inform the House.
requests the government to work out such a form of reward and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering met een uitwerking te komen van een dergelijke vorm van beloning en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie- Koppejan c.s. over het naar de Europese Commissie sturen van een nationaal aalbeheerplan
Asks the government to submit a national eel management plan to the European Commission with room for later choices, and to give affected fishers real consultation and inform the House.
to send a national eel management plan to the European Commission before 31 December 2008
voor 31 december 2008 een nationaal aalbeheerplan naar de Europese Commissie te sturen
Motie -Jacobi over geïntegreerde visserijvergunningen voor de kleinschalige visserij
Asks the government to create a scheme allowing small-scale sustainable fishers to use integrated fishing licences with rules suited to them.
requests the government to arrange a scheme allowing small-scale sustainable fishers to use integrated licences
verzoekt de regering zorg te dragen voor een regeling waardoor kleinschalige, duurzame vissers gebruik kunnen maken van geïntegreerde vergunningen
Motie - Jacobi/Koppejan over een evaluatie van het functioneren van het VIP
Asks the government to evaluate the functioning of the Visserij Innovatie Platform and propose its future role.
requests the government to come with an evaluation of the functioning of the VIP so far
verzoekt de regering te komen met een evaluatie van het functioneren van het VIP tot nu toe
Motie Cramer c.s. over het bepleiten van het visurensysteem binnen de Europese Unie
Asks the government to advocate within the EU for a fishing-hours system instead of fishing days at sea.
requests the government to advocate the fishing-hours system within the European Union
verzoekt de regering het visuren systeem binnen de Europese Unie te bepleiten
Motie -Snijder-Hazelhoff c.s. over het niet meer vangen van glasaal ten behoeve van de export
Asks the government to do everything to stop glass eel catches for export, using them only to restore the eel stock.
calls on the government to do everything to ensure no more glass eels are caught for export
roept de regering op om alles in het werk te stellen dat er geen glasaal meer wordt gevangen ten behoeve van de export
Motie- Koppejan c.s. over een regeling ondersteuning certificering
Asks the government to develop a certification support scheme for fishers and to inform the Chamber by 1 April 2009.
to develop a certification support scheme that fishers from all fishing sectors can use individually or collectively
een regeling ondersteuning certificering te ontwikkelen waarin vissers uit alle visserijsectoren zowel op individuele basis als ook collectief gebruik van kunnen maken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over het bericht ‘Alleen noodfonds kan schaapskuddes nog redden’

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government responds to reports that only an emergency fund can save traditional shepherd flocks, and whether it will support them. The state secretary says the financial position of shepherds is a provincial responsibility under the Natuurpact, that he is working with provinces and organisations toward a structural solution, and that an emergency fund is unnecessary if a structural solution is provided.
I am of the view that when shepherds are offered a structural solution, an emergency fund is not needed.
Ik ben van mening dat wanneer herders een structurele oplossing geboden wordt, een noodfonds niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Leenders en Jacobi over de onkostenvergoeding voor de plaatsing van hoogspanningsmasten

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether compensation for high-voltage pylons on farmland differs by period, whether some owners were bought out permanently for small sums, and whether TenneT could harmonise payments nationally. The minister answered that full compensation applies everywhere, that older buy-outs were legally permissible and that the current TenneT system is already applied nationally.
This principle is always and everywhere applied, regardless of the period in which the compensation was agreed.
Dit principe wordt altijd en overal toegepast, onafhankelijk van de periode waarin de schadevergoeding is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jacobi over het bericht 'Onderbetaling bij aanleg Centrale As'

MPs Kerstens and Jacobi asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment and sham constructions on the Centrale As project, and whether the province of Friesland as principal client should act and whether it could hide behind the timing of the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said the province had engaged the contractor and FNV, that the Inspectie SZW report is for the complainant only, that liability runs through the employer chain, and that government clients will receive further awareness outreach.
It is therefore not for me to share information from this report with your House.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om informatie uit dit rapport met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over illegale gaswinning in Heerenveen

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about gas extraction under Heerenveen without an approved winning plan, the council's advisory rights, the lack of baseline measurements and whether extraction should be halted. The minister answered that he had consented to the plan in 2012, that a 2015 amendment was under review with a draft decision expected in July 2017, that the municipality's advisory rights were not bypassed, and that he sees no acute risk justifying an immediate halt.
I have the authority to intervene at the moment there is or threatens to be a serious impairment of interests.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid in te grijpen op het moment dat er sprake is of dreigt van een ernstige aantasting van belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Mei li Vos over het bericht “Consumentenbond wil Bel-me-niet-Register ook voor ex-klanten”

MPs Jacobi and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why consumers registered on the Bel-me-niet register can still be called by former customers, and whether the law will be changed to protect all consumers. The minister replied that former customers may still be called, that the right of objection (recht van verzet) provides a balanced safeguard, and that the rules will be reviewed in the context of the revision of the ePrivacy directive, in consultation with stakeholders.
I consider it important to continue pursuing these goals.
Ik vind het belangrijk om deze doelen te blijven nastreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over zandwinning onder het Markermeer

An MP asked whether sand extraction under the Markermeer is being made unprofitable by the clay layer and the abolished domain-fee discount, and whether the government will reconsider and create instruments to make it as profitable as IJsselmeer extraction. The minister replied that the clay layer does not make extraction unprofitable, that no discounts have been granted for regular sand extraction since 2014, and that no new instrument is planned.
Given what has been stated in the answers to questions 1, 3 and 5, the Real Estate Agency sees no reason to revise its decision.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf ziet gezien het gestelde in de beantwoording van vraag 1, 3 en 5 geen reden haar besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jacobi over de hulpverlening op het Schelde-Rijnkanaal

MPs de Vries and Jacobi asked the ministers how rescue duties on the Schelde-Rijnkanaal were reorganised between two safety regions, whether the new rescue vessel meets comparable standards, whether other stakeholders were consulted, and whether shipping will face delays. Minister Blok answered that the safety regions decided on the split, that the new vessel meets at least the same standards, that stakeholders were consulted in working groups, and that shipping delays are not expected, while declining to account for the regional boards' decisions to parliament.
I do not wish to enter into this accountability relationship.
In deze verantwoordingsrelatie wil ik niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over doorverbindwebsites die consumenten onnodig op kosten jagen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why ACM has not acted against misleading call-routing websites that charge high per-minute rates, and whether the Telecommunications Act or maximum call costs should be changed. The minister answered that ACM is still investigating how to tackle these practices, that new rules would only be considered if current law proves inadequate, and that authorities and consumer groups already warn consumers.
ACM cannot make statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ACM geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het kappen van beschermd ooibos

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the felling of protected riverside forest in the Stiftse uiterwaarden under the Stroomlijn programme, including whether local support and alternatives were adequately considered. The minister answered that the programme is nearly complete, that the southern part's plan was adjusted with the owner, and that the process was transparent, while maintaining that the vegetation removal is necessary for flood safety.
In consultation with the owner/manager of the Stiftsche Uiterwaard, it was agreed to adjust the locations for vegetation removal in the southern part.
In overleg met de eigenaar/beheerder van de Stiftsche Uiterwaard is afgesproken de locaties voor vegetatieverwijdering op het zuidelijk deel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de discussie rondom de aanleg van een bypass bij Kampen

An MP asked the minister about the dispute over the Kampen bypass and the Reeve housing plans, including consequences for financing and existing agreements. The minister answered that the bypass is independent of the housing plans, is financed from the Deltafonds, and that the 2013 agreements with the province and municipality are being honoured.
The bypass near Kampen is being built to improve water safety and does not depend on the building plans the municipality of Kampen wants.
De bypass bij Kampen wordt aangelegd ter bevordering van de waterveiligheid en is niet afhankelijk van de door de gemeente Kampen gewenste bouwplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over hoge boetes in de binnenvaart

MP Jacobi asks the minister about high fines in inland shipping, the motion on anticipatory enforcement of crew rules, the 80 percent fine reduction not applying to owner-skippers, and whether bonds were involved in setting fines. The minister says anticipatory enforcement is only possible in specific cases and will be considered for the December 2017 crew rule change, justifies the differing fines for employees versus self-employed skippers, notes that ILT convenants with major shipping firms reduce checks, and commits to evaluating fine levels again in 2017 with sector partners.
Following proposals from social partners to modernise crew regulations, the CCR recently decided to amend parts of the Rhine Shipping Personnel Regulations.

Naar aanleiding van voorstellen van sociale partners voor modernisering van de bemanningsregelgeving is onlangs in de CCR besloten om onderdelen van het Reglement Scheepvaartpersoneel op de Rijn aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht 'Waddenclub: stop gaswinning direct'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that seabed subsidence under the Wadden Sea was faster than NAM predicted, and whether this justified stopping gas extraction under the hand-on-the-tap principle. The government answered that the Audit Committee found the subsidence within the permitted limits and no evidence of nature-threatening change, that the anomalies stem from LiDAR measurement inaccuracy, and that NAM will follow the committee's recommendations.
The advice of the independent Audit Committee and the monitoring results give me no reason to assume there is a striking, nature-threatening decline.
De adviezen van de onafhankelijke Auditcommissie en de monitoringsresultaten geven mij geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er sprake is van een opvallende natuurbedreigende verlaging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan.

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked about reports that water boards invest in risky foreign projects via the NWB Fund, including coco loans, export credit insurance, OECD guidelines, and the Cali (Colombia) evacuations. The minister answered that water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad, that the NWB Fund made an AT1 loan to NWB Bank rather than a coco loan, that export credit insurance is unavailable to public bodies, and that the Cali situation is being followed by the embassy.
Under the Decentralised Governments Financing Act (wet FIDO), water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) ondernemen waterschappen geen commerciële activiteiten in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht “Helft vliegtuigpassagiers krijgt geen vergoeding bij lange vertraging”

An MP asked the government about a report that half of air passengers receive no compensation for long delays, and whether the ILT (inspectorate) is doing enough to prevent barriers to claims. The state secretary answered that airlines largely comply with information duties, that the ILT handles complaints and can enforce, but that no structural problem or new measures are seen, while noting the 80,000 figure cannot be verified.
I have no overview of the total number of compensation claims, the extent to which they are justified or not, or whether money remains unpaid that should be paid out.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het totaal aantal compensatieclaims, de mate waarin deze gegrond zijn of niet en of er geld blijft liggen dat uitgekeerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over het bericht 'Traag internet of verplicht tv - vier vragen over de macht van KPN en Ziggo'

Two PvdA MPs asked the economic affairs minister about broadband prices, the duopoly of KPN and Ziggo, and bundling practices that force consumers into expensive packages. The minister answered that alternative internet-only offers exist, that access regulation remains needed, that no own price study is necessary, and that the competition authority ACM is already researching the market.
I refer specifically to the market analysis decision on unbundled access that was published on 17 December.
Ik verwijs specifiek naar het marktanalysebesluit ontbundelde toegang dat op 17 december is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jacobi over de belangenverstrengeling bij commerciële stichtingen die consumenten zouden moeten helpen bij collectieve schaderegelingen

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jacobi asked whether the governance of claim foundations representing consumers in mass-damage cases is adequate, given research showing most do not comply with the voluntary Claimcode, and whether a Consumer Ombudsman should be created. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance, said a bill would make certain Claimcode requirements legal admissibility conditions for collective actions, and declined to create a Consumer Ombudsman for now, citing the private-enforcement primacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de aalbeheerplannen in relatie tot de Europese aalverordening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether current eel fishing meets the recovery targets of the EU eel regulation and whether fishing is still viable at 40 percent escapement, and how the sector's low compliance on the IJsselmeer squares with its responsibility for control and enforcement. The State Secretary replied that the 2015 evaluation shows a slight decline in fishing mortality, that no reason to tighten the plan exists yet, and that enforcement conditions and sanctions apply under the crab scheme with annual reporting by the sector.
So far the evaluation gives no reason to tighten the eel management plans.
Tot nu toe geeft de evaluatie geen aanleiding om de aalbeheerplannen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over het bericht ‘Chemelot loost opnieuw een omstreden stof in de Maas’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about reports that Chemelot discharged melamine into the Maas again, and whether Sitech broke rules and what action can be taken. The minister confirmed elevated melamine levels from Sitech's treatment plant, said it is for the water board and courts to judge rule breaches, and declined to change the division of responsibilities while promising a risk assessment and possible review of the permit.
Ultimately it is for the court to judge to what extent an appeal against permits or against a decision whether or not to enforce is well-founded.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te oordelen in hoeverre een beroep tegen vergunningen of tegen een besluit om al dan niet te handhaven, gegrond of niet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over het gebruik van Dimethylaceetamide (DMAc) door DuPont

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about DMAc exposure at DuPont Kerkrade, including past occupational health monitoring, inspection follow-up, urine test results withheld from workers, and possible risks to residents. The minister answered that the Dordrecht fact-finding study will cover lessons learned, that employers are primarily responsible for worker protection with inspection oversight, that urine results cannot be shared for privacy reasons, that RIVM found resident risk very unlikely, and that prosecutorial matters cannot be discussed.
Answering the questions about the situation at DuPont Kerkrade in the past would require in-depth research.
Het beantwoorden van de vragen over de situatie bij Dupont Kerkrade in het verleden zou diepgaand onderzoek vergen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het project Watertruck-plus

The MP asks about the Watertruck-plus pilot, a publicly co-funded project (about EUR 23 million, with EU support) to introduce small standardized barges for inland shipping, and whether it risks unfair competition with existing inland shipping and how it is justified. The minister answers that the project is an innovation pilot in Flanders targeting goods not yet carried by waterway, that additionality is a Flemish responsibility, and that the Commission views any market interference as acceptable given the potential gains.
Ensuring the additional character of the goods flows is the responsibility of the Flemish government.
Het borgen van het additionele karakter van de goederenstromen is aan de Vlaamse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Jacobi, Bosman en over een onderhoud met schippers uit de binnenvaart

MPs asked why commercial shipping was barred from the Krammer recreational lock, whether this and deferred maintenance cause delays and safety concerns, and about weekend closure of the Middensluis. The minister replied that the lock's structures cannot safely bear commercial use, that the maintenance is planned rather than overdue, and that weekend closure reflects low demand pending a new lock.
When commercial shipping uses the Krammer recreational lock, the structural capacity of the scaffolding and fenders is insufficient, so safety cannot always be guaranteed.

Bij gebruik van de Krammerjachtensluis door de beroepsvaart is de constructieve capaciteit van de steigers en remmingwerken niet voldoende, waardoor de veiligheid dan niet te allen tijde kan worden gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Modewinkelier staat voor het blok’

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether commission-based platforms like Zalando threaten retailers, including price rises, abuse of dominance under the Competition Act and unfair trading rules. The minister answered that platforms offer benefits, that retailers can choose to leave, that the ACM rather than the minister assesses abuse of dominance and complaints can be filed there, and that unfair-practice rules protect consumers rather than imposing duties on platforms toward retailers.
It is up to the entrepreneur to decide whether he wishes to use a specific platform as a sales channel.
Het is aan een ondernemer zelf om te bepalen of hij gebruik wil maken van een specifiek platform als verkoopkanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Oosenbrug en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Voor je het weet, troggelt de doorverbindsite je centen af’

MPs Jacobi, Oosenbrug and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about commercial websites that route consumers to police, tax authority and company customer-service numbers via expensive 0900 numbers costing up to 90 cents per minute. The minister finds this undesirable, notes the ACM supervises 0900 numbers and unfair trade practices, has discussed the numbers with the ACM, and says new rules would only be considered if current law proves inadequate.

I consider it undesirable that consumers are misled by this and pay unnecessarily high information rates to contact agencies or companies that are reachable by phone for free or at limited call costs.

Ik vind het onwenselijk als consumenten hierdoor worden misleid en onnodig hoge informatietarieven betalen om telefonisch contact op te nemen met instanties of bedrijven die gratis of tegen beperkte belkosten telefonisch bereikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de inzameling van scheepsbedrijfsafval in de binnenvaart

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the shipping association ASV withdrew from consultations on ship waste collection, how the process will proceed, and whether more containers, cheaper subscriptions and waste separation will be pursued. The minister answered that ASV will present its ideas separately and at the October sector meeting, that all proposed improvements will be discussed together within a cost-recovery framework, and that expanding waste separation is included in those talks.
I want to discuss the sector's ideas with all involved parties at the same time and jointly assess which improvements are feasible
Ik wil graag de ideeën vanuit de sector met alle betrokken partijen tegelijk bespreken en gezamenlijk bezien welke verbeteringen haalbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Jacobi over het ziekenhuis in Dokkum

MPs Bouwmeester and Jacobi (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health why an agreement on a new care arrangement for the Dokkum hospital is not being implemented, which parties are not honouring it, and whether the NZa will again monitor the process. The Minister regrets the situation, says no single party is to blame, reports no signal that continuity of care is at risk, notes the NZa sees no risks to the duty of care while investigating possible bottlenecks, and calls on all parties to cooperate.
I do not want to comment on the question of who is responsible for what is happening.
Ik wil mij ook niet uitlaten over de vraag door wiens toedoen wat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek in relatie tot oude milieumisdrijven

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked whether soil contamination in the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek had been systematically investigated before deepening, given past environmental scandals, and where dredged sludge would go. The minister answered that extensive soil research (TAUW 2015, MER documents) gave sufficient insight, that most material is clean enough for reuse, and that contaminated sludge goes to the Slufter depot.
With the research carried out, sufficient insight has been gained into the state of the soil.
Met de uitgevoerde onderzoeken is voldoende inzicht gekregen in de staat van de bodem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de certificering van zeegaande zeilschepen

Two MPs asked the minister about outsourcing certification of sailing ships to classification societies, replacing Register Holland, including tender concerns, price rises and transition timing. The minister answered that EU rules require EU-recognised classification societies, that the ILT will oversee the transfer and arbitrate interpretation disputes, that prices will rise without a known amount, and that the transfer is planned between October 2016 and mid-2017.
I have instructed the Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate to closely supervise the transition.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport de opdracht gegeven de overgang intensief te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over de verscherpte Stempelplicht Opvarenden van de Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Rotterdam Seaport Police has tightened application of the Schengen Borders Code, shortening stays of foreign crew and limiting shipowners' freedom to deploy their crews, and why existing practice was abandoned. The government answers that the police apply the Code no more strictly than before, that exit stamps are given only when departure is imminent (about 300 persons were not stamped), and that it will work with the sector until 1 October to reach a workable implementation.
The Rotterdam Seaport Police does not apply the Schengen Borders Code more strictly than before.
De Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam past de Schengengrenscode niet strikter toe dan voorheen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over ‘Toezichthouders MCL gaan er fors op vooruit’ (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Wet normering topinkomens, which raised the maximum pay for supervisory board members, invites supervisors to rush to the new maximum, especially in healthcare, and whether the stated reason for the increase (compensating for lower executive pay) was accurate. The minister answered that the increase reflects broader supervisory roles and greater actual time spent, that individual agreements must stay within the law, and that the increase was separately motivated in the legislative process.
Any increases in remuneration must also be seen in the context of this broadening of roles, responsibilities and time commitment.
Eventuele verhogingen van de bezoldiging moeten ook in het kader van deze verruiming van de rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en tijdsbesteding worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Vermue en Bisschop over de veiligheid van binnen- en zeevaart op de Westerschelde

MPs asked whether shipping safety on the Westerschelde is adequate and whether a speed limit for sea-going vessels should be imposed after complaints from inland skippers about wash damage. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes existing separation measures and evaluation mechanisms, argues a speed limit would not solve the problem and could worsen safety, and says the issue will be discussed in the existing nautical platform.
Imposing a speed limit may actually adversely affect safety on the Westerschelde.
Het opleggen van een snelheidsbeperking kan de veiligheid op de Westerschelde juist nadelig beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Grote misstanden bij aanleg Friese autoweg’

MPs Kerstens, Jacobi and Monasch asked Minister Asscher about FNV reports of systematic underpayment of workers on the Friesland road project 'De Centrale As', and about the responsibilities of contracting authorities under the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said he could not judge the allegations, pointed to social partners and the Inspectorate SZW as the proper investigators, and described contractor liability and existing information efforts for lower governments, while committing to monitoring the law but not to new action.
It is extremely difficult for me to form a judgement on the FNV's allegations of underpayment by parties involved in the construction of 'De Centrale As'.
Het is voor mij buitengewoon lastig om mij een oordeel te vormen over de door de FNV gedane beweringen t.a.v. onderbetaling door partijen die bij de aanleg van «De Centrale As» zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over de buitenproportionele hoge tarieven van bellen en internetten buiten de Europese Unie

MPs Jacobi and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why mobile calling and internet tariffs outside the EU are far higher than inside it, and whether he would regulate them or amend the Telecommunications Act. The minister answered that non-EU roaming tariffs are unregulated and undesirable, but he will not regulate them domestically because wholesale rates would make providers loss-making, and he sees the matter as an EU/ITU/WTO negotiation issue.
I do not intend to make agreements with providers in the Netherlands to regulate tariffs for calling and internet use outside the European Union.
Ik ben niet voornemens om afspraken te maken met providers in Nederland om tarieven voor bellen en internetten buiten de Europese Unie te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de mogelijkheid voor consumenten om bij annulering van een vliegticket deze over te kunnen dragen aan een ander

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked why consumers can transfer package holidays but not airline tickets, and whether the government would allow resale of cancelled flight tickets as proposed by TradeYourTrip. The minister answered that package transfers are governed by Civil Code rules, airline resale is banned by IATA-based airline terms, and that the government will consult industry and consumer groups and examine feasibility, fraud and safety implications.

I will, together with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment, enter into discussions with the Consumentenbond, industry bodies such as ANVR and BARIN, and airlines to discuss the possibilities and implications.

Ik zal in samenwerking met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu in gesprek gaan met de Consumentenbond, brancheorganisaties zoals de ANVR en de BARIN en luchtvaartmaatschappijen om de mogelijkheden en implicaties te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de CvO-plicht betreffende sleepboten

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the mandatory inspection certificate (CvO) for tugboats is proportionate for recreational boating, and whether enforcement would be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the problems, said talks with the sector were ongoing and enforcement for small tugs was suspended pending their outcome, but gave no firm commitment to change the rules.
Pending the outcome of these talks, the ILT has for now suspended enforcement of the CvO obligation for small tugboats intended or used to tow small vessels.

In afwachting van de uitkomst van deze gesprekken heeft de ILT de handhaving op de CvO-plicht voor kleine sleepboten die zijn bestemd of worden gebruikt om kleine schepen te slepen vooralsnog opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de uitvoering van het programma Stroomlijn, deelgebied 1 en 2)

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about public opposition to the Stroomlijn flood-safety vegetation-clearing programme, the balance with nature protection, the role of residents and organisations, the beaver habitat, the mid-term evaluation and the lack of compensation for felled trees. The minister answered that the programme is proportionate, consulted stakeholders, that the mid-term evaluation was completed and found the goals achievable, and that compensation is limited because most protected nature is spared.
Yes, the mid-term evaluation of the Stroomlijn programme has now been carried out.
Ja, de tussenevaluatie van het programma Stroomlijn is inmiddels uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over kaalslag in broedgebied Keteleiland

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked whether clearing a ten-metre vegetation strip on Keteleiland during the bird breeding season was lawful under the Flora and Fauna Act, why it was done then, and what alternatives existed. The minister said the Act permits work if nesting birds are not disturbed, that a survey found insufficient distance from some nests but no significant loss of breeding success, that the clearing was necessary for bank stability, navigation safety and flood risk, and that a Ministry of Economic Affairs investigation is ongoing.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, as competent authority for the Flora and Fauna Act, is currently having further investigation carried out.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, als bevoegd gezag voor de Flora en Faunawet, laat momenteel nader onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over de beperkte bescherming van de consumenten wanneer het misgaat bij het overstappen van abonnementen met een overstapservice

MPs Jacobi and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why consumers are left paying double telecom subscription fees when a provider's switching service goes wrong, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the new provider is responsible for cancelling the old contract, that few complaints exist, and that the government sees no reason for measures beyond the self-regulated service improvements and the Geschillencommissie route.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over de bescherming van broedvogels in het waddengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about declining breeding bird populations in the Wadden Sea, the consistency of cross-border monitoring figures, the need for stronger trilateral cooperation, and whether current protection policy should be revised. The State Secretary answered that the figures are consistent with national monitoring, pointed to the trilateral Action Plan for breeding birds and a national offensive under the 'Naar een Rijke Waddenzee' programme, and stated that multiple parties' involvement does not hinder effective policy.
My aim is that the managers and governments involved will, each within their own responsibility, make efforts to reverse this decline in breeding success.
Mijn inzet is dat de betrokken beheerders en overheden vanuit ieders verantwoordelijkheid zich zullen inspannen om deze achteruitgang van het broedsucces te keren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de zorgen van waterschappen over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about water boards' concerns over deepening the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek, including salinisation, groundwater, freshwater supply and whether source-based mitigation was considered beyond compensation. The minister answered that source measures are not feasible per the MER, that the permit procedure is ongoing and monitoring and conditions will be set in the Ontgrondingenwet permit, while declining to anticipate the draft decision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Nijboer over afvalwater van NAM in de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports that NAM would discharge treated production water into the Wadden Sea via the Eems, and why NAM does not simply choose the purification-and-discharge option. The minister replied that the re-injection alternatives are still under evaluation with a decision expected in December 2016, that composition monitoring classifies the injection water as non-hazardous, and that he does not recognise the portrayal of NAM as cost-evading.
The supervisory committee's task is to check whether the research process is transparent and that the questions and concerns in the region are taken into account in the study.
De begeleidingscommissie heeft als taak om te controleren of het onderzoeksproces transparant verloopt, en dat de vragen en zorgen die leven in de regio worden meegenomen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de Belastingdienst die in publiekscontacten in Friesland niet in het Fries communiceert

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the Tax Authority refuses to speak Frisian on its public phone line in Friesland and whether it must comply with the Frisian Language Use Act. The government answered that Leeuwarden tax office can communicate in Frisian in person and in writing, that the national Tax Telephone Service is not obliged to offer Frisian, and that it will discuss the DINGtiid advice on a language officer before deciding on follow-up.
It is true that taxpayers are not spoken to in Frisian on the Tax Telephone Service.
Het klopt dat belastingplichtigen bij de Belastingtelefoon niet in het Fries te woord worden gestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de vervanging van een dorpswindmolen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a village windmill replacement in Reduzum, and the Friesland wind-energy targets, are consistent with the national wind action plan and what role the Rijk should play in local energy initiatives. The minister replied that the provinces are responsible for local projects, that his role is to set frameworks and subsidies, and that Friesland's 2020 wind target is at risk but the Kop van Afsluitdijk project may now be realised on time.
It is the responsibility of the provinces, in consultation with municipalities and the local population, to decide on concrete initiatives such as this project.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om in overleg met gemeenten en de lokale bevolking te beslissen over concrete initiatieven zoals dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het retourneren van kleding bij Perry Sport

An MP asked the government about consumers losing refunds, gift cards and online return rights because of the Perry Sport bankruptcy, and why the 14-day online return right differs from in-store purchases. The minister answered that consumers must file claims with the curator or administrator, that the return right can be enforced only while the business continues under the curator's supervision, and that in-store purchases lack a statutory cooling-off period because the goods can be inspected beforehand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Otwin van Dijk over de stand van zaken rondom projecten waarbij medicijnresten uit het water worden gezuiverd

MPs Jacobi and Otwin van Dijk asked about the halting of a pilot medicine-residue water treatment installation at Isala hospital, its cost-effectiveness, and related Pharmafilter projects. The state secretary answered that the Isala installation was a time-limited research facility now stopped due to high operating costs, that treatment is being explored in a broader chain approach, and that no specific new commitments were made beyond further reviews.
The installation was stopped because there are currently no new research questions related to it and its operating costs are considerable.
De installatie is stopgezet omdat er op dit moment geen nieuwe onderzoeksvragen in relatie tot deze installatie zijn en de exploitatiekosten van de installatie aanzienlijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Veldhoven over de opsporingsvergunning bij Grou

MPs Jacobi and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Vermilion's exploration permit near Grou/Akkrum, including whether the permit could be revoked for delays, the location of the test drilling, the Leeuwarden council motion against new gas extraction, and the relation between gas exploration and geothermal energy. The minister answered that Vermilion met the notification requirement, that the delay is not Vermilion's fault so revocation is not warranted, and that gas and geothermal development rarely compete.
If this did not have the desired effect, I am entitled to revoke the exploration permit.
Als dit niet tot het gewenste effect zou leiden, dan ben ik gerechtigd om de opsporingsvergunning in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht ‘machtige lobby houdt scheepvaart milieuvervuilend’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether shipping is held back on sustainability by a powerful lobby, and what measures exist for LNG uptake, enforcement of emission rules, a European fine system and global climate rules for shipping. The minister answered that shipping is globally regulated via the IMO, outlined LNG incentives and port discounts, said enforcement is being intensified without seeing signs of weak enforcement, and described a phased IMO approach to shipping CO2 emissions.
I have no signals that the European environmental rules on emissions of harmful substances from ships are being poorly enforced.
Ik heb geen signalen dat de Europese milieuregels omtrent de uitstoot van schadelijke stoffen door schepen slecht worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gifuitstoot van de afvaloven in Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the State Secretary about a technical fault at the Harlingen waste incinerator that raised dioxin emissions for two days in October 2015, and about health risks, causes, measures and monitoring. The government answered that the province and municipality found no clear effect on local dioxin levels, that the province imposed penalty-backed orders on the operator, and that monitoring is carried out under accredited, independent measurement rules.
The province of Fryslân has instructed REC Harlingen to make additional efforts within two months to further reduce dioxin emissions during malfunctions and the chance of malfunctions.
De provincie Fryslân heeft REC Harlingen opgedragen binnen twee maanden extra inspanningen te verrichten om de dioxine-emissie tijdens storingen en de kans op storingen verder omlaag te krijgen.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gevolgen van jarenlang gebruik van PFOA bij Dupont in Dordrecht

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about long-term PFOA use at DuPont (now Chemours) in Dordrecht, including undisclosed blood test results, unpermitted emissions, drinking water contamination, and calls for a population health study. The state secretary answered that the company is responsible for sharing blood results, that a RIVM exposure study and an Inspectie SZW investigation are underway, that polluter-pays rules apply, and that a stricter drinking water guideline is being prepared.

For privacy reasons and because of the medical confidentiality of the company doctor, results traceable to individual employees may not simply be shared with the Labour Inspectorate (or any other government body).

Uit privacyoverwegingen en vanwege het medisch beroepsgeheim van de betrokken bedrijfsarts mogen naar individuele werknemers herleidbare uitslagen niet zonder meer met de Inspectie SZW (of enig ander overheidsorgaan) worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jacobi over de handhaving van cao’s

MPs Yücel and Jacobi asked whether all childcare and early-education staff should be paid under the Peuterspeelzaalwerk collective agreement, whether the government monitors salary developments during municipal harmonisation, and what tools it has to enforce collective agreements. The minister answered that several collective agreements apply, that salary agreements are for social partners, and that the Inspectie SZW can investigate enforcement only at the request of social partners, with compliance being primarily their responsibility.
It is up to social partners to make agreements on salaries in the harmonisation of child care facilities.
Het is aan sociale partners om afspraken te maken over de salarissen bij de harmonisatie van de kindvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het gebrek aan autoafzetplaatsen langs de Rijn in Duitsland

An MP asked the minister whether the government would press Germany to provide more car-unloading and mooring places along the Rhine for Dutch inland shipping. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said the matter lies with the German Länder and federal authorities, and said the government raised it through regular contacts and would pass it on to the CCR and EU.
I have also asked my contact at the federal government to pass the signals on to the responsible regional authorities.
Ik heb mijn contactpersoon bij de federale overheid ook gevraagd de signalen door te geleiden naar de verantwoordelijke regionale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over laad- en losfaciliteiten aan de Spijksedijk in de gemeente Rijnwaarden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the wish of the municipality of Rijnwaarden for additional water-bound loading and unloading facilities at the Spijksedijk, including the feasibility study commissioned by the province, the role of Rijkswaterstaat, possible modal shift, and financial contributions. The minister answered that the initiative lies first with business, municipality and province, that Rijkswaterstaat is only competent for the water permit, that no national financial scheme exists for such private initiatives, and that the province will decide on follow-up after further research.
This is first and foremost a matter for business, the municipality and the province.
Dit is allereerst een zaak van het bedrijfsleven, de gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Aukje de Vries over stremmingen op de Afsluitdijk

MPs Jacobi and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about repeated breakdowns and closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, prevention and whether postponed maintenance is involved. The minister answered that storm-related disruptions stem mainly from ageing control systems being replaced in 2016, that emergency response and repair times are being shortened, and that maintenance is not postponed for the Afsluitdijk project.
In anticipation of the planned major maintenance, Rijkswaterstaat has started additional inspections of critical components to prevent breakdowns.
Vooruitlopend op het geplande groot onderhoud is Rijkswaterstaat gestart met extra inspecties van kritische onderdelen, om storingen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over waterveiligheid in het kustgebied

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked the minister about the proposal to allow more building along the Dutch coast, the adequacy of coastal defences, changes to the Barro rules, decentralisation of coastal quality policy and related stakeholder demands. The minister answered that the current coastal rules stay unchanged for now, that a renewed consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that coastal safety is currently well in order, though many answers restate policy without detailing specific safeguards.
In addition, I have indicated that I will again consult the relevant societal and administrative parties on coastal policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aangegeven dat ik opnieuw in overleg zal treden met de betrokken maatschappelijke en bestuurlijke partijen over het kustbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de gevolgen van de nieuwe loodsplicht voor kleine Nederlandse zeeschepen

An MP asked the minister about the effects of the new pilotage obligation on small Dutch sea vessels and whether they would be disadvantaged. The minister described the timetable, confirmed that exemptions will be tied to captain, ship and route, and promised calculations of effects while admitting some tightening for registered vessels.
After that I will bring the final proposal into procedure in the form of draft legislation.
Daarna zal ik het definitieve voorstel in de vorm van conceptwetgeving in procedure brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over vissterfte bij waterkrachtcentrales

An MP asked the minister about fish mortality at the Linne and Lith hydropower plants on the Maas, which exceeds the 10% norm, and about progress on a motion and enforcement. The minister answered that consultations with operators have led to a requirement to submit a permit application by 1 July 2016, with enforcement possible afterwards, but gave no firm timeline for reaching the norm.
If no admissible application is received after 1 July 2016, I will consider further steps, including initiating an enforcement procedure.
Indien na 1 juli 2016 geen ontvankelijke aanvraag is ontvangen, zal ik mij beraden omtrent de verder te nemen stappen, waaronder het opstarten van een handhavingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat een omstreden onkruidverdelger in wil zetten langs de IJssel

MPs Leenders and Jacobi asked how Rijkswaterstaat's planned use of the contested herbicide glyphosate along the IJssel fits with the upcoming ban on glyphosate use and whether safety grounds justify an exception even when alternatives exist. The minister answers that current rules allow glyphosate on stumps, that Rijkswaterstaat applies a stricter-than-required policy, that an exception for safety-critical cases is planned in a ministerial regulation, and that water contamination risk is negligible.
Nevertheless, Rijkswaterstaat preferably does not use crop protection products in management and maintenance.
Desalniettemin gebruikt Rijkswaterstaat bij voorkeur geen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen bij beheer en onderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Yücel over het voornemen van het waterschap Delfland de kwijtschelding van de afvalwaterzuiveringsheffing in twee stappen geheel af te schaffen

MPs Jacobi and Yücel asked whether the Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission (kwijtschelding) of the wastewater treatment levy would hurt low-income households and whether national government should intervene. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards are autonomous in remission policy, that consultations with the Unie van Waterschappen took place, and that social minimum safety nets such as bijstand and municipal compensation exist, with no national intervention planned.

At the same time it was established that the individual water boards are themselves responsible for their own remission policy and account for it to the general board of the water board, which is democratically elected.

Tegelijkertijd is vastgesteld dat de individuele waterschappen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun eigen kwijtscheldingsbeleid en dat zij hierover verantwoording afleggen aan het algemeen bestuur van het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de aanpak van (micro)plastics in de Rijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about microplastic pollution of the Rhine, its contribution to the North Sea, and whether current national and EU policy is adequate. The minister said the Rhine is an important source, outlined national measures (waste reduction, phasing out primary microplastics in cosmetics by 2017) and EU/OSPAR efforts, and offered to raise the issue with German and Swiss counterparts.
In addition, I am willing to raise the approach to microplastic sources via the Rhine during my regular contacts with German and Swiss counterparts.
Daarnaast ben ik bereid om de bronaanpak van microplastics via de Rijn aan de orde te stellen tijdens mijn reguliere contacten met de Duitse en Zwitserse ambtsgenoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch inzake de gaswinning in Súdwest-Fryslân

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why he proceeds with the Oppenhuizen gas extraction and pipeline despite opposition from the municipality and province, and about the peat soil, the expected subsidence and the scale of the field. The minister replied that he is legally bound to decide on the winning plan regardless of local opposition, that subsidence will be assessed and monitored by Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen and TNO with mandatory plan revision if it deviates, and that Vermilion will engage in local consultations and agreements.
This political position of the municipality and province does not, however, release me from my legal responsibilities and the applicable legal framework.
Deze politieke stellingname van gemeente en provincie ontslaat mij echter niet van mijn wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden en de daarbij geldende wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dik-Faber inzake het Wob-verzoek over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Jacobi and Dik-Faber asked why the Minister had not yet answered a Wob (freedom of information) request on salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, which was more than five months old. The Minister replied that the information was provided on 18 November 2015, after an inventory of 558 documents required considerable review and coordination.
The Wob request submitted on 29 May 2015 was picked up immediately at the time.
Het op 29 mei 2015 ingediende Wob-verzoek is indertijd direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over het werkbezoek aan Port of Twente en de daar gevestigde bedrijven d.d. 30 november 2015

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked the minister how she will limit the lengthy closure of Twente Canal locks during renovation, whether business was consulted on alternatives, and whether a long closure fits the policy of stimulating water transport. The minister answered that the tender challenges the market to minimise closure days (maximum 35), that business was consulted on temporary loading points, and that phasing the works is not an option because it would lengthen total closure.
I am preparing the tender for the renovation of the Delden and Hengelo lock complexes in the Twente Canal.
Ik bereid de aanbesteding voor van de renovatie van de sluiscomplexen Delden en Hengelo in het Twentekanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het wegpompen van grondwater bij de A4 Midden-Delfland

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the Minister about groundwater pumping at the A4 Midden-Delfland tunnel, including its causes, responsibility, impacts and whether the road can open by year-end. The Minister confirmed the problem, said the contractor is responsible for design and construction, and deferred the outcome to a pending Hoogheemraadschap decision expected in December, while describing further measures and reporting to the Chamber if desired.
Given the ongoing procedure at the Hoogheemraadschap, I do not want to anticipate the outcome of this procedure.
Ik wil gezien de lopende procedure bij het Hoogheemraadschap niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van deze procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Recourt over het gebruik van de  Friese taal in de rechtbank

MPs Jacobi and Recourt asked the Minister of Justice whether the decision to hear a Friesland-linked case in Zwolle rather than Leeuwarden was consistent with court presidents' statements that regionally tied cases can be heard locally. The minister answered that the Overijssel court moved the hearing to Zwolle to shorten travel, that Friesland is outside its jurisdiction, and that the statements concern allocation within one court.
The options for the Overijssel court regarding the choice of hearing location for a case are limited to the hearing venues within its own jurisdiction.
De mogelijkheden voor de rechtbank Overijssel ten aanzien van de keuze voor de locatie van behandeling van een zaak beperken zich tot de zittingsplaatsen binnen het eigen rechtsgebied
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van de kankerverwekkende stof perfluoroctaanzuur (ook wel PFOA of C8) bij DuPont in Dordrecht

MPs Jacobi, Cegerek and Wolbert asked the government about PFOA (C8) use at DuPont in Dordrecht, including health risks, the company's blood-monitoring data not being shared with the inspectorate, and whether specific environmental health research was ever done. The government answered that the inspectorate lacks the data, that the environmental permits followed national guidelines, and that it will ask RIVM to prepare a study on possible health effects.
The company concerned has not shared the research data with the Inspectorate SZW.
Het betreffende bedrijf heeft de onderzoeksgegevens niet met Inspectie SZW gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Jacobi en Ypma over het bericht van kindermishandeling in een tehuis voor jongeren met het Prader-Willi syndroom

Three PvdA MPs asked about reports of systematic abuse of residents at a Prader-Willi youth home under enhanced Inspectorate supervision, and whether the home should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ found no evidence of abuse in its visits, that a prosecution was dropped for insufficient evidence, and that the home remains under monitoring with a follow-up inspection pending.
The Northern Netherlands district public prosecution service opened a criminal investigation following complaints by former staff about abuse.
Het arrondissementsparket Noord-Nederland heeft een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar aanleiding van aangiftes door oud-medewerkers over mishandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over het afschaffen van de kwijtschelding van de heffing voor de zuivering van afvalwater door het waterschap Delfland

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked about Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission of its wastewater treatment levy, its consistency with the Unie van Waterschappen advice and interbestuurlijke cooperation, and effects on low incomes and municipal debt and poverty policy. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards decide on remission democratically, that the Waterwet cooperation is unaffected by levy remission, and that the Staatssecretaris will invite the Unie van Waterschappen for a discussion.
The starting point is the freedom of each water board to shape and determine its remission policy in a democratic deliberative process.
Voorop staat de vrijheid van elk waterschap om zijn kwijtscheldingsbeleid in een democratisch afwegingsproces vorm en inhoud te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht dat de Maas in Limburg sinds 4 augustus 2015 ongeschikt zou zijn voor drinkwaterwinning door een chemische lozing van pyrazool door het bedrijf Sitech op het industr

MP Jacobi asked whether the Maas has been unfit for drinking water since a pyrazole discharge from Sitech at Chemelot, and what the central government's role is. The minister denies the river is unfit, explains that the water board Roer en Overmaas is the competent authority and that the national government supports the drinking water companies and monitors the issue.
The competent authority lies with the Waterschap Roer en Overmaas, because discharge takes place into a regional water, the Ur (a tributary of the Maas).
Het bevoegd gezag ligt bij het Waterschap Roer en Overmaas, omdat wordt geloosd op een regionaal water, de Ur (een zijriviertje van de Maas).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Recourt over het gebruik van de Friese taal in de rechtszaal

MPs Jacobi and Recourt asked why a Frisian-only mestsilo case was assigned to Almelo rather than Friesland, and whether defendants may be tried in Frisian. The minister explained that specialist Functioneel Parket cases are concentrated at four courts, and that the court has moved the hearing to Zwolle to reduce travel while offering a Frisian interpreter.
Since the case could also have been heard in Almelo in Frisian with the help of a Frisian interpreter, there was no reason to deviate from this arrangement.
Aangezien de behandeling van de zaak ook in Almelo in het Fries had kunnen plaatsvinden met behulp van een tolk Fries, was er geen reden om van deze afspraak af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jacobi over de strenge regionaliteitsregels voor regionale commerciële radiozenders

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Rotterdam court ruling that strictly interpreted regionality rules for regional commercial radio, including birthplace criteria and the size of the region. The minister defended the Agentschap Telecom interpretation, appealed the ruling on the digital-range point, declined to loosen the rules for the next licensing period, and said the agency has an independent duty to enforce the law.
The Agentschap Telecom has an independent responsibility (and competence) to enforce the law.
Het Agentschap Telecom heeft een eigenstandige verantwoordelijkheid (en bevoegdheid) om de wet te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de afsluiting van het kreeftenvang-seizoen op de Oosterschelde

Two MPs asked whether intensive lobster fishing at the end of the season on the Oosterschelde keeps prices down and causes animal suffering, and whether the government will investigate stopping it. The state secretary confirmed intensified late-season fishing and said prices fluctuate seasonally, found no evidence of greater damage, and declined to restrict fishing because only stock and nature considerations, not market prices, are decisive.
Solely stock considerations and nature interests are decisive for this, as I already informed your House in my letter of 26 March 2015 on lobster fishing in the Oosterschelde.
Uitsluitend bestandsoverwegingen en natuurbelangen zijn hiervoor bepalend, zoals ik uw Kamer reeds heb medegedeeld met mijn brief d.d. 26 maart 2015 over de kreeftenvisserij in de Oosterschelde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Jacobi en Van Dekken over mogelijke schade door zoutwinning aan de flora en fauna van werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responds to a study by environmental groups showing the Wadden Sea seabed could subside from salt extraction, harming birds' feeding and the World Heritage site, and why it conflicts with the industry consultant's findings. The State Secretary declined to give a substantive response, citing the ongoing appeal before the Council of State's administrative law division, and promised to inform the House after that ruling.
In light of this, I do not wish to give a substantive response to the mentioned research report at this time.
In dit licht wil ik nu geen inhoudelijke reactie geven op het genoemde onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de positie van zeilende zeegaande en binnenvaartpassagiersschepen en motorpassagiersschepen binnen de Woningwet, Omgevingswet en de Erfgoedwet

Two MPs asked whether sailing sea-going and inland passenger ships and motor passenger ships should fall under the building definition in the Woningwet and Omgevingswet, given their minor residential use. The minister agreed they should not be treated as buildings, said this will be clarified in the explanatory memorandum, and promised further information on the heritage vessel position by year end.
