Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi inzake het vrijgekomen asbest bij een grote brand in Harlingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about asbestos released in a large fire in a Harlingen warehouse, including health risks, whether residents were warned via NL-Alert, and fire prevention. The secretary said the fire was probably arson, a certified firm found no asbestos spread by smoke, residents were advised to close windows, and existing building rules are considered sufficient, with no new measures promised.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de oproep van de Vereniging van waterbedrijven in Nederland (Vewin) om de waterkwaliteit te verbeteren

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about a list of 62 measures to improve water quality proposed by the drinking water association Vewin, including whether the government requested it and whether it will be included in the National Water Plan. The minister welcomed the list, said it was drawn up after a meeting with drinking water companies, and promised a further discussion with Vewin and a debate in parliament before the measures are finalised in the National Water Plan.
The definitive package of measures will be included in the National Water Plan and the river basin management plans for the Water Framework Directive that form part of it.
Het definitieve pakket maatregelen zal worden opgenomen in het Nationaal Waterplan en de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen voor de Kaderrichtlijn Water die daarvan onderdeel uitmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de financiële problemen bij onderzoeksinstituut NIOZ en de gevolgen voor NIOZ-Yerseke

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked about NIOZ's financial problems and the reported plan to close the Yerseke branch and move staff to Texel, questioning the government's commitment to Zeeland. The Secretaries answer that the financial problems are real, that options including concentration on Texel are being studied with regional parties, that no irreversible decisions have been taken, and that a broader regional knowledge strategy is under review.
There is currently intensive consultation with the province and the municipality, and no irreversible decisions have yet been taken.
Er is inmiddels intensief overleg met de provincie en de gemeente en er zijn nog geen onomkeerbare besluiten genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar bodem Wijnaldum’ in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports on soil subsidence in Wijnaldum, whether the Tcbb only examines mining-related causes, and whether residents get timely compensation and burden-of-proof reversal. The minister explained the Tcbb's legal mandate and compensation procedure, said damage to public infrastructure is handled faster through agreements, and referred to earlier letters on reversing the burden of proof.
It is in the interest of both the citizen and the mining company that the correct cause of the damage is established.
Het is zowel in het belang van de burger als van de mijnbouwonderneming dat de juiste oorzaak van de schade wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de bruine vloot en de mogelijkheden om in Denemarken te varen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the deadline for certifying Dutch sailing ships (the 'bruine vloot') to sail to Danish ports could be postponed to winter, and whether she would negotiate with Denmark. The minister replied that a formalised solution now lets such ships sail to Denmark on a declaration of compliance plus a certified safety management system due by year-end.
I am pleased to inform you that the solution proposal about which I informed you earlier has been formalised.
Met genoegen kan ik u melden dat het oplossingsvoorstel waarover ik u eerder heb geïnformeerd, is geformaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de compensatie aan vissers op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the delayed 340,000 euro compensation for IJsselmeer fishers, the allocation key proposed by the producers' organisation, and whether illegal shad fishing affects compensation. The State Secretary answered that the money has been paid to a transition foundation which passes it to the producers' organisation, that the allocation key is left to that organisation under the 2014 agreement, and that illegal fishing has no effect on the compensation.
The administrative agreement stipulates that the allocation key is determined by the PO.
In het bestuurlijk akkoord is afgesproken dat de verdeelsleutel door de PO wordt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de problemen die de bruine vloot ondervindt in Denemarken

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the status of a deal with Denmark allowing Dutch commercial sailing charter vessels to sail in Danish waters, the BBZ's concerns, and whether ILT inspections would be done in time before 1 April. The minister said the solution is being formalised with Denmark, the BBZ will endorse it, certification will be done by Bureau Veritas with ILT as fallback, and extra time is being sought with Denmark for implementing the safety management system.
I am therefore in consultation with Denmark to allow extra time for this.
Ik ben daarom in overleg met Denemarken om hiervoor extra tijd in te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Bosman en Visser over het strandvissen met kleine fuiken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether the ban on recreational eel fyke-netting in Zeeland's beach fishing could be reconsidered given its heritage status and the Waddeneilanden exception. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies nationwide, enforcement would be disproportionate, and the eel stock remains critical, so there is no reason to reopen the ban or consult again.
I therefore see no reason to revisit the position of my predecessors or to enter into consultation on this again.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op het standpunt van mijn ambtsvoorgangers terug te komen en hierover opnieuw in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken over de “toename van antibiotica in water”

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about rising antibiotics in surface water, including whether swimmers could develop resistance and whether drinking water is at risk, and what steps would reduce emissions. The government answered that no research shows low antibiotic concentrations cause resistance in swimmers, that drinking water treatment is effective and meets norms, that residues come from both livestock and human use, and that an integrated approach letter will follow before summer.
No research data are known on the presence of antibiotics specifically in Dutch recreational waters.
Over de aanwezigheid van antibiotica specifiek in Nederlandse recreatiewateren zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over douanecontroles op de Waddenzee

MP Jacobi asked whether customs inspections on the Wadden Sea will only occur after emergencies or third-party reports due to cuts in staff and inspections, and whether the crew of the Stormmeeuw will be cut. State Secretary Wiebes denies that inspections will be limited to emergencies, arguing that two fast, intelligence-driven vessels will replace the slower patrol boat, and says crew members are being redeployed by Rijkswaterstaat.
It is not correct that the inspection of the Wadden Sea by Customs will only take place in emergencies and on reports from third parties.
Het is niet correct dat de controle op de Waddenzee door de Douane alleen nog maar bij calamiteiten en meldingen van derden zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Van Dekken over de gaswinningsplannen op en rond Terschelling

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tulip Oil's gas extraction plans near Terschelling, including CO2 content, risks to the island's freshwater supply, use of harmful substances, and how national interest is weighed against nature and water protection. The Minister answered that the CO2 share (about 14%) and the feasibility of reinjection await TNO and Energiebeheer Nederland advice, that risks to freshwater and substances will be assessed in the EIA after permit approval, and that further decisions under the national coordination regime will follow.
I first await these advices before I can address concrete quantities of gas (or CO2).
Ik wacht eerst deze adviezen af, alvorens ik kan ingaan op concrete hoeveelheden gas (of CO 2 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Jacobi over de aanwezigheid van de politie in Friesland

MPs Marcouch and Jacobi asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police response times and presence in Friesland, including missed 15-minute targets in the North Netherlands unit and whether police posts had closed. The minister confirmed the target was missed in 2014 but improving since 2012, listed measures taken, said no posts in Friesland had closed since 2012, and stated that cell facilities on the Wadden islands exist for the first six hours with transfer to the mainland beyond that.
Yes, the police target standard was not met in North Netherlands in 2014.
Ja, de streefnorm van de politie is in Noord-Nederland in 2014 niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Jacobi over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Leeuwarden

MPs Recourt and Jacobi asked whether plans could cost at least 54 jobs at the Leeuwarden Court of Appeal and how this fits earlier assurances of no relocations. The Minister replied that no decision has been taken, that four scenarios are being explored (three involve moving jobs within the court's area, two of them moving 54 jobs from Leeuwarden), and that the Rvdr will report soon.
The Rvdr will inform me shortly of its findings following the discussions with court boards and its own research.
De Rvdr informeert mij binnenkort over zijn bevindingen naar aanleiding van de gesprekken met gerechtsbesturen en eigen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over visserijproblemen op het Lauwersmeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about intensive commercial fyke-net fishing on the Lauwersmeer and whether a fishing company complies with its lease conditions, including participation in the fish stock management committee. The State Secretary confirmed the concerns, described a 2015 enforcement action and a report for late return of fyke nets, explained the sanctions available under criminal and private law, and said the existing fish management plan suffices while a new statutory regime is being prepared.

At a control action at the beginning of this year, however, a official report was drawn up against this commercial fisherman for failing to empty the fyke nets in time (and after being called upon to do so), as a result of which unnecessary mortality of the bycaught scaled fish occurred.

Bij een controleactie begin van dit jaar is wel een proces verbaal opgemaakt tegen deze beroepsvisser vanwege het niet tijdig (en na oproep hiertoe) legen van de fuiken als gevolg waarvan onnodige sterfte van de bijgevangen schubvis optrad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de herintroductie van de Atlantische zalm naar aanleiding van de antwoorden op eerdere vragen

Jacobi (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about staand want fishing permits at the Rotterdam harbour mouth, the 500m fishing-free zone at the Haringvliet sluices, survival of discarded protected fish from seine fishing, and causes of declining fish stocks. Dijksma answered that the three historic permits (only two in use) are not new, that the zone is set in the Uitvoeringsregeling, that seine-caught discards survive well, and that a 2012 study found no overfishing in the Benedenrivieren area.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de invloed van de muizenplaag op veendijken in Friesland

An MP asked the ministers about the vole plague damaging Frisian peat dykes, including safety risks and measures to prevent future damage. The ministers answered that damage to primary defences is limited (about 10 km of 200 km), that the water board repairs it and has contingency plans, and that a study into vole control and early warning is underway.
The water board repairs the damage and has contingency plans in place, with which damage can if necessary be repaired using clay applied by cranes, sandbags and rock armouring.
Het Wetterskip herstelt de schade en heeft calamiteitenplannen achter de hand, waarmee schade zo nodig met door kranen aan te brengen klei, zandzakken en steenbestorting kan worden hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de herintroductie van de Atlantische zalm

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the declining return of Atlantic salmon after reintroduction, the alleged role of new fishing permits and by-catch, and measures to improve the outcome. The State Secretary disputed that new permits were issued, cited research attributing losses mainly to conditions at sea, and pointed to the planned Haringvliet sluice opening (Kier) in 2018 and ongoing international coordination.
I cannot agree with that. Contrary to the claims, there are no new permits, and this fishery does have restrictions, which have not recently been changed.

Dat kan ik niet onderschrijven. In tegenstelling tot de beweringen is er geen sprake van nieuwe vergunningen en kent de betreffende visserij wel degelijk beperkingen en zijn deze niet onlangs gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jacobi over het gebruik van verboden bestrijdingsmiddelen op sierplanten

MP Jacobi asked the state secretaries about Greenpeace findings that ornamental plants sold in garden centres contained banned pesticide residues, and about how to stop illegal use. The government shares the concern, says residues may stem from illegal use, storage or imports, promises publication of NVWA compliance measurements, and announces extra enforcement, tougher sanctions and retail-chain certification.
I told your House during the committee meeting on crop protection agents on 4 December 2014 that I find the illegal use of crop protection agents completely unacceptable.
Ik heb uw Kamer tijdens het AO gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op 4 december 2014 aangegeven dat ik het illegaal gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen volstrekt onaanvaardbaar vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

An MP asked the state secretaries whether research showing that neonicotinoids such as imidacloprid also harm birds means the temporary EU moratorium is too limited, and whether the government will act and raise the study in Brussels. The state secretary refers to a separate letter to parliament of 27 October 2014 for all answers, without giving substantive content here.
For the answers to questions 1 through 4 I refer you to the letter to parliament.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 4 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het niet nakomen van afspraken met betrekking tot Hoogwatergeul Veessen-Wapenveld

MP Jacobi asked the minister whether agreements on enforcement support for the Veessen-Wapenveld flood relief channel with the municipality of Heerde were being kept, given a redistribution of tasks between Rijkswaterstaat and the ILT, and whether this fits a reliable government. The minister replied that a joint supervision plan was completed in September 2014, that the ILT will act as competent authority as specified, and that the agreements were kept.
Yes. The earlier agreements were worked out and fulfilled in cooperation with the parties involved.
Ja. De eerder gemaakte afspraken zijn in samenwerking met de betrokken partijen uitgewerkt en nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de financiële verplichtingen voor het grensoverschrijdend Park De Zoom –Kalmthoutse heide

An MP asked whether the national government's withdrawal of structural funding for the cross-border De Zoom-Kalmthoutse Heide park, despite the 2011 extension of a ministerial decision, breaches informal financial commitments and harms relations with Flanders. The minister replied that the decision only provides a formal basis for a commission and no funding, that structural national funding ended as part of budget cuts and decentralisation, that the province of Noord-Brabant is responsible, and that he is willing to consult Flanders if needed.
The decision provides no basis for financial support to the commission itself.
De beschikking geeft geen grondslag voor financiële steun aan de commissie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Jacobi over berichten over mogelijke opslag van kernafval onder de grond in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether there is research into underground storage of nuclear waste in Friesland, what alternatives to final disposal exist, and when final disposal would apply. The minister answered that the OPERA bureau study on Boom clay does not identify suitable sites, that site-specific research is not on the agenda for decades, that a study of long-term options will be sent to parliament by year-end, and that waste is stored at COVRA for at least 100 years before deep disposal.
Site-specific research or a site selection is not on the agenda in the research or in policy for the coming decades.
Locatie specifiek onderzoek of een locatiekeuze is in het onderzoek én in het beleid de komende tientallen jaren niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Jacobi en Kuiken over de plannen voor ontwikkeling van het KNSF-terrein in Muiden

PvdA MPs asked the minister about the draft zoning plan for the former KNSF site in Muiden, including very high building heights, its effect on the Kruitbos nature area, the EUR 376 million damage claim, and Schiphol flight path and Stelling van Amsterdam implications. The minister answered that zoning is the municipality's responsibility and that the Council of State is the appeal forum, while stating that nature agreements are upheld and that the damage claims are frozen pending the plan becoming final.
Under the Spatial Planning Act (Wro), it is the municipality's responsibility to adopt zoning plans for 'good spatial planning'.
Op grond van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening (Wro) is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om bestemmingsplannen vast te stellen ten behoeve van «een goede ruimtelijke ordening».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘gaswinning zorgt opnieuw voor een conflict tussen provincie en het Rijk’

MPs Jacobi, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the national government requires water boards to pay half the cost of strengthening dikes in Groningen because of gas-field economic interests, and how the government will limit gas-extraction harm and fund dike reinforcement. The minister denies any such demand, describes the standard 50/40/10 cost split under the flood protection programme and a separate 100 million euro fund for earthquake-proofing vital infrastructure, and says talks with water boards are ongoing.

There is, however, no requirement from the central government that the water board pay half the costs of dikes that receive a stricter standard because of the economic importance of the gas locations and therefore need to be strengthened.

Er is echter geen sprake van een eis van het Rijk dat het waterschap de helft van de kosten betaalt voor dijken die vanwege het economisch belang van de gaslocaties een strengere norm krijgen en daardoor versterkt zouden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over de verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 bij Lemmer

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked the minister about congestion at A6 exit 17 near Lemmer in the tourist season and whether it creates unsafe situations, and whether temporary measures are planned. The minister answered that no structural congestion or unsafe situation is evident, no temporary measures are planned, and the province of Fryslân is studying N359 ring road improvements with Rijkswaterstaat involved.
As previously indicated, there is currently no unsafe traffic situation on the A6 at Lemmer.
Zoals eerder aangegeven is er op dit moment geen sprake van een verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 ter hoogte bij Lemmer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de inbeslagneming van vee bij een Friese bioboer-oormerkweigeraar

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether the government knew the NVWA had seized cattle from a Frisian organic farmer who refused ear tags, and what it would do to develop alternatives for conscientious objectors. The Secretary of State confirmed the seizure and said a proposal for an alternative identifier was submitted to Brussels but lacked support, that a 20% CAP cut remains under EU rules, and that she will keep pursuing an EU-level alternative and discuss the cut with the Commission.
For the second means of identification, one could for example think of a rumen bolus with a chip or a chip implanted under the skin.
Voor het tweede identificatiemiddel kan bijvoorbeeld gedacht worden aan een maagbolus met een chip of een chip welke onderhuids wordt aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Aukje de Vries, Jacobi en De Rouwe over het behoud van de monumentenstatus molen “Windlust”

MPs asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had advised against keeping the monument status of the Windlust windmill in Burum after a 2012 fire, on what criteria, and why it differs from the Schultehuis in Meppel. The minister answered that the agency started a delisting procedure because 95% of the mill was destroyed, that the municipality advised retaining status, and that a final decision awaits the Raad voor Cultuur's advice.
I will make a final decision on the monument status after receiving both advices.
Ik neem een definitief besluit over de monumentenstatus nadat ik beide adviezen heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Rebel over handhaving dumping drugsafval in de natuur

MPs Jacobi and Rebel asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about enforcement against dumping of drug waste in nature, including whether existing law is adequate, who pays cleanup costs, enforcement numbers and capacity, and expertise. The minister replied that existing Environmental Management Act provisions suffice, that no new rules are planned, that the polluter should pay with waterproofing funds being explored, and that specialist police expertise (LFO) is available.

Further data on the number of drug waste dumpings and the resulting prosecutions, sentences, and collected fines cannot be generated from the business process systems of the Public Prosecution Service and investigative agencies.

Nadere gegevens over aantallen drugsafvaldumpingen en de daarop volgende strafvervolging/strafoplegging en geïnde geldboetes en/of gevangenisstraffen kunnen niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het OM en de opsporingsinstanties worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Ypma over het niet baggeren van de gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Jacobi and Ypma asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat handed over the Gekanaliseerde Hollandsche IJssel to Hoogheemraadschap De Stichtse Rijnlanden without dredging, and whether combined sanitation and maintenance dredging could save costs. The minister confirmed the handover and the EUR 37.5 million lump sum, said sanitation dredging was decoupled and is under joint investigation, and called it worth considering that HDSR undertake the combined dredging.
To allow the GHIJ to be transferred quickly, it was decided at the end of 2012 to decouple the sanitation of the riverbed below the required depth from the December 2012 transfer.
Omwille van het snel kunnen overdragen van de GHIJ is eind 2012 besloten om het saneren van de waterbodem onder de leggerdiepte te ontkoppelen van de overdracht van december 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over het nemen van onomkeerbare maatregelen bij sluis Eefde

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked why a rook colony at lock Eefde is being relocated and irreversible measures taken before the new lock chamber decision and zoning plan are final, and whether the relocation could wait. The minister answered that a Flora and Fauna Act exemption was granted, no objection was filed, no irreversible steps will be taken before the zoning plan is adopted, and relocation must start before the next breeding season.
Moreover, no irreversible measures will be taken pursuant to the exemption before the zoning plan has been adopted.
Overigens worden er ter uitvoering van de ontheffing geen onomkeerbare maatregelen genomen voordat het bestemmingsplan is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Eijsink en Albert de Vries over de rapportage ‘Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde is “tikkende tijdbom”

MPs Jacobi, Eijsink and Albert de Vries asked the ministers whether the WWII munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde pose a danger to people and nature, and whether new research is needed after a media report called it a ticking time bomb. The Minister of Defence answered that TNO research shows spontaneous detonation is practically impossible and that environmental effects are not demonstrated, while monthly water and mussel monitoring will be carried out in 2014 and Parliament will be informed of results if needed.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dumping site will be measured monthly.
In 2014 wordt de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Jacobi en Monasch over de spoorverbinding met Leeuwarden in verband met het besluit Leeuwarden te nomineren als Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary how rail services to Leeuwarden will cope with extra visitors if it is Culturele Hoofdstad 2018, and whether NS will offer incentives or a cultural-capital train. The state secretary answered that rail choice is up to travellers, that organisers should contact NS early about visitor numbers, that discounts and marketing are commercial matters for NS, and that Leeuwarden and NS should take up the train-promotion ideas themselves.
This is primarily a consideration for NS.
Dit is primair een afweging voor NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jacobi over de veiligheid van mestsilo’s

MPs Dikkers and Jacobi asked about the safety of manure silos after a fatal accident in Makkinga, including the adequacy of rules, inspection practices and comparison with neighbouring countries. The minister answered that current rules are adequate, pending the Safety Board's investigation, and that a reaction will be sent to Parliament after publication.
In my view, the current regulations for manure silos and manure gases are adequate.
Mijns inziens is de huidige regelgeving voor mestsilo's en mestgassen adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Vries over de bereikbaarheid van de jachthaven van Schiermonnikoog

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked why the Schiermonnikoog marina will not be dredged in 2013, whether Natura 2000 rules prevent dumping silt for salt-marsh creation, and whether silt disposal can be restored. The minister explains the municipality stopped unpermitted dumping, its 2009 permit was refused for lack of information, and that options including a Rijkswaterstaat disposal arrangement are being explored, with clarity expected in autumn.
In the autumn, more clarity will emerge on this.
In het najaar ontstaat hierover meer duidelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het bericht voorstellen van Rederij Doeksen om de winterdienstregeling te versoberen en de tarieven te verhogen

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the state secretary about Doeksen's plan to cut winter ferry services and raise fares to Terschelling and Vlieland due to competition from EVT, which sails at dumping prices while the concession is suspended pending a court case. The state secretary said he is consulting the island municipalities on short-term options and will report later this summer, and that the best solution is for the concessions to become final, which depends on the pending appeal.
The concessions becoming final would be the best solution to the problem.
Het onherroepelijk worden van de concessies zou de beste oplossing voor het probleem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen Jacobi over de «realisatiestrategie EHS» van de provincie Zuid-Holland waarbij natuur verkocht wordt en internationale natuurdoelen mogelijk niet gehaald worden

MP Jacobi asked whether Zuid-Holland's EHS realisation strategy, which sells land outside the revised nature network and may jeopardise international nature targets, complies with the Lenteakkoord funding and the Rijk's responsibilities. The state secretary answered that the province is responsible for its instruments and boundaries, that the Rijk remains the contact for the EU and for agricultural nature management standards, and that she sees no reason to doubt the province's approach while calling buy-back by compensated farmers undesirable in principle.
It is the responsibility of the province to determine which measures are needed to realise that ambition.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie om te bepalen welke maatregelen nodig zijn om die ambitie te realiseren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Intensieve veehouderij in Achtkarspelen: een bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid’

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Health about public health concerns over intensive livestock farming in Achtkarspelen, including fine dust, odour, and municipal expansion despite provincial policy. The government said responsibility for expansion lies with the local authority, pointed to the restrictive national policy and provincial interim rules, and committed to a new RIVM study and a possible knowledge platform.
Responsibility for decisions on any expansion lies with the local competent authority.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor beslissingen aangaande de eventuele uitbreiding ligt bij het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, Jacobi en Wolbert over het bericht dat bij 44% van de Europeanen glyfosaat in de urine zit

MPs Dikkers, Jacobi and Wolbert asked the health and economic affairs ministers about a German study finding glyphosate in the urine of 44% of Europeans, including whether the NVWA tests crops and what risk applies. The minister answered that the RIVM sees no health risk at these microgram levels, that the NVWA tests grains with no MRL exceedances, and that glyphosate is under EU re-evaluation which will be followed closely.
Because the RIVM currently has no indication that the glyphosate levels found in urine give cause for concern, there is no reason to inquire with neighbouring countries about such research.

Omdat het RIVM op dit moment geen aanwijzingen heeft dat de gevonden glyfosaatwaarden in de urine reden tot zorg geven, is er geen aanleiding om bij de omringende landen te informeren naar dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Mei Li Vos over de doorvoer van walvisvlees via de haven van Rotterdam

MPs Jacobi and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the government would block transit of whale meat through Rotterdam, citing a petition and earlier commitments to pursue an EU or IWC transit ban. The state secretary replied that no formal transit ban is legally feasible because of Iceland's and Japan's CITES reservations, but said she would pursue a West-European port and industry code of conduct and approach EU colleagues.
As I reported above, a formal transit ban is not feasible.
Zoals ik u hierboven meldde, is een formeel doorvoerverbod niet haalbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Jacobi over “overtredingen door veehouderijen met luchtwassers”

MPs Van Dekken, Fokke and Jacobi asked about violations by livestock farms with air scrubbers, including 58% of inspected cases with breaches and 16% serious ones, and their effect on fine-particle and nitrogen calculations, enforcement in Brabant versus other provinces, and sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the non-compliance, pointed to mandatory electronic monitoring from 2016, said enforcement is delegated to municipalities and provinces without a national register, and promised to take further measures if compliance does not improve.

There is no national system in which the competent authorities under the Wabo record inspections, so no overview of the results of inspections of intensive livestock farms with air scrubbers can be given.

Er is geen landelijk systeem waarin de bevoegde gezagen voor de Wabo de controles registreren, waardoor geen overzicht van de resultaten van controles op intensieve veehouderijen met luchtwassers gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Almere nieuwe schaatscentrum’

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Almere would host a new national speed-skating centre, questioning KNSB's commitment to Thialf and the selection criteria. The minister replied that the ministry is not involved in choosing among the three bids, that the KNSB and NOC*NSF make the decision on 15 August 2013, and that she will not intervene.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the assessment and choice among the three initiatives.
Het ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling en keuze voor één van de drie initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Vergunning megastal Grubbenvorst geweigerd’

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the Council of State's annulment of environmental permits for a large livestock farm in Grubbenvorst, and whether such projects near homes are responsible given health risks, and whether the arrival could be prevented. The state secretary replied that the annulment was on procedural grounds (inadequate notice to interested parties), that other grounds were not reached, and that the Health Council advice and a policy response on farm scale will follow.

The Council of State declared the appeal against this environmental permit well-founded and ruled that the contested decision must be annulled for breach of article 3:12, first paragraph, of the General Administrative Law Act.

De Raad van State heeft het beroep inzake deze milieuvergunning gegrond verklaard en bepaald dat het bestreden besluit wegens strijd met artikel 3:12, eerste lid, van de Awb dient te worden vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het Oostvaarderswold

An MP asked the state secretary about the Oostvaarderswold ecological connection after Flevoland province decided to abandon it and prepare sale of acquired land, questioning conflict with the coalition agreement and whether state-funded land sales are allowed. The secretary answered that the province is responsible, that sale is not per se contrary to agreements but proceeds from ILG-funded land must go to development, and that talks with the province are planned.
Based on Mr Bekker's advice, the province of Flevoland has decided to abandon its efforts on the Oostvaarderswold ecological connection zone.
De provincie Flevoland heeft op basis van het advies van de heer Bekker besloten de inzet op de verbindingszone Oostvaarderswold los te laten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Jacobi over het dreigende collectieve ontslag bij Prins Dokkum en een reactie op de situatie bij het bedrijf Prins Dokkum waar gestaakt wordt tegen overplaatsing naar het buitenla

MPs Hamer and Jacobi asked the minister of Social Affairs about the threatened collective dismissal at Prins Dokkum after parent company Saferoad changed policy, including the legal force of employment guarantees given at the 2010 takeover and how such guarantees are weighed by UWV. The minister answered that the legal value depends on the guarantee's wording, that the UWV procedure is at an early stage, that guarantees are considered in the economic-necessity assessment, and that group-level profitability does not automatically defeat the subsidiary's dismissal case.
It is not for me to make further statements about the legal value of the employment guarantee in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om verdere uitspraken te doen over de juridische waarde van de werkgarantie in dit individuele geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Wolbert over de mogelijke frustratie van recreatie en natuurontwikkeling in het gebied Dwingelderveld als gevolg van stagnatie bij de herinrichting

MPs Jacobi and Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that renewed delays in the Dwingelderveld restoration would stall nature development and keep parts of the area closed to walkers, cyclists and disabled visitors, including whether the rezoning and subsidy deadlines are at risk. The State Secretary answered that she is aware of the reports but that, under the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, responsibility for the restoration and for walking paths lies with the province of Drenthe and regional bodies, and she declined to take that responsibility on.
By signing the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, the restoration of the Dwingelderveld falls under the responsibility of the province of Drenthe.
Met het ondertekenen van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur valt de herinrichting van het Dwingelderveld onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Drenthe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de verkiezingen voor het fusiewaterschap Vechtstromen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the planned autumn 2013 elections for the merged water board Vechtstromen are lawful given the postponement of water board elections to 2015 and the transitional rules for mergers. The minister answered that the Water Board Act requires elections before a merger, that the board's term is extended to January 2019 by skipping the November 2014 elections, and that differing provincial decisions on guaranteed seats require a joint provincial decision under article 6.
Under article 29, fourth paragraph, the Vechtstromen board skips these elections and its term ends together with the end of the following term (January 2019).

Op grond van het bepaalde in artikel 29, vierde lid, slaat het bestuur van Vechtstromen deze verkiezingen over en eindigt de zittingsperiode gelijk met het einde van de hierop volgende zittingsperiode (januari 2019).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Eijsink over het bericht dat de Hydrografische Dienst de verschijning van de 1800-serie kaarten opschort

Two MPs asked whether suspending the spring publication of the 1800-series nautical charts endangers navigation safety and whether digital publication is possible. The government answered that safety is not compromised because free online notices to mariners keep charts current, that budget cuts and Northsea traffic-scheme changes justify ending the annual spring edition, and that a new system may enable digital editions.
The budget cuts at Defence also affect the processing and production capacity of the Hydrographic Service.
De bezuinigingen bij Defensie treffen ook de verwerking- en productiecapaciteit van de Dienst der Hydrografie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Jacobi en Van der Steur en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie verlaat Leeuwarden’

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is leaving Leeuwarden for Groningen, what that means for Leeuwarden as a justice city, and whether Friesland was promised anything to protect jobs. The minister answered that Leeuwarden remains a full justice city with OM workplaces, that the regional ZSM and local cooperation are secured, and that no specific commitments were made to Leeuwarden or Friesland beyond attention to employment effects.
No commitments have been made to Leeuwarden and Friesland.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen gedaan aan Leeuwarden en Friesland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de gestegen waterschapsbelastingen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked the Minister whether rising water board charges in 2012 were consistent with the efficiency gains agreed in the Bestuursakkoord Water, and about regional differences. The Minister replied that charges rose about 2% on average, that the efficiency targets moderate rather than reduce charges, and that the rise is expected to fit the agreements, attributing regional differences to area characteristics and local policy choices.

As the answers to questions 3, 4 and 5 show, contrary to what the Vereniging Eigen Huis appears to assume, the Bestuursakkoord Water did not agree that the efficiency gains would lead to lower charges, but to a moderation of the increase in charges.

Zoals uit de beantwoording van de vragen 3, 4 en 5 blijkt is, anders dan de Vereniging Eigen Huis lijkt te veronderstellen, in het Bestuursakkoord Water niet afgesproken dat de te realiseren doelmatigheidswinsten gaan leiden tot lagere lasten, maar dat ze leiden tot een matiging van de lastenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht dat de provincie Friesland 50 km aan wandelpaden over boerenland schrapt

MP Jacobi asks whether the province of Friesland's decision to fund no hiking-path applications under the Boerenlandpad scheme, and the resulting gaps in the historic farm-path network, is acceptable, and why the 1000 km target for 2013 is relevant. The state secretary answers that the national government has ended funding for hiking paths, that responsibility now lies with regional authorities, and that she will not step in, while acknowledging the 2013 target was 879 km with 207 km realised by 2011.
The national government has ended the funding for hiking paths.
Het Rijk heeft de financiering voor wandelpaden beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jacobi over de toepassing van de subsidieregeling schaapskuddes

MPs Van Gerven and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the sheep-flock subsidy scheme, including late publication, eligibility safeguards against intensive livestock farms, excluded rare breeds, and delayed payments under the ferry allowance scheme. The state secretary defended the eligibility criteria and the one-off nature of the scheme, said the ferry allowance payments would follow the planned schedule, and gave no individual accommodation.
The subsidy scheme is however limited to flocks of sheep being herded with rare Dutch breeds.
De subsidieregeling is echter beperkt tot gescheperde schaapskuddes met zeldzame Nederlandse rassen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over de vervuiling van oppervlaktewater door microplastics

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about microplastics and nanomaterials polluting surface water, including measures on cosmetics, research on health effects, filtering, and producer responsibility. The minister answered that the government focuses on source-based action, ongoing research, EU cosmetics rules, and a voluntary packaging agreement, without yet filtering microplastics from water.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for now steers towards a source-based approach.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu stuurt vooralsnog aan op een brongerichte aanpak.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over “het feit dat ruim de helft van de Brabantse veeboeren teveel ammoniak uitstoten”

MPs Jacobi and Van Dekken asked why over half of Brabant livestock farms exceed ammonia limits and what this means for Natura 2000 goals, air quality and enforcement. The state secretary says enforcement is the province's responsibility, promises electronic monitoring of scrubbers from 2013, and deems the province's planned enforcement measures sufficient for now while refusing to halt new livestock farms.
As a result, the verifiability and enforceability of scrubbers will improve considerably.
Hierdoor zal de controleerbaarheid en handhaafbaarheid van luchtwassers aanzienlijk verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Fokke over “het bericht dat Brabant duizenden boeren niet gaat controleren op vergunning”

MPs Jacobi and Fokke asked the State Secretary whether Noord-Brabant can refuse to enforce the Nature Conservation Act against thousands of farmers lacking permits, and whether the province should be held to its enforcement duty. The State Secretary said he is aware of the long-running 'interimmers' problem, that the PAS can help, and that he is working with the provinces on a solution, without committing to a specific enforcement action.
Within the framework of the PAS, I am working with the provinces on a solution.
Ik werk in het kader van de PAS samen met de provincies aan een oplossing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over het bericht dat de NAM gebruikt gaat maken van fracking nabij Blija

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether NAM's fracking near Blija is permitted under its existing licence, how often fracking is used in the Netherlands, and what objection rights residents have. The minister answered that the licence allows fracs, that notification was given under the general rules, that no formal objection or appeal route exists for fracking in existing wells, and that residents were informed through local newspapers.
Current laws and regulations provide no formal objection or appeal possibility when applying this type of technique in existing wells.
De huidige wet- en regelgeving biedt geen formele bezwaar- en beroepmogelijkheid bij het toepassen van dit soort technieken in bestaande putten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jacobi over door mijn ministerie verleende vergunning voor het uitzetten van otters in zwaar verontreinigd water in de grote rivieren in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about a permit allowing the otter reintroduction in heavily polluted large rivers, and whether this conflicts with dioxin/PCB risks and IUCN guidelines. The state secretary confirmed the permit, said current water quality and removed causes of extinction justify it, and referred to an expert report commissioned by regional authorities.
I adhere to the Policy line on reintroduction of animals, which was also discussed with the House of Representatives at the time.
Antwoord 4 Ik houd mij aan de Beleidslijn herintroductie van dieren 9 , die indertijd ook met de Tweede Kamer is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de geplande aanleg van het agrologistieke bedrijventerrein Nieuw-Reijerwaard bij Ridderkerk

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked why the province of Zuid-Holland omitted air quality from the MER for the Nieuw-Reijerwaard logistics business park, questioning its demand, location and irreversible steps. The minister answered that the province is the competent authority under a decentralised budget, that air quality is covered by the NSL monitoring tool, and that the Rijk backed the project as an alternative location, with the provincial inpassingsplan due for adoption in spring 2013.
The province of Zuid-Holland is therefore also the competent authority for determining the scope and level of detail of the MER to be drawn up.
De provincie Zuid-Holland is daarmee ook het bevoegde gezag voor het vaststellen van de reikwijdte en het detailniveau van het op te stellen MER.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over plofkippen en het Beter Leven Keurmerk

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the 'plofkip' (fast-growing broiler), antibiotic use, welfare problems, and whether government canteens could switch to Beter Leven chicken. The state secretary largely deferred to retail and industry initiatives, cited pending research on antibiotic use, and said canteen criteria were being updated to encourage more animal-friendly products.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Jacobi over de gevolgen voor Den Oever van een dijkverhoging door het Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the consequences for Den Oever of a dike raising by the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier, including whether an integrated approach was considered and whether a commission's recommendations were taken into account. The state secretary replied that the water board is primarily responsible under a subsidy programme, that an integrated alternative was studied and rejected on cost grounds, and that the concept preferred option can still be adjusted with the parties while the province safeguards regional interests.
The manager, in this case the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK), is primarily responsible for carrying out this project.
De beheerder, in dit geval Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK) , is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van dit project.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Jacobi over de financiering van grote sportevenementen

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked whether the First European Sport for All Games 2014 in Friesland, which TAFISA Nederland requested, could count as a major event for the Olympic 2028 bid and why it is excluded from federal co-funding. Minister Schippers answered that the event is a first edition with no reliable data yet, that it fits the Olympic Plan's grassroots goals but not the top-sport criteria, and that the existing events policy applies until a new cabinet decides.
I have not yet published the development of a new framework for the events policy.
Ik heb de ontwikkeling van een nieuw kader voor het evenementenbeleid (nog) niet uitgebracht.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Jacobi over de toekomst van de enige academische opleiding Friese taal en cultuur

MPs Jadnanansing and Jacobi asked whether the University of Groningen's plan to fold Frisian language and culture into a broad European languages bachelor threatens the only academic Frisian programme. The state secretary replied that the Frisian bachelor stays separately registered in the CROHO register and will be offered jointly with the new programme to safeguard Frisian's sustainability.

I understand that, contrary to what the University of Groningen's website states about Frisian, the Frisian language and culture bachelor programme remains registered as a separate programme in the central register of higher education programmes.

Ik heb begrepen dat – in afwijking van hetgeen op de website van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen met betrekking tot het Fries is gesteld – de bacheloropleiding Friese taal en cultuur aan de RUG als afzonderlijke opleiding geregistreerd blijft in het Centraal Register Opleidingen Hoger Onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Jacobi over de dreigende investeringsstop van provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen

MPs Heijnen and Jacobi asked the Finance Minister whether the planned Wet Hof (sustainable public finances act) would hinder infrastructure investment by provinces, municipalities and water boards, and whether it would be adjusted. The minister replied that decentralised governments must contribute to EU deficit targets, that the Act is under Council of State advice, and that the decentralised governments will give a definitive reaction after the spring consultation.
With the Wet Hof, the main principles of trend-based budget policy will be anchored in law.
Met de Wet Hof worden de belangrijkste uitgangspunten van het trendmatig begrotingsbeleid wettelijk verankerd.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans over het salaris van de Floriadedirectie en de vergoedingen van de commissarissen bij de Floriade

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Floriade directorate's pay exceeds the Balkenende norm, how much public subsidy funds it, and whether commissioners' fees (reportedly 4000 euro per meeting) are excessive and publicly financed. The minister answered that the Wopt does not apply to the Floriade company, that the directorate's pay is reportedly below the norm, that no state subsidy is used for directorate salaries, that commissioner fees average 750 euro net per month and are not state-financed, and that the exhibition commissioner's fee is split 50/50 between the ministry and the company.
At my request, the chair of the Supervisory Board informed me that the Floriade directorate's remuneration does not exceed the norm amount.
Op mijn verzoek heeft de voorzitter van de Raad van Commissarissen mij medegedeeld dat de vergoeding van de Floriadedirectie niet boven het normbedrag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Smeets over de berichtgeving dat er wederom problemen zijn met de vaargeul tussen Holwerd en Nes op Ameland

MPs Jacobi and Smeets asked about reports of renewed problems with the Holwerd–Nes ferry channel to Ameland, including its width and depth, and what the government is doing. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a contract penalty, a failed alternative dredging trial and a demand for faster dredging, gave no firm completion date, and rejected restoring the old channel by dredging a sandbank because the Nature Conservation Act and the Waddenzee policy prohibit it.
Rijkswaterstaat is doing its utmost to ensure a good connection to and from Ameland and has taken measures to solve this problem.
Rijkswaterstaat zet zich maximaal in voor een goede verbinding van en naar Ameland en heeft maatregelen getroffen om dit probleem te verhelpen.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over het hoogwater in Woltersum en andere plaatsen in de de provincies Groningen en Friesland en de roep om de aanleg van een extra gemaal in Lauwersoog

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why flood-defence weaknesses on the Eemskanaal dike at Woltersum were not fixed earlier, how long reinforcement will take, why the FUGRO report was not accessible, and whether a new pumping station at Lauwersoog will be built. The state secretary replied that the regional water boards are responsible, that work is underway with completion targets, that the FUGRO report is now public, and that the regional water manager decides on the Lauwersoog pumping station.
This is a responsibility of the regional flood defence managers, the water boards Fryslân and Noorderzijlvest.
Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de regionale waterkeringbeheerders, de waterschappen Fryslân en Noorderzijlvest.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Jacobi over over de berichtgeving dat het Loodswezen een miljoenenstrop lijdt vanwege de aanhoudende discussie over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Vlaanderen's refusal to pay the Loodswezen is linked to the Netherlands not honouring its commitment to de-embank the Hedwigepolder, and whether other projects are affected. The state secretary said the dispute is between the Loodswezen and Flanders under binding arbitration, that the minister will raise it with her Flemish counterpart, and that de-embanking the Hedwigepolder is not on the table.
It should be noted that the Dutch government is not a party to the dispute over the payments.
Daarbij zij aangetekend dat de Nederlandse overheid geen partij is in het geschil over de betalingen.

Vagen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Van der Veen (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulp in het

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about the closure of three emergency and maternity departments at the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum and the regional opposition to it. The government answered that regional access to acute care is secured within 45 minutes through extra ambulance capacity and a helicopter arrangement, that other hospitals can serve the region, and that a hospital availability allowance for 2012 is conditional on an adequate plan.
With these measures, the accessibility of acute care in the region within 45 minutes is secured.
Met deze maatregelen is de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio binnen 45 minuten geborgd.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over meerdere gevallen van vergiftiging roofdieren door malafide jagers (ingezonden 15 n

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about poisonings of predators by unlawful hunters, the penalties involved, the lack of national registration, the role of Staatsbosbeheer and whether a temporary hunting ban in Drenthe would be imposed. The state secretary said the Flora- and faunawet provides enforcement powers and hunting licences can be withdrawn, but could not give a complete figure of cases because there is no national registration, and he rejected a hunting ban.
Because there is no national registration, I am currently examining the possibilities of having all suspected dead animals sent to the Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).
Vanwege het ontbreken van een landelijke registratie bezie ik momenteel de mogelijkheden om alle verdachte dode dieren te laten opsturen naar het Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vervuilde en levenloze rivier de Eems (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Van Dekken ask the state secretary about the polluted, lifeless Ems river, the delay in a recovery plan promised four years earlier, its timing, consultation with Germany, and whether economic activity is being weighed against ecology after Council of State rulings. The state secretary answers that a joint Dutch-German management plan is being worked on for completion around 2013, the plan covers conservation goals rather than an economic outlook, and both economy and ecology are weighed under the existing framework.
The intention is that the IMP for the Ems-Dollard will be adopted in 2013 and that the Natura 2000 management plan with concrete measures for this area will be ready in 2015.
Het is de bedoeling dat in 2013 het IMP voor de Eems-Dollard wordt vastgesteld en dat in 2015 het beheerplan Natura 2000 met de concrete maatregelen voor dit gebied gereed is.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma, Monasch en Jacobi ( allen PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging van de aanleg van het knooppunt Joure (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs from the PvdA asked the minister why the start of construction of the Joure junction slipped from 2012 to 2013, whether designing for 130 km/h caused the delay and extra costs of EUR 4 million, and whether the budget increase and cost decisions are justified. The minister confirmed the 2013 start and the extra EUR 4 million for a 130 km/h-proof design, said the opening year stays 2015, and rejected calling it a delay.
By way of explanation of my decision on 130 for Joure, the following.
Ter toelichting op mijn 130-besluit voor Joure het volgende.

Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over bedreigde haaiensoort op de menukaart van een Schevenings restaurant (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether an endangered Lamna nasus shark sold and served in a Scheveningen restaurant reflected a failure of EU fishing bans and inspections, what sanctions apply, and how the minister protects sharks and enforces the landing ban. The state secretary said the species should not have been landed, the case was referred to UK authorities, and that enforcement responsibility lies with member states, with further EU protective measures promised.
Responsibility for control lies with the member states.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de controle ligt bij de lidstaten.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Monasch en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de getroffen maatregelen van een verpleeghuis te Sneek (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about a Friesland nursing home leaving beds empty because of a tight AWBZ budget, whether freed funds for staff would be made more flexible, and how to prevent empty beds alongside growing waiting lists. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the 12,000 staff convenant is not flexible, and said the NZa advises €25 million in redistribution funds to two care-purchasing concessionaires, which the minister intends to follow, plus a request for further NZa investigation.
I intend to follow this NZa advice.
Ik ben voornemens dit Nza-advies te volgen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de afvaloven in Harlingen de normen zou overschrijden (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Samsom asked the state secretary about reports that the Harlingen waste incinerator exceeded emission norms, including health risks and monitoring. The secretary replied that Tauw found no exceedances of emission limits after start-up, that dioxin emissions were negligible, and that the GGD and a Wageningen biomonitoring programme are following local health.
Tauw found no exceedances of the emission limit values.
Tauw heeft geen overschrijdingen van de emissiegrenswaarden geconstateerd.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Jacobi (PvdA) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de emissies van de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie OMRIN te Harlingen (ingezonden 27 mei 2011)

MPs Jansen, Jacobi and Samsom asked whether the OMRIN waste incinerator in Harlingen exceeds its permitted emission levels, what the limits on downtime and enforcement framework are, and what action the government will take. The State Secretary replied that the provincial authority enforces the permit and Besluit verbranden afvalstoffen, that the 60-hour annual downtime cap has reportedly not been exceeded, and that no additional measures are needed.
According to the province, this maximum has not been exceeded since commissioning.
Volgens de provincie is dit maximum sinds de ingebruikname niet overschreden.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi (PvdA) en Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over correspondentie met de Europese Commissie over de afbraak van het natuurbeleid (ingezonde

MPs Jacobi and Van Veldhoven asked the state secretary about correspondence with the European Commission over the rollback of nature policy, including whether an EU information request covered several Natura 2000 issues and whether a formal infringement notice and fines were to be expected. The state secretary answered that the letter was an informal EU Pilot inquiry, not a formal notice, that the EU-pilot letter would be sent confidentially to parliament, and that fines are only possible after a Court of Justice ruling.
I have meanwhile sent the EU-pilot letter to your House on a confidential basis.
Ik heb de EU-pilot brief inmiddels op vertrouwelijke wijze uw Kamer doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bestrijding van de visstroperij in Nederland en in F

MPs Jacobi and Marcouch asked why the Friesland fish-poaching enforcement team was dissolved amid budget cuts, and about the current approach to fish poaching. The state secretary answered that enforcement continues in three regional teams, that a bill strengthening poaching enforcement is pending, and that a more offender-focused approach and animal police are planned, though the future institutional arrangement is still to be decided.
What matters is that fish poaching enforcement is not endangered. I will, together with my colleague of Security and Justice, examine what the most appropriate form for this is.
Van belang is dat de stroperijbestrijding niet in gevaar komt. Ik zal samen met mijn ambtgenoot van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien wat daarvoor de meest passende vorm is.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over waterkrachtcentrales en visgeleidingssystemen (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about fish mortality at existing Dutch hydropower plants and the absence of fish guidance systems, citing a motion on the matter. The government confirmed the problem, said no working guidance systems exist yet, and committed to adjusted turbine management from autumn 2011 and fish-protection measures by 2015 to be written into water permits.

By 2015 the existing hydropower plants must have adequate fish-protection measures, failing which the turbines must be shut down during fish migration periods, as will be included in the water permit.

Uiterlijk in 2015 dienen de bestaande WKC's te beschikken over afdoende visbeschermende maatregelen, zoniet dienen de turbines te worden stilgelegd tijdens de periode van vismigratie, zo zal worden opgenomen in de Watervergunning.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi (PvdA) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inzet van Nederland in Brussel (EU) voor een regeling voor oormerkweigeraars (ingezonden 1

Two MPs asked the state secretary what the Netherlands has done in Brussels to secure recognition of the Dutch scheme for cattle ear-tag refusers, and what obstacles the Commission sees and whether EU rules could be amended. The secretary replied that repeated efforts have so far failed because EU rules recognise only yellow ear tags, that alternative identification means will be put on the agenda in autumn and will be pressed, and that the Commission lacks competence to grant conscientious-objector exemptions and sees no reason to amend the rules.
I will once again advocate this with the European Commission.
Ik zal dat wederom bij de Europese Commissie bepleiten.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister-president over de toezeggingen aan de heer Robesin ten aanzien van ontpoldering in Zeeland (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether an open letter from Provincial Councillor Robesin showed that a promise had been made to him in exchange for his vote against depoldering in Zeeland, and whether his claim that no commitments were made holds. The Prime Minister answered that the government will keep the coalition agreement's commitment to develop an alternative to depoldering the Hedwigepolder, that he will not comment on a confidential meeting, and that no commitments were given to the councillor.
It concerned a confidential conversation. I wish to confirm once again that no commitments were made to those involved.
Het betrof een vertrouwelijk gesprek. Ik wil bij deze nogmaals bevestigen dat er geen toezeggingen zijn gedaan aan betrokkenen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vernielde dassenburchten en vergiftigde wilde dieren in Drenthe (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Wolbert asked the state secretary about destroyed badger setts and poisoned wildlife in Drenthe, and about penalties and enforcement against illegal pesticide use and animal cruelty. The state secretary answered that such acts are already prohibited and punishable, that fines and economic-offence penalties are sufficient, and pointed to existing animal police and boa training arrangements without committing to new investment.
I consider the fine mentioned in answer 4 sufficiently deterrent for most cases.
Ik acht de bij vraag 4 genoemde boete voldoende afschrikkend voor de meeste gevallen.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris en minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de opheffing van het Kenniscentrum Recreatie (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

MPs Smeets and Jacobi asked the state secretary why the subsidy to the Kenniscentrum Recreatie was fully cut, given the sector's economic importance, and whether knowledge gaps would be compensated. The state secretary replied that cuts from the coalition agreement and decentralisation of nature and recreation tasks phase out the structural contribution from 2012 to 2014, and that the centre's legacy will be transferred to partners and knowledge institutions.

As a result of the spending cuts in the coalition agreement and the decentralisation tasks it contains regarding nature, landscape and recreation, the structural contribution of EL&I to the Kenniscentrum Recreatie (KCR) will also be phased out from 2012 to 2014.

Als gevolg van de bezuinigingen uit het regeerakkoord en de hierin opgenomen decentralisatie-opgaven met betrekking tot natuur, landschap en recreatie wordt ook de structurele bijdrage van EL&I aan het Kenniscentrum Recreatie (KCR) vanaf 2012 tot 2014 afgebouwd.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de hoogwatergeul bij Veessen – Wapenveld (gemeente Heerde) (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the flooding arrangements for the Veessen-Wapenveld flood relief channel and a Rijkswaterstaat letter suggesting changes to how the gates open, and whether this was appropriate given earlier opposition. The state secretary confirmed the chosen flood frequency will not change, said the gate operation protocol is still to be drafted, and described the letter as a routine preliminary review feeding into the pending project decision.
No agreements have yet been made on how the channel will fill and how the inlet will be operated.
Over de wijze waarop de geul gaat volstromen en de inlaat wordt bediend, zijn nog geen afspraken gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Dijksma en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de onuitvoerbaarheid van de nieuwe Europese meldplicht voor Nederlandse traditionele zeilschepen (ingezonden 11

MPs Jacobi, Dijksma and Smeets asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the new EU port state control reporting duties (24-hour and 72-hour notifications, electronic reporting) are unworkable for Dutch traditional sailing ships, and what the government will do to protect them abroad. The minister answered that the duties are not new, that most sailing ships under 300 GT are exempt, that electronic reporting is required only where possible, and that the problem has been raised with the European Commission, which is preparing rules for sailing vessels by mid-2012.
I have brought the problem of reporting via internet raised by the BBZ to the attention of the European Commission via the EU Committee on Safe Seas (COSS).
Ik heb de door de BBZ aangegeven problematiek betreffende melden via internet, onder de aandacht van de Europese Commissie (EC) gebracht via het EU Committee on Safe Seas (COSS).

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem, Çelik en Jacobi (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Jeugdproject Wyldemerk gedwongen de deuren moet sluiten (ingezonden 4 apri

MPs Dijsselbloem, Çelik and Jacobi asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the closure of the Wyldemerk youth project, including whether 24-hour support for 43 youths stops, whether pupils can finish the school year, and whether a school inspectorate report caused the closure. The state secretary confirmed the support ends after the 2010-2011 school year, said the foundation itself decided to close and the inspectorate report was not the cause, and placed responsibility for finding alternative places and for youth care on the foundation and the provinces.
That guarantee I cannot give you; that is the responsibility of Wyldemerk.
Die garantie kan ik u niet geven, dat is de verantwoordelijkheid van Wyldemerk.
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het proefjaar waarin de zeeverkeerscentrale en de vuurtorens naast elkaar werken (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for details of the planned one-year trial in which the sea traffic control centre and manned lighthouses operate side by side, including staffing, tasks, the radar system and whether the lighthouses would be kept manned. The state secretary answered that detailed plans are not yet finalised pending supplier and camera-system talks, confirmed both lighthouses will be manned, and committed to a decision on lighthouse staffing only after the trial year.
However, I cannot yet give you specific information on the elaboration of the comparison year at this time.
Specifieke informatie over de uitwerking van het vergelijkingsjaar kan ik u echter nog niet geven op dit moment.
Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Afsluitdijk (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Lucas and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the Afsluitdijk project, including the division of roles between the national government and the provinces and municipalities, and how a motion on a phased masterplan would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the national government is responsible for safety measures, that a structure vision and administrative agreement will set out the plan with regional partners, and that adoption is planned for December 2011.
Adoption of the structure vision is planned for December 2011, after which the structure vision will be sent to the States General.
Vaststelling van de structuurvisie is voorzien in december 2011, waarna de structuurvisie aan de Staten-Generaal zal worden toegezonden.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de rechtspositie van eigenaren van vakantiehuisjes. (Ingezonden 2 maart 2011).

MPs Smeets and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the legal position of owners of holiday homes on leased pitches, including delays in new RECRON conditions, a claimed loss of assets, a legal gap, and possible legislation. The state secretary answered that the process is progressing, that the RECRON conditions are self-regulation with existing legal protection (dispute committee and civil courts), that new legislation is not needed, and that municipalities can specify land uses themselves.
Additional legislation is therefore not an issue.
Aanvullende wetgeving is zodoende niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gebiedsontwikkeling Ooijen-Wanssum (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the Ooijen-Wanssum area development in light of plans to reverse flood-protection connecting zones and the high Meuse water levels. The state secretary said a decision depends on completing the MIRT process and budget constraints, that the project cannot be confirmed for the spring 2011 MIRT meetings, and that no short-term certainty can be given.
Around the summer I will inform you about this, in accordance with my commitment in the committee meeting of 13 December 2010.
Rond de zomer zal ik u, conform mijn toezegging in het AO op 13 december 2010, hierover informeren.

Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een geheim plan voor huizen in de natuur (ingezonden 11 februari 2011

MP Jacobi asked the ministers whether they knew of a regional ILG committee plan to deviate from nature and spatial policy to build about 1,000 homes in the Gooi area, who sits on the committee, and whether other regions run similar studies. The state secretary answered that he was unaware of any intent to deviate from policy, that the committee is only exploring clearing built-up locations within existing spatial schemes, that committee members are not civil servants under his responsibility, and that similar studies elsewhere are possible within provincial frameworks.
As I understand it, the ILG area committee Amstel, Gooi en Vecht streek is also not intending to deviate from policy.
Naar ik heb begrepen is de ILG gebiedscommissie Amstel, Gooi en Vecht streek ook niet voornemens af te wijken van het beleid.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ontbreken van de Friese taal en cultuur in de adviesaanvraag voor cultuurbeleid (ingezonden 14 fe

MPs Klijnsma and Jacobi asked why the government's advisory request to the Council for Culture omitted Frisian language and culture, and whether it would add them. The state secretary replied that the request asks for an integral advice covering all sectors, that Frisian is protected through a new language law and a bestuursafspraak, and that he is willing to consult the province of Fryslân instead of adding it to the request.
However, I am willing to consult with the province of Fryslân, for example through the consultation with the northern region.
Ik ben echter bereid om met de provincie Fryslân overleg te voeren, bijvoorbeeld via het overleg met landsdeel Noord.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mogelijkheid om de woonplaats van de moeder als geboorte

MPs Heijnen and Jacobi asked whether the mother's residence could be recorded as the birthplace when a birth occurs in a neighbouring hospital, and whether Terschelling could get a birth enclave in Leeuwarden. Minister Donner answered that recording the mother's residence conflicts with the Civil Code, that the Wet arhi does not allow the enclave, and that the civil registry advisory commission will be asked about possible conditions.
Recording the mother's residence as the child's birthplace, instead of the actual place of birth, conflicts with the Civil Code.
Antwoord 6 Het opnemen van de woonplaats van de moeder als de geboorteplaats van het kind, in plaats van het opnemen van de feitelijke geboorteplaats, is in strijd met het Burgerlijk Wetboek.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de geplande helihaven Coolen nabij het Natura 2000 gebied He
