MPs Smeets and Jacobi asked the state secretaries whether a heliport at Coolen near the Natura 2000 area Het Leudal, included in a Limburg airport regulation, had been assessed under nature protection law and whether there were compelling public interest grounds for it. The state secretary replied that the provincial executive is the competent authority, that a separate study concluded no significant effects, so no appropriate assessment or permit was required.
The airport regulation in question is the responsibility of the province of Limburg.
De betreffende luchthavenverordening is een verantwoordelijk van de provincie Limburg.
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de afslag op Terschelling (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

MP Jacobi asked the state secretary about Terschelling's coastal defence, including whether the dune barrier was tested, who is responsible for water safety, and whether dynamic coastal management keeps residents safe. The state secretary answered that the primary flood defence was tested and found safe, that responsibility is split between Wetterskip Fryslân and Rijkswaterstaat, and that the location of the primary defences will be decided after research due this autumn.
I want to take this wish seriously and will include the option of moving the primary flood defence to the sea dune ridge in the research.
Ik wil deze wens serieus bekijken en zal in het onderzoek de optie om de primaire waterkering naar de zeereep te verleggen meenemen.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Timmermans en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de dijken in Limburg (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about Limburg dike safety, whether provincial funding requests were justified, and how costs would be split between the state and water boards. The state secretary confirmed the request and the Maaswerken budget use, said the national picture would follow the Inspectorate's validation, and gave no firm timetable or final cost split.
The national picture will be final after the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management has judged all provincial assessments.
Het landelijk beeld wordt definitief na het oordeel van de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat op alle provinciale oordelen.
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over besluitvorming van Staatsbosbeheer over Lauwershage (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the decision-making process at Staatsbosbeheer concerning the Lauwershage plan in Kollumerland, following complaints from Frisian mayors, and about the democratic legitimacy of that process. The state secretary answered that the algemeen directeur decides on procedures after advice from regional staff, that Staatsbosbeheer acts as an independent administrative body under its statute, and that the province of Fryslân is the competent authority for the relevant procedures.
In addition, I point out that the province of Fryslân is the competent authority in the procedures required for the decision-making on Lauwershage.
Ter aanvulling wijs ik er u nog op dat de provincie Fryslân het bevoegde gezag is in de procedures die nodig zijn voor de besluitvorming rond «Lauwershage»
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het wegvallen van subsidie voor schaapskuddes (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

An MP asked whether sheep flocks in Gelderland face uncertainty because the old subsidy scheme ended before the new nature and landscape management scheme took effect, and how their disappearance will be prevented. The state secretary replied that competence for scheduled sheep flocks was transferred to the provinces in 2007, so the question is the responsibility of the province of Gelderland.
The subsidy and competence for scheduled sheep flocks was transferred to the provinces in 2007 under the Investment Budget for Rural Areas.
De subsidie en de competentie voor gescheperde schaapskuddes is in het kader van het Investeringsbudget Landelijk Gebied in 2007 overgedragen aan de provincies.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de voorgenomen ontslagen bij De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk. (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether planned dismissals at De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk, and the reorganisation process, violated the Collective Redundancy Notification Act (WMCO) and whether intervention was planned. The minister answered that a court ruled the notification met WMCO requirements, that the late involvement of unions and the works council was cured by later consultation, and that no fraud occurred, so the interests of employees were adequately protected.
I do not share that view.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ontwikkelingen nieuwe zeeverkeerscentrale (Ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the minister about preparations for a new sea traffic control centre on Terschelling and the risks of removing human lookouts at lighthouses. The state secretary confirmed that human observation at the Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog lighthouses will be retained after the centre opens and that no decisions on lighthouse staffing will be taken before a promised evaluation is discussed in parliament.
Therefore I hereby undertake that human observation at both lighthouses (Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog) will be retained, even after the Wadden Sea sea traffic control centre is in operation.
Daarom zeg ik u hierbij toe dat het menselijk oog op beide vuurtorens (Terschelling en Schiermonnikoog) behouden blijft, ook nadat de zeeverkeerscentrale Waddenzee in werking is.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de rechtspositie van eigenaren van vakantiehuisjes (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Smeets and Jacobi asked whether owners of holiday homes on campsites, who may be forced out by landowners, should be better protected and what compensation or measures are possible. The state secretary replied that holiday-park policy is a municipal responsibility, that contracts are private law governed by RECRON conditions, and that disputes go to the civil courts or the Geschillencommissie Recreatie.
Holiday-residence policy is the responsibility of the municipalities.
Het verblijfsrecreatiebeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de aanleg van een geluidswal met vervuilde g

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether a noise barrier built with contaminated soil in the Ecological Main Structure in Heerenveen, by a remediation contractor, complies with rules, with no VROM-Inspectie objection, and whether ecological and health effects were studied. The state secretary answered that the contract is private law and details are unknown, the soil is lightly contaminated and meets the Bbk, ecological studies found no negative effects, and sample results are required per lot through partij keuringen.
The activity concerned involves a private-law contractual arrangement, so I have no insight into its details.
Bij de genoemde activiteit is er sprake van een privaatrechtelijke contractvorming. Ik heb dan ook geen zicht op de details daarvan.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de kippenfarm in Landkreis Emsland (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked why no cross-border environmental impact assessment was applied to a large poultry farm in Landkreis Emsland, whether formal consultation with Germany is planned, whether errors were made in the permit, and whether the VROM-Inspectie should review it. The minister answered that the omission resulted from communication misunderstandings, that a consultation on 22 October 2010 clarified matters without need for formal consultation, that no Dutch fault occurred, and that the inspectorate has no role since permitting happens in Germany.
This consultation led to a clarification of the situation that had arisen.
Dit overleg heeft geleid tot een verduidelijking van de ontstane situatie.

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe (CDA), Jacobi (PvdA), Berndsen (D66) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over problematiek rondom de aansluiting van de Meldkamer Noord-Nederland (MkN

MPs De Rouwe, Jacobi, Berndsen and Çörüz asked the minister why the regional control rooms MkNN and OCSB must use the closed NAFIN network for C-2000, causing high connection costs, and whether a cheaper public fibre link could be allowed. The minister defended NAFIN as essential for reliable, secure emergency communication, refused any revision, and said regional budgets should cover these costs, which could be offset by merging control rooms.
Given the importance of C-2000 for the safety of both citizens and emergency workers and the strict requirements this imposes on the network, I see no room to reconsider.
Gezien het belang van C-2000 voor de veiligheid van zowel burgers als hulpverleners en de strenge eisen die hierdoor worden gesteld aan het netwerk, zie ik geen ruimte om tot een herziening te komen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister van Landbouw, Natuurbeheer en Voedselkwaliteit over bestrijding van natuurbranden (i

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked whether nature management conflicts with fire prevention and suppression, following criticism from fire services that current forest management increases the risk of large fires. The minister answered that the relation is complex: the shift from conifer to broadleaf forest has reduced fire risk, road closures may hamper firefighting, and relevant studies (NIFV, IOOV) are ongoing with conclusions pending.
No central registration is available of the state of maintenance of firebreaks in forest and nature areas in the Netherlands.
Er is geen centrale registratie beschikbaar van de staat van onderhoud van brandgangen in bos- en natuurterreinen in Nederland.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de sluiting van de ASR-vestiging in Woudsend (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

MPs De Rouwe, Van Hijum and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the closure of the ASR office in Woudsend, its employment impact, the government's northern economic strategy, and the status of two shrinkage-related motions. The minister acknowledged the job loss, said the decision was a company strategy matter outside government intervention, pointed to Koers Noord and local responsibility, and reported that the motion inventory is finished and will be sent to parliament.
It is not my role to look for solutions at national level for an individual employment problem such as the one now arising around ASR Woudsend.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om voor een individueel werkgelegenheidsprobleem, zoals dat zich nu voordoet rond ASR Woudsend, op rijksniveau naar oplossingen te zoeken.

m: Amendement van de leden Bevers en Joseph over Over middelen voor het mobiel medisch team voor de regio Oost en in Limburg
Shifts funds within the health budget to station a 24/7 mobile medical team helicopter and ground team in the East and Limburg regions.
The problem can be solved by stationing a 24/7 helicopter MMT at Teuge airfield and a 24/7 ground MMT in South Limburg (Maastricht UMC).
Het probleem kan worden opgelost door de stationering van een 24/7 Helikopter-MMT op vliegveld Teuge en een 24/7 grondgebonden-MMT in Zuid-Limburg (Maastricht UMC).
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het waarborgen van zeggenschap bij interne collectieve waardeoverdracht
Amendment giving pension fund members an individual objection right or an approval right over internal collective value transfers, with notice, procedure and safeguard requirements.
that it is also desirable to give an individual objection right or an approval right for internal collective value transfer
dat het tevens gewenst is om een individueel bezwaarrecht dan wel een goedkeuringsrecht te geven bij interne collectieve waardeoverdracht
Motie van het lid Joseph over sociale partners en pensioenfondsen verplichten een koopkrachtambitie te formuleren
Asks the government to oblige social partners and pension funds to formulate a purchasing-power ambition for pension payouts tied to inflation.
requests the government to oblige social partners and pension funds to formulate a purchasing power ambition
verzoekt de regering sociale partners en pensioenfondsen te verplichten een koopkrachtambitie te formuleren
Motie van het lid Joseph over de wettelijke vereisten voor communicatie over het pensioenstelsel aanscherpen
Asks the government, with the AFM, to tighten legal requirements so pension communication explicitly warns of risks in the new pension system.
requests the government, in consultation with the AFM, to tighten the legal requirements for communication about the pension system
verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met de AFM de wettelijke vereisten voor communicatie over het pensioenstelsel aan te scherpen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen
Amends the pension bill so that internal collective value transfers require prior approval by members, with information duties and a 30% response threshold, and a supervisor notification.
No later than four weeks before the intended date of the internal collective value transfer, approval must be obtained and electronically reported to the supervisor

Uiterlijk vier weken voor de beoogde datum van de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht moet goedkeuring als bedoeld in lid 1a, onderdeel c, zijn verkregen en elektronisch zijn gemeld aan de toezichthouder.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen

Amends the pension act so that internal collective value transfers require prior member approval (majority of respondents, at least 30% response) and individual objection rights, with a supervisor notification duty.
At least four weeks before the intended date of the internal collective value transfer, approval must be obtained and electronically reported to the supervisor.

Uiterlijk vier weken voor de beoogde datum van de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht moet goedkeuring als bedoeld in lid 1a, onderdeel c, zijn verkregen en elektronisch zijn gemeld aan de toezichthouder.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen

Amendment requires prior member approval (or an individual objection option) for internal collective transfers of pension capital, with information duties and a 30% response threshold, and a transitional rule.
Without this approval the internal collective value transfer cannot take place.
Zonder deze goedkeuring kan de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht niet plaatsvinden.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen
Requires prior participant approval, with a supervisor notification, before internal collective pension value transfers may proceed.
Amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen
Requires prior approval by participants, former participants and pensioners before a collective internal value transfer of pensions can proceed, with a 30 percent response threshold.
prior approval of the participants, former participants and pensioners has also been obtained.
tevens voorafgaande goedkeuring van de deelnemers, gewezen deelnemers en pensioengerechtigden is verkregen
Motie van het lid Joseph over onderzoeken hoe aankomende Europese wetgeving beter getoetst kan worden op regeldruk
Asks the government to study how incoming EU legislation can be better tested for regulatory burden, since most new Dutch law originates in Europe.
requests the government to study how incoming European legislation can also be better tested for regulatory burden
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe ook aankomende Europese wetgeving beter te toetsen op regeldruk
Motie van het lid Joseph over nieuwe wetgeving op het gebied van informatievoorziening over cryptovaluta al na een jaar evalueren
Asks the government to evaluate new crypto-asset information legislation after one year, given possible privacy and regulatory burden effects.
requests the government to evaluate this legislation after just one year
verzoekt de regering deze wetgeving al na een jaar te evalueren
Motie van het lid Joseph over uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 de financiële prikkels wegnemen die het aanbod van gespecialiseerde ggz ontmoedigen
Asks the government to remove financial incentives discouraging specialised mental health care supply by Q1 2025, including market functioning for complex cases.
by Q1 2025 to come up with solutions that remove the financial incentives discouraging the supply of specialised mental health care
uiterlijk in Q1 2025 met oplossingen te komen die de financiële prikkels wegnemen die het aanbod van gespecialiseerde ggz ontmoedigen
Motie van de leden Joseph en Slagt-Tichelman over monitoren hoeveel geclusterde woonzorgcomplexen voor 24-uurs langdurige zorg er zijn
Asks the government to monitor how many clustered care-home complexes providing 24-hour long-term care exist.
requests the government to monitor how many clustered residential complexes for 24-hour long-term care there are
verzoekt de regering te monitoren hoeveel geclusterde wooncomplexen voor 24-uurs langdurige zorg er zijn
Motie van de leden Krul en Joseph over inzicht geven in de precieze praktische uitwerking van de versobering van de Subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden
Asks the government to explain by 1 January the practical effects, affected subgroups, numbers and legal feasibility of cutting the subsidy scheme for uninsured medical care.
requests the government to provide by 1 January insight into the precise practical implementation of the scaling back of the subsidy scheme for necessary medical care for uninsured persons
verzoekt de regering voor 1 januari inzicht te geven in de precieze praktische uitwerking van de versobering van de Subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden
Motie van het lid Joseph over verpleeghuizen bij een spoedopname vanaf opnamedag één de vergoeding geven die hoort bij een opname, ongeacht of de zorg binnen de Wlz of binnen de Zvw valt
Asks the government to ensure nursing homes receive the admission reimbursement from the first day of an emergency admission, whether the care falls under the Wlz or the Zvw.
requests the government to ensure that nursing homes can receive the admission reimbursement from the first day of an emergency admission
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat verpleeghuizen bij spoedopname vanaf opnamedag één de vergoeding kunnen krijgen die hoort bij een opname
Amendement van het lid Joseph over het per pensioenuitvoerder en beroepspensioenregeling bepalen of de mogelijkheid van het bedrag ineens geboden wordt
Makes the option of a lump-sum payment of up to 10% of pension capital dependent on whether the pension scheme or occupational scheme provides for it.
If the pension agreement provides for this option, the pension administrator is
Indien de pensioenovereenkomst voorziet in deze mogelijkheid, is de pensioenuitvoerder
Amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. over het verbod op contante betaling doen gelden vanaf €10.000
Raises the threshold of the ban on cash payments by goods traders from 3,000 to 10,000 euro, aligning it with the EU AML regulation.
In the proposed article 1f in article I, part C, '€ 3,000' is replaced by '€ 10,000'.
In het in artikel I, onderdeel C, voorgestelde artikel 1f wordt «€ 3.000» vervangen door «€ 10.000».
Amendement van de leden Claassen en Joseph over het beperken van een aantal grondslagen voor gegevensverwerking
Amendment removes or tightens data-processing bases in medical and help-line contexts, requiring patient consent and deleting IGJ and Kaderwet grounds for special personal data.
This basis is deleted by this amendment.
Deze grondslag wordt met dit amendement geschrapt.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de toepassing van artikel 137 Pensioenwet bij pensioenfondsen met bijstortingsverplichting

MP Joseph (BBB) asked whether the Wtp exception to the indexation rules of article 137 Pensioenwet for funds with an employer top-up obligation lapses once new accrual moves out, and how the transition safeguards protect members from social partners invaring such funds. The minister confirmed the exception lapses for closed funds, said invaren is a choice for social partners subject to DNB review and the requirement of an evenwichtige transitie, and rejected the premise that members could rely on article 137 in the way described.
It is not for me to pass judgment on whether or not to invaren.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over het wel of niet invaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het artikel ‘Cordaan en Amsterdam UMC stoppen na zeven jaar met Wijkkliniek in Zuidoost’

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Cordaan/Amsterdam UMC wijkkliniek in Amsterdam Zuidoost and whether the minister would press insurers to keep it open and support such models structurally. The state secretary replied that care capacity for the region is assured, that the NZa and ZiNL are discussing lessons learned with the parties, and that the minister will not force insurers to contract specific providers, though the wijkkliniek concept continues in a revalidation payment experiment.
The NZa and ZiNL are taking up their system responsibility by entering into discussion with Cordaan and Zilveren Kruis.
De NZa en ZiNL pakken hier hun systeemverantwoordelijke rol door samen in gesprek te gaan met Cordaan en Zilveren Kruis
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de opvolging van aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman Pensioenen en het functioneren van de Geschilleninstantie Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the follow-up given by pension funds to Ombudsman Pensioenen recommendations and the functioning of the GIP dispute body, including calls for stronger powers and wider use of hardship clauses. The Minister largely defends the existing framework, stating no legal change is needed now, the GIP will be evaluated in 2028, and promising only to raise the Ombudsman's recommendations in consultations with the Pensioenfederatie and the GIP.
I hold regular consultations with the Pensioenfederatie and also regularly speak with the GIP. I take the Ombudsman's recommendation seriously and will raise it in those consultations.
Ik heb periodiek overleg met de Pensioenfederatie en daarnaast spreek ik periodiek de GIP. De aanbeveling die de Ombudsman maakt neem ik ten harte en zal ik bespreekbaar maken in die overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over communicatie en inrichting van compensatieregelingen in de pensioentransitie

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about how pension funds communicate compensation arrangements during the pension transition, citing an AFM report warning of late and unclear information and differences in compensation rules across funds. The Minister replies that funds must send personal transition forecasts one month before transition, that funds and employers can and should inform members earlier, that differences in compensation design are acceptable, and that no new communication rules are currently planned.

Because there are differences between pension funds in how compensation arrangements are designed, it is advisable for employees to contact their employer or pension fund with questions when something changes.

Omdat er verschillen zijn tussen pensioenfondsen in de vormgeving van compensatieregelingen, is het verstandig dat werknemers met vragen contact opnemen met de werkgever of met het pensioenfonds als er iets gaat veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het gebruik van ALM-modellen in de transitie naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether ALM models, designed for high-level strategy, are unsuitable for individual-level wealth redistribution during the pension transition, and whether statutory requirements risk overstating model reliability. The minister defended the framework, stating that ALM models are useful, that transition effects are assessed per cohort rather than individually, that DNB supervises the process, and that no additional guidelines are needed.
The supervision by DNB is sufficient. Therefore, no investigations, additional guidelines or safeguards are needed.
Het toezicht van DNB is voldoende. Er zijn dus geen onderzoeken, aanvullende richtlijnen of waarborgen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de spreiding van financiële schokken in de uitkeringsfase van flexibele premieregelingen

An MP asked the government whether pension rules on smoothing financial shocks in the payout phase disadvantage participants in flexible premium schemes compared with solidarity schemes, and whether these rules should be harmonised. The state secretary acknowledged implementation difficulties, pointed to a forthcoming bill (Q1 2026) allowing a one-off capital allocation at retirement, and largely referred back to that bill without committing to a new harmonisation review.
As already reported to your House, the Bill on pension commitments is expected to be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2026.
Zoals reeds aan uw Kamer gemeld wordt het Wetsvoorstel toezeggingen pensioenonderwerpen naar verwachting in het eerste kwartaal van 2026 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over ‘het fiscaal belasten van persoonlijk pensioenadvies’

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority's view that employer-paid personal pension advice is taxable wage conflicts with the Wet toekomst pensioenen goal of guidance and whether tax treatment should change. The state secretary replies that mandatory choice guidance is not taxable, but employer-paid personal advice is a private cost and thus taxable wage; a tax exemption would require a law change with budget effects, which the government sees no reason to pursue.
That is something different from extensive personal pension advice.
Dat is wat anders dan een uitgebreid persoonlijk pensioenadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over governance bij pensioenfondsen

MP Joseph (BBB) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension fund boards have too much influence over the supervisory board (RvT) and accountability body (VO), and whether independence of internal oversight should be strengthened. The minister answered that the bodies deliberately check each other, that no reform is planned now, and that a governance study will start in 2026.
In line with the answer to the previous question, all bodies in pension fund governance influence each other.
In lijn met de beantwoording op de vorige vraag hebben alle organen in de governance van pensioenfondsen invloed op elkaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de voorgestelde wijzigingen in de Regeling vrijstellingen Wet Bpf 2000

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about proposed changes to the Regeling vrijstellingen Wet Bpf 2000, which govern exemptions from mandatory sector pension funds, and criticism that the actuarial equivalence test may make exemptions too costly or impossible. The Minister defends the amendments as negotiated with the sector, notes that the regulation was revised after consultation (deterministic calculation as standard, no actuarial test per pension type), keeps the actuarial test in place, and promises publication in early October.
It was deliberately chosen to include elements in the test that can be well valued with a relatively simple calculation method (the deterministic calculation).
Er is bewust gekozen om elementen in de toetsing te betrekken die goed waardeerbaar met een relatief eenvoudige berekeningswijze (de deterministische berekening).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de mogelijkheid om af te wijken van parameters artikel 23a Besluit FTK bij bepaling transitie- effecten

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether DNB's Q&A allowing pension funds to deviate from the parameters of article 23a of the FTK Decree in transition calculations undermines legal certainty and democratic control. The minister replies that the Q&A only clarifies that net-benefit calculations are exempt from those parameters under the Pensioenwet, that DNB has since amended the Q&A, and that no existing transitions or legal changes are affected.
It is not the case that DNB, through a Q&A, generally permits pension providers to deviate from the law.
Het is niet zo dat DNB via een Q&A generiek toestaat dat pensioenuitvoerders afwijken van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over belastingheffing op pensioenen opgebouwd in Duitsland

MP Joseph (BBB) asks the Finance Minister about Dutch income tax on small German pensions since 2016, the roughly 57,500 affected people, the choice of the 15,000 euro threshold, the pending Supreme Court case, and whether relief will be given before a ruling. The State Secretary answers that the treaty rule is intended to reduce administrative burden, that the Hoge Raad has not yet ruled so no action will be taken beforehand, and that the EU ruling was implemented via the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2025 law.
There is an ongoing cassation procedure. I therefore await the judgment of the Supreme Court.
Er is sprake van een lopende cassatieprocedure. Ik wacht derhalve het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over onrust onder gepensioneerden over nieuw verwacht belastingverdrag met Spanje

An MP asked the Finance Minister about unrest among Dutch pensioners in Spain over a planned new tax treaty, and asked whether income-effect calculations for example households would be published. The state secretary said he knows of the concern, is willing to illustrate effects for some stylised cases and will inform the House when the treaty is published, while noting a full general estimate is not feasible.
I am willing to map out, as requested, the effects on the tax burden for a number of example cases.
Ik ben bereid om, zoals gevraagd, voor een aantal voorbeeldgevallen in kaart te brengen wat de gevolgen voor de belastingdruk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Fondsen mogen operationele buffer toch aanvullen vanuit solidariteitsreserve’

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension funds may top up their operational buffer from the solidarity reserve, and whether this conflicts with the Wet toekomst pensioenen and with DNB's invaarbesluiten. The Minister answered that the draft verzamelbesluit allows the solidarity reserve to be used to prevent pension cuts, that specific cases (APG, the multiplicative method) are for DNB to judge, and that DNB applies proportionality in enforcement.
I do not comment on specific cases, because I cannot enter into the relationship between the pension fund and the independent supervisor.
Over specifieke casussen doe ik geen uitspraak, omdat ik niet in de relatie kan treden tussen het pensioenfonds en de onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de gebrekkige naleving van de Europese toegankelijkheidswetgeving (EAA)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Interior Ministry about poor compliance with the European Accessibility Act, citing NOS reporting that most Dutch websites fail accessibility criteria, and asked about enforcement, ministry coordination, and complaint channels. The government answered that the directive only binds private firms, that supervisors have adequate powers and mandate, that it is too early to judge effects so an implementation review is planned, and that complaint reporting channels exist though no figures are yet available.
I will therefore first await practical experience and intend, together with the other relevant ministries, to have an implementation review of the European Accessibility Directive carried out.
Ik wacht daarom eerst de praktijkervaringen af en ben voornemens om samen met de andere betrokken ministeries een invoeringstoets op de Europese Toegankelijkheidsrichtlijn te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de rechtspositie van pensioendeelnemers bij informatieverstrekking en invaren

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension participants can rely on UPO pension statements and transition information, whether they can obtain binding confirmation and extra calculations, and whether statutory rights and timelines should be strengthened. The minister answers that pension entitlements follow the pension regulation rather than statements, that participants may request calculations and explanations, and that no binding documents or statutory changes are planned beyond announced information measures.
I see no reason nor possibility to grant rights to the UPO.
Ik zie geen aanleiding noch mogelijkheden om rechten toe te kennen aan het UPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het artikel ‘Datahack bij laboratorium veel groter, deel gegevens op dark web’

An MP (BBB) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Health about a data hack at laboratory Clinical Diagnostics, with records of about 485,000 cervical screening participants and other patients possibly exposed and some data on the dark web, and about delayed reporting, oversight, and trust in screening. The State Secretary answered that the breach affects about 230,000 additional people, that the AP and IGJ have opened investigations, that the lab has been suspended, and that the Cyberbeveiligingswet will strengthen obligations for care providers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over het bericht ‘Hervorming politieke pensioenen per 2028 in gevaar’

MPs Joseph and Vermeer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that the reform placing politicians' pensions in the new pension system by 2028 is at risk, including the bill's status, budgetary effects of delay, unresolved legal issues, and timing of consultation. The minister answered that the bill is in preparation, the target date of 1 January 2028 still stands, legal and technical issues will be addressed in the bill, and consultation is aimed for 2025.
The aim is to put the bill into consultation in 2025.
Het streven is het wetsvoorstel in 2025 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over de verjaring van schadeclaims bij invaren van pensioenen

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the 20-year absolute limitation period for pension-fund errors during the transition to the Wtp should be extended or start later, and whether members should get additional rights and documents. The minister acknowledged the court ruling, defended the existing limitation rules and Wtp safeguards, and declined most proposals, while promising some information measures.
I understand the concerns of the questioners about whether participants have sufficient room to act if errors are discovered late.
Ik heb begrip voor de zorgen van de vragenstellers over of deelnemers voldoende handelingsperspectief hebben, in geval fouten pas laat worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht 'Overstap naar nieuw stelsel drijft kosten pensioenfondsen flink op'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that transition costs to the new pension system are driving up pension fund expenses by about 20%, questioning their acceptability, deductibility from participants' pensions, and transparency. The minister answered that transition costs are expected and estimated at about 1 billion euro in total, that the cost rise is not solely due to the transition, and that a separation of transition costs is not feasible without creating false precision, while pointing to existing reporting duties and monitoring.
However, as previously agreed with your House, I consider it important to keep a close eye on this together.
Wel vind ik het, zoals eerder afgesproken met uw Kamer, belangrijk om met elkaar de vinger aan de pols te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Joseph over het havenpensioenfonds Optas en Aegon en de voortdurende juridische strijd, waarbij miljarden pensioengeld in verkeerde zakken beland is

Omtzigt and Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Optas harbour pension fund and Aegon, including the decades of litigation over pension money, a timeline of events, how much pension money was lost, DNB's supervisory role, whether a new mediator would be appointed, and the risk of future litigation under the Wtp. The Minister gave a largely defensive answer: past procedures were lawful, DNB has learned lessons and oversight of DNB is in place, no new mediator is planned, and the Wtp situation is different.

Since then DNB has taken as its starting point that insurers must individually notify policyholders in advance of a proposed merger and explicitly mention the right of objection policyholders have with DNB.

DNB hanteert sindsdien als uitgangspunt dat verzekeraars polishouders voortaan vooraf individueel aanschrijven over een voorgenomen fusie en dat verzekeraars daar expliciet het verzetsrecht noemen dat polishouders hebben bij DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Ppi’s splitsen pensioenkapitaal na schrappen restitutiebeding'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension providers (PPIs) are splitting accumulated pension capital after the Wtp removed the restitution clause, which otherwise returned a deceased member's savings to a partner or children. The minister confirmed that capital-funded survivor pension before retirement is no longer allowed under the Wtp, defended risk-based survivor coverage as clearer and fairer, and rejected the view that restitution must be restored, while noting existing accrued rights are protected by transitional law.
The survivor pension would indeed be low if the member has only been building pension for a short time and has relatively low wages.
Het nabestaandenpensioen zal namelijk laag zijn als de deelnemer nog maar kort pensioen opbouwt en bij deelnemers met relatief lage lonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Pensioenen flink omhoog in nieuw stelsel: Stijging tot 8 procent

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension payouts would rise under the new pension system, and about data errors, the timing of corrected payouts, accountant checks, and how members were informed and can seek redress. The minister answered that data quality is secured through fund-level checks, external accountant reviews and DNB assessment, that errors may still surface and must be corrected, and that members can seek redress via the fund, GIP/Kifid or the courts.
It cannot be ruled out that errors will still come to light in the future.
Het is echter niet uit te sluiten dat er, in de toekomst, alsnog fouten naar voren komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht “De slapers worden wakker”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about claims that the Wet toekomst pensioenen sidelines inactive pension members (slapers) during the pension transition, including the hearing right and the risks for young slapers. The minister rejected the claim that slapers are excluded, pointed to collective safeguards such as the hearing right and fund-level balancing, and declined to comment on individual fund cases.
I do not go into individual cases, because it is not for me to provide insight into pension fund-specific situations or to give a judgement on them.
Op individuele casussen ga ik niet in, omdat het niet aan mij is om inzicht te verschaffen in pensioenfondsspecifieke situaties en/of hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat een geheime deal een gapend gat achterliet in de pensioenen van DSM

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a reported EUR 99 million transfer from the DSM pension fund to the employer, low premium payments, the fund's complaints committee and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister answered that the fund must follow the law under DNB and AFM supervision, that the Ombudsman acts independently, and that the questions could not be answered within three weeks because information was being obtained from external parties.
I cannot go further into specific questions about the supervision that AFM and DNB exercise over institutions.
Ik kan verder niet ingaan op specifieke vragen over het toezicht dat AFM en DNB op instellingen uitoefenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Joseph over het feit dat het pensioenfonds Gasunie wil beleggen met geleend geld voor jonge deelnemers, die daardoor hun hele pensioenopbouw kwijt kunnen raken

Two MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that young pension members could lose their entire accrued pension if a pension fund lifts the borrowing restriction and invests with leverage, and what will be done about it. The minister answers that governance requirements and DNB supervision sufficiently limit the risk, that an evaluation of the practice will follow, and that no further agreements or regulation are seen as necessary.
I believe the current governance requirements and safeguards sufficiently limit the risk.
Ik vind dat de huidige governancevereisten en waarborgen het risico voldoende beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over uitsluiting juridische hulp bij conflicten die te maken hebben met invaren door DAS rechtsbijstandverzekering

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked whether insurer DAS excluded legal aid for disputes about the transition to the new pension system (invaren) and what this means for citizens' legal protection. The minister confirmed the exclusion, said the Wtp offers internal complaint routes and the GIP and Kifid as low-threshold external bodies, and said insurers set their own terms while the government has not yet found reason for intervention.
The effective legal protection for people during invaren is not determined by the policy terms of any legal expenses insurer.
De effectieve rechtsbescherming voor mensen bij het invaren wordt niet bepaald door de polisvoorwaarden van enige rechtsbijstandsverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de informatievoorziening rondom invaren en de kritiek van de AFM

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the AFM's criticism that informing pension fund members only one month before transition to the new pension system (invaren) is not in their interest, and whether the statutory notice period should be extended to two to three months. The minister answered that one month is adequate, that funds set their own timing, that no extension is planned, and that existing guidance and the AFM's own transition bulletins suffice.
No, at this moment I, like the AFM, see no reason to extend this minimum term.
Nee, op dit moment zie ik net als de AFM geen redenen om deze minimale termijn te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omzigt, Welzijn en Joseph over de Woontop, waar pensioenfondsen schitteren door afwezigheid

MPs Omtzigt, Welzijn and Joseph asked why pension funds were absent from the Woontop housing summit, whether they had been invited and how their participation would be secured. Minister Keijzer answered that the Pensioenfederatie was invited but declined to sign commitments on individual investment decisions, and that talks with the pension sector and a joint investment-climate picture within six months would continue.
I cannot make statements about confidential conversations.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over vertrouwelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over “de vooraankondiging voor reparatiewetgeving met terugwerkende kracht in verband met invaren 1 januari 2025”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about tax knots that could make pensions of the early-invaring funds (PWRI, Loodsen, APG) tax-excessive from 1 January 2025, and why the government did not postpone invaren while retroactive repair legislation is pending. The government answered that the knots are technical, that a policy decision anticipating legislation will provide legal certainty, that the repair is not budgetary, and that it could not answer all questions before 25 December 2024.
It did not succeed in answering these before 25 December 2024.
Het is niet gelukt deze te beantwoorden voor 25 december 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over pensioenfonds PWRI dat 1 januari 2025 wil invaren

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the regulators (AFM and DNB) should have approved the transition of pension fund PWRI on 1 January 2025, given the fund's own warnings that members will not understand or trust the mandatory information and that individual data are not yet loaded. The Minister answers that the fund is responsible for communication, that DNB assesses the transition on legal criteria without a power to judge the specific fund's merits, and that members can request inspection of their individual calculations.
I cannot go into supervisory-confidential questions about specific institutions under the supervision of the regulators AFM and DNB.
Ik kan niet ingaan op toezichtvertrouwelijke vragen over specifieke instellingen die onder toezicht staan bij toezichthouders AFM en DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de effecten van invaren voor gewezen deelnemers

Rep. Joseph asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the position of deferred members ('slapers') when pension rights are transferred to the new pension system, citing an opinion piece and concerns about the hearing right, transition plans, projected losses and DNB's supervision. The Minister answers that individual cases are not commented on, that statutory safeguards (balanced interest weighing, hearing right, advisory and approval bodies) apply, and that the responsibility for transition plans and their assessment lies with social partners, pension funds and DNB.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, it is not for me to go into individual cases and give a judgement on them; social partners decide on the design of their pension scheme.

Het is, zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven, niet aan mij om op individuele casussen in te gaan en daar een oordeel over te geven; sociale partners gaan over de invulling van hun pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het indexatiebeleid van pensioenfondsen die willen invaren

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about pension funds such as ABP and PFZW choosing lower indexation than the rules allow while citing protecting the transition to the new pension system, and whether this is fair to members who may die before transition or who have small pensions. The minister replied that fund boards decide independently under the balanced-interests norm, that the relaxed indexation rules are a legitimate option when transitioning, and declined to require DNB supervision changes or public, quantified justification by funds.
It is up to a fund to account to its participants.
Het is aan een fonds om verantwoording aan zijn deelnemers af te leggen.
Antwoord op de nog openstaande vraag (nr. 5) van het lid Joseph over het onderzoek naar de tevredenheid over het hoorrecht onder gewezen deelnemers en gepen

An MP asked the minister for all correspondence between EY and the ministry on the survey into satisfaction with the right to be heard among former participants and pensioners, including draft versions. The minister sent partial correspondence, withholding drafts and redacting names and business-confidential material, while offering a follow-up assignment to produce verifiable interview summaries.
I hereby send you the answer to question 5 from MP Joseph of NSC about the survey into satisfaction with the right to be heard among former participants and pensioners.
Hierbij zend ik u het antwoord op vraag 5 van het lid Joseph van NSC over het onderzoek naar de tevredenheid over hoorrecht onder gewezen deelnemers en gepensioneerden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de spreidingsmethodes in de uitkeringsfases van de nieuwe premieregelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about spreading methods for benefit phases in new collective pension schemes, including whether asymptotic spreading conflicts with the 10-year rule in article 63a Pensioenwet and whether the coverage-ratio method should be legally enabled. The Minister answered that the Besluit gelijke aanpassingen met spreiden provides a workable framework, that the coverage-ratio method is not desirable to enable by law, and that the flexible scheme's options will be reviewed and reported in spring.
I will inform your House about this in the spring, so that you can take it into account in the planned handling of the Toezeggingenwet.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in het voorjaar informeren, zodat u dit bij de voorgenomen behandeling van de Toezeggingenwet kunt betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de toekomst van de Volksbank

An MP asked the Finance Minister why privatisation options (private sale or IPO) are considered for the Volksbank rather than public or cooperative models, and whether public interests like branch access and a diverse banking sector are secured without state ownership. The minister answered that the NLFI advice favours sale or listing, that public interests can be safeguarded by sector-wide instruments, and that the reorganisation and job cuts are decisions of the bank's board, though he could not rule out branch reductions.
It is up to the bank's board to determine the commercial and operational strategy.
Het is aan het bestuur van de bank om de commerciële en operationele strategie te bepalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Paniek over veiligheid pensioenen APG: kritisch rapport legt problemen bloot’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Minister's office whether APG, a major pension administrator, is adequately protected against cyberattacks, including a worst-case no-IT scenario, after a critical consultancy report surfaced. The minister answered that APG's security is high, that the worst-case scenario is extremely unlikely, that emergency payment processes were tested and reliable, and that supervision by DNB and AFM covers ICT risk, while not committing to a specific new step.
Following the reporting in De Limburger, I contacted APG about this.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in De Limburger heb ik hierover contact opgenomen met APG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de afscheidsrede van prof. Nijman over misleidende berekeningen in transitieplannen en pensioencommunicatie

MP Joseph asks the Minister of Social Affairs about Prof. Nijman's claim that transition calculations comparing old and new pension contracts are misleading, because buffers in the old FTK contract inflate the comparison, and whether pension funds should proceed with the 1 January 2025 transition. The Minister disagrees that the calculations are misleading, states they are supplementary to a balanced transition decision with context required in communication, and says the AFM supervises this and that funds may proceed.
I can confirm that. I note that these transition calculations do not in themselves define a balanced transition, but can only serve as a basis for reaching a balanced decision.

Dat kan ik bevestigen. Daarbij merk ik op dat deze transitieberekeningen op zichzelf niet een evenwichtige transitie definiëren, maar enkel kunnen dienen als onderbouwing om tot een evenwichtig besluit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de sluiting van online geldvraagbaak Kandoor

An MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the closure of the online financial help service Kandoor just before the pension transition, and whether pension funds are prepared for the resulting flood of questions. The minister answered that pension providers are responsible for informing members, that existing government information channels exist, that he has confidence in the sector's preparedness, and that he will examine with the sector whether Kandoor's functions could be added to the communication approach.
I cannot give insight into the annual costs, as this concerns business-confidential information of Kandoor.
Inzicht in de jaarlijkse kosten kan ik u niet geven, dit betreft namelijk bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie van Kandoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de aanpassing van ingegane variabele uitkeringen bij verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about whether insurers and pension funds may lower already-started variable pension payments after a rise in interest rates reduces the permitted fixed reduction, and whether this risk was intended by law. The Minister answered that some providers interpret the rules differently, that changes to the risk-free rate should not alter agreed reductions after payments start, and that DNB will clarify the explanation.
There is no overall overview available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Joseph over hittestress

MPs Welzijn and Joseph asked the minister about heat stress in homes, including the claim that half of Dutch residents live in overheating homes and whether heat should count as a defect. The minister partly recognises the problem, says the claimed figures cannot be confirmed, outlines existing measures and says the heat-as-defect question is under review.
The cited Investico research refers to 1 in 2 people, whereas the recently published Statistics Netherlands (CBS) research refers to 1 in 3 households.
Het aangehaalde onderzoek van Investico spreekt namelijk van 1 op de 2 mensen terwijl het recent gepubliceerde Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) 9 onderzoek spreek van 1 op de 3 huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Joseph over de berichten ‘ACM-beschuldiging van stilzwijgende kartel zit bank hoog’ en ‘Protestacties lijken ING niet te raken’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ACM findings on tacit collusion and weak competition in the Dutch savings market, including bank share buybacks, savings rates, account fees, cybersecurity costs, liquidity and credit to SMEs. The minister largely accepts the ACM diagnosis, announces studies on unbundling and fee issues, and defers many questions to banks and DNB, declining to act directly on buybacks.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who have no current account with them.
Ik ga onder meer onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over uitingen van de AFM over verkeerde pensioenverwachtingen als gevolg van een ‘rentedip’ in de modelberekeningen

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister about the AFM warning that a 'rate dip' in the scenario sets can misstate pension expectations for people about to retire, by up to about 8%. The minister acknowledged the concern, said DNB is studying adjustments to the scenario sets, and that pension funds bear responsibility for communicating with context.
DNB has indicated that it is researching possible adjustments to limit the impact of the interest rate jumps.
DNB heeft aangegeven onderzoek te doen naar mogelijke aanpassingen om de impact van de rentesprongen te beperken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht dat GGZ Friesland het Centrum voor Neuropsychiatrie uiterlijk per 1 juli 2024 sluit

An MP asked the minister about the closure of neuropsychiatry units at GGZ Friesland (CNP) and Altrecht (Vesalius), whether they were unprofitable, whether care capacity and regional spread are adequate, who is responsible, and whether the closures could have been prevented. The state secretary answered that closures had several causes (no continuous demand, no waiting list, portfolio and financial considerations), that patients were placed elsewhere, that responsibility lies with insurers and providers, and that no further investigation is needed, while a regional care-network approach is being developed.
I have no information on the treatment capacity of all clinical and outpatient neuropsychiatry departments in the Netherlands and cannot say whether there are plans to close these departments.

Ik heb geen informatie over de behandelcapaciteit van alle klinische en poliklinische afdelingen van neuropsychiatrie in Nederland en ik kan niet aangeven of er plannen zijn om deze afdelingen te sluiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het antwoord van de minister op vraag 25 uit Aanhangsel Handelingen II, vergaderjaar 2023-2024, nr. 766 over Kamerstuk 32 043, nr 628, over de buffer van pensioenfondsen onder a

An MP asks the Minister for Pensions whether, after the Wtp amendment of article 129 Pensioenwet, DNB's view that the buffer below that threshold must benefit existing accrued rights still stands, and whether using the buffer to fund transition compensation amounts to prohibited repayment. The minister confirms the DNB memo, says it is a supervisory interpretation rather than a DNB opinion, and states that article 129 no longer applies to compensation at transition, leaving the choice on compensation to social partners.

For completeness, I note that the document referred to does not represent a view, opinion or otherwise of DNB but an interpretation of the supervisory framework regarding the legal provisions then in force.
Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het genoemde document geen visie, mening of anderszins van DNB betreft maar een duiding van het toezichtskader aangaande de toen geldende wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de P-scenariosets en hun impact op pensioencommunicatie en beleggingsbeleid

Member Joseph (NSC) asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about DNB's P-scenario sets, including interest-rate dips, the sharp rise in long-term equity volatility, and their effects on pension communication and risk-appetite tests. The Minister defended the Commissie Parameters methodology as objective and replicable, attributed the changes mainly to fund-specific choices, and declined to modify the sets or open the model code, while promising a DNB summary of changes each quarter.
I therefore see no reason to doubt the correctness of the scenario sets.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om te twijfelen aan de correctheid van de scenariosets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over de brief van 6 februari ‘Gelijke aanpassingen met spreiden in de uitkeringsfase’

Two MPs (Joseph and Vermeer) asked 30 detailed questions about the minister's letter on equal adjustments with smoothing in the pension payout phase of solidarity schemes, including methods, transparency and the Palland amendment. The minister answered that the forthcoming Decree will give legal clarity on conditions for equal adjustments with smoothing, while many answers defer detailed design to pension funds and the forthcoming Decree.
The implementation framework from the letter will result in the Decree, which will be submitted for internet consultation in April, and I will inform your House about it.
Het uitvoeringskader uit de Kamerbrief resulteert in het Besluit wat in april ter internetconsultatie zal worden voorgelegd en waar ik uw Kamer over zal infomeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over uitingen van de AFM over onrealistische verwachtingen van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about AFM/DNB warnings that participants may hold unrealistic expectations of the new pension system, including very high optimistic-scenario projections in transition plans, and about the legal robustness and responsibilities for those plans. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the AFM consultation is ongoing, states that transition decisions are legally valid if made properly, and places responsibility for transition plans with social partners and pension providers.
The AFM is consulting with pension federations, SZW and other pension parties on this subject.
De AFM voert overleg met pensioenkoepels, SZW en andere pensioenpartijen over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Joseph over het bericht 'Long covid is lichamelijk en 'zit niet tussen de oren', toont onderzoek aan'

MPs Daniëlle Jansen and Joseph asked the Minister of Health whether long COVID has a physical cause, whether complex multi-organ care should be concentrated in expertise centres under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, and how funding, work reintegration and policy effectiveness are handled. The Minister answered that research is ongoing, that care organisation is primarily up to care providers and insurers, that no specific concentration was agreed in the IZA, and that he will facilitate talks and hold a conference, without committing to new structural measures.
It is primarily up to the care parties themselves to organise good care around the patient together.
Het is primair aan de zorgpartijen zelf om met elkaar goede zorg rondom de patiënt te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark en Joseph over het bericht 'Richard (35) zit zonder strafblad al 12 jaar opgesloten in tbs-kliniek tussen zware criminelen: hij is niet de enige'

MPs Uitermark and Joseph asked about reports that a psychiatric patient without a criminal sentence has been held for 12 years in a tbs clinic, and about shortages of care places. The minister said seven people without a criminal title are in a level-4 setting for treatment reasons, that a plan of action with sector partners is underway to create temporary and permanent places for about sixty people, and that co-placement is in principle undesirable but may be clinically justified.
I cannot go into the case mentioned in the article and therefore cannot give a judgement on the reporting on this point.
Ik kan hier niet ingaan op de in het artikel genoemde casus en daarom ook geen oordeel geven over de berichtgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over monitoring doelen transitie Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about transition plans under the Wet toekomst pensioenen for many pension funds, covering premiums, pension targets, projected pensions, investment mix, partner pensions and risks. The Minister answered that transition plans are the responsibility of social partners and funds, provided factual summaries of publicly available plans, and explained that comparisons are limited and risks largely fall on participants.
It is up to social partners to make collective labour agreements and record them in the transition plan.
Het is aan sociale partners om arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken te maken en deze vast te leggen in het transitieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over "de invaaradviezen"

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister why legal advice on pension-transition (invaren) would only be available confidentially, whether counsel and the public could see it, and asked for the advice and internal correspondence to be published. The minister refused to publish the advice because it concerns the state's litigation position, offered confidential inspection to MPs, declined to release counsel correspondence, and agreed only to inventory internal correspondence on invaren advice from 2020 with an update expected by end of March.
Advice concerning the state's litigation position is not suitable for publication.
Adviezen die betrekking hebben op de procespositie lenen zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de openbaarmaking van interne adviezen aan bewindspersoon rond invaren in het kader van de Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the disclosure of internal advice on invaren (collective transfer of accrued pension rights) under the Wet toekomst pensioenen, including the legal tests for property rights under the ECHR, the feasibility of a phased 'ingroei' alternative, and why fiscal indexation limits were kept. The minister answered at length that invaren meets the ECHR criteria, that the ingroei variant does not achieve the same goals, and that some advice is confidential and not disclosed.
The content of this communication falls under the confidentiality of communications between lawyer and client. I will not make this communication public.
De inhoud van deze communicatie valt onder de vertrouwelijkheid van de communicatie tussen advocaat en cliënt. Ik zal deze communicatie niet openbaar maken.

m: Motie van het lid De Vos over een gedekt voorstel voor de herinvoering van rode diesel zonder belastingen elders te verhogen
Asks the government to propose a fully funded reintroduction of red diesel without raising taxes elsewhere.
requests the government to come with a funded proposal for reintroducing red diesel without raising taxes elsewhere
verzoekt de regering om met een gedekt voorstel te komen voor de herinvoering van rode diesel, zonder de belastingen elders te verhogen
Motie van het lid De Vos over de hypotheekrenteaftrek onaangetast laten en met een gedekt voorstel komen om het maximale aftrektarief terug te brengen naar 52%
Asks the government to keep mortgage interest deduction untouched and propose a funded plan to restore the maximum rate to 52%.
requests the government to leave this deduction unaffected
verzoekt de regering deze aftrek onaangetast te laten
Motie van het lid De Vos over een voorstel uitwerken dat alle bedrijven in Nederland de optie verleent om btw bij B2B-transacties te verleggen via btw-nummers
Asks the government to draft a proposal giving all Dutch businesses the option to shift VAT on B2B transactions via VAT numbers, and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum 2026.
requests the government to draft a proposal giving all companies in the Netherlands the option to reverse-charge VAT in B2B transactions via VAT numbers
verzoekt de regering om een voorstel uit te werken dat alle bedrijven in Nederland de optie verleent om btw bij B2B-transacties te verleggen via btw-nummers
Motie van het lid De Vos over afzien van de geplande verhoging van de vliegbelasting per 2027 en geen nieuwe lastenverzwaring op vliegreizen invoeren
Asks the government to drop the planned 2027 increase in the aviation tax and not introduce new burdens on flights.
requests the government to refrain from the planned increase of the aviation tax from 2027
verzoekt de regering af te zien van de geplande verhoging van de vliegbelasting per 2027
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de mogelijkheid niet langer heel Nederland aan te wijzen als kwetsbare zone in het kader van de Nitraatrichtlijn

An FVD MP asked whether the Netherlands can narrow the Nitrates Directive's vulnerable-zone scope from the whole territory to parts of it, so that the stricter 2026 manure rules apply less broadly. The minister answered that the 7th action programme applies nationwide, so no zones are designated, that revision is for the next cabinet's 8th programme, and that the Commission must be notified and could start infringement proceedings if designation is inadequately justified.
Since in the Netherlands the action programmes apply to the entire Dutch territory, there is no list of vulnerable zones that can be revised.
Aangezien in Nederland actieprogramma's van toepassing zijn op het gehele Nederlandse grondgebied is er geen lijst van kwetsbare zones die herzien kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het bericht 'Nederland koopt opvang migranten af voor 33 miljoen euro'

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that the Netherlands would pay 33 million euros to offload reception of 1,650 migrants, why the EU solidarity figures were kept confidential, whether asylum seekers can re-apply after relocation, and whether the Netherlands should seek exemption or refuse the pact. The minister answered that the solidarity pool was agreed at 21,000 relocations (420 million euros), the Dutch share is 5.2% (about 21.9 million), the proposal was confidential by law until Council agreement, and that the Dublin rules and the pact's border measures remain binding, with no Dutch exemption sought.
The document has been shared confidentially with your House.
Het stuk is vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de beslisnota bij Terugkeerondersteuning Syrië

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the raised departure premium of EUR 5,000 per adult for Syrians was determined, whether those who take it should be barred from future asylum or residence, and how re-entry could be detected through biometrics and border checks, and whether the support should extend to other migrant groups. The Minister answered that the amount follows the Ukraine precedent, that participants sign a declaration withdrawing pending or granted residence procedures, that re-entry would be refused under Schengen rules with the prior choice weighed in any new asylum assessment, and that identity is already recorded via DTenV systems.
Someone who departs with support signs a declaration by which any pending residence procedures, or an already granted residence permit, are withdrawn.
Iemand die met ondersteuning vertrekt tekent een verklaring waarmee eventuele aanhangige verblijfsmatige procedures, dan wel een reeds afgegeven verblijfsvergunning, worden/wordt ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de reactie van links-extremisten op de moord op Charlie Kirk

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about left-wing extremist reactions to the killing of Charlie Kirk, including celebrations in the Netherlands, a Radboud lecturer, Bob Vylan's Paradiso concert, and whether to expel foreign students or ban the concert. The Minister answered that glorifying political violence is unacceptable but generally not criminal, that prosecution and assessment are for the OM and courts, that no new monitoring or research is planned, and that tackling all forms of extremism is a government priority.
Glorifying a murder is in principle not punishable.
Het verheerlijken van een moord is in beginsel niet strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het sturen van uitkeringen en inkomsten door statushouders en migranten naar hun land van herkomst

An MP asked whether benefits paid to refugees and migrants (notably Eritreans) are sent abroad, whether this should be restricted, and about counter-terrorism financing. The government said it does not track how benefit recipients spend money, that discrimination by origin is prohibited so benefits cannot be cut for these groups, and it described existing controls and the end of the remigration scheme.
The Ministry of SZW does not keep an overview of how recipients spend benefits.
Het Ministerie van SZW houdt geen overzicht bij van de besteding van uitkeringen door ontvangers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid vragen van het lid De Vos over de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing voor en weerlegging van de zogeheten “hockeystick” grafiek van het IPCC

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to substantively address the McIntyre and McKitrick critique of the IPCC hockey stick graph and to explain why the minister cited the Berkeley Earth 2024 temperature report, which does not address that graph. The minister answered that the critique was already rebutted, cited a National Center for Atmospheric Research review and later independent reconstructions that confirm recent warmth is unprecedented, and said one graph is not a pillar of climate policy though IPCC reports as a whole are.
However, the criticism of McIntyre and McKitrick of the hockey stick graph has already been extensively refuted.
Kritiek van McIntyre en McKitrick op de hockeystickgrafiek is echter al uitgebreid weerlegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de wijze waarop geluidshinder rondom Schiphol wordt gemodelleerd, gevalideerd en gemeten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how aircraft noise around Schiphol is modelled, validated and measured, including whether NOMOS outdoor measurements can capture indoor annoyance. The minister answered that noise exposure is modelled with Doc29 and validated against measurements since 2017 (structurally since 2024), that outdoor measurements are not meant to measure annoyance, and that indoor measuring is impractical, while promising a plan for noise measurement before summer 2025.
Measuring aircraft noise exposure indoors at residents' homes gives no insight into the annoyance those residents experience.
Het binnenshuis meten van de geluidbelasting van vliegverkeer bij omwonenden geeft geen inzicht in de hinder die deze omwonenden dan ervaren.

m: Amendement van de leden Saris en Mohandis ter vervanging van nr. 11 over extra financiële ondersteuning voor de inrichting van het Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket
Shifts 750,000 euro in 2025 from long-term care to sport and exercise to fund the Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket.
In article 3 Long-term care and support, the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 750 euros (x 1,000).
In artikel 3 Langdurige zorg en ondersteuning worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 750 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Saris over extra financiële ondersteuning voor de inrichting van het Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket
Shifts 750 thousand euro for 2025 from long-term care to sport to fund the Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket.
to free up an extra 750,000 euro for this central desk in 2025
om voor 2025 extra € 750.000 vrij te maken voor dit centrale loket
Motie van het lid Saris over de verkorting van de WW-duur alleen doorvoeren met concrete maatregelen voor betere ondersteuning en omscholing bij werkloosheid en arbeidsongeschiktheid
Motion asks the government to pair the shortening of unemployment benefit duration with concrete support, retraining and prevention measures.
requests the government to make maximum efforts to implement the WW duration cut only together with concrete measures
verzoekt de regering zich maximaal in te spannen om de WW-duurverkorting alleen door te voeren gepaard met concrete maatregelen

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Saris c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over het voor de Europese blauwe kaart vereisen van een minimumsalaris van 1,3 keer het gemiddelde bruto jaarinkomen in Nede

Requires that applicants for the EU Blue Card be refused if they would earn below 1.3 times average gross annual salary, with a lower 1.1 threshold for recent graduates, set by general administrative order.
is refused if the foreign national will work for a lower salary
wordt afgewezen indien de vreemdeling arbeid zal gaan verrichten voor een lager salaris
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Saris c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over een verplichte arbeidsmarkttoets door het UWV

shall be refused if the body referred to in article 5(2) of the Foreign Workers Act advises that priority labour supply exists for the position
