qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verouden, Kouwenhoven en Saris over de ingreep bij Nexperia

MPs Verouden, Kouwenhoven and Saris asked Minister Karremans about the government's intervention at Nexperia under the Goods Availability Act, including legal advice, timing, consultation with Europe and China, and information provision to parliament. The minister largely referred to earlier letters and a timeline, withheld advice and documents citing confidentiality and company information, and defended the intervention as necessary to protect supply security.
Because of the classified nature of this file, the cabinet cannot make these advices public.
Vanwege het geclassificeerde karakter van dit dossier kan het kabinet deze adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Saris over het aanpakken van sluiproutes voor derdelanders om toegang te krijgen tot de Nederlandse arbeidsmarkt

MPs Van Hijum and Saris asked how third-country nationals obtain BSN numbers via RNI counters to access the Dutch labour market illegally, and what sanctions and checks apply. The State Secretary answered that a BSN confers no work rights, announced restricted RNI counters for third-country nationals from January 2, higher fines for employers, and an ongoing study on an arrival notification, but gave limited detail on some sanctions and timing.
I am having it examined, as previously reported, whether it can be effective and proportionate to exclude registration at RNI counters for third-country nationals.
Ik laat, zoals eerder gemeld, onderzoeken of het effectief en proportioneel kan zijn om inschrijving aan RNI-loketten voor derdelanders uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kouwenhoven en Saris over het bericht 'Terugbetaling toeslagen leidt steeds vaker tot problemen bij burgers'

MPs Kouwenhoven and Saris asked the Dutch government about reports that repayment of childcare and other benefits is causing growing problems for citizens, including the scale of repayments and debts, the complexity of the system and its social and economic costs. The state secretary answered that the system is not bankrupt but needs fundamental reform, pointed to recent simplification measures and planned bills, and acknowledged that repayments cannot always be avoided under the current design.
To prevent that, it is necessary to fundamentally revise the system of allowances.
Om dat te voorkomen is het nodig om het stelsel van toeslagen fundamenteel te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Wingelaar en Saris over het gebruik en de bescherming van Nedersaksisch en Limburgs als streektalen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior why Low Saxon and Limburgish are protected under Part II rather than Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, and what the state has done to support them. The minister answered that Part II already provides adequate protection through convenants with regional governments, that Part III's adoption requires further analysis, and that the convenant with Low Saxon is under evaluation.
Whether extension to Part III is appropriate requires further analysis of feasibility and resources and will proceed in consultation with the regional governments concerned.
Of uitbreiding naar deel III passend is, vraagt een nadere analyse van uitvoerbaarheid en middelen en gaat in samenspraak met de betrokken regionale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Saris over het bericht dat schijnzelfstandigen worden ingezet bij de renovatie van het Binnenhof

MP Saris asks whether false self-employed workers are being used on the Binnenhof renovation and what the government is doing about it. The government answers that it has not received union complaints, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf checks contractors on compliance and will take measures if violations are found, and that it plans to reduce false self-employment within the central government by 1 January 2026.
On the progress in reducing the number of (potential) false self-employed workers in central government, you will be informed shortly by the Minister of BZK, in line with the Boon motion.
Over de voortgang van het afbouwen van het aantal (potentieel) schijnzelfstandigen bij de Rijksoverheid wordt u – conform de motie Boon – op korte termijn geïnformeerd door de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Dijk en Patijn over de Kamerbrief 'Informeren over bouwplaats ID en over inhoudingen op het minimumloon,' d.d. 30 oktober 2025 (kenmerk: 2025-0000214845)

MPs Saris, Dijk and Patijn asked why the minister abandoned the planned phase-out of deductions from the minimum wage for housing, given the migration goal, the Labour Inspectorate's warnings about abuse and the Aanjaagteam recommendations. The minister answered that the 25% cap stays because abolition would currently harm migrant workers more, and pointed to consultation, the Wet Goed Verhuurderschap and planned measures, answering all twelve questions in substance.
The cabinet has therefore decided that employers may for the time being continue to charge up to 25% of the statutory minimum wage for housing costs.
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten dat werkgevers vooralsnog maximaal 25% van het Wettelijk minimumloon in rekening mogen blijven brengen voor huisvestingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Saris en Dijk over het besluit de inhoudingsregeling voor huisvesting op het minimumloon van arbeidsmigranten in stand te houden

MPs Patijn, Saris and Dijk asked why Minister Paul decided within two weeks of taking office to keep the wage-deduction scheme for housing from the minimum wage for migrant workers, which the ministry had planned to phase out, and with whom he had discussed it. The minister answered that he made an independent decision based on the ministry's exploratory review, that employer and union bodies were consulted earlier in that review, and that the only later contact was a briefing to the Stichting van de Arbeid under embargo, with the rest of the answers repeating that no other conversations took place.
On 28 August my ministry received a copy of a letter sent by VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland to members of the House of Representatives.
Op 28 augustus heeft mijn ministerie een kopie ontvangen van een brief die door VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland is verzonden aan leden van de Tweede Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kouwenhoven en Saris over de ingreep van de Nederlandse overheid bij het bedrijf Nexperia

MPs Kouwenhoven and Saris ask the Minister of Economic Affairs about the government's Wbg order placing Nexperia under state supervision, including its economic and legal risks, the US 50% rule, Chinese export measures, and precedent for other multinationals. The minister defends the order as a targeted, independent decision based on the CEO's conduct, says it was not driven by US pressure, and states that the Wbg will very unlikely be used again.
Regarding the content of contacts with the US government in the context of export or sanctions regimes, I cannot make statements due to their confidential nature.
Over de inhoud van contacten met de Amerikaanse regering in het kader van export- of sanctieregimes kan ik vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter daarvan geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Voor 325.000 huishoudens dreigt pensioenarmoede’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that 325,000 households risk pensioner poverty, the definition of an adequate pension, the reduction target for workers without supplementary pension, and gaps for migrants and the self-employed. The minister answered that the AIO safety net prevents most such households from falling below the poverty line, that the reduction target is on track, and that foreign pension accrual cannot be tracked, while promising monitoring of self-employed pension accrual.
The Dutch pension system has several objectives.
Het Nederlandse pensioenstelsel kent meerdere doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Postma en Saris over de teloorgang van de iconische fietsenfabriek Batavus in Heerenveen en nieuwe kansen voor de maakindustrie

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the relocation of Batavus bicycle production from Heerenveen to Hungary, job losses, private equity motives, Hungarian industrial policy and state aid, and possible national programmes to keep manufacturing in the Netherlands. The minister replied that the move is a company decision within Accell's transformation programme, that the government cannot prevent it, had no direct contact with Accell, and that no new national programme is currently needed.
This concerns a company decision by the company itself, in which the government has no formal role and which cannot be stopped.
Het betreft een ondernemingsbeslissing van het bedrijf zelf, waarin de overheid geen formele rol heeft en die niet kan worden tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Welzijn over het Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland

MPs Saris and Welzijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the legal basis, supervision, Woo coverage and accountability of the Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland (BIDN), formerly the Inlichtingenbureau. The minister said tasks are largely statutory or performed as processor for public bodies, that the statutes change will be pre-submitted later this year, and that a conversion into an independent administrative body is left to that decision.

After advice on this intention from the Ministry of Finance's Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen and the Algemene Rekenkamer, the cabinet will take a decision, which is expected to be pre-submitted to the Eerste and Tweede Kamer by the end of this year.

Na advisering over dit voornemen door de Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen van het Ministerie van Financiën en de Algemene Rekenkamer neemt het kabinet hierover een besluit, dat naar verwachting voor het eind van dit jaar zal worden voorgehangen bij de Eerste en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het memo uniforme beoordeling duurzaamheid post-COVID

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a UWV memo on uniform assessment of long-COVID durability, WIA caseload figures, a planned monitor, and follow-up on Central Court rulings for ME/CFS. The minister confirmed awareness of the memo, gave case counts, declined an annual long-COVID monitor, and deferred to the NVVG guideline and UWV's own regional-differences study while noting that the rulings bind future and non-final decisions.
UWV's research into regional differences is in full swing and its results are expected in December of this year.
Het onderzoek van UWV naar regionale verschillen is in volle gang en de uitkomsten hiervan worden in december van dit jaar verwacht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Saris over de berichten ‘Meer buitenlanders kopen woning in Nederland, verdubbeling in vijf jaar’ en ‘Steeds meer woningen verkocht aan expats, ‘terwijl zoveel Nederlanders juis

MPs Welzijn and Saris asked the government about reports that expats and international buyers are increasingly purchasing homes, and about calls to end the 30% tax ruling, restrict expat admission and require municipal consent in scarcity areas. The minister answered that international buyers account for about 1.6% of purchases, with local price effects, that existing municipal tools suffice, that the 30% ruling is kept for business continuity, and that the government will address the shortage by building more homes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Saris over het bericht 'Basisscholen mogen helft van de lessen in het Engels, Duits of Frans geven: ‘een verrijking’'

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether allowing primary schools to teach up to 50% of lessons in English, German or French endangers Dutch language skills, given low literacy levels and the weight of the pilot's findings. The secretary answered that bilingual primary education does not harm Dutch skills, that schools will adopt it only where they have reason to, and that the pilot results and new core objectives adequately address the concerns.
With the decision on bilingual primary education, schools are given the option to provide up to 50% of instruction in English, French and German.
2 Met het besluit tweetalig primair onderwijs krijgen scholen de mogelijkheid om tot maximaal 50% onderwijs te geven in het Engels, Frans en Duits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht “Arbeidsmigrant heeft vaker ongeluk op de werkvloer. Weinig aandacht voor arbeidsveiligheid”

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about the higher accident rate among migrant workers, flexible employment, language barriers, unclear responsibility between employment agency and employer, and enforcement by the Labour Inspectorate. The government acknowledges the disproportionate accident rate, points to planned measures such as a reporting obligation for temp agencies and the Arbovisie 2040, and promises a full response to the Safety Board report by year-end.
As promised at the parliamentary committee debate on labour migration on 11 September, a response to the OVV report on the safety of migrant workers will follow before the end of the year.

Zoals toegezegd bij het commissiedebat Arbeidsmigratie op 11 september jongstleden zal er voor het einde van het jaar een reactie komen op het rapport van de OVV over de veiligheid van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Communicatieplannen grote fondsen laten tegenvallers onbesproken’

A member of parliament asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large pension funds' communication plans for the transition to the new pension system adequately address setbacks, as the AFM had warned. The minister acknowledged the importance of realistic transition communication, said regulation on transition information will be tightened by year-end, and stated that the AFM supervises the legal requirement to show worst-case pension outcomes.
The aim is to include this in regulations by the end of the year.
Het streven is om dit voor het eind van het jaar in regelgeving op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Patijn en Bikkers over borging van de regionale scholingsfondsen

MPs Saris, Patijn and Bikkers asked the Minister of Social Affairs about structural funding for regional training funds such as Twente and Achterhoek, the complexity of the SLIM subsidy scheme, unused SLIM funds, and the status of the Lifelong Development agenda. The minister acknowledged their value, said structural funding is still being explored and that no money is available for it, and promised a letter on the LLO agenda by year-end.
There are no funds available for structural funding, so a bridge to structural funding is not realistic.
Er zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor structurele borging, waardoor een overbrugging naar structurele borging niet reëel is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) de wet overtreedt bij keuringen op arbeidsongeschiktheid door een tekort aan personeel.

An MP asked the minister about reports that UWV breaches the law in disability assessments due to staff shortages, including the use of telephone assessments and quality control of assessing physicians. The minister denies that telephone assessments are unlawful, describes quality monitoring (MOK, audits, risk-based investigations) and says results are shared with the ministry and parliament where warranted.
That is factually incorrect, because the telephone assessment is, depending on the circumstances, a method permitted by the Dutch Association for Insurance Medicine (NVVG).
Dat is feitelijk onjuist, want de telefonische beoordeling is – afhankelijk van de omstandigheden – een volgens de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Verzekeringsgeneeskunde (NVVG) toegestane methode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘Mogelijk lichtpuntje voor werknemers Apollo Vredestein’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Apollo Vredestein plant in Enschede, including whether state aid rules should be revised, how the ESF+ and EGF funds could support affected workers, and whether the minister would visit Enschede. The government sees no need to revise the state aid anti-relocation rules for now, explains that ESF+ is available via the labour market region, notes SZW is exploring EGF options, and declines to commit to a visit until the company's plans are clearer.
On the basis of this assessment, the cabinet currently sees no need for revision, but continues to monitor closely
Op basis van deze afweging ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak tot herziening, maar blijft aandachtig volgen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Patijn, Bikker en Saris over de vertraging van het UWV-onderzoek naar de beoordeling van post-COVID-patiënten

MPs asked why the UWV study into how post-COVID patients were assessed for WIA benefits was delayed, and what is being done about knowledge gaps among insurance physicians and the duration-capacity standard. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the study is expected to finish in September, outlined a handbook and casuistry being developed with the NVVG, and rejected the view that the problem is structurally underestimated.
I regret that the study has been delayed.

De besprekingen van de ministerraad en de benoemingen die voorliggen zijn niet openbaar en hetgeen besproken wordt, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over “het bericht dat de minister van LVVN haar bevoegdheid misbruikte om de publicatie van emissiegegevens te verhinderen

MP Podt (D66) asks whether Minister Wiersma misused her powers and acted unlawfully by re-running the objection procedure and delaying publication of farm emissions data containing farmers' addresses, despite an Advisory Council and court ruling favouring publication. The minister defends the delay as a careful protection of farmers' privacy and safety, refuses to withdraw the appeal, and promises a study into farmers' social safety.
The use of this power is in accordance with the legal framework and is aimed at careful decision-making, not at delaying disclosure.
Het gebruik van deze bevoegdheid is in overeenstemming met het wettelijk kader en is gericht op een zorgvuldige besluitvorming, niet op het vertragen van openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht “Jongvolwassen Oekraïners tussen wal en schip: geen recht op onderwijs, geen toekomstperspectief”

MPs Podt and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about reports that young adult Ukrainians lack access to education and prospects, including tuition and student finance parity with EU/EEA students, lower institutional tuition, Piri motion follow-up, Dutch language provision and support for vulnerable newcomers. The government replied that temporary protection runs to 4 March 2027, that tuition-level decisions rest with institutions, and that details of a return programme and transition document will be sent to parliament in September 2025, without changing current rules in the meantime.
Pending final decision-making on this temporary national status for displaced persons from Ukraine, I do not intend to amend current laws and regulations in advance.
In afwachting van finale besluitvorming over deze tijdelijke nationale status voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne ben ik niet voornemens om vooruitlopend daarop de huidige wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt en Bamenga over “Het Uitvoeringsprogramma Impuls KRW Utrecht”

Two D66 MPs asked why the Netherlands is failing Water Framework Directive targets, why Utrecht province is adopting extra measures (notably on pesticides) that the national government is not, and how pesticide, nitrate and KRW rules can be aligned. The minister answers that the targets are shared with provinces and municipalities, that national action focuses on generic pesticide and nutrient measures and reauthorisation, and that the Utrecht programme is a provincial choice, while acknowledging further measures will be needed.
It is up to individual government bodies to weigh to what extent additional measures are appropriate.
Het is aan individuele overheidsorganen om af te wegen in hoeverre aanvullende maatregelen gepast zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over jongeren werkzaam in de bollenteelt

An MP asked whether 13-17 year olds may work with bulbs treated with pesticides, how many minors work in bulb growing, whether inspections target them, and whether rules are adequate. The Secretary of State answered that minors may only handle such bulbs under strict conditions (no CMR substances, residues minimised, employer obligations under the Arbobesluit), that data on minors' health risks are not yet known, and that the government is in talks with the sector about clarifying the rules.
SZW is in talks with the sector (LTO, Stigas) and trade unions about the practice regarding young people and crop protection products.
SZW is in gesprek met de sector (LTO, Stigas) en vakbonden over de praktijk rond jongeren en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Podt over stikstofbelemmeringen op defensielocaties

MPs from D66 asked the government about nitrogen (stikstof) rules blocking expansion of Dutch military training sites and air bases, including the consequences for NATO readiness and the specific permit barriers at each location. The State Secretary for Defence answered that a TNO study finds the impact on operational readiness 'enormous', that defence sites mostly lack nature permits, that permit procedures are slow and complex with no generic defence exemption under the Habitat and Birds Directives, and that the ministerial commission and an EU defence readiness omnibus are being used to find solutions.
The management summary of the TNO study and the Haskoning research report were sent to your House on 3 July 2025.
Het managementuittreksel van het onderzoek van TNO en het onderzoeksrapport van Haskoning zijn op 3 juli 2025 aan uw Kamer verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van Nispen, Piri en Bruyning over kinderen in de noodopvang

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks-PvdA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about children housed in emergency reception locations, including overcrowding, unsuitable sites, municipal population conditions, schooling delays, repeated relocations and access to youth care. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, acknowledged shortcomings, and pointed to a COA inventory study due in summer 2025 and steps on schooling and relocation.
COA does not keep track of whether a minor asylum seeker is enrolled in a school or regularly attends it.
Het COA houdt niet bij of een minderjarige asielzoeker staat ingeschreven op een school en of het kind de school geregeld bezoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het rapport ‘State of play on the implementation of the Pact on Migration and Asylum’ van de Europese Commissie

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a European Commission report on implementing the EU Migration and Asylum Pact, including Dutch reception capacity gaps, the delayed emergency plan, implementation delays, and the tension with the Commission's critical tone. The minister replied that the Netherlands is on schedule for June 2026, acknowledges reception capacity as a known concern, says an emergency plan has now been submitted, and promises ongoing monitoring and periodic updates to parliament.
The cabinet therefore appreciates the Commission's progress reports and that these reports respond to the Netherlands' request that concrete examples from member states be named.

Het kabinet waardeert daarom de voortgangsrapportages van de Europese Commissie en dat deze rapportages gehoor geven aan het verzoek van Nederland dat concrete voorbeelden van lidstaten worden benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de Zembla uitzending 'Gevlucht en verwaarloosd'

MP Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration, after a Zembla broadcast, about overload at Nidos guardianship, unsafe conditions in unaccompanied minors' shelters, foster-type family placements and oversight of host families. The Minister answered that workload concerns were raised and monitored, that smaller-scale care is the aim but emergency locations are used due to capacity pressure, that a Nidos internal review and an IGJ inspection are ongoing, and that the IND hearing practice and a broader improvement plan will be considered.
I will ensure that appropriate follow-up is given to the outcomes.
Ik zal erop toezien dat passend vervolg wordt gegeven aan de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het rapport 'Investeren in samenleven. Hoe arbeidsmigranten beter ingebed kunnen worden in de Nederlandse samenleving' van de Adviesraad Migratie

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the Adviesraad Migratie report on better integrating labour migrants, covering language skills, access to language courses, employer responsibility and a national integration programme. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to existing language provision and subsidies, and promises a letter before the summer recess with a policy response.
Before the summer recess I will send a letter on my policy to improve the social integration of labour migrants.
Voor het zomerreces zal ik een brief sturen met mijn beleid om de sociale inbedding van arbeidsmigranten te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Piri, Rajkowski, Van Nispen, Boomsma en Van Zanten over het preventiefonds en schaderegelingen voor ondernemers in Ter Apel

MPs asked whether the 800,000 euro preventive fund for Ter Apel is nearly exhausted, how remaining costs will be financed, whether damage settlement will be broadened by this summer, and whether a single counter for damage claims and preventive funds can be set up. The minister said the funds were paid to Westerwolde municipality, that the damage scheme will be widened case by case, and that a single counter is being explored with a decentralised grant to be decided by the municipality.
As promised to the House and stated in the letter of 11 March 2025, the damage scheme will be broadened.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd en benoemd in de Kamerbrief op 11 maart 2025, zal de schaderegeling verruimd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over regulering van bestrijdingsmiddelen

Two D66 MPs asked about the difference between low- and high-risk pesticides, health risks to farmers, residents and children, and whether municipalities can regulate pesticides and set spray-free zones. The minister explains the EU categories (candidates for substitution are approved for 7 years with comparative assessment), states that no carcinogenic substances are approved and that the RIVM is researching Parkinson, COPD and leukaemia, promises to improve municipal knowledge and information, but declines to set a national spray-free zone rule pending a research plan.
I maintain close contact with the VNG on the pesticide policy field.
Ik onderhoud nauw contact met de VNG over het beleidsterrein gewasbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de verdeelbesluiten Spreidingswet

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about dispersal decisions under the Spreidingswet, including municipalities receiving quotas that differ from provincial proposals, objections filed, and cases like Nijkerk and Brummen. The minister explains the criteria used for kansrijke initiatives, confirms 33 municipalities and one province objected, declines to discuss individual cases, and commits to talks with municipalities willing to do more and to reviewing financing of regular reception places.
Given the ongoing discussions and procedures, I cannot, as you know, go into individual cases at this time.
Gezien de lopende gesprekken en procedures kan ik zoals u weet op dit moment niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het Natuurnetwerk Nederland

An MP from D66 asked why the Natuurnetwerk Nederland (NNN) lags far behind its annual realisation target, what lessons from the IBO and Taskforce Versnelling have been implemented, what the consequences are for international goals, and what funding and measures will close the gap by 2027. The State Secretary attributes the shortfall to provincial capacity, land prices and procedures, states that responsibility lies with the provinces since decentralisation, reports that no results from the Taskforce recommendations are known yet, and refers to a forthcoming policy letter.
It is therefore the responsibility of the provinces to complete the Natuurnetwerk Nederland on time.
Het is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om het Natuurnetwerk Nederland tijdig af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over innovaties in de landbouw

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister about emission-reducing livestock innovations, the Lely Sphere subsidy, the reliability of the ammonia emission measurement method, and the wider effects of relying on innovation. The minister answered that the Lely Sphere is one of several subsidised techniques, that a measurement protocol and certification system are being revised, and that flanking policy is being explored within a ministerial commission, without committing to a specific new structural change.
It is desirable to reduce the uncertainty margins where possible. Work is being done on this.
Het is wenselijk om de onzekerheidsmarges waar mogelijk te verkleinen. Hier wordt aan gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Er woedt een keurmerkenstrijd om het ‘groene’ bosje bloemen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about Royal FloraHolland's MPS sustainability certificate, whether it exceeds legal requirements, its effect on organic growers and consumer confusion. The minister answered that the certificate partly adds requirements beyond the law, that the market sets its own standards, and that no commitment to change the scheme or talk with FloraHolland was given.
It is up to the market to determine the substantive requirements of various market-driven certification schemes and labels, such as those of MPS, and not up to the government.
Het is aan de markt om de inhoudelijke eisen van verschillende marktgedreven certificatieschema's en keurmerken, zoals die van MPS, te bepalen en niet aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Podt over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (KRW)

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the EU Water Framework Directive, including the Commission's finding that the Netherlands will likely miss its 2027 targets, the Tussenevaluatie, nitrogen and manure rules, permit backlogs and legal risks. The minister acknowledged the shortfall and the legal risks, pointed to the impulse programme and forthcoming measures before summer 2025, but gave largely general answers and deferred several points to other ministers and authorities.
Before summer 2025 the House will be informed about this.
Vóór de zomer van 2025 wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over veehouderij en gezondheid omwonenden (VGO-III)

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about the health risks for residents living near goat farms, including the rising goat numbers despite earlier advice on distances, the lack of causal proof, and whether direct measures will follow. The ministers answered that the risks are taken seriously, that the Health Council has been asked to advise in two parts (June and November 2025) before any follow-up policy is decided, and that talks with provinces and a WUR advice on reducing pathogens in stables are underway.
We take the health risks shown in the VGO-III report very seriously.
De gezondheidsrisico’s die uit het VGO-III rapport blijken, nemen we heel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Schoof: binnen twee maanden stikstofplan, 'economie moet blijven functioneren''

Two D66 MPs asked the agriculture minister for sector-level agricultural emissions figures, whether the 2030 climate target for farming is achievable, the budget gap, and how the stikstof (nitrogen) lock affects green projects. The minister gave breakdowns for 2023, said 2024 figures and the 2030 target status will follow later, outlined planned policy measures, and promised a joint package to be announced in the spring budget.
The cabinet will consider the required budgets for the various challenges, including the climate task, during the spring budget decision-making.
Het kabinet zal bij de voorjaarsbesluitvorming stil staan bij de benodigde budgetten voor de verschillende opgaven, waaronder de klimaatopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht 'Openbare agenda’s van bewindslieden geven te weinig inzicht in hun lobbywerk'

D66 MPs Podt and Sneller asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why his public agenda omitted or delayed entries, whether he had met burgomasters and key migration bodies. The minister answered that the agenda is generally accurate, that omissions were corrected, and listed meetings held with the Adviesraad Migratie, IOM, Nidos, UNHCR and the Inspectie, while admitting no contact with Vluchtingenwerk Nederland and Inspectie Jeugd & Gezin.
There were some omissions in the agenda, which have already been corrected.
Er was sprake van enkele omissies in de agenda, die zijn reeds hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over “Toezichthouder en ministerie van landbouw negeren EU-regels die kalfjes moeten beschermen, zeggen experts”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture whether Dutch rules on calf housing (isolated single boxes, visual and physical contact) fall short of the EU Calves Directive and whether the NVWA enforces them, and what will be done about it. The minister denies any incomplete implementation, says the Dutch rules match the EU minimum, and promises a Dutch animal-friendly livestock decree to be submitted to parliament in summer.
Rectification is not necessary; the Calves Directive has been correctly implemented in Dutch regulations.
Rectificatie is niet nodig, de Kalverrichtlijn is correct geïmplementeerd in de Nederlandse regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Meulenkamp, Bromet, Holman, Boomsma en Podt over gesprekken met de Deutsche Umwelthilfe en Agora Agrar gedurende het werkbezoek aan Berlijn van 15 tot en met 18 januari 2025

Six MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the German Stoffstrombilanzverordnung, a nutrient balance regime for farms, could inform the Dutch design of an enforceable nutrient balance and emissions targets, and whether the Dutch government would engage German authorities and report back. The minister answered that the German scheme is similar to the planned Dutch balance, that Dutch data sources exist, that lessons will be drawn, and that the minister is willing to talk with Germany and inform parliament if this yields insights.
I am willing to discuss this with the German government. If this leads to additional insights, I will inform you about it.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met de Duitse overheid. Indien dit tot aanvullende inzichten leidt, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Syriërs krijgen 900 euro contant bij terugkeer'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why voluntary return to Syria was being encouraged without a new country report, why the Chamber was not informed of the financial decision, and about the wording of a return promotion and an online post. The minister answered that there is no new policy, that the €900 is part of existing return support rounded up from €815, and that no forced return is currently happening.
Er is geen sprake van nieuw beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Wiersma: voorlopig geen ondergrens voor stikstofuitstoot, juridische check duurt minimaal 1,5 jaar' (Trouw)

An MP from D66 asks why the minister announced the nitrogen deposition floor (rekenkundige ondergrens) via media rather than a parliamentary letter, why the expert opinion was not shared with parliament, and whether the timeline of at least 1.5 years was communicated. The minister answers that no new process step was taken, the expert opinion will be published after the Raad van State advises, and the legal durability will take 1 to 1.5 years, while the floor could be applied in permitting in the meantime.
I intend to make the expert opinion and the peer reviews public after the Advisory Division of the Council of State has issued its advice on this.
Ik ben voornemens om het expertoordeel en de peerreviews openbaar te maken nadat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State hierover haar voorlichting heeft uitgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het artikel 'Ongrijpbaar voor haar ambtenaren, onbereikbaar voor de buitenwereld: minister Faber opereert ‘volstrekt ongebruikelijk’'

MPs Sneller and Podt asked about reports that a political assistant to the Minister of Asylum and Migration had not passed an AIVD security screening, whether they had access to sensitive information via WhatsApp groups, and about staff departures and the absence of spokespersons at that ministry. The government declined to discuss the individual case, described the general screening procedure and rules on messaging apps, and said an independent advice on extra rules for political assistants had been requested.
Due to the confidential nature of personnel information of this type, I will not make any statements about individual cases.
In verband met het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter van dit type informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de pandemische paraatheid van Nederland in het licht van recente internationale ontwikkelingen en aangekondigde bezuinigingen

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the ministers about Dutch pandemic preparedness amid international outbreaks, planned budget cuts of 300 million euros, staffing, vaccination willingness, and bird flu risks. The government answered largely by describing existing EU frameworks and programmes, noting that cuts are phased in and clarity will come mid-2025, and committing to further analysis and studies on bird flu structural measures.
The Ministry of VWS expects to be able to provide more clarity on funding for 2026 and beyond by mid-2025.
Het Ministerie van VWS verwacht medio 2025 meer duidelijkheid te kunnen geven over de middelen voor 2026 en verder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het wegtrekken van talent uit de Verenigde Staten naar aanleiding van de verkiezingswinst van Trump

Two D66 MPs asked how the Netherlands could attract talent leaving the United States after Trump's 2024 election, including whether to introduce a talent visa like the UK's or France's. The government answered that it runs a neutral, inviting knowledge-migrant policy, pointed to existing schemes, outreach and tax facilities, and said a new talent visa was unnecessary.
The cabinet will not speculate about possible policy the next government in the United States will introduce.
Het kabinet gaat niet speculeren over mogelijk beleid dat de volgende regering in de Verenigde Staten gaat invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Belgische sekswerkers krijgen arbeidscontract en sociale zekerheden’

MP Podt asked the Justice Minister about Belgium's new rules giving sex workers employment contracts and social security, and whether the Netherlands should follow, including questions on worker numbers, social security gaps, bank accounts, employer integrity rules, rights and trafficking detection. The minister answered that a Belgian-style law is not currently warranted, that most Dutch sex workers are self-employed or under the opting-in scheme, and described ongoing work on opting-in oversight, bank account standards and integrity screening via local licensing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Kinderrechtencollectief: 65% meer kinderen in noodopvang is onacceptabel'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that children in emergency asylum shelters face poor conditions, including the Minister's earlier claim that shelters met legal standards, and about the rise in children in emergency shelters, school access, and implementing a motion on limiting forced relocations. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the government is aware of the earlier inspection and ombudsman reports, admitted that current pressure makes it impossible to meet the standard of keeping children out of emergency shelters, and outlined measures such as child contact persons and school support, while stating it is not yet possible to say when the relocation limit will be achieved.
The starting point is that children do not stay in emergency shelter locations, but given the current pressure on reception capacity it is currently not feasible to meet this.
Het uitgangspunt is dat kinderen niet in noodopvanglocaties verblijven, maar met de huidige druk op de opvangcapaciteit is het momenteel niet haalbaar om hieraan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over doorstroomlocaties

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how many transit locations will be needed for refugees who cannot move into housing in 2025-2027, what they will look like, and who will pay for them. The minister answered that the number depends on location sizes, that details, financing and responsibility are still being worked out with local governments, and that new funding decisions will follow the budget cycle.
The exact number of transit locations depends on the size of the locations brought into use and is difficult to specify in advance.
Het precieze aantal doorstroomlocaties hangt af van de grootte van de locaties die in gebruik worden genomen en is op voorhand moeilijk te preciseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Piri en Podt over de (beveiligde) opvang van COA-bewoners en ongedocumenteerden met ernstige psychische problemen

MPs asked the government why it appeared to downplay concerns that the Veldzicht centre would stop accepting COA residents and undocumented migrants with severe psychiatric problems, and where such people could be placed safely. The minister answered that no decisions had yet been taken, that beds for the group remain available with case-by-case assessment, that responsibility is shared across ministers, and that the group will not be left on the street, while deferring full answers until a decision on the cooperation agreement was taken.
Discussions are taking place between the parties involved to ensure it is clear under which criteria and conditions this group can be placed in the reserved beds at Veldzicht.
Er vinden gesprekken plaats tussen betrokken partijen om te borgen dat duidelijk is onder welke criteria en randvoorwaarden deze groep op de gereserveerde bedden in Veldzicht geplaatst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Nispen over Veldzicht en de uitvoering van de motie-Van Nispen c.s. (Kamerstuk 24 587, nr. 995)

Two MPs asked whether the government will ensure that vulnerable undocumented migrants and COA residents with serious mental health problems, covered by a motion, do not end up on the street, after two people were refused access to Veldzicht. The minister confirmed the target group, said one refused person was ordered admitted by a court, and said that cases are assessed individually and cooperation arrangements remain in place, without giving a firm guarantee on all points.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament 'Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht' (reference 544779), you can assume that the current population staying in Veldzicht without a suitable alternative in mental health care will not simply be put on the street.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief «Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht» (referentie 544779), kunt u ervan uitgaan dat de huidige populatie die in Veldzicht verblijft zonder passend alternatief in de GGZ niet zomaar op straat wordt gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de Ontbossingswet

An MP asked the state secretary how the government views European Parliament amendments to the EU deforestation regulation (EUDR) that weaken it, whether it will oppose them in the Council, and whether it still backs the Dutch position adopted by parliament. The state secretary replied that a provisional trilogue agreement postpones the application date by one year, that the government supports the postponement, did not back the weakening amendments in the Council to avoid risking a quick deal, and still stands by its earlier position.
Although the cabinet understood some of the considerations behind the proposed EP amendments, the Netherlands indicated in the Council that it does not support the amendments.

Hoewel het kabinet begrip had voor een aantal van de overwegingen die ten grondslag lagen aan de voorgestelde amendementen van het EP, heeft Nederland in de Raad aangegeven de amendementen niet te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Podt over het bericht ‘Ministeries laten gevaarlijke man op straat zwerven, ondanks waarschuwingen’

MPs Van Nispen and Podt asked the Asylum and Migration Minister, on behalf of the Justice Secretary, why a dangerous undocumented man with a violent past was left on the street despite warnings, why he was refused by the Veldzicht clinic, and how this squares with earlier promises and a motion. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said he will be admitted to Veldzicht following a court ruling, defended clinic admission decisions as medical, and said the government shares responsibility while promising to clarify admission conditions with partners.
We do not go into individual situations.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Werf over de gevolgen voor veiligheid van de aangekondigde grenscontroles

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Migration, Defence and Justice how border controls would affect security, given KMar staff shortages, whether extra funding helps, and whether border municipalities were consulted. The government answered that controls run within existing KMar capacity, that funding is being worked out, that there was consultation with border regions, and that impacts on the economy will be kept to a minimum.
The internal border checks will be carried out on the basis of the KMar's existing capacity.
De uitvoering van de binnengrenscontroles zullen plaatsvinden op basis van de bestaande capaciteit van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de voortgang van het implementatieplan voor het EU Migratiepact

MP Podt (D66) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the progress of the national implementation plan for the EU Migration Pact, including missed deadlines, timing, budget realism and the EES implementation. Minister Faber answered that the final plan was sent to the Commission on 6 December with a copy to parliament, that the budget implications will be considered in the spring memorandum, and that the EES start is being phased by the Commission.
The final plan was sent to the Commission on 6 December.
Het definitieve plan is op 6 december jl. aan de Commissie gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht “Vrees voor grote chaos door grenscontroles: ellenlange files en klap voor Nederlandse economie”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Asylum and Migration about fears that border controls would cause traffic chaos and harm the Dutch economy, including impacts on border regions and whether an impact analysis would be made. The government answered that controls will be risk-based rather than systematic, no crossing points will be designated, no speed-limiting measures are planned unless strictly necessary, controls will be coordinated with Germany, and no significant extra costs are expected, but it declined to commit to a formal impact analysis.
The cabinet therefore expects that no significant additional costs will arise from the reintroduction of internal border controls.
Het kabinet verwacht daarom dat er geen significante extra kosten zullen ontstaan vanwege de herinvoering van binnengrenstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het kidnappen van Turkse burgers in Kenia

MPs Paternotte and Podt asked about the abduction of seven Turkish refugees in Nairobi, risks of refoulement and political punishment in Turkey, transnational repression of Gülen movement members, and whether a new country report on Turkey would be requested. The minister condemned the refoulement, said the ambassador raised it with Kenya, noted Gülen-linked profiles are treated as a risk profile in asylum policy, and committed to a new Algemeen Ambtsbericht Turkije by end of February 2025.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over nieuwkomer dierenartsen

MPs Podt and Bamenga asked about the NVWA's onboarding team for refugee veterinarians, recognition of foreign veterinary diplomas, remediation pathways, language training and similar programmes. The government confirmed the team contributes to NVWA staffing shortages, explained the recognition process and the legal limits on restricted veterinary licences, and described existing language subsidies and cooperation efforts, but did not commit to new funding or a specific new initiative.
The committee debate is no longer scheduled for 6 November.
Het Commissiedebat is niet langer gepland op 6 november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Vijlbrief over de Meerjarige Productie Prognose 2024-II

MPs Podt and Vijlbrief asked the Minister of Finance whether he knew of the MPP 2024-II forecast for Asylum and Migration, why the budget cuts for COA and IND were approved despite gaps with the forecast, and how he responded to the Court of Audit's concerns. The minister confirmed knowledge of the forecast, said the 2024-I version was known when the budget was set, pointed to the coalition agreement's planned asylum spending cuts, and promised to address budget adjustments in Voorjaarsnota 2025 using MPP 2024-2 data.
As usual, the cabinet will inform your House in the Voorjaarsnota 2025 about any budgetary adjustments to the Asylum and Migration budget.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal het kabinet uw Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota 2025 informeren over eventuele budgettaire bijstellingen voor de begroting van Asiel en Migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

An MP asks the agriculture minister whether the coalition's climate policy is sufficient to meet the 2030 targets, and about the emissions effects of dropping the nature/land programme, reintroducing red diesel and dropping the manure market plan. The minister answers that the 2024 Climate and Energy Outlook will show whether targets are met, that specific emissions effects are hard to isolate, and that further policy will be decided in the spring budget decision, but does not answer several questions in substance.
To what extent the current, planned and scheduled policy will achieve the 2030 climate targets will become clear from the Climate and Energy Outlook 2024.
In hoeverre met het huidige, voorgenomen en geagendeerde beleid de klimaatdoelen voor 2030 gehaald worden, zal moeten blijken uit de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning van 2024
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over enkele gedane uitspraken en de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid

MP Podt asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration what she meant by saying COA had been informed and had months to prepare, how this squares with ministerial responsibility for COA, and whether publicly blaming COA is appropriate. The Minister replied that she sought to meet the Ter Apel agreement by asking COA to place one or two extra asylum seekers per location, that she stands by her staff and agencies, that she will keep parliament informed, and that internal documents should stay internal, without committing to stop such statements.
It is my responsibility as Minister to transparently inform your House in response to questions the House has asked.
Het is mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister om uw Kamer transparant te informeren naar aanleiding van vragen die de Kamer heeft.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Bollenteelt levert mooie plaatjes op, maar overheid komt met verbod: ‘Risico voor drinkwater’’

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether other provinces or municipalities want a ban on non-organic bulb cultivation near drinking water catchment areas, what barriers exist, what the costs of water purification are, and how pesticide approval (Ctgb) relates to Water Framework Directive norms. The minister replied that provinces hold the powers over groundwater protection, that the issue will be raised in administrative consultation, that a study on banning pesticides in groundwater protection areas is ongoing, and that the Ctgb adjusted its working method after European Court rulings without yet changing its groundwater protection approach.
Provinces have far-reaching powers to protect groundwater.
Provincies hebben vergaande bevoegdheden om grondwater te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over opvang en werk voor asielzoekers en statushouders die nog in een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) verblijven

An MP asked about barriers to employing asylum seekers and status holders still in reception centres, including the 24-week rule, relocations, permit timing and commuting. The government answered that the Raad van State ruling removed the 24-week rule, that permit processing delays were largely resolved, and that it is pursuing pilots, a support structure, and a subsidy scheme, while declining to commit to a two-week transition period for relocations.
It is not desirable to introduce a transition period of at least two weeks, because a bed may then have to be reserved for too long.
Het is niet wenselijk om een overgangsperiode van minimaal twee weken in te voeren, omdat een bed dan mogelijk te lang moet worden gereserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Podt over het proefballonnetje van de minister

MPs Piri and Podt asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether the cabinet had decided to cut asylum residence permits from five to two years, and why she floated this in the media before a formal decision. The minister answered that no decision has yet been taken, that she wants two years for subsidiary protection holders based on her Denmark visit, and that the measure will be elaborated with other duration options.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Minister Faber schittert door afwezigheid in eigen ‘asielcrisis’: ‘Ik ken geen burgemeester die door haar gebeld is’

MP Podt asked how many mayors Minister Faber had personally phoned to secure asylum reception places, following a newspaper report that she knew of none. The minister answered that the COA is the first point of contact with municipalities, that she will raise the reception situation at the Landelijke Regietafel and with the Commissarissen van de Koning, and that she will contact a municipality herself if necessary, without giving a number.
I myself will speak on Thursday 26 September at the Landelijke Regietafel with representatives of, among others, the Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten
Zelf spreek ik op donderdag 26 september aanstaande tijdens de Landelijke Regietafel met vertegenwoordigers van onder meer de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht «Burgemeesters Apeldoorn en Epe lopen tegen grenzen aan: zelfs criminele Oekraïner eruit zetten mag niet»

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how municipalities can remove or sanction nuisance-causing Ukrainian displaced persons, given that expulsion from shelter is legally constrained, and whether high-security supervision locations (htl) could be used. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing tools and psychosocial support, says htl placement is legally and practically complex and the situation is still being evaluated, and promises answers to the remaining questions before the debate.
At present I am exploring the extent to which municipalities have implemented the new measures and what the effects of these are.
Op dit moment verken ik in hoeverre gemeenten de nieuwe maatregelen hebben geïmplementeerd en wat de effecten hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht Wc-papier komt vaak uit de groene woestijn van Brazilië

An MP asked whether FMO's 40 million euro loan to Suzano, a Brazilian pulp company, is justified given NGO claims of environmental and Indigenous harm, and whether the state should tighten FMO's sustainability policy and EU rules on financial flows linked to deforestation. The minister replied that FMO operates at arm's length within agreed frameworks, that FSC certification and an Environmental and Social Action Plan mitigate the risks, that the state cannot itself change FMO's policy, and that the EU will assess financial-flow rules by June 2025.
The State cannot itself change or tighten FMO's CSR and sustainability policy.
De Staat kan niet zelf het IMVO- en duurzaamheidsbeleid van FMO wijzigen of aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de aangenomen Europese Natuurherstelwet

An MP from D66 asked the minister how the EU Nature Restoration Regulation affects Dutch nature, food security, permitting, and the funding for the countryside, and when the national restoration plan will be presented. The state secretary answered that the regulation can help nature over time, that the government will implement it without national add-ons, that the cabinet is still working out the policy and funding, and that the national restoration plan will be drafted with a deadline of 1 September 2026.
The cabinet is currently further elaborating the coalition agreement into a government programme. I will inform the House later about my plans.
Momenteel is het kabinet het Hoofdlijnenakkoord verder aan het uitwerken tot een regeerprogramma. Ik informeer de Kamer later over mijn plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over verschillende nieuwsberichten met betrekking tot Europese grensbewaking

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about news reports on Polish border guards being allowed to shoot irregular migrants, the exclusion of journalists from the Polish buffer zone, and Greek coast guard abuses. The minister said the Netherlands expects compliance with international and EU law, leaves assessment of the Polish measures to Polish and European courts, and points to an independent Greek investigation and existing EU monitoring.
It is up to the national judge to assess whether this condition is met in a concrete situation.
Het is aan de nationale rechter om te beoordelen of in een concrete situatie aan deze voorwaarde wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het bericht 'Hoger onderwijs onbereikbaar: Oekraïense studenten struikelen over collegegeld'

Two D66 MPs asked whether Ukrainian displaced students can access higher education on equal terms with EU/EEA students, given high institutional tuition fees up to 15,000 euro, and about student finance eligibility. The minister answered that Ukrainians are not automatically entitled to statutory tuition, that changing this would require legislation with wide policy consequences, that the cabinet will meet universities and hogescholen and urges them to lower institutional tuition for other displaced Ukrainians, and that student finance for Ukrainians is not extended because Ukraine is outside the EEA.
The cabinet regularly speaks with universities and universities of applied sciences about Ukrainian displaced persons.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met de universiteiten en hogescholen over de Oekraïense ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht dat in Nederland tussen 2013-2022 de oppervlakte van natuur- en bosgebieden met bijna 2,5 procent is afgenomen

An MP asked the minister how nature area fell by 15,800 hectares between 2013 and 2022 despite the Natuurnetwerk target, and about related biodiversity and Natuurpact questions. The minister replied that Statistics Netherlands found data inconsistencies so the figures cannot yet be relied on, that the NNN area in fact grew, and that the government will push provinces to meet the 80,000 hectare target while withholding the detailed answers until corrected data are available.
It is therefore not possible to draw conclusions from the report. As soon as the CBS has formulated a consistent time series, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Het is dus niet mogelijk om conclusies te ontlenen aan het bericht. Zodra het CBS een consistente tijdsreeks heeft geformuleerd, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Van der Burg: 1500 asielplekken minder sinds hoofdlijnenakkoord'

MP Podt (D66) asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the coalition's plan to repeal the dispersal law is already causing 1,500 fewer asylum places, and what can be done to keep reception capacity available. The State Secretary says some municipalities are withdrawing or freezing commitments while many remain willing, that he cannot guarantee no asylum seekers will sleep outside this summer, and points to short-term reception plans.
Answer 9: No, unfortunately I cannot guarantee that.
Antwoord 9 Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de behandeling van asielverzoeken van Palestijnse asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary why processing of asylum applications from Palestinian asylum seekers had not started after the Council of State lifted the decision moratorium, and whether the return moratorium would be ended. The State Secretary confirmed processing had not started in general, said the Gaza situation justified recognising refugee status and treating Gaza-based applicants as facing generic danger, and said the return moratorium was to be ended because sufficient information now existed.
I agree that a ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State must be implemented as quickly and correctly as possible.
Ik ben het er mee eens dat een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State zo spoedig en correct mogelijk moet worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de problemen voor nareizigers bij de IND in Zevenaar

The MP asks about long waiting times at the IND in Zevenaar for family reunification migrants, whether they can be registered, housed by COA and obtain a citizen service number, and what action is taken. The state secretary denies that they lack registration, COA shelter or social security cover, states the backlog has been cleared, rejects giving municipalities power to issue citizen service numbers before IND registration, and describes capacity and efficiency measures.
Municipalities must be certain that the person they register has lawful residence and must also know who they are registering.
Gemeenten moeten zeker weten dat de persoon die zij inschrijven rechtmatig verblijf heeft en dienen ook te weten wie zij inschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Podt over grondgebonden boeren in het licht van afbouw derogatie

MP Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture how grondgebondenheid is defined given the phase-out of the manure derogation, whether a 0.35 ha grassland norm balances manure, and whether grondgebonden dairy farmers will be compensated. Minister Adema answered that there is no single definition, that a grassland norm is proposed, that the derogation phase-out reduces on-farm manure placement, and that a subsidy for grassland retention is being raised for 2024 and 2025.
The cabinet has decided to increase the grassland retention subsidy for 2024 and 2025.
Het kabinet heeft besloten de subsidie behoud graslandareaal te verhogen voor 2024 en 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Podt en Inge van Dijk over het dreigende vertrek van ASML

MPs Sneller, Podt and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about reports of a secret government operation ('Project Beethoven') to prevent ASML from relocating abroad, the economic stakes, the fourth Growth Fund round, talent attraction and expat policy. The government confirmed Project Beethoven as a sector-support effort, explained the stakes and measures, said the fourth Growth Fund round is paused and will likely be dropped by the new coalition, and outlined talent and migration policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘IND hield lage cijfers over ‘nareis op nareis’ vlak na val kabinet achter’

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she knew of a report that the IND held back low figures on family reunification follow-up ('nareis op nareis') just after the cabinet fell, and asked for a full factual account, all internal communications and memos, and certainty that the ministry's top was not informed. The government answered that it cannot provide all documents due to their breadth and lack of time limit, points to a process sketch and ongoing Woo requests, and says it cannot categorically rule out information reaching the top but concludes from the process sketch that it did not.
The request for documents is extensive and not limited in time. It has not been possible to meet it.
Het gedane verzoek naar documenten is omvangrijk en niet in tijd afgebakend. Het is niet gelukt om daar in te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over het bericht Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels

Two D66 MPs asked the nitrogen minister whether Schiphol's permit, built on buying out farms, breached additionality rules and PAS case law, and whether it could be revised before court rulings. The minister says she applied the same additionality test as for other external netting and that the permit is under appeal, so she cannot comment on substance.
Given the ongoing appeal procedure, I cannot make substantive statements on this.
Gelet op de lopende beroepsprocedure kan ik hierover geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Veldkamp over het informatieverzoek inzake de coördinator nationale aanpak overlast

MPs Podt and Veldkamp asked why the ministry bypassed tendering for Snel Beveiliging Nodig's mobile supervision teams, why the Chamber was not informed, and about the coordinator's project plan, budget and evaluations. The government admits tendering was skipped due to urgent need, says the Chamber was informed later, and defends the pilot evaluation and monitoring arrangements.
The Chamber was not informed promptly about deviating from the tendering rules, because it is customary to inform the Chamber of this in the financial accountability.
Over het afwijken van de aanbestedingsregels is uw Kamer niet terstond geïnformeerd, omdat het gebruikelijk is uw Kamer daarover te informeren bij de financiële verantwoording.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over de berichten 'EU biedt Egypte miljardensteun om stabiliteit in de regio te waarborgen' en 'Egypte ontvangt 7,4 mrd van EU voor bestrijden-migratie’

Two D66 MPs asked about the EU's EUR 7.4 billion package for Egypt, including whether the spending was approved before parliamentary consent, concerns about migration routes and detention, legal migration options, and human rights and civil society space. The government answered that the EU's urgent procedure bypasses the European Parliament for EUR 1 billion, that the rest follows the regular procedure, and that human rights conditions will be monitored, while the Commission holds the disbursement decision and member states have no formal role.
Authority to disburse tranches lies with the Commission. Member states have no formal role in this process.
Bevoegdheid tot uitbetaling van tranches ligt bij de Commissie. Er is voor lidstaten geen formele rol weggelegd in dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Rechtbanken wijzen voorlopige voorzieningen ‘derdelanders’ toe’

MPs Podt and Koekkoek asked why courts granted interim relief to third-country nationals with Ukrainian temporary protection and how the policy to end that protection was made and implemented. The Secretary of State defended ending the protection, said the status was frozen pending CJEU rulings, and described municipal and private-sector obligations and reception arrangements.
As a result, I have been obliged to again freeze the consequences of ending temporary protection for these third-country nationals until the CJEU answers the preliminary questions.

Als gevolg hiervan ben ik genoodzaakt geweest om opnieuw de gevolgen van de beëindiging van de tijdelijke bescherming voor deze derdelanders te bevriezen tot de beantwoording van de prejudiciële vragen door het HvJEU.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van Commandant der Strijdkrachten van Estland over Russische activiteiten in de Baltische regio met betrekking tot GPS-verstoringen.

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about Estonian military remarks on Russian GNSS jamming and spoofing and the resulting risks to aviation, NAVO operations and critical infrastructure, including measures, airspace safety and cyber/electronic warfare strategy. The government acknowledges the threat as a destabilising hybrid one, points to existing rules (Wbni), sector-led protection, NAVO policy and Galileo PRS work, and answers each question without committing to new oversight or parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet is aware of this statement.
Het kabinet is bekend met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Mostafa is ongedocumenteerd, op leeftijd en nergens welkom – behalve in de Pauluskerk in Rotterdam'

An MP asked about homeless elderly people without residence permits, their eligibility for care under the coupling rules, and whether gemeenten should provide care. The government said homelessness monitoring does not capture this group, that medically necessary care is guaranteed under the regeling onverzekerbare vreemdelingen, and that it sees no need for new talks with municipalities.
Existing methods for monitoring the number of homeless people in the Netherlands do not specifically capture the group of homeless elderly people without a residence permit.
Bestaande methoden die het aantal dakloze mensen in Nederland monitoren, brengen niet specifiek de groep dakloze ouderen zonder verblijfsvergunning in beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over trucs van kinderopvang om de omzet te verhogen

An MP asked the minister about childcare providers inflating billed hours and contract changes pressuring parents, including the availability of complaint routes and oversight of billed versus used hours. The minister acknowledged the signals, said Dienst Toeslagen only checks that declared hours match parents' declarations, pointed to complaint procedures and the Geschillencommissie, and promised a steekproef, transparency measures and further study.
No government supervision is exercised over whether the childcare is actually open during all billed hours.
Er wordt vanuit de overheid geen toezicht gehouden op of de opvang tijdens alle gefactureerde uren daadwerkelijk open is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de tekortkomingen in de geboortezorg voor asielzoekers

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the government about a study showing higher perinatal loss among pregnant asylum seekers, interpreter use, relocation of pregnant women, and communication problems between care providers. The State Secretary replied that the data are already known and regretted, that existing measures and the care chain working group address them, that access to care is adequately arranged, and that relocation of pregnant women is restricted but not fully avoidable.
Yes. Access to maternity care is also well arranged for asylum seekers in the Netherlands.
Ja. De toegang tot de geboortezorg is ook voor asielzoeksters in Nederland goed geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Nieuwe regels na uitspraak Raad van State: asielzoeker mag meer dan 24 weken werken'

MP Podt asked whether the government will remove other barriers, identified by Regioplan, to asylum seekers entering the labour market beyond the 24-week rule, and asked about BRP registration backlogs, guidance to work, meedoenbalies, VOG and diploma recognition. The minister says the 24-week rule will be removed from regulations, other options are being explored for a next cabinet, BSN waiting times will be cleared by end 2024, and the government is examining support for asylum seekers while avoiding commitments beyond that.
In this amendment the 24-week requirement will no longer be included in the Decree implementing the Foreign Nationals Employment Act 2022 and the ministerial regulation.
Bij deze aanpassing zal de 24-weken-eis niet meer in het Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2022 en de ministeriële regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Mijn kinderen voelen zich door mij in de steek gelaten, mijn dochter gelooft niet dat een asielaanvraag zo lang kan duren'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the asylum moratorium for Palestinians should be revised given the situation in Gaza, and whether urgent cases can be prioritised. The State Secretary replied that the moratorium stays because the situation is too uncertain for lasting policy, with limited exceptions, and that the situation will be monitored and Parliament informed within six months.
Naturally, the situation in the Palestinian territories is being monitored in the meantime.
Uiteraard wordt de situatie in de Palestijnse Gebieden tussentijds gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het verblijfsrecht van derdelanders onder de Tijdelijkebeschermingsrichtlijn

MP Podt asked whether third-country nationals under the Temporary Protection Directive still have residence rights while appeal proceedings run, whether the IND portal showing no residence right should be corrected, and how affected people are being informed. The State Secretary replied that termination of temporary protection was suspended pending a Council of State ruling, so the group is still treated as protected, that the IND is examining portal changes, and that affected people were informed by letter.

After this decision, on 2 September it was decided not to implement the consequences of this decision until the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State (hereinafter: Division) issues a guiding ruling on appeal.

Na dit besluit is op 2 september besloten aan de gevolgen van dit besluit geen uitvoering te geven totdat de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (hierna: Afdeling) een richtinggevende uitspraak doet in hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen en Ceder over het onderzoek Oxfam “From Development to Deterrence”

MPs Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen and Ceder asked whether EU development aid (ODA) under NDICI is being used for migration deterrence, citing an Oxfam report on Libyan and Tunisian coast guard funding and weak EU transparency. The minister says the Commission must check ODA eligibility and that the Netherlands will press for better reporting and human rights risk analysis, but gives no firm new commitments and says there is no misuse so far.

In the context of the mid-term evaluation of NDICI, the Netherlands has asked the Commission for insight into the calculation of migration-related expenditure and access to the markers used to attribute spending to NDICI's migration objective.

In het kader van de mid-term evaluatie van NDICI heeft Nederland de Commissie gevraagd om inzicht in berekening van migratie gerelateerde uitgaven en inzage in de markers die worden gebruikt om uitgaven aan de migratiedoelstelling van NDICI toe te rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over koppeling statushouders aan gemeenten

An MP asks how statushouders (recognised refugees) are matched to municipalities, including family, work and study ties, the reliance on regional advice, the treatment of unaccompanied minors, early integration courses, and the handover of case files.
