The State Secretary answers that COA matches on hard and soft criteria with 79% of advice followed in 2022, that early contact is encouraged but hindered by reception shortages, and that short-term measures on early start and COA-municipality cooperation are being developed.
The main obstacle to early contact with the municipality and starting integration is the distance between COA reception and the matched municipality.
Het belangrijkste knelpunt bij vroegtijdige kennismaking met de gemeente en het starten met de inburgering is de afstand tussen de COA-opvang en de gekoppelde gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Beëindiging opvang 'derdelander' uit Oekraïne mag van de rechtbank'

An MP asked why information to municipalities and third-country nationals about ending temporary protection for Ukrainian third-country nationals came late, whether the process was legally tested, and what happens to shelter, work and returns given pending court proceedings. The State Secretary answered that the end date was frozen pending a Council of State ruling, that communication was broadly consistent though some letters caused confusion, and described legal checks, shelter transitions and remigration support.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Palland en Maatoug over de onderwijsroute naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan het Da Vinci College te Dordrecht over de onderwijsroute Wet inburgering 2021

Three MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Wi2021 education route after a visit to Da Vinci College in Dordrecht, covering extra assessments, the share routed to the education track, national coverage, and waiting youths. The minister answered that most municipalities now offer the route, that the maximum inburgering term is three years, and that outcome data on quality and progression will only be available in 2024.
Regarding the quality and progression from the education route to regular education, there is still insufficient knowledge due to the short duration of the Wi2021.
Over de kwaliteit en doorstroom vanuit de onderwijsroute naar regulier onderwijs is nog onvoldoende bekend vanwege de korte looptijd van de Wi2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Tunesië-deal zit vol ‘juridische bochten’, zeggen experts'

An MP from D66 asked the government about the EU-Tunisia migration deal, including the EUR 105 million for border management, human rights safeguards, monitoring, asylum capacity and legal basis. The government answered that the MoU is non-binding, references respect for human rights and international law, and that details will follow once the Commission specifies the EU support.
Your House will be informed further once more detailed information can be provided on the design and conditions of EU support and any budgetary consequences for the Dutch budget.
Uw Kamer zal, zodra nadere informatie kan worden gegeven over vormgeving en voorwaarden van de EU-steun en eventuele budgettaire gevolgen voor de Nederlandse begroting, nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘ Bijna elke dag verdwijnt er een kind uit de asielopvang’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that children disappear from asylum reception almost daily, including how disappearances occur, whether they relate to recent measures for unaccompanied minors, and how they are monitored and prevented. The government answered that absolute numbers of disappearances have fallen since 2018, that most cases involve unaccompanied minors, that it sees no evidence linking them to recent measures, and described existing monitoring, police notification and prevention procedures while committing to no new steps.
I am not aware of signals indicating a possible link between minors leaving asylum reception and the current measures to address the reception shortage
Ik ben niet bekend met signalen die duiden op een mogelijk verband tussen het vertrek van minderjarigen uit de asielopvang en de huidige maatregelen om het opvangtekort tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Podt over financiering van grensbewakingsprojecten in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers whether EU border-control funding in Sudan indirectly benefited the RSF militia, why projects ended only in 2019-2020, and what lessons apply to future projects. The minister denied that EU funds or equipment went to the RSF or army, said safeguards and monitoring existed, and committed to no new action beyond raising risks in Brussels.
The EU, however, provided no financial support for that security training either in 2017 or in the years after.
De EU heeft echter noch in 2017 noch in de jaren daarna financiële steun gegeven aan genoemde veiligheidstraining.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Als tweederangsburgers opgehokt: in één jaar vijf arbeidsmigranten vermoord door huisgenoten'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an RTL Nieuws report on five deadly violent incidents among migrant workers in one year, and about data, trends and protections for migrant workers. The minister said the police and judiciary cannot register victims or suspects by migrant-worker status, declined to confirm the trend, and pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap, reporting points and ongoing measures.
The police have indicated that they cannot retrieve from their systems the number of fatal victims of violent incidents, or the number or type of violent incidents, among migrant workers.
De politie heeft aangegeven dat zij het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers na geweldsincidenten, of het aantal of soort geweldsincidenten, tussen arbeidsmigranten niet uit de politiesystemen kan halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over minderjarige inklimmers in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about unaccompanied minors climbing onto lorries in the Rotterdam port to reach the UK, including numbers, registration, recidivism and prevention. The government answered with figures for 2021 and 2022, described a joint Nidos-police-Raad voor de Kinderbescherming approach and border measures, while stating that some data (such as KMar recidivism and whether attempts succeed) are unavailable.
There is no central overview recording whether persons had previously stayed in the Netherlands when they attempted irregular departure.
Er bestaat geen centraal overzicht waarin wordt bijgehouden of personen al eerder verblijf hadden in Nederland toen zij een poging deden irregulier uit te reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het vervolg van de financiële impuls huisvesting grote gezinnen

An MP asked about the results of the earlier pilot grant for housing large refugee families, its distribution across municipalities, and why the new subsidy is run by RVO and open first-come first-served rather than via a specific grant. The minister answered that 24 municipalities were selected, 17 large families were housed by January 2022 with no measurable acceleration, the new scheme opens in July 2023, and it deliberately avoids a fixed application window while monitoring regional spread.
That is why it is logical for municipalities to submit the application.
Daarom ligt het voor de hand dat gemeenten de aanvraag indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Podt over het bericht over het visumbeleid door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Podt (D66) asked about press reports that the Foreign Ministry's visa profiling algorithm (IOB) may discriminate, including objections from the data protection officer and questions on transparency, the algorithm register, the Dutch DPA's role and waiting times at VFS Global. The minister replied that the IOB uses rule-based profiles, that legal advice from external counsel found the use of nationality lawful and non-discriminatory, that the algorithm will be added to the register by 1 January 2024, and that a new data protection officer will focus on oversight of the IOB.
The algorithm is not yet included in the Algorithm Register. The ministry will ensure that the algorithm is included and explained in the register by the set deadline of 1 January 2024.

Het algoritme is op dit moment nog niet in het Algoritmeregister opgenomen. Het ministerie zal er zorg voor dragen dat het algoritme voor de hiervoor vastgestelde uiterlijke datum van 1 januari 2024 in het register is opgenomen en toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de te realiseren opvangplekken voor asielzoekers

MP Podt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reception places for asylum seekers, including whether people would again have to sleep outside at Ter Apel, the status of measures to speed up status holders' exit from reception, whether the hotel and accommodation scheme and use of large vacant sites would be expanded, and whether the spreading law's transitional arrangement would be activated early. The State Secretary answered that measures were taken, that the scheme would be extended to 1 January 2025, that talks with municipalities would continue, and that the questions could not be answered before the debate date.
I will expand and extend the hotel and accommodation scheme until 1 January 2025.
Ik zal de hotel- en accommodatieregeling uitbreiden en verlengen tot 1 januari 2025.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Ceder en Podt over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake NGO's

MPs Ceder and Podt asked the Prime Minister and the State Secretary of Justice and Security to explain and justify the Prime Minister's remarks distinguishing 'good and bad' NGOs at sea, and whether those remarks were unfounded. The State Secretary answered that the government values NGO rescue work, that national authorities (the Public Prosecution Service in the Netherlands) decide on criminal investigation, and that humanitarian motives can already be weighed under necessity defences, while giving no evidence that specific NGOs are involved in smuggling.
It is up to the national (investigative) authorities, if there is cause, to investigate this and, where necessary, to proceed to criminal prosecution.
Het is aan de nationale (opsporings)autoriteiten – als daartoe aanleiding is – hiernaar onderzoek te doen en zo nodig over te gaan tot strafrechtelijke vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht 'Schakelklassen voor gevluchte jongeren vrijwel allemaal vol'

MPs Van Meenen and Podt asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that international bridging classes for refugee youths are full and some schools no longer accept refugees. The Minister acknowledged the waiting lists as undesirable, said regional coordinators and LOWAN monitor the situation, and announced an emergency bill for temporary arrangements, expected in mid-May.
To guarantee this as well as possible, I have decided to come forward shortly with an emergency bill that will enable temporary arrangements for newcomers in education.

Om dit zo goed mogelijk te garanderen heb ik besloten om op korte termijn met een spoedwetsvoorstel te komen waarmee voor nieuwkomers in het onderwijs tijdelijke voorzieningen mogelijk worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Dordts asielzoekerscentrum komt waarschijnlijk op bedrijventerrein Distripark langs de A16'

MP Podt (D66) asked whether Dordrecht's plan for an asylum centre of at least 500 places, with full-time work for residents, is a good example and what the government will do about work rights. The State Secretary welcomed Dordrecht's initiative but declined to commit to full-time work rights, pointing to a pending study by the Minister of Social Affairs and no timetable for pilots.
The cabinet considers it undesirable to anticipate the results of the study.
Het kabinet acht het niet wenselijk om vooruit te lopen op de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het realiseren van een tweede aanmeldcentrum voor asielzoekers

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how many municipalities have been approached about a second asylum registration centre, why some refuse, what incentives exist, and when spatial planning instruments would be used. The State Secretary answered that talks are ongoing with two municipalities, that the Bant plan changed form, that incentives such as shared agreements on capacity and local economic benefits are offered, and that spatial planning instruments are not currently being used since voluntary cooperation is still being pursued.
At this moment, therefore, there is no question of deploying spatial planning instruments.
Op dit moment is daarom geen sprake van de inzet van het ruimtelijk ordeningsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Niemand op de boot in Genemuiden weet waar de 85 vluchtelingen aan toe zijn' en de bereikbaarheid van de IND.

MP Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that asylum seekers in Genemuiden and elsewhere have waited months without a first IND interview, with no information on timing, and about the IND's poor telephone and email accessibility. The State Secretary acknowledges rising inflow and waiting times of about 12 weeks, explains information sessions and staff expansion, but gives no firm timeline for reducing waits and declines to commit to a visit within a month to all locations.
It is unfortunately not possible to indicate for each asylum seeker when the hearing will take place.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om per asielzoeker aan te geven wanneer het gehoor plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Podt over het bericht ‘Joana Duarte wil Nederlander worden met een Friese eed (maar of dat mag, is de vraag)’

MPs Romke de Jong and Podt asked the Minister of Interior about a report that a candidate for Dutch citizenship wanted to take the oath in Frisian, and whether the Frisian Language Use Act allows this in all cases. The minister confirmed the Act permits swearing in Frisian, acknowledged implementation gaps, and committed to clarifying the rules to Frisian municipalities by letter.

Therefore I will, ahead of the new administrative agreement on Frisian language and culture, clarify in a letter to the Frisian municipalities in the short term how the Frisian Language Use Act applies to taking an oath, declaration or pledge.

Daarom zal ik, vooruitlopend op de nieuwe Bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur, op korte termijn per brief aan de Friese gemeenten de toepassing van de Wet gebruik Friese taal bij het afleggen van een eed, verklaring of belofte verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Podt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie kreeg toch signalen over zwaar sjouwwerk Schiphol'

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate ignored several worker complaints about heavy physical work at Schiphol baggage handling, why its self-regulation approach and the handling of signals were not adequate, and what will be done so the Chamber receives correct information. The Minister acknowledged that seven complaints related to physical strain were judged not relevant, that the inspectorate is reviewing its approach, will give heavier weight to airside work, and will improve its complaint registration and transparency, reporting back in the 2024 annual plan.

At my request, the Labour Inspectorate is reviewing its working method and I will enter into further discussion with the Inspectorate on how the method can be further improved and made more transparent.
Op mijn verzoek houdt de Arbeidsinspectie haar werkwijze tegen het licht en ga ik met de Arbeidsinspectie nader in gesprek over hoe de werkwijze verder verbeterd en transparanter kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘En weer schat het ministerie het aantal asielzoekers te laag in: locaties 'te laat, te krap en te kort' beschikbaar’

MP Podt asked whether asylum forecasts in the Meerjaren Productie Prognose (MPP) are again too low, why forecasts on family reunification miss, how the MPP is made and whether it should be drawn up outside the asylum chain. The State Secretary acknowledges asylum inflow is above the medium scenario, explains the probabilistic methodology and protocol, and declines to outsource the MPP, citing safeguards already in place.
Following the Regioplan study commissioned by WODC on the governance of the MPP, a policy response was sent to your House last year.
Naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Regioplan (in opdracht van het WODC) naar de governance van de MPP is vorig jaar een beleidsreactie naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over verschillende kwesties in de gemeentelijke opvang van Oekraïners.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about friction in municipal reception of Ukrainian displaced persons, including how complaints are handled, rules on nuisance behaviour, and whether shelters can be denied to people. The State Secretary acknowledged friction in some municipalities, said complaints are handled by municipalities with no central complaint figures, and said a joint approach to nuisance is being developed with the VNG and safety regions.
No figures on complaints are kept centrally.
Er worden centraal geen cijfers over klachten bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over problemen voor Oekraïners die zonder verblijfsstickers in Nederland zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary about Ukrainians without residence stickers, including those who were in other EU countries or had expired visas when the war began, and who are being turned away by municipal shelters. The State Secretary answered that such persons fall outside the Temporary Protection Directive, that they can apply for asylum, that objections have no suspensive effect, and that the IND is adjusting BRP registration codes.
Objection to not receiving a residence sticker has no suspensive effect.
Bezwaar tegen het niet ontvangen van een verblijfssticker heeft geen schorsende werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht 'Honderden asielkinderen op wachtlijst voor onderwijs, Den Haag wil hulp van kabinet'

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister about reports of hundreds of asylum-seeking children on waiting lists for schooling and whether the government would act. The minister confirmed the problem across many municipalities, said the regular newcomer education remains preferred, and promised to explore alternative temporary provisions and further steps with stakeholders.
I will explore what the options are for another type of temporary educational provision, more tailored to the heterogeneity of this target group.
Ik ga verkennen wat de mogelijkheden zijn voor een ander type tijdelijke onderwijsvoorziening, meer toegespitst op de heterogeniteit van deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Vannacht sliepen toch mensen buiten in Ter Apel'

The Dutch Member of Parliament Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that people slept outside at Ter Apel, the waiting times and shelter, ticketing, responsibility for the forecourt, reception capacity, and AVIM registration backlogs. The State Secretary answered that about 30 people slept outside on one night, that a ticketing system has been in use since 10 September, that shelter and covering are being arranged, and that responsibility for the forecourt is shared by the municipality and the safety region.
It is true that in the night of Tuesday 27 to Wednesday 28 September about 30 people slept outside.
Het klopt dat er in de nacht van dinsdag 27 op woensdag 28 september circa 30 mensen buiten hebben geslapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het realiseren van een aanmeldcentrum voor asielzoekers in Bant

MP Podt asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the collapse of a planned asylum registration centre in Bant, Noordoostpolder, what the next steps are, and why the alternative is housing family reunifiers. The State Secretary says COA withdrew the request after local opposition, the municipality now offers a 300-place alternative mainly for family reunifiers, and no timeline for a new location can yet be given because it depends on municipal cooperation.
I am in discussions at various locations in the Netherlands about realising an additional registration centre.
Ik ben op diverse plaatsen in Nederland in gesprek voor de realisatie van een additioneel aanmeldcentrum.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de nieuwsberichten 'Veiligheid en gezondheid van kinderen zonder ouders in de asielopvang onder de maat' en 'Minderjarige alleenstaande asielzoekers geëvacueerd uit Ter Apel, omda

The MP asks about inspectorate findings on unsafe and unhealthy conditions for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Ter Apel, and what has been done since April. The state secretary acknowledges severe overcrowding and understaffing, lists interim measures (extra security, cleaning, early transfers, emergency shelters) and structural plans for more reception places, while admitting the measures are insufficient and that staffing shortages persist.
The main means to improve the situation in Ter Apel for amv immediately and structurally, however, is to reduce the occupancy and length of stay.
Het voornaamste middel om de situatie in Ter Apel voor amv per direct en structureel te verbeteren is echter het terugschroeven van de bezetting en de verblijfsduur.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over de berichten 'Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op Schiphol' en 'Schiphol geeft toe: we hadden te weinig oog voor arbeidsomstandigheden'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about press reports that the labour inspectorate did not inspect physical workload at Schiphol baggage handling for twelve years and that many workers became incapacitated. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate has started an investigation and will report on its past inspections at Schiphol, and it committed to talks with Schiphol and KLM and to a site visit in November.
Following the press reports, the Labour Inspectorate has meanwhile started an investigation into the situation of baggage staff at Schiphol.
De Arbeidsinspectie is, naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving, inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de situatie bij het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Rechter: gemeente mag student niet uitsluiten van € 800 energietoeslag'

Two MPs asked the minister how a court ruling that a municipality may not exclude a student from the energy allowance affects national guidance excluding students as a group. The minister maintains that categorical exclusion is justified, directs individual students to individual special assistance, and notes extra funding for municipalities.
The national guidelines will be supplemented with a more extensive justification for not granting the one-off energy allowance to students on a categorical basis.
De landelijke richtlijnen zullen worden aangevuld met een uitgebreidere motivering voor het niet categoriaal verstrekken van de eenmalige energietoeslag aan studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Podt over het bericht ‘Friese mbo's verliezen deel van inburgeraars’

MPs Hagen and Podt asked why Friese Poort and Friesland College declined to tender for the B1 and Z integration routes, citing non-cost-covering fees, and what consequences this has for newcomers and for the government's funding of the education route. The minister replied that court rulings found the regional bandwidths reasonable, that a contract for both routes has been secured in Friesland, and that additional funding and a structural solution are being prepared.
In view of these rulings, I see no reason to take further measures.
Met het oog op deze uitspraken zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de opvang van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception of Ukrainian refugees, covering residence stickers, travel documents, IND waiting times, particular-housing shifts, student access, and bank accounts. The government answered that the IND has issued about 45,000 stickers with a temporary pause, that the work-permit transition was extended to 31 October 2022, and that roughly a quarter of adult displaced persons may lack a bank account, with solutions still being explored.
The aim is for displaced persons from Ukraine already registered in the BRP before 1 November 2022 to be able to collect their residence document (sticker or O-document).
Het streven is dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die reeds zijn ingeschreven in de BRP voor 1 november 2022 in de gelegenheid zijn om hun verblijfsbewijs (sticker of O-document) op te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over het toenemende aantal covid-besmettingen in relatie tot de asielopvang

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked about rising COVID-19 infections in asylum reception centres, including monitoring, prevention measures, vaccination rates, quarantine capacity and staffing contingency planning. The State Secretary answered that COA relies on self-tests with no registration of positives due to GDPR, that measures and vaccination information are in place, that vaccination uptake cannot be measured, and that scenarios are being prepared by COA and IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Uitspraak Europees Hof zet Nederlands asielbeleid op losse schroeven; staat mag documenten asielzoeker niet meer zomaar opzijschuiven'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a Volkskrant report that a European Court ruling and a Council of State ruling require the Netherlands to stop setting aside documents submitted by asylum seekers, and asked what concrete steps will ensure a realistic burden of proof, equality of arms, the benefit of the doubt, and safeguards in the return process. The State Secretary answered that the current IND practice is compliant with EU law, that documents of unverified authenticity may be weighed, that the benefit of the doubt is applied where appropriate, and that the return process contains several opportunities for the individual to raise risks.
I consider the current working method of the IND to be in line with the relevant case law of the EU Court of Justice and the Council of State.
Ik acht de huidige werkwijze van de IND in overeenstemming met de hier bedoelde jurisprudentie van het EU-Hof van Justitie en de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘De IND komt vaak niet opdagen bij rechtszaken’

MP Podt asked why the IND (immigration service) often fails to appear at court hearings in asylum cases and whether this harms asylum seekers, and the state secretary replied that about 11% of cases had no IND representation due to staffing shortages, planning problems and sick leave, while stating that the IND screens cases and that absence is unwanted but usually does not harm applicants; he also described measures to improve planning with the courts.
Yes, the IND cannot retrieve from its system in how many cases it was absent from court hearings, but manual registration shows that in about 11% of cases no IND representation was present.

Antwoord 2 Ja, de IND kan niet uit het systeem halen in hoeveel zaken zij niet aanwezig was bij de rechtszaken, maar uit een handmatige registratie blijkt dat bij ongeveer 11% van de zaken (alle gerechtelijke procedures) geen vertegenwoordiging van de IND aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Kabinet overweegt asielopvang op zee, huidige situatie kan nog weken duren’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum seekers would be housed on cruise ships moored offshore, and whether this is humane and compatible with EU and international law. The State Secretary replied that offshore reception was examined but rejected because of too many disadvantages, including weather-dependent transport and restricted freedom of movement, which would be unlawful.
This initial inventory showed that there are too many disadvantages attached to offshore reception.
Uit deze eerste inventarisatie is gebleken dat er te veel nadelen aan opvang op open zee kleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over “het bericht 'Uitsluiting studenten energietoeslag is onrechtmatig, zeggen juristen'

MPs Podt and Van der Laan asked whether excluding students from the categorical energy allowance is justified, given reports that lawyers call it unlawful. The minister defends advising municipalities to exclude students, citing the diversity of student housing, and points to individual special assistance and a planned DUO communication.
I cannot state how many students are facing a higher energy bill.
Ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel studenten te maken hebben met een hogere energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'

MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Boulakjar en Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchteling mag wel in herrie’

MPs Boucke, Boulakjar and Podt asked why student housing is blocked near Schiphol under the LIB noise rules while refugee housing at Kronenburg is allowed, and about the duration, permit (vvgb) and planned LIB revisions. The minister replied that temporary stays up to six months are exempt from LIB rules, longer stays need a vvgb which the ILT is assessing, and a LIB revision decision is targeted for year-end.
The ILT will assess whether a vvgb can be issued.
De ILT zal beoordelen of een vvgb kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de zorgelijke situatie rondom de aanmeldprocedure van nareizigers

An MP asked the State Secretary about the situation at Ter Apel, where family reunification migrants (nareizigers) must register there even when they could stay with a sponsor, occupying scarce reception beds. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said COA and IND are exploring alternatives such as a separate location and streamlined procedures, but gave no firm timeline and noted that a thorough registration process remains necessary.
COA and IND are currently exploring the possibilities for this.
Het COA en de IND zijn momenteel de mogelijkheden daartoe aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over lange wachttijden bij de IND

An MP asked the State Secretary about long IND waiting times for biometrics and residence documents, the requirement to re-submit biometrics at each renewal, and the closure of the Rotterdam counter. The State Secretary explained the EU and ICAO rules behind the requirement, attributed waiting times to rising applications and labour shortages, listed measures such as extended opening hours and recruitment, and promised a letter before the summer recess on the asylum chain.
From early July the IND will have part of the residence documents delivered by the IPKD.
De IND zal per begin juli een deel van de verblijfsdocumenten laten bezorgen door de IKPD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht ‘Surinaamse leerkrachten kunnen ons lerarentekort opvangen, maar ze mogen niet komen’ en de uitzending van Kassa van 5 maart 2022

MPs Van Meenen and Podt asked why Surinamese teachers were refused residence and work permits in the Netherlands despite a teacher shortage, and whether Suriname has a teacher surplus. The minister answered that permits are refused when Wav conditions, including qualifications and priority supply, are not met, that there is no evidence of a surplus in Suriname, and that the Netherlands will focus mainly on domestic recruitment and retention.
The reason for refusal was that the conditions set in the Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) were not met, including possessing the correct qualifications.
Reden voor afwijzing was dat niet voldaan werd aan de voorwaarden die in de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen (hierna: Wav) worden gesteld, waaronder het beschikken over de juiste kwalificaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Boulakjar over de situatie rondom de Regeling Huisvesting Aandachtsgroepen

Two D66 MPs asked the housing minister why funds under the Regeling huisvesting aandachtsgroepen remained unspent, whether legal deadlines and start-date rules hinder realisation, and what the Ukraine crisis changes for municipalities. The minister answered that nearly all applications were granted, that a mid-term evaluation and 2021 accountability are pending, that deadlines are meant to ensure timely delivery, and that no formal signals of spending problems or financial strain have been received.
At the end of June I will share the outcomes of an interim evaluation of this scheme with you by letter.
Eind juni zal ik per brief de uitkomsten van een tussenevaluatie op deze regeling met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en van Ginneken over automobiliteit van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked whether Ukrainian refugees can renew Ukrainian car insurance or obtain Dutch insurance, and whether their Ukrainian driving licences lapse after 185 days, with consequences for work and life in the Netherlands. The government answered that Ukrainian insurers still issue green cards so policies can be extended, the Vereende offers short-term cover as a fallback, and the European Commission is preparing an EU-wide extension of the licence validity.
That insurance provides cover for three months and can be extended for a maximum of three months.
Die verzekering biedt voor drie maanden dekking en kan voor maximaal drie maanden worden verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Weyenberg over problemen bij het inschrijven van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Weyenberg asked about problems registering Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands, including slow municipal registration, identity documents, financial access, and bank accounts. The government answered that it is working with municipalities, banks and the Ukrainian embassy, describes temporary flexibilities and a planned Hryvnia exchange scheme, but gives little detail on definitive fixes.
It is good that we also gain insight into this group.
Het is goed dat we ook zicht krijgen op deze groep.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary how the merged asylum intake hearing works for unaccompanied minors, whether minors get enough rest and preparation time and legal support, and whether the evaluation will cover their rights. The State Secretary replies that safeguards such as Nidos involvement, a child-specific hearing, and a three-week rest period are sufficient, and commits to an evaluation in Q3 2022 that includes Nidos, the asylum bar and Vluchtelingenwerk.
Following the brief outline of asylum motives, the IND does not ask further, in-depth questions during the intake hearing.
Naar aanleiding van de korte uiteenzetting van de asielmotieven stelt de IND tijdens het aanmeldgehoor verder geen nadere, verdiepende vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de zorgelijke toestand van etnisch-Russische studenten, docenten en onderzoekers

MPs Podt, Van der Laan and Sjoerdsma asked about the difficult situation of ethnic-Russian and Belarusian students, teachers and researchers in the Netherlands after sanctions, including financial hardship, work-hour limits, unclear visa prospects and knowledge-leakage risks. The minister acknowledged the problems, said work-hour limits will not be changed, urged institutions to support these students, and said residence rights are kept while study conditions are met.
Adjusting the number of hours students may work is not seen as a solution.
Het aanpassen van het aantal uren dat studenten mogen werken wordt niet als oplossing gezien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Tjeerd de Groot over de schrijnende situatie rondom arbeidsmigranten in de grensregio

MPs Podt and Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the poor housing of Romanian agency workers in a German border area working for a Dutch agency, and how cross-border enforcement and the separation of housing and work contracts would be addressed. The minister said cooperation with Germany and Belgium is being intensified, the Goed Verhuurderschap bill will require separate housing contracts, a ban on employers also acting as landlord was judged too far, and a certification regime for agencies will be informed later this year.
I hope to be able to inform the House in the coming autumn.
Ik hoop uw Kamer in het komende najaar te kunnen informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Jasper van Dijk en Kuik over naturalisatieverzoeken RANOV-vergunninghouders en de Kamerbrief over diverse onderwerpen migratiebeleid van 7 juli 2021 en het WODC rapport “(N)ooit Nede

MPs Podt, Jasper van Dijk and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders may still be asked for identity and nationality documents, how many naturalisation applications were filed and refused since the July 2021 policy change, and whether the Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion was properly implemented. The State Secretary answered that about 2,070 RANOV holders filed applications, around 690 were granted and fewer than 10 refused, that the documentary requirement is waived for RANOV holders with the possibility of submitting documents voluntarily, and that the motion is considered implemented.
Do you think you are implementing the adopted Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion in a way consistent with its spirit and intent?
Vraag 5 Vindt u dat u de aangenomen Kamermotie Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg 5 uitvoert op een manier die in lijn is met de geest en de bedoeling van de motie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingenstroom op gang vanuit Oekraïne, buurlanden bereiden opvang voor’

MP Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether the ministry's view that no extra measures are needed for Ukrainian refugees is wise, given full asylum reception and COA/IND backlogs, and whether extra preparatory measures will be taken and reported to parliament. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands is preparing for possible large-scale reception with municipalities, COA, IND, police and Defence, and that Ukrainians already present will be assessed for residence-status issues such as expiring visas.
The Netherlands is preparing for the arrival of refugees from Ukraine.
Nederland bereidt zich voor op de komst van vluchtelingen uit de Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de opvang van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers, including whether small-scale housing is still feasible, placement waiting lists, school access, guardian caseloads and youth participation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging that capacity pressure forces longer stays and transfers and that guardian caseloads are too high, while committing to evaluate extended care only later.
Question 1: What is the most recent state of affairs regarding the reception of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in small-scale facilities?
Vraag 1 Wat is de meest recente stand van zaken met betrekking tot de opvang van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (amv's) in kleinschalige voorzieningen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Gemeenteraad besluit over individuele studietoeslag en bouwplan ROC Mondriaan in Leidschenveen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions whether municipalities may no longer deviate from harmonised national individual study allowance amounts from 1 April 2022, and about transitional rules, budget effects and the removal of the youth norm. The minister replied that national age-based amounts are being set by AMvB, that existing higher allowances are protected for their duration, that the youth norm link is retained for allowance design, and that budget effects cannot be precisely estimated.
The national government does not collect information on the amount of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid verzamelt geen informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Podt over het bericht dat de politie onschuldige asielzoekers aan strafrechtelijke informatie koppelde

MPs Van Ginneken and Podt asked whether police wrongly matched asylum seekers' phone data against criminal intelligence, whether the data still exists and whether it was used in criminal cases. The government admits the Athene project lacked a legal basis after the 2019 privacy law change, says the project was stopped and the data destroyed, and says the Raad van State advice on statutory safeguards is taken to heart, while several questions get only partial or general answers.
That realisation came through a Data Protection Impact Assessment carried out within AVIM in November 2021 as part of a force-wide programme.
Dat besef kwam dankzij de uitvoering van een Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) 2 die in november 2021 binnen AVIM als onderdeel van een korpsbreed programma is gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de Uitvoeringsagenda Flexibilisering Asielketen (mei 2020) en de Voortgang Flexibilisering Asielketen

The MP asks about the progress of the flexible asylum chain programme: whether the target-group approach works, the status of flexible reception locations and satellite sites, the knowledge desk, and the handover of measures after the programme ended. The State Secretary answers that the approach is being applied and refined, that few flexible locations exist because of acute shortages of places, that provincial plans are not yet complete, and that a progress letter is promised with the reply delayed.
Due to a combination of various pressing circumstances and the efforts devoted to them, it regrettably has not been possible to answer your questions in time.
Door een samenloop van verschillende prangende omstandigheden en de inzet die daarop gepleegd wordt, is het tot mijn spijt niet gelukt om uw vragen tijdig te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht dat de toename van coronabesmettingen in Goes veroorzaakt is door een uitbraak in de noodopvang

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Health Minister, on behalf of the Justice State Secretary, about reports that a rise in COVID-19 cases in Goes was caused by an outbreak in an emergency asylum reception centre, and about vaccination, quarantine, distancing and information in asylum locations. The minister answered each question in general terms, stating that current measures and protocols are in place, vaccination is offered and quarantine capacity is sufficient, and admitted that answering each question separately before the plenary debate was not achieved due to workload.
Unfortunately, that has not been achieved due to busy schedules.
Dat is vanwege drukte helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de situatie op de Griekse vluchtelingekampen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about access restrictions, gated entry and detention concerns at new Greek island reception camps built with EU funds, and about camp conditions and winter preparation. The government replied that the Greek state now provides services previously delivered by NGOs, that gate access is controlled by biometric passes with daytime free movement, that the European Commission oversees compliance with EU reception rules, and that winter and Afghan-arrival preparations are ongoing without a specific Greek request for Dutch support.
I share with the House the principle that civil society organisations should have as much access as possible to locations where asylum seekers are received, but this need not be automatic.

Met uw Kamer onderschrijf ik het uitgangspunt dat maatschappelijke organisaties zo veel mogelijk toegang moeten hebben tot locaties waar asielzoekers worden opgevangen, maar dit hoeft geen automatisme te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Ginneken over het onderzoek 'Transcript from the Margins'

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the 'Transcript from the Margins' report on how the asylum procedure treats transgender applicants, including IND reliance on country information, the sourcing of ambtsberichten, misgendering in communication, and complaints. The State Secretary replied that individual assessments take the applicant's position into account, that the small sample limits representativeness, that IND will meet Transgender Netwerk Nederland, and that complaints about transgender applicants cannot be traced because asylum motive is not registered.
Following the report, the IND has therefore extended an invitation to Transgender Netwerk Nederland to meet with the IND's LHBTI coordinators.
De IND heeft naar aanleiding van het rapport daarom een uitnodiging verstrekt aan Transgender Netwerk Nederland om in gesprek te treden met de LHBTI-coördinatoren van de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Ceder over het bericht 'Angstcultuur en machtsspelletjes en een verziekte sfeer bij afdeling van de IND: ‘die collega gaan wij afbranden’'

MPs Podt and Ceder asked the State Secretary about an NRC report on a toxic work climate and a whistleblower complaint at the IND, and whether top management intervened. The State Secretary answered that the IND investigated the signals, explained the internal reporting procedure and the role of the integrity committee, acknowledged shortcomings in caring for the complainant, and said internal protections are adequate and a culture scan is underway.
I regret that in this case the care for the complainant fell short in a number of respects.
Ik betreur dat in deze zaak in een aantal opzichten in de zorg voor de melder tekort is geschoten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder en Ellemeet over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met het regelen van de aanmeldfase

Opposition MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Council of State's criticism of the new asylum pre-registration phase, which drops the first hearing and lacks safeguards such as legal aid and medical checks before the initial hearing. The State Secretary defended the change, saying safeguards are not needed for the brief initial questioning, that statements in pre-registration do not weigh against credibility, and that an evaluation will be published in mid-2022.
The cabinet is of the view that the brief questioning on asylum motives can be justified without yet meeting the safeguards named by the Council of State.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat de korte uitvraag van asielmotieven verantwoord kan zonder dat al aan de door de Afdeling genoemde waarborgen is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Hoe een Nederlandse reder migranten ‘terugduwde’ naar Libië'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reporting that a Dutch shipowner pushed migrants back to Libya, and whether commercial ships are increasingly involved in pushbacks and how the EU should sanction states. The government answered that the state where a rescue occurs is responsible for coordinating SAR, that it lacks figures on Dutch-flagged commercial vessels, that it refuses to comment on individual media cases, and that it will keep pressing for a predictable disembarkation mechanism and safe ports.
The cabinet does not have figures on the involvement of commercial ships in SAR operations in the Mediterranean that sail under the Dutch flag or are owned by a Dutch company.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers betreffende de betrokkenheid van commerciële schepen bij SAR-operaties in de Middellandse zee die onder Nederlandse vlag varen dan wel eigendom zijn van een Nederlands bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Straus over het bericht ‘Inzet budgetcoaches Vebego: sociaal en slim. Nu het onderwijs nog!’

MPs Moors and Straus asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about budget coaches for employees, prevention of debt, and financial education in schools (kerndoelen 35 and 42), and about measuring effectiveness and using Nibud rules of thumb. The State Secretary welcomed budget coaching and prevention, said curriculum responsibility lies with OCW, cited existing projects and the WiG platform, and said the effectiveness of financial education cannot yet be stated overall.
Including financial skills, learning to manage money and learning to budget in the school curriculum is the responsibility of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
Het opnemen van financiële vaardigheden, het leren omgaan met geld en het leren budgetteren, in het curriculum voor scholen is de verantwoordelijkheid van het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Amsterdam gaat huurders financieel bijstaan

MPs Moors and Van der Linde asked the ministers about Amsterdam's plan to financially support tenants through rent reductions funded by the municipality and their view on using poverty funds against costly housing. The government answered that existing rent instruments suffice, that the Amsterdam approach is individual case-based and grounded in local agreements rather than the Participatiewet, and that municipalities and corporations each carry defined responsibilities.

Incidentally, it has come to my attention that Amsterdam does not base this policy on the Participatiewet, but is an elaboration of the cooperation agreements between the tenants' association, the federation of housing corporations and the municipality of Amsterdam.
Overigens is mij gebleken dat Amsterdam het onderhavige beleid niet baseert op de Participatiewet, maar betreft het een Uitwerking van de Samenwerkingsafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus, Aukje de Vries en Moors inzake vmbo-leerlingen die aangeven onvoldoende kennis van geldzaken te hebben

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Finance about a survey showing vmbo pupils feel insufficiently informed about money matters, and what schools, the curriculum and the Wijzer in Geldzaken programme do about it. The government answers that money management is embedded in existing curriculum goals and subjects, that monitoring of school practice is not done centrally, and that prevention is preferred to municipal debt write-offs.
However, it is not monitored nationally in what way and with what intensity schools pay attention to societal themes such as managing money, nor why they do so.
Er wordt echter niet landelijk gemonitord op welke wijze en met welke intensiteit scholen aandacht besteden aan maatschappelijke thema's zoals omgaan met geld, en ook niet waarom zij dat zo doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moors over het bericht "Gemeenten helpen jongeren met schulden"

MP Moors asks whether young people with problematic debts are excluded from municipal debt assistance, and about Leiden and The Hague taking over youth debts, possible interest charges, debt forgiveness and rewarding school or volunteer hours. The Secretary of State answers that the Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening gives broad access, that debt rescheduling is hard for youths, that the Hague and Leiden schemes are municipal pilots financed from local budgets, and that municipalities themselves must judge these projects against local frameworks.
I encourage municipalities, where a debt rescheduling is not possible, to make use of these other products.
Ik moedig gemeenten aan daar waar een schuldregeling niet tot de mogelijkheden behoort om van deze producten gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Moors over het bericht ‘Schotschrift tegen asbesthysterie’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a critical pamphlet claiming asbestos policy is overly alarmist and that the asbestos roof ban is poor value for money. The State Secretary rejected the alarmism claim, defended the cost-benefit analysis and the 2024 roof-removal deadline, and outlined subsidies, a programme office and enforcement measures while declining to quantify victim numbers precisely.
No, I do not endorse that conclusion. The central government takes a sober and pragmatic approach to asbestos in the residential, working and living environment.
Nee, die conclusie onderschrijf ik niet. De rijksoverheid staat voor een nuchtere en pragmatische benadering van asbest in de woon-, werk- en leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Moors over de hulp van een netbeheerder betreffende het betalen van de energienota

MPs Bosman and Moors asked whether netbeheerder Alliander's infrastructure arm contributes staff to a new charity, Energiebank Nederland, and whether a public company with a statutory task should fund poverty policy. The minister answered that Alliander provides about three full-time equivalents until 1 April 2016, costs borne by the infrastructure company rather than passed to tariffs, and left the choice to the company and its public shareholders within legal limits.
It is therefore a decision for the shareholders whether they consider such spending desirable.
Het is dan ook een afweging van de aandeelhouders of zij een dergelijke besteding wenselijk vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn, Moors en Van Oosten over het bericht “Tweetal steelt AOW via DigiD-fraude”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about a report that two people stole old-age pensions via DigiD phishing fraud, and how victims were compensated and future fraud prevented. The state secretary answered that a criminal investigation found about 5,000 possibly misused DigiD accounts and total losses of about 50,000 euro, that victims were fully compensated, and that the government will try to recover the money and promote safer DigiD use, with a promised overview of further measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en De Liefde over het bericht «Geen progressie in open data»

MPs Moors and De Liefde asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of no progress on open data, the steps taken since November 2013, dataset counts per ministry, and how open data becomes the default. The minister listed actions taken (top-50 dataset list, portal upgrade, cost study, projects), said exact per-ministry counts are not available until a portal upgrade, and promised a cabinet proposal by end of September.
This is not known. Via data.overheid.nl there is not yet the possibility to monitor exact figures per ministry or other governments.
Dit is niet bekend. Via data.overheid.nl bestaat nog niet de mogelijkheid om exacte cijfers per ministerie of andere overheden te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Moors, Dijkhoff en Litjens over de opslag van vertrouwelijke data door overheidsorganisaties en semi-publieke instellingen

MPs from the VVD asked whether foreign intelligence services should be able to access confidential government data and where that data is stored by government and semi-public bodies. The minister answered that the central government is building a Rijkscloud within Dutch data centres, that subnational and semi-public bodies are responsible for their own security, and that a complete overview of storage locations cannot be given.

It is not possible to provide such an overview for all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions, and as regards provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions it falls outside my responsibility.

Het is niet mogelijk om een dergelijk overzicht voor alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen te geven en valt wat betreft provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en van Oosten over een trust framework en eID

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about trust frameworks and personal data stores that give citizens control over their data, and about the government's role in e-identity initiatives. The minister answered that the government follows and partly supports such initiatives, that supervision is still being studied, and that legislation may be needed depending on the framework.
The cabinet set out in its e-privacy letter of 24 May 2013 several conditions for protecting personal data in the customer-business relationship.
Het kabinet heeft in haar e-privacybrief van 24 mei 2013 4 een aantal randvoorwaarden gesteld voor de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de relatie klant-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Moors over de vergoeding van advocaatkosten van een oud-ambtenaar

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reimbursement of legal costs for a former secretary-general after a court ordered prosecution to proceed, and whether reimbursement should continue after retirement. The minister answered that legal costs for the criminal defence will be terminated, civil proceedings and the earlier article 12 procedure remain reimbursed, no decision has been taken on the pre-trial witness hearing, and reclaiming paid costs is intended but depends on the eventual outcome.
If not, why not? Answer 4 Yes.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over opvang en werk voor asielzoekers en statushouders die nog in een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) verblijven

An MP asked about barriers to employing asylum seekers and status holders still in reception centres, including the 24-week rule, relocations, permit timing and commuting. The government answered that the Raad van State ruling removed the 24-week rule, that permit processing delays were largely resolved, and that it is pursuing pilots, a support structure, and a subsidy scheme, while declining to commit to a two-week transition period for relocations.
It is not desirable to introduce a transition period of at least two weeks, because a bed may then have to be reserved for too long.
Het is niet wenselijk om een overgangsperiode van minimaal twee weken in te voeren, omdat een bed dan mogelijk te lang moet worden gereserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over malafide bewindvoerders die stelen van kwetsbare cliënten

MP Van Nispen asks about a bewindvoerder who stole from vulnerable clients, why such a person could be appointed and continue, and whether funds, lifetime bans or a public system should be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledges the abuse is unacceptable, describes existing quality requirements, court supervision, annual accounts and dismissal and registry measures, and says a WODC study on publicly organised guardianship is underway.
As soon as abuses come to light, the district judge can suspend or dismiss a guardian.
Zodra er misstanden aan het licht komen, kan de kantonrechter een bewindvoerder schorsen 3 , dan wel ontslaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Rajkowski over de huiverigheid van werkgevers om kunstmatige intelligentie in te zetten

MPs Aartsen and Rajkowski asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch employers' reluctance to deploy AI, including its role in easing labour shortages, comparisons with Poland, Germany and Belgium, and government support. The ministers answered that AI offers productivity gains and labour-shortage relief, pointed to existing programmes (AiNed, ROBUST, NL AIC), and announced an SER advisory request and an exploration of an AI advisory council.
It is expected that a proposal will be sent to your House this autumn.
Naar verwachting wordt dit najaar een voorstel aan uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op van het lid Kostić over de brief 'Uitkomst overleg over misstanden inzet flexkrachten en arbeidsmigranten in vleessector'

An MP asked whether a blanket ban on temporary agency work in the meat and poultry sector would be considered, how the government will prevent abuse by malafide agencies, and how migrant workers can report abuses safely, including in other languages. The minister says talks with the sectors continue, a complaints point will be set up by the sectors with a link to the Work in NL information points, multilingual support is planned, and the Wtta licensing regime will address malafide agencies, with reporting to parliament after the summer.
It has been promised that the House will be informed again about this after the summer.
Toegezegd is dat de Kamer hier na de zomer opnieuw over zal worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Deen over een protest op 19 juni 2024 buiten de Tweede Kamer

PVV MPs Boon and Deen asked the ministers whether they knew of a 19 June 2024 protest outside the Tweede Kamer where chants allegedly called for violence against Jewish people, and whether demonstrators dressed as Al-Qassam Brigades members amounted to glorification of terrorism. The minister confirmed awareness, said prosecution of such expressions is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to assess case by case, and noted the cabinet plans to make glorification of terrorism a separate criminal offence.
Whether publicly uttering certain wording qualifies as a criminal offence ... is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court to assess.
Of het in het openbaar uiten van bepaalde bewoordingen te kwalificeren valt als strafbaar feit ... is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en in laatste instantie aan de rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over “recente berichtgeving rond haatimams in Nederland”

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports of hate-preaching imams in the Netherlands, including whether prosecution is underway, whether residence permits can be revoked, funding transparency of Ar-Rahmah, and whether municipalities can prevent such speakers. The government answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that prosecution is for the OM to decide, that revocation is possible only under strict proportionality rules, and that legislation on transparency and informal education oversight is in preparation.
For this reason, it is not appropriate for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Justice and Security to address investigations into individual cases.
Daarom past het ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op onderzoeken naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over het aantal toegenomen schijnzelfstandigen bij het Ministerie van Financiën

An MP asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the rise in suspected false self-employed (schijnzelfstandigen) working at the Ministry of Finance and its services, after an Algemene Rekenkamer finding and a taskforce meant to reduce them. The government answered that about 1,000 potential false self-employed are hired via intermediaries, mainly at Toeslagen/UHT for the childcare benefits recovery operation, that the taskforce aims to phase them out by 1 January 2025, and that no central overview exists across other departments.
There is currently, however, no central overview of the specific numbers of potential false self-employed at the departments.
Er is momenteel echter geen centraal overzicht van specifiek de aantallen potentiële schijnzelfstandigen bij de departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘In Gambia dreigt genitale verminking weer legaal te worden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the government would act against a Gambian bill that would legalise female genital mutilation, including aid, diplomatic contacts and prevention in the Netherlands. The government answered that it opposes FGM, has raised the issue with the Gambian government and works through EU projects and campaigns, but has no direct Dutch programmes on FGM in Gambia.
Our ambassador in Dakar has repeatedly discussed the Dutch position on the bill to legalise female genital mutilation with representatives of the Gambian government.

Onze ambassadeur in Dakar heeft de Nederlandse positie met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel betreffende legalisering van vrouwelijke genitale verminking meermaals met vertegenwoordigers van de Gambiaanse regering besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Bushoff en Bikker over het bericht ‘Overheid wilde vooral niet te veel uitgeven aan compensatie ‘zorghelden’ met long covid’

MPs Dijk, Bushoff and Bikker asked whether the government deliberately limited compensation for healthcare workers with long COVID to contain costs, and why the claim process was so burdensome and so few were compensated. The minister answers that the scheme was a gesture of recognition rather than driven by cost or litigation, acknowledges the application process was strict, and announces a reopened application window with a higher amount and wider sick-leave period.
The cost aspect never played a central role in this.
Het kostenaspect heeft hierbij nooit vooropgestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Podt en Inge van Dijk over het dreigende vertrek van ASML

MPs Sneller, Podt and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about reports of a secret government operation ('Project Beethoven') to prevent ASML from relocating abroad, the economic stakes, the fourth Growth Fund round, talent attraction and expat policy. The government confirmed Project Beethoven as a sector-support effort, explained the stakes and measures, said the fourth Growth Fund round is paused and will likely be dropped by the new coalition, and outlined talent and migration policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het moratorium om te handhaven op schijnzelfstandigheid

The MP asks how the state secretary's statement that amending labour law is a condition for lifting the enforcement moratorium on sham self-employment fits with earlier government positions on a three-track approach, and what delaying the labour-law amendment would mean for lifting the moratorium. The state secretary answers that enforcement proceeds in parallel tracks, that a clearer legal framework supports compliance, and that the government still intends to lift the moratorium on 1 January 2025 after impact assessments.
The cabinet has the ambition to fully lift the enforcement moratorium on 1 January 2025.
Het kabinet heeft de ambitie om het handhavingsmoratorium op 1 januari 2025 volledig op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Van Oostenbruggen over "regeling Tegemoetkoming Stoffengerelateerde Beroepsziekten (TSB)"

MPs Patijn and Van Oostenbruggen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about low uptake, high rejection rates and the evidentiary standard in the occupational disease compensation scheme (TSB), including patient involvement, diagnostics costs and the 'voorshands aannemelijk' test. The Minister acknowledges shortcomings, promises a patient advisory group, further improvement plans and a progress letter in the second half of 2024, while defending the evidentiary threshold and the non-liability nature of the scheme.
That is why I will set up a sounding board group that will also play a role in drafting new protocols that applications must meet.
Daarom ga ik een klankbordgroep instellen die ook een rol zal krijgen bij de opstelling van nieuwe protocollen waar aanvragen aan moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over ‘schijnzelfstandigheid bij YoungOnes’

The MP asks how the planned permit regime for temporary labour will prevent false self-employment at YoungOnes, and what the Tax Authority has done after a letter flagging possible employer status. The minister answers that the Labour Inspectorate will focus on exposing such constructions and enforce against them, while the Tax Authority cannot comment on individual taxpayers and describes its general enforcement options, including a moratorium-based warning procedure.
The Labour Inspectorate will therefore, in its supervision and enforcement activities under the Temporary Agency Work Permit Act, pay attention to recognising and exposing sham constructions.

De Arbeidsinspectie zal daarom in haar toezichts- en handhavingsactiviteiten in het kader van de Wet toelating terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten aandacht hebben voor het onderkennen en blootleggen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over AKW+

MP Patijn asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the AKW+ supplementary child benefit after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that excludes partners whose income is from benefits rather than current work, questioning fairness, the eligibility rules and simplification. The Minister acknowledges the impact and inconsistency between partners and single parents, and announces an exploratory review of the scheme's future, including its purpose, eligibility and possible simplification, without committing to specific legal changes now.
In response to your questions and because of the phasing out of the IACK, my ministry will carry out an exploration of the future viability of this allowance.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen en vanwege de uitfasering van de IACK, zal mijn ministerie een verkenning uitvoeren naar de toekomstbestendigheid van deze tegemoetkoming.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk en Aartsen over het bericht van de Hoge Raad: ‘Gratis verstrekking gezonde lunchmaaltijden aan werknemers valt voor de loonbelasting onder de gerichte vrijstelling voor Arbovoorzie

MPs Van Eijk and Aartsen asked whether the Supreme Court ruling that free healthy lunches fall under the tax exemption for occupational health provisions should be read broadly, and what the government will do to stimulate such lunches. The State Secretary answered that the ruling concerns pre-2022 rules, that since 2022 the exemption covers only mandatory occupational health provisions, that employers can provide healthy lunches using the WKR free space, and that the government sees no need or plan to change tax law, though an Arbo-regulation simplification plan is underway.
The cabinet considers it a good initiative that employers invest in keeping their staff healthy by providing healthy lunch meals.
Het kabinet vindt het een goed initiatief dat werkgevers zich door gezonde lunchmaaltijden te verstrekken inzetten om hun personeel gezond te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over "een artikel dat ingaat op de eenzijdige historische context van een video die bedoelt is als handreiking vanuit het Rijk aan gemeenten ter bestrijding van spanningen en polari

An MP asked whether a video documentary by Maurits Berger, recommended in a national handreiking for municipalities on polarisation around the Israel-Palestine conflict, gives a one-sided historical account lacking the Israeli perspective, and whether it should be revised. The minister replied that the video is one source among several, that a bibliography of additional sources was added to the handreiking, that the ministry will not impose perspectives or commission a new documentary, and declined to give paragraph-by-paragraph responses or meet the three-week deadline.
The video is not presented as an instrument for municipalities to use in dealing with tensions and polarisation.
Het filmpje wordt niet gepresenteerd als instrument voor gemeenten om in te zetten bij het omgaan met spanningen en polarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over een VPB-vrijstelling voor kinderopvang naar voorbeeld van de zorg

An MP asked the ministers whether a corporate tax exemption for childcare organisations without profit motive, modelled on the healthcare exemption, could be created, and about its rationale, budget impact and needed amendments. The government answered that such an exemption is not justified because non-profit childcare providers compete with commercial firms, that introducing one would be very restrained and raises state aid concerns, and estimated a revenue loss of at least 10 million euros.
