Given that non-profit childcare organisations compete with regular market parties, a subjective exemption for these organisations cannot be sufficiently justified.

Gegeven het feit dat kinderopvangorganisaties zonder winstoogmerk in concurrentie treden met reguliere marktpartijen laat een subjectieve vrijstelling voor deze organisaties zich niet voldoende rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het NOS-artikel van 16 februari 2024: ‘Prorail: “Vervangen spoor Vroomshoop kost mogelijk miljoenen”’

An SP MP asked the government about the costs of replacing asbestos roofs after a fire near Vroomshoop, including insurance coverage, who pays for cleanup when owners cannot, and loans and other support for roof owners. The minister answered that the government has no insight into insurer conditions, that the owner is primarily liable for cleanup, that a loan fund exists for low-income private owners with a possible wider opening under study, and that a communication programme with advisory support is starting.
The Ministry of IenW has no insight into the extent to which insurers provide coverage, nor into the owners' own resources.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft geen zicht op de mate waarin verzekeraars dekking bieden en evenmin over de eigen middelen van de eigenaren.
Antwoord op van het lid Patijn over de ontwikkeling van de AIQ

MP Patijn asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the decline of the labour income share (AIQ), its causes, historical trends, the SER's earlier 80% target, and policy options to raise it. The minister confirms the CEP 2024 lowered the forecast, attributes this mainly to productivity and terms-of-trade effects and wage revisions, and says wage recovery should continue while noting limited direct policy levers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Léon de Jong over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie: ook kappers en kabelleggers werken als 'kennismigrant''

Two MPs asked the minister about an Arbeidsinspectie report that hairdressers, cable layers and similar firms are using the knowledge-migrant scheme, and about how such abuse can be controlled. The minister acknowledged the problem, defended the scheme's salary criterion, gave migrant numbers by sector and nationality, and said the scheme will be reviewed with other ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over een conferentie door Hizb ut Tharir in Nederland

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about a March 2024 Hizb ut-Tahrir conference in Amsterdam, its extremist character, visa refusals, the possibility of banning the organisation, and the status of the government's problematic-conduct taskforce. The minister answered that speech crimes can be reported and prosecuted by the police and Openbaar Ministerie, that the AIVD rates the threat as low, that banning is for the prosecutor to decide, and that the taskforce has no legal basis for sharing case information.
The Openbaar Ministerie can ask the court to prohibit and dissolve an organisation under article 2:20 of the Civil Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan de rechter verzoeken een organisatie te verbieden en ontbinden op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over de roep in Amsterdam om het weren van een Samidoun kopstuk

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about Samidoun, its alleged links to the PFLP, possible bans, prosecution, funding scrutiny and whether a speaker could be barred in Amsterdam. The Minister of Justice answered that Samidoun is not currently under organisation-level investigation, that banning or listing decisions rest with the prosecutor, the Foreign Minister and the EU, and that individual cases and intelligence cannot be discussed, while pointing to a pending transparency bill and a forthcoming extremism strategy.

In this respect, as Minister of Justice and Security, I do not, given the confidentiality, make statements about information pictures and investigations by investigative, intelligence and security services.

Hierbij geldt dat ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid gezien de vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doe over informatiebeelden en onderzoeken van opsporings-, inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de financiële situatie van de gemeente Vlissingen

An SP MP asked ministers about the financial distress of Vlissingen municipality, including cuts affecting care, income support and children's activities such as swimming lessons, and whether minimum-level provision can be guaranteed. The minister answered that individual cases are the municipality's responsibility, that municipalities have policy discretion, that the inspector's list of options was not a recommendation, and that a new cabinet must decide on the division of responsibilities; most answers were substantive but several deflected or declined to guarantee outcomes.
It is up to the municipality of Vlissingen to decide how it deals with this.
Het is aan de gemeente Vlissingen om te bepalen hoe zij hiermee omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat “twee kinderopvangcentra in Utrecht per direct zijn gesloten"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two unregistered childcare centres in Utrecht closed immediately, including how illegal operations went unnoticed and how to prevent cross-municipal evasion. The minister answered that unregistered centres are unknown to supervisors, that the municipality handles enforcement and a Public Prosecution report was filed, and that no structural change to the system is currently planned beyond existing information-sharing arrangements.
They are not aware of childcare that is not registered in the National Childcare Register.
Zij zijn niet op de hoogte van kinderopvang die niet ingeschreven is in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht 'Turkse sekte met tweeëntwintig moskee-internaten stapt nu in scholen'

MPs Becker and De Kort asked about reports that a Turkish religious movement with boarding schools was entering mainstream schools in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, raising concerns about civic integration, founder backgrounds, oversight of the approval process and boarding houses. The government answered that the schools meet all legal founding requirements and may open in August 2024, that inspectorates monitor civic education, that it can refuse applications where concrete signals exist, but that no such signals were received, and that the boarding-house oversight and the planned informal-education bill are being maintained.
The powers to investigate persons and/or civil society organisations are not vested in the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Social Affairs and Employment, and Health, Welfare and Sport.

De bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen naar personen en/of maatschappelijke organisaties zijn niet belegd bij de Ministeries van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het artikel “Dit is de extreem-conservatieve club die zich ook dit jaar verzet tegen lessen over seks”

Two VVD MPs asked the Education Minister whether pressure by Civitas Christiana on schools to avoid sex-education material (Rutgers) is unacceptable, whether schools are obliged to teach respect for sexual diversity, and whether the government will monitor and act. The minister called the pressure undesirable and misleading, said schools are free to choose materials and reported no known cases of schools dropping them, but stated that the ministries have no legal basis to investigate or ban such organisations and offered support and a newsletter instead.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Marktplaats-melding aan fiscus blijkt ook risico voor uitkering; 'Overheid heeft geen goed track record in zulke zaken''.

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about risks that DAC7 platform data sharing with the tax authority could lead to benefit clawbacks and extra checks on welfare recipients selling goods online. The government answered that DAC7 creates no new obligations, that the tax authority only gives yes/no income signals to municipalities via the Inlichtingenbureau, that municipalities initiate checks, and that the effects will be monitored and reported in December 2024.

The Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions will inform the House in the Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in December 2024 about the effects of platform data sharing on municipalities' enforcement activities.

De Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen informeert uw Kamer via de Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in december 2024 over de effecten van de gegevensdeling van platformbedrijven op de handhavingsactiviteiten van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'WO II-voorstelling afgelast vanwege antisemitisme'

Two MPs asked whether cancelling a WWII performance due to antisemitism signals capitulation to anti-Jewish hatred and what role government plays in safeguarding cultural events. The State Secretary condemned such cancellations, said culture must remain free, and outlined cooperation with the sector, local security triangles and a forthcoming broader antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a clear directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'Reeks muzikale holocaustherdenkingen afgelast door antisemitische dreiging: ‘Risico is veel te groot’

MPs asked whether the cancellation of Holocaust commemoration concerts due to antisemitic threats is unacceptable and what measures will be taken to keep such events going, and whether the sector's exposure to antisemitism will be mapped. The Staatssecretaris condemns antisemitism, says cultural events must not be cancelled over Jewish themes, and reports sector agreements on protocols and a round-table, while committing to inform parliament further on the antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over ‘onterecht niet verkregen ontslagvergoedingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that flex workers rarely receive transition payments (transitievergoedingen) to which they are entitled, and about monitoring and deadlines. The minister said employers must pay unless an exception applies, that the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans will be evaluated in 2025 including payment compliance, and that the ministry cannot intervene in individual cases but workers can claim via information tools and the kantonrechter.
The evaluation will specifically examine awareness of the right to a transition payment, compliance with the obligation to pay it, its use, and whether it can be claimed.

Bij de evaluatie wordt specifiek aandacht besteed aan de bekendheid met (het recht op) de transitievergoeding, de naleving van de verplichting om een transitievergoeding te betalen, het gebruik van de transitievergoeding en de opeisbaarheid.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over arbeidsmigratie

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour migration in low-productivity sectors such as glasshouse horticulture, distribution centres and slaughterhouses, including exploitation, housing, and whether to study its broader social effects. The minister acknowledged misstanden and unequal distribution of costs and benefits, pointed to the Aanjaagteam recommendations, existing regulation of temp agencies, and expanded inspectorate capacity, but declined to commission a new cost estimate or broader study, deferring choices to a next cabinet.
No estimate can be given of all the financial costs of measures stimulating labour migration.
Er is geen inschatting te geven van alle financiële kosten ten aanzien van stimulerende maatregelen van arbeidsmigratie.

Antwoord op vragen van het leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Koekkoek over de berichten 'Steeds meer arbeidsmigranten op straat: 'De opvang moet humaner'', 'Een half miljoen arbeidsmigranten: uitbuiting en maatschappelij

MPs from CDA and Volt asked the ministers about media reports on homeless EU labour migrants, including causes, the BRP temporary address registration, the legal-entitlement tool for municipalities, language barriers and WW benefits, and measures against exploitation. The government answered that the numbers are uncertain and being monitored via a new census, that causes are varied and mostly personal, that a legal tool and a short-stay pilot are underway, and that existing measures such as the agency-licensing bill and the labour-market reform are the route forward.
The cabinet recognises the signals that the legal reality regarding the rights of EU citizens is complex.
Het kabinet herkent de signalen dat de juridische werkelijkheid ten aanzien van de rechten van EU-burgers complex is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over de blootstelling van werknemers aan kerosinemotoremissie op Schiphol

An MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure about the Labour Inspectorate's finding that Schiphol and platform employers are not doing enough to protect workers from kerosene engine emissions, including a 2007 internal report and delays in the sustainable taxiing programme. The government says it expects Schiphol and employers to comply with the inspectorate's demands, that the Health Council is assessing a classification and limit value, and that sector talks on faster rollout of taxibots and alternative towing continue.
I expect that Schiphol and the employers will follow the requirements set by the Netherlands Labour Inspectorate.
Ik ga ervan uit dat Schiphol en de werkgevers de eisen die zijn gesteld door de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat werknemers op Schiphol worden blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkende stoffen

The SP MP Van Kent asked ministers about reports that Schiphol platform workers are exposed to carcinogenic aircraft engine emissions, and what measures, health monitoring and compensation exist. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's demands require Schiphol and employers to do more, cited phased measures such as APU limits and a green zone by 2027, said the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing classification of kerosene engine emissions, and declined to commit to immediate mandatory electrification or a site visit.
I have asked the Health Council to determine whether kerosene engine emissions as a whole should be classified as carcinogenic.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd te bepalen of kerosinemotoremissie als geheel als kankerverwekkend moet worden geclassificeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Zo worden Oekraïners onder valse voorwendselen door schimmige uitzendbureaus naar Nederland gehaald'

Van Kent (SP) asked the minister about a report that Ukrainians are recruited under false pretences by dubious staffing agencies and posted to the Netherlands via A1 certificates. The minister condemned the practice, said detachment of third-country nationals is legal but abused through sham constructions, and described enforcement steps, EU-level efforts and the lack of sanction data.
I continuously bring this to the attention of employer organisations.
Ik breng dit continu onder de aandacht van werkgeversorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het rapport ‘De (on)menselijke maat van het UWV’

MPs Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report by a patient group on UWV assessments of ME/CVS patients, including alleged disbelief, outdated prognoses, and whether the 2018 Health Council advice was acted on. The minister acknowledged the patients' experiences, defended UWV's recognition of ME/CVS and individualised assessments, and announced a file review of the 59 patients with a dedicated team, plus an ongoing inventory of input on the adopted motion for a protocol.
Therefore UWV will carry out a file review of the 59 patients from the report, by a team set up specifically for this purpose.
Daarom zal UWV een dossieronderzoek uitvoeren naar de 59 patiënten uit het rapport, door een speciaal daarvoor ingesteld team.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "geluidsnormen op de werkvloer"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about noise limits in workplaces such as gymnasiums after a Pointer broadcast, and about Labour Inspectorate inspections, violations and risk-assessment (RI&E) compliance. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible, that the Inspectorate found no noise-related violations in about 40 gym and 50 swimming pool inspections, and that RI&E compliance is being addressed under the Arbovisie 2040.
The risk of health damage from noise emerges as relatively less of a priority in those risk analyses.
Het risico op gezondheidsschade door geluid komt als relatief minder prioritair uit die risicoanalyses naar voren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht 'Ministerie van Sociale Zaken informeert mensen actief over onrechtmatige verwerking van persoonsgegevens'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the unlawful processing of personal data on salafism and radicalisation, asking how many people were affected, how many access requests were filed and handled, the cause, whether apologies were given, and preventive measures. The minister said 12 of the first 131 access requests revealed unlawful processing, that apologies were sent, that proactive notification and an investigation by the Data Protection Authority are pending, and that the deadline for requests is extended to 31 July.
I therefore expect to be able to inform your House only after the summer about the total of unlawful processing of personal data.
Ik verwacht daarom uw Kamer pas na de zomer te kunnen informeren over het totaal aan onrechtmatige verwerkingen van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over "de representativiteit van werknemers tijdens het cao-proces"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about declining union membership undermining representativeness at collective bargaining, and whether all workers should be involved in CAO negotiations. The minister replies that support for unions and CAOs is stable, that the SER advice is endorsed, and that existing scope for tailoring is sufficient, while promising broader dialogue on workers' involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Roep in Amsterdam om weren Samidoun kopstuk'

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked whether Amsterdam or the national government can ban Samidoun-linked speaker Mohamed al Khatib from events in the Netherlands, given his alleged membership of a banned terrorist organisation. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the IND found insufficient grounds for exclusion, that local authorities cannot impose a ban on the closed event, and that the government will keep monitoring the risks.

On the basis of the available information, there is insufficient ground in this case to conclude that the person's individual conduct constitutes a genuine, present and sufficiently serious threat to a fundamental interest of society.

Op basis van de beschikbare informatie is er in deze zaak onvoldoende grond om te concluderen dat het persoonlijk gedrag van betrokkene een werkelijke, actuele en voldoende ernstige bedreiging voor een fundamenteel belang van de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de gevolgen van recente branden waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about the health risks and clean-up after recent asbestos-releasing fires, including whether workers cleaning up in Vroomshoop lacked protective equipment and how often such fires occur. The government answered that local authorities and implementing bodies are responsible for safety measures, clean-up and resident information, that asbestos-fire incidents are not centrally registered, that the Arbeidsinspectie found no reports of unprotected workers, and that it will inform parliament before summer on encouraging removal of asbestos roofs.
The number of fires in which asbestos is released is not centrally registered.
Het aantal branden waarbij asbest vrij komt, wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het NOS-bericht “Problemen op werk door uitspraken over Gaza-Israël, soms zelfs ontslag"

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked ministers about a NOS report on employees facing problems at work, even dismissal, over pro-Palestinian statements, asking whether civil servants can be ordered to remove online posts, whether dismissal for such posts is justified, what they will do about reported unsafe workplaces, whether a national reporting point will be set up, and whether a DJI employee was dismissed on the spot for sharing a video. The minister answered that civil servants have free speech subject to limits in the Ambtenarenwet, that dismissal is a matter for courts and the employer, that the government will strengthen workplace safety and consider mandatory codes and complaint procedures, but declined to create a national reporting point and declined to comment on individual cases.
This concerns a matter between an employer and an employee. As is customary, individual cases are not discussed.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid tussen een werkgever en een medewerker. Zoals gebruikelijk wordt er niet ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op van het lid Patijn over het bericht “Duizenden truckers werken onder schrijnende omstandigheden: ‘Ik voel me als een hond aan de lijn’”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that third-country truck drivers work in poor conditions in the Netherlands, often under foreign-posted employment constructions, and asks who is responsible, how labour law is enforced, and how the proposed EU Talent Pool could enable further abuse. The minister responds that the Labour Inspectorate enforces Dutch rules on posted workers where detachment applies, that cross-border enforcement runs through the ELA and other agencies, and that the Netherlands will press for limits on the Talent Pool, without committing to a decision on participation.

If lorry drivers are employed by a foreign transport company but posted to the Netherlands and thereby have a sufficiently close connection with the Netherlands, they are entitled under the European legal framework to Dutch statutory working conditions.

Als vrachtwagenchauffeurs in dienst zijn bij een buitenlands transportbedrijf maar in Nederland gedetacheerd zijn en daarmee een voldoende nauwe band hebben met Nederland, dan hebben zij volgens de Europese juridische kaders recht op de Nederlandse wettelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht: ‘Oekraïners gelokt: vanuit heel Europa komen mensen nu af op gratis woning en zorg.’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Ukrainians are arriving from across Europe for free housing and care, asking about arrival numbers, motives, medical care, work rights and long-term planning. The government answered that arrivals are mostly under temporary protection rules, that a monitoring study will be launched, and that it will prepare a uniform co-payment scheme and information on self-employment rules before the summer recess.
In light of these signals, a formal (qualitatively reliable) monitoring study will be launched in the short term at the HUB in Utrecht.
Mede naar aanleiding van deze signalen zal er op korte termijn een formeel (kwalitatief betrouwbaar) monitoringsonderzoek worden opgestart bij de HUB in Utrecht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Kinderdagverblijven en bso's gebruiken vaker trucs om omzet te verhogen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare providers are increasingly using tricks such as package changes, extended opening hours and billing for closures, and how this is monitored and how parents can complain. The minister answered that no overview of the scale or financial effects exists because these are private contracts, promised a sample study, dialogue with the complaints committee, clarification of the public holiday rule, and sector transparency measures.
There is no overview of the scale at which the practices described in the article are applied.
Er is geen overzicht op welke schaal de praktijken uit het artikel worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over trucs van kinderopvang om de omzet te verhogen

An MP asked the minister about childcare providers inflating billed hours and contract changes pressuring parents, including the availability of complaint routes and oversight of billed versus used hours. The minister acknowledged the signals, said Dienst Toeslagen only checks that declared hours match parents' declarations, pointed to complaint procedures and the Geschillencommissie, and promised a steekproef, transparency measures and further study.
No government supervision is exercised over whether the childcare is actually open during all billed hours.
Er wordt vanuit de overheid geen toezicht gehouden op of de opvang tijdens alle gefactureerde uren daadwerkelijk open is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Kinderdagverblijven en bso's gebruiken vaker trucs om omzet te verhogen’

An MP asked the minister whether childcare centres and after-school care use tricks such as billing extra hours and pressuring parents into contract changes, and what the government will do about it. The minister says such practices are undesirable, points parents to complaint routes and a planned transparency and monitoring approach, and defers the new financing system's safeguards to the next cabinet.
I intend to clarify the regulations on this point.
Daarom ben ik voornemens de regelgeving op dit punt te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over kinderopvanglocaties die trucs inzetten om meer omzet te draaien

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare centres use accounting tricks to inflate billed hours and how the government will prevent misuse when setting price rules. The minister says the sector was urged to improve transparency, a sample of opening hours will be taken, parents have complaint routes, and tariff regulation is being studied with results expected in early 2025.
There is no overview of the scale on which the practices discussed in the article are applied, or of their financial consequences for parents.
Er is geen overzicht op welke schaal de praktijken die besproken worden in het artikel, worden toegepast en wat de financiële gevolgen voor ouders zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over “recente inzichten over arbeidsmarkttekorten in de kinderopvang”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about recent data on staff shortages in childcare, including vacancies, inflow and outflow, regional breakdowns, and sector comparisons. The minister answered with ABF Research forecasts showing a 5,900-person shortage in 2023 that is stabilising, regional figures, comparisons with healthcare and education, and a list of measures such as the Ontwikkelpad and the PNIL programme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over zzp’ers in de schoonmaakbranche die hun werk verrichten in onveilige omstandigheden en een verhoogd risico lopen op armoede

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Minister's colleague at Finance about self-employed cleaners working in unsafe conditions, facing poverty risk and lacking social insurance protection. The government acknowledged the rise in one-person cleaning firms and the lack of protection for self-employed workers, pointed to planned measures (mandatory disability insurance for self-employed, enforcement against sham self-employment, arbovisie), but said it has no specific data on poverty or health risks in the cleaning sector.
I consider it undesirable that (vulnerable) self-employed persons are insufficiently protected against risks such as loss of income due to incapacity for work.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat (kwetsbare) zelfstandigen onvoldoende beschermd zijn tegen risico's zoals inkomensterugval door arbeidsongeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het functioneren van de arbeidswetgeving in de vrije culture sector

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about labour rights, union fears, employment contract chains and working conditions in the free culture sector, such as musicals. The government answers that collective agreements and sector dialogue (via Platform ACCT) are the main route, that existing labour protections including the chain rule should remain, and that it will continue dialogue within the sector rather than launch a new initiative.
It is of great importance to conduct the dialogue with and within the sector to improve working conditions in the sector.
Het is van groot belang de dialoog met én binnen de sector te voeren om de arbeidsomstandigheden in de sector te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Nieuwe regels na uitspraak Raad van State: asielzoeker mag meer dan 24 weken werken'

MP Podt asked whether the government will remove other barriers, identified by Regioplan, to asylum seekers entering the labour market beyond the 24-week rule, and asked about BRP registration backlogs, guidance to work, meedoenbalies, VOG and diploma recognition. The minister says the 24-week rule will be removed from regulations, other options are being explored for a next cabinet, BSN waiting times will be cleared by end 2024, and the government is examining support for asylum seekers while avoiding commitments beyond that.
In this amendment the 24-week requirement will no longer be included in the Decree implementing the Foreign Nationals Employment Act 2022 and the ministerial regulation.
Bij deze aanpassing zal de 24-weken-eis niet meer in het Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2022 en de ministeriële regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op van het lid Palland over doorwerken na AOW-leeftijd naaraanleiding van het commissiedebat Pensioenonderwerpen d.d. 21 juni 2023

An MP from the CDA asked how employment law and collective agreement pay scales apply when employees keep working for the same employer after reaching the AOW pension age, including whether prior service counts. The minister answers that these terms are for employer and employee to agree within collective agreements, that the government offers public information campaigns, and that it sees no role in discussing the matter with social partners.
It is important that employer and employee discuss the options for working after the AOW age in good time, if this is the wish of one or both.
Het is belangrijk dat werkgever en werknemer tijdig het gesprek aangaan over de mogelijkheden om na de AOW-leeftijd door te werken, als dit de wens van (één van) beide is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon over het bericht 'Opnieuw pro-Palestijnse sit-ins op stations, dit keer op Joodse feestdag: 'Zorgwekkend en intimiderend''

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security about pro-Palestinian sit-ins at railway stations on a Jewish holiday, including antisemitic slogans and whether Jewish Dutch citizens feel threatened. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned discriminatory expressions, said the government and NCTV monitor the situation, and noted that criminal offences during demonstrations can be acted upon by the mayor, prosecutor and police.
When possible criminal offences such as incitement, hatred, discrimination or violence are committed during a demonstration, action can be taken.
Op het moment dat tijdens een demonstratie (mogelijke) strafbare feiten worden gepleegd, zoals opruiing of het aanzetten tot haat, discriminatie of geweld, kan worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel 'Stijgende kosten, dalende omzet: kartonfabrikant Solidus sluit vestiging Hoogkerk'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about Solidus closing its Hoogkerk plant, the reasons for it, and what government would do about job losses and worker support. The minister confirmed the plan from media reports, called it a business decision, pointed to UWV, municipal and regional mobility-team support, and said government sees no role in mediation between management and unions.
I see no role for the cabinet in the mediation process between Solidus management and the union(s).
Ik zie geen rol voor het kabinet in het bemiddelingsproces tussen de directie van Solidus en de vakbond(en).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Bevers over "initiatieven met software die gesproken taal real-time omzet naar geschreven tekst”

MPs De Kort and Bevers asked why speech-to-text software such as Speaksee is not reimbursed for hearing-impaired workers, and about savings, interpreter shortages and access to aids. The minister acknowledges an omission in the Reïntegratiebesluit and intends to amend it so UWV can provide such aids in the interim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Erdogan: Hamas is geen terroristische organisatie'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about President Erdogan calling Hamas a liberation group, whether Turkish-funded mosques and schools spread such views, and how the government counters foreign influence and antisemitism. The ministers condemned Hamas as terrorist, said they raised the issue with Turkey and monitor foreign interference, but declined to investigate specific mosques or schools, citing lack of competence and absence of signals.
The Ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and of Foreign Affairs are not authorised to investigate persons or organisations.
De Ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Buitenlandse Zaken zijn niet bevoegd onderzoek naar personen of organisaties te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel 'Achterstanden lopen op: verzekeringsartsen dreigen met afsplitsing UWV'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about large backlogs in UWV insurance-physician medical assessments for WIA benefit claims and a union proposal to split off the medical assessments. The minister confirmed the structural backlog, described temporary measures including advance payments and an unlawful-but-temporary simplified assessment for over-60s, and said an advisory commission would report in early 2024.

That is why I, in consultation with UWV, the Dutch Association for Insurance Medicine and insurance physicians among others, have taken various measures in recent years and we continue to jointly seek and work on new measures.

Daarom heb ik – in overleg met onder meer het UWV, de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Verzekeringsgeneeskunde (NVVG) en verzekeringsartsen – de afgelopen jaren verschillende maatregelen getroffen en blijven we in gezamenlijkheid zoeken naar en werken aan nieuwe maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het artikel '‘Verstoorde arbeidsverhouding’ als ontslaggrond ondermijnt sociale veiligheid’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about the use of the 'disrupted working relationship' dismissal ground, its relevance for dismissals in education and for social safety, and whether the employer's culpability plays a role. The minister answered that data on the ground is not registered, that the employer's culpability can weigh in but is not decisive, that no separate research on education is planned, and pointed to existing workplace safety measures and a forthcoming handbook for employers.
This ground is not always explicitly mentioned in the request and is therefore not registered as such.
Deze grond wordt niet altijd expliciet in het verzoek genoemd en wordt dan dus ook niet als zodanig geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het bericht dat twee op de drie werkende Nederlanders zich niet door zijn werkgever gestimuleerd voelen om zichzelf te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van e

MPs Westerveld and Kathmann asked whether workers should receive a lifelong personal learning budget, how government can encourage employers to stimulate training, and how to reduce learning reluctance among practically educated workers, citing STAP-budget lessons. The ministers answer that lifelong learning is important, that employers bear primary responsibility, point to existing schemes (SLIM, leercultuur, LLO collectief, levenlanglerenkrediet) and say a personal learning budget is a decision for the next cabinet, referring to a November 2023 exploration.
Weighing the various pros and cons of introducing a development budget and the further decision-making on it is up to a next cabinet.
Het afwegen van de diverse voor- en nadelen van invoering van een ontwikkelbudget en de verdere besluitvorming daarover is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV vordert tienduizenden euro’s aan toeslagen terug vannietsvermoedende arbeidsongeschikten’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV reclaimed tens of thousands of euros in supplementary benefits from disability recipients who received back-payments of disability pensions, and whether UWV followed its own rules. The minister acknowledged two confirmed cases, said UWV regrets the contact failures, outlined ongoing efforts on gross reclaiming, pension cooperation, and a review of recovery policy, but did not provide aggregate figures.
Pension funds and UWV unfortunately have no insight into the number of disabled Dutch citizens who received a back-payment in the past five years.
Pensioenfondsen en UWV hebben helaas geen inzicht in het aantal arbeidsongeschikte Nederlanders dat in de afgelopen vijf jaar een nabetaling heeft ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ‘de wachtlijst voor een WIA-indicatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the six-month wait for a WIA disability assessment, the low advance payment (around 1,000 euros per month), whether it is possible to live on that amount, and whether UWV actively informs people about the advance. The minister confirmed waits average 21 weeks and that UWV is working toward a uniform national wait, explained that advances depend on the applicant's daily wage and can be topped up under the Toeslagenwet but never exceed prior income, and described UWV's service calls that offer the advance.
Resolving the mismatch and thereby reducing waiting times therefore has my highest priority.
Het oplossen van de mismatch en daarmee het terugdringen van de wachttijden heeft dan ook mijn hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het nieuwsbericht ‘Lien mag niet meer werken als treinassistente omdat ze een abaya draagt: ‘Voelde me vernederd’’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Staatssecretaris of Infrastructure about reports that a train attendant was barred from working for NS while wearing an abaya, and about whether NS dress rules and handling of the case were lawful. The government answered that it lacks full details, that personnel policy is NS's responsibility, that employers may impose dress rules within limits, that questions of discrimination are for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the courts, and that it cannot share any internal investigation for privacy reasons.
It is for the judiciary to assess in a specific case whether dress rules comply with laws and regulations.
Het is aan de rechterlijke macht om in een specifiek geval te beoordelen of kledingvoorschriften in overeenstemming zijn met wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over digiC

MP Kathmann asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the digiC consultation model for collective bargaining undermines trade union independence, whether cao's signed by De Unie alone or using digiC should be withdrawn or refused registration, and how independence is enforced. The minister says unions must be independent, online consultation of workers does not in itself breach independence, the ministry does not record digiC use, and it will discuss union independence with the social partners and leaves it to courts to judge.
The use of online means to consult employees in collective bargaining does not, in general terms, constitute an infringement of trade union independence.
Het gebruik van online middelen voor raadpleging van werknemers bij cao-onderhandelingen maakt in algemene zin geen inbreuk op de onafhankelijkheid van vakbonden.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over de voorgenomen wijziging in het asbestcertificatiestelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the planned amendment of the asbestos certification system, including the scope and periodicity of an external evaluation, how behavioural aspects and final inspections are assessed, whether air monitoring is structurally used, and the risk assessment for dropping air measurements. The minister replied that the evaluation starts six months after entry into force, will cover the full regulatory change and possibly periodic evaluation, that monitoring is mainly the employer's duty supported by TNO data, and that the stelselwijziging risk assessment rests on TNO advice and tests, with more independent inspections, without a separate impact analysis on background asbestos concentrations.
As my predecessor committed, at the request of the House of Representatives the external evaluation of the asbestos system will start six months after the regulation takes effect.
Zoals mijn voorganger heeft toegezegd 1 , gaat op verzoek van de Tweede Kamer de externe evaluatie op het asbeststelsel een half jaar na inwerkingtreding van de regelgeving van start.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Bagagemedewerkers mogen maximaal 216 koffers per dag tillen op Schiphol, maar zitten vaak aan de 200 per uur’

MPs De Hoop and Kathmann asked the government about a report finding that baggage handlers at Schiphol are exposed to excessive physical strain, and about employer responsibility, liability, enforcement and timelines. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that the Labour Inspectorate has imposed penalty payments and conducts inspections, and that mechanisation will take 8-10 years while interim measures are required now.

With the penalty payments imposed on the baggage handling companies, the Labour Inspectorate is forcing employers to take technical and organisational measures to limit physical strain as much as possible.

Met de lasten onder dwangsom die zijn opgelegd aan de bagageafhandelaren dwingt de Arbeidsinspectie de werkgevers technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen om de fysieke belasting zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden De Kort en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Utrecht wil parkeerkosten voor lage inkomens vergoeden, ook als ze geen auto hebben'

MPs De Kort and Koerhuis asked whether Utrecht's plan to compensate low-income U-pas holders for paid parking, including those without a car, is proportionate, redistributive, or an indirect form of income policy. The minister replied that parking and minima policy fall within municipal competence, that the mobility budget was raised for all U-pas holders because the law does not allow distinguishing car owners, and that no national enforcement is planned.
It falls within the competence of municipalities to make independent considerations and choices regarding parking policy.
Het valt binnen de bevoegdheid van gemeenten om op het gebied van parkeerbeleid eigenstandige afwegingen en keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht "Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen"

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about NRC reports that tank cleaner Claessen Tankcleaning discharged benzene-laden waste water into the Maas, and about enforcement history. The state secretary answered that waste water is treated on-site and discharged via the municipal sewer and the Waterschap plant, that enforcement began in 2020, and that a penalty order was issued in July 2023 with follow-up checks.

On 31 July 2023 the municipality of Venlo sent Claessen Tankcleaning an order subject to a penalty after it was established that benzene tank cleaning was carried out differently, in method and installations, than described in the permit.

Op 31 juli 2023 is er door gemeente Venlo een last onder dwangsom verstuurd aan Claessen Tankcleaning nadat is vastgesteld dat de reiniging van tankwagens met benzeen anders wordt uitgevoerd qua werkwijze en installaties dan in de vergunning is omschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over koppeling statushouders aan gemeenten

An MP asks how statushouders (recognised refugees) are matched to municipalities, including family, work and study ties, the reliance on regional advice, the treatment of unaccompanied minors, early integration courses, and the handover of case files. The State Secretary answers that COA matches on hard and soft criteria with 79% of advice followed in 2022, that early contact is encouraged but hindered by reception shortages, and that short-term measures on early start and COA-municipality cooperation are being developed.
The main obstacle to early contact with the municipality and starting integration is the distance between COA reception and the matched municipality.
Het belangrijkste knelpunt bij vroegtijdige kennismaking met de gemeente en het starten met de inburgering is de afstand tussen de COA-opvang en de gekoppelde gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht "Indonesische verpleegkundigen worden hier uitgeknepen: Ik voel me opgelicht''

MPs Dijk (SP) asked ministers about reports that Indonesian nurses recruited via study permits were being exploited, including questions on labour inspection oversight of recruitment agencies, prior warnings, and working conditions. The minister replied that the Labour Inspectorate has no overview of such agencies, a handhavingstraject is ongoing, the IND has put new applications on hold pending its outcome, and the government will consult the Labour Inspectorate once that process concludes.
The Dutch Labour Inspectorate has no overall picture of such intermediary agencies, nor of their business profitability.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie heeft geen overkoepelend beeld van dergelijke bemiddelingsbureaus noch van hun bedrijfseconomische winstgevendheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam en Van Baarle over het illegaal verzamelen van gegevens van uitkeringsgerechtigden door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's unlawful collection of benefit recipients' data via cookies and IP addresses for a fraud risk scan, its ethics and human-rights checks, the discrimination risk, data deletion, costs and proportionality. The minister acknowledged the cookie-based IP data was collected unlawfully and proportionality was lacking, stopped the scan, reopened 460 cases, and promised a technical briefing and further information, while withholding operational details for inspection reasons.
In the interest of inspection, control and supervision I cannot make this public.
In het belang van inspectie, controle en toezicht kan ik dit niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het toenemend wantrouwen in de overheid onder jongeren

An MP asks several ministers about growing distrust of government among young people, its link to conspiracy theories and anti-institutional extremism, and how prevention of polarisation and radicalisation is organised. The Minister answers that youth distrust is a concern, outlines existing prevention efforts and coordination between ministries, and announces ongoing work such as a new training on anti-institutional extremism.
It is part of a healthy democracy that people can voice criticism of the government.
Het hoort bij een gezonde democratie dat mensen kritiek kunnen uiten op de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Warmerdam over cao’s met afspraken over zelfstandigen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about collective agreements (cao's) that set terms for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including whether such terms restrict contractual freedom, how many workers and self-employed are affected, whether these agreements belong in cao's, and how member participation and enforcement against false self-employment work. The minister answers that the competition-law exception allows collective bargaining for vulnerable self-employed, that only a small number of cao's contain such provisions, that enforcement and a legal presumption against false self-employment are being pursued, and that the questions could not be answered by the requested deadline.
Exact numbers of self-employed workers in the sectors are not available.
Exacte aantallen van zelfstandigen in de branches zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Kent over de storting van ballaststenen in Apeldoorn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about quartz-containing ballast stored in an Apeldoorn residential area, including health risks, whether work should be halted, inspection and permit issues, and ProRail's compliance with quartz-free ballast requirements. The government answered that ProRail and BAM bear the legal responsibility, an independent investigation has been commissioned, the Labour Inspectorate is requesting information and will enforce as needed, and it is awaiting the outcomes of further research and a municipal fact report, while noting that the transition to quartz-free ballast is constrained by market availability.
It is understandable that residents want to know whether the way they were exposed to quartz dust poses health risks.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de bewoners willen weten of de manier waarop zij zijn blootgesteld aan kwartsstof gezondheidsrisico’s met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over het artikel 'Zorgmedewerker in verkapte loondienst aangepakt: 'Enorm probleem'; 'Bureaus agressief aan het werven''

MPs Van den Hil and Smals asked the Minister for Long-term Care about bogus self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) in healthcare, agency recruitment, a proposed quota and a conduct code for intermediaries, the new professional control law, and collective agreement flexibility. The minister answered that no data exist on involuntary self-employment, that a sector control model and a conduct code are being developed, and that the Wkkgz amendment on staff influence is being implemented.
No figures are available on this specific question.
Over deze specifieke vraag zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.

Antwoord op van het lid Omtzigt over "10.000 gezinnen (vaak met een parttime werkende en/of gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte) die onder het bijstandsniveau leven, omdat de fiscale en sociale regels ernstig in hun nadeel w

Omtzigt asked the ministers why about 10,000 households, often with a part-time or partly disabled earner, fall below the social assistance level because of tax and benefit rules, and why they are not being proactively contacted for a top-up, citing the 2022 Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling and earlier warnings from the National Ombudsman. The ministers answered that a new approach is being prepared, about 6,400 households are affected in 2023, some municipalities have started active outreach, and no national overview of contacts exists, with broader communication postponed to avoid overloading municipalities.
There is no national picture of the number of households that have been contacted or have already been helped.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van het aantal huishoudens waarmee inmiddels contact is of dat inmiddels geholpen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van het amendement Becker c.s. over voor- en vroegschoolse educatie voor kinderen van inburgeraars (35483-51)

Becker (VVD) asks how the adopted amendment requiring municipalities to address pre- and early-school education (VVE) for children of integration-obliged migrants is implemented, including agreements in the integration plan, participation figures and monitoring. The minister answers that no national data exist on agreements or participation, that municipalities only stimulate rather than must offer VVE, and that a qualitative study will report in 2024.
I do not have national figures on the agreements in the PIP.
Ik beschik niet over landelijke cijfers over de afspraken in het PIP.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Sahla en Wuite over "over de vertraagde invoering van bijna-gratis kinderopvang op de BES-eilanden"

Two D66 MPs asked why the introduction of near-free childcare (4% parental contribution) on the Caribbean Netherlands islands was delayed, and whether capacity problems justified this, given the Ministers' differing positions. The government answered that the phased approach aligns the Caribbean parental contribution with the Dutch schedule toward 4% by 2027, that capacity and quality concerns exist but did not justify postponing the Wet kinderopvang BES, and that the bill's content and timing remain open to parliamentary amendment.
Members of the House of Representatives can influence the content of the bill and the related implementing regulations through motions or amendments.
De Tweede Kamerleden kunnen door middel van moties of amendementen invloed uitoefenen op de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel en de bijbehorende uitvoeringsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over "de werkerscoöperatie in aanvulling op de beraadslagingen tijdens het commissiedebat ZZP van woensdag 7 juni 2023"

Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether platform workers forming a worker cooperative escape the cartel prohibition, whether they may agree collective terms with clients, how independence from the platform is guaranteed, and whether the 149-member limit under financial supervision rules applies. The Minister answered yes, subject to conditions: the cooperative must be an economic unit with no internal competition and decisive influence over members' market conduct, collective agreements with platforms are outside the cartel ban, independence rests on ILO convention 98 and voluntary cooperation, and the 149-person threshold relates to the Prospectus Regulation exemption.
Yes, provided certain conditions are met.
Ja, mits aan bepaalde voorwaarden is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over kinderopvang voor kinderen van ouders met een ernstige ziekte

An MP asks the minister why childcare support for children of parents with serious illness such as cancer differs between municipalities, and whether a national minimum should apply. The minister answers that municipalities have policy freedom under the SMI scheme, that differences will be discussed with the VNG, and that a future cabinet should decide on wider childcare reform.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing SMI and have policy freedom in doing so.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van SMI en hebben daarbij beleidsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over "pgb-zorgverleners zonder sociaal vangnet”

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) care workers without social safety nets, including family carers, should receive unemployment, sick-pay and disability benefits after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and what would be done. The minister answered that the ruling covers only employment-contract workers under the Rdah, that family carers working on service contracts lack an employment relationship and are excluded, that possible solutions are being explored with a decision expected in autumn, and that extending benefits to the excluded group would cost about 115 million euro structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Palland en Maatoug over de onderwijsroute naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan het Da Vinci College te Dordrecht over de onderwijsroute Wet inburgering 2021

Three MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Wi2021 education route after a visit to Da Vinci College in Dordrecht, covering extra assessments, the share routed to the education track, national coverage, and waiting youths. The minister answered that most municipalities now offer the route, that the maximum inburgering term is three years, and that outcome data on quality and progression will only be available in 2024.
Regarding the quality and progression from the education route to regular education, there is still insufficient knowledge due to the short duration of the Wi2021.
Over de kwaliteit en doorstroom vanuit de onderwijsroute naar regulier onderwijs is nog onvoldoende bekend vanwege de korte looptijd van de Wi2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over arbeidsmigratie

Omtzigt asked how many labour migrants entered the Netherlands in 2021 and 2022, whether a leaked migration letter is authentic, and when each measure will be elaborated and submitted to parliament. The minister gave partial figures (EU data delayed until November 2023; non-EU permits for 2021 and 2022), declined to confirm the letter's authenticity citing confidentiality of inter-party negotiations, and said the cabinet had not agreed on the measures.
In line with the established practice between parliament and cabinet and the legal framework, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to provide the political input and documents.
Conform de vaste lijn in het verkeer tussen Kamer en kabinet en het wettelijk kader is het niet aangewezen om vanuit het kabinet de politieke inbreng en stukken te verstrekken.
