Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel “Zorgen om kinderdagverblijven en bso’s: ‘Ernstige incidenten zijn topje van ijsberg'"

A Member of Parliament asks about high-risk profiles (oranje/rood) for childcare locations, regional differences, and the causes including staff shortages, and whether risk profiles should be public. The minister responds that risk profiles are estimates rather than inspection verdicts, describes ongoing studies, planned incident reporting duties, a new quality monitor, and staffing measures, and states that publication of risk profiles is up to the GGDs and municipalities.
It is up to the GGDs and municipalities to assess whether it is desirable to make the risk profiles public.
Het is aan de GGD’en en gemeenten om te beoordelen of het wenselijk is om de risicoprofielen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over het bericht dat kinderen soms langer dan een jaar wachten op logopedie

MPs Sahla and Hagen asked about reports that children sometimes wait over a year for speech therapy, including waiting-list data, the Treek norm, therapist numbers, tariffs, insurer duties and measures to reduce waits. The minister reported that over half of first-line practices had waits exceeding one year in 2022, that insurers must ensure access and mediate, and that he will consult the NZa on more intensive supervision, while stating that tariff adequacy cannot yet be judged.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision of speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het artikel “Betaald voetbal predikte loonmatiging tijdens corona, maar spelers kregen meer”.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Eredivisie clubs that received NOW wage subsidies while promising wage restraint had acted improperly, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that loonmatiging was not a NOW condition, that UWV checks eligibility and may reclaim subsidy in case of non-compliance with NOW rules, and that no sector-specific agreements with the KNVB or clubs existed.
Wage restraint was not a condition for the NOW and is therefore not a relevant factor in the determination.
Loonmatiging was geen voorwaarde voor de NOW en is dus geen relevante factor in de vaststelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de sluiting van papierfabriek De Hoop in Eerbeek

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Stora Enso's plan to close the De Hoop paper mill in Eerbeek with 185 job losses, its timing after the takeover, the regional labour market outlook, what the government will do to protect workers, and whether UWV has received a dismissal request. The Minister replied that closure is an entrepreneurial decision, outlined the regional labour market (growth below the national average, industry weakening but skilled-labour shortages), explained the consultation and UWV dismissal-permit procedures, and declined to confirm any specific dismissal request for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality of the information, I do not make statements about any dismissal applications submitted by individual companies.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over eventueel door individuele bedrijven ingediende ontslagaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over seizoensarbeid

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the seasonal-work exception to the fixed-term chain rule's break period is kept, whether seasonal workers can be kept in repeated temporary contracts without a permanent contract, and whether seasonal work can be legally defined. The Minister answered that the exception stays because it balances worker protection and employer needs, that collective agreements designate the functions and enforcement lies with social partners, and that a statutory definition for a differentiated unemployment premium is not feasible.
I therefore do not intend to remove the existing possibility that collective agreements can designate functions of recurring temporary work for which a 3-month break applies.
Ik ben dus niet voornemens de bestaande mogelijkheid te schrappen dat bij cao functies voor terugkerend tijdelijk werk aangewezen kunnen worden waarvoor een tussenpoos van 3 maanden geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘werkloze ouderen komen nog altijd moeilijk aan een baan’

MPs Den Haan and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether older workers and people with chronic illness have very low odds of finding paid work within a quarter, and what the government will do about labour market activation. The minister disputes the framing, gives labour market statistics and describes existing and planned measures (Seniorenkansenvisie, banenafspraak, communication on working after AOW age), while stating the effects of abolishing zero-hour contracts on pensioners' participation will be assessed.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Ja, ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de instroom in de sociale zekerheid tijdens een crisis

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployment benefits (WW) and social assistance (Participatiewet) can cope with a sharp rise in claims during a crisis, what analysis was done, and what lessons apply to the proposed crisis job-retention scheme. The minister answered that WW proved operationally resilient in past crises, that no specific study was done for the Participatiewet, and that the new scheme aims to reduce inflows, while describing lessons from the NOW wage subsidy and the trade-off between wage and income subsidies.
No research was conducted on the Participatiewet regarding the effects of a sharply rising inflow in the event of a crisis.
Er is voor de Participatiewet geen onderzoek gedaan naar de gevolgen van een fors oplopende instroom in het geval van een crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over aanpassingen in de WW premiedifferentiatie

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the line between on-call and other contracts under the lower WW premium is unclear, why the government dropped planned changes to the on-call and Wfsv decrees, and whether that increases misuse risk. The minister answers that the decrees were judged too complex and disproportionate, that monitoring via UWV reports was chosen instead, and that a bill abolishing on-call contracts is in consultation, with the Wab evaluation due around mid-2025.
I have therefore for the time being chosen monitoring.
Ik heb daarom vooralsnog gekozen voor monitoring.
Antwoord op van de leden Warmerdam en Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Loonkloof tussen man en vrouw in Nederland is groter dan in veel andere EU-landen'

MPs Warmerdam and Romke de Jong asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the gender pay gap in the Netherlands compared with other EU countries, why the decline has stalled, the timing and scope of the EU pay transparency directive implementation, and related questions on company size thresholds and temp workers. The minister attributed the gap largely to part-time work and sector differences, acknowledged slow progress, committed to implementing the directive by mid-2024, and answered most questions, with consultation planned.
I see the introduction of this directive as an important step in promoting equality in the labour market.
Ik zie de invoering van deze richtlijn als een belangrijke stap in het bevorderen van gelijkheid op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Slootweg 'kabinetsbrief van 14 juni 2023, inzake kinderbijslag per 1 juli 2023'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs why child benefit (kinderbijslag) was negatively indexed from 1 July 2023 and whether the government would compensate families, including past negative indexations, budget effects, other benefits at risk, why the WML freeze mechanism was not used for child benefit, and whether family impacts will be shown in purchasing-power figures. The minister answered that a generic compensation is not suitable and will be considered in the August decisions, that the indexation was a shortfall versus the budget assumption, that the mechanism will be reviewed and reported in December, and that the government will implement the Palland/Stoffer motion on showing child impacts.
As promised during the Social Security Implementation committee debate on 29 June, I will examine whether adjusting the indexation method is possible and desirable.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Commissiedebat Uitvoering Sociale Zekerheid op datum 29 juni jl. zal ik kijken of aanpassing van de wijze van indexeren mogelijk en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de verplichte arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor ZZP’ers

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked about the mandatory disability insurance for self-employed workers: how many self-employed people are on welfare due to long-term disability, expected early inflow, why the waiting period became one year, the opt-out for private coverage, and the size of the solidarity levy. Minister Van Gennip answered that welfare data on self-employed people are not registered and will be investigated with CBS, that early inflow is expected to be high, that a one-year waiting period balances personal responsibility with income protection, that an opt-out is being designed with equivalent coverage, and that the levy amount depends on pending research.
It is currently not known how many self-employed people are on welfare.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel zelfstandigen in de bijstand zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en De Kort over het artikel 'Stijging ziekteverzuim in 2022 naar 5,6%: hoogste ooit'

MPs Smals and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick-leave rising to 5.6% in 2022, its link to labour shortages, SME support, WIA/IVA inflows and cooperation with occupational physicians and UWV. The minister answered that the rise is mainly driven by COVID and flu rather than work, that prevention is primarily employers' responsibility supported by government schemes, and that the government is working on WIA backlogs and reintegration, without introducing structural changes to executive oversight.
This high sick-leave figure is worrying.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kathmann over een uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over het uitzendbeding

MPs Van der Lee and Kathmann asked the minister about the Supreme Court ruling on the temp-agency termination clause and its consequences, including repeated four-week contracts, misuse against holiday pay and pregnancy, and whether the ketenbepaling should apply to phase A. The minister explained the new cao rules, acknowledged some reports of misuse, but declined to extend the chain rule to phase A or change the four-week minimum, promising only an exploratory review of sick-leave termination.
Under the law there is no obligation whatsoever regarding the duration of such an agreement.
Op basis van de wet geldt geen enkele verplichting voor de duur van een dergelijke afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'UWV keerde miljoenen STAP-budget uit voor spookcursisten'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV paid millions in STAP training budget for courses that were never completed, and why no sanctions or repayments were enforced. The minister answered that participants are generally not pursued for repayment except in cases of evident fraud, that about a third of awards had proof of participation so far with 93% of those completed, and that no further communication change or enforcement step is planned.
Situations of evident fraud by participants have not yet been shown.
Situaties van evidente fraude door deelnemers zijn nog niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het vrijgeven van CBS-data met betrekking tot de doodsoorzakenregistratie tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asked the ministers why the CBS refuses to release the Dutch-language dictionary table used for automatic cause-of-death coding under the Woo, and whether it will publish it independently. The minister answers that the CBS has granted the request and provided the tables to the requester, that the tables are publicly obtainable, and that the Dutch dictionary is necessary for automatic coding while COVID-19 forms were coded manually.
The tables are obtainable by anyone.
De tabellen zijn voor eenieder opvraagbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Turkse Nederlanders mogen opnieuw in Amsterdam stemmen, extra aandacht voor veiligheid’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports that Turkish voters in Amsterdam could vote again amid safety concerns, including who organised the polling locations, the role of Turkish and Dutch authorities, campaign rules and possible foreign interference. The government answered that foreign states organise their own elections with local authorities advising on safety, that Turkish consulates submitted security plans, that campaigning by foreign officials is restricted, and that it would not commit to changing how voting is organised.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was informed in a timely and complete manner, both in writing and orally, by the Turkish embassy about how the voting process for the 2023 Turkish presidential and parliamentary elections would be organised in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is tijdig en volledig, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling, door de Turkse ambassade op de hoogte gebracht van de wijze waarop het stemproces voor de Turkse presidentiële en parlementaire verkiezingen van 2023 in Nederland wordt georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over deelname aan het arbeidsproces wordt in sommige gevallen moeilijk gemaakt voor gepensioneerden c.q. AOW-gerechtigden

An MP asks whether working should pay for pensioners who want to keep working and whether the five-year administrative expiry rule for chained temporary contracts should be relaxed for them. The minister says work should pay, that information campaigns will start, that a structural fix is being sought for a benefit overlap affecting breadwinners rather than pensioners, and that no separate exemption or further study is planned beyond the existing SEO evaluation.
The cabinet believes that work must pay, including for AOW recipients.
Het kabinet vindt dat werken moet lonen, zo ook voor AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Als tweederangsburgers opgehokt: in één jaar vijf arbeidsmigranten vermoord door huisgenoten'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an RTL Nieuws report on five deadly violent incidents among migrant workers in one year, and about data, trends and protections for migrant workers. The minister said the police and judiciary cannot register victims or suspects by migrant-worker status, declined to confirm the trend, and pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap, reporting points and ongoing measures.
The police have indicated that they cannot retrieve from their systems the number of fatal victims of violent incidents, or the number or type of violent incidents, among migrant workers.
De politie heeft aangegeven dat zij het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers na geweldsincidenten, of het aantal of soort geweldsincidenten, tussen arbeidsmigranten niet uit de politiesystemen kan halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het NRC-artikel 'Een op negen flitsbezorgers van Getir betrokken bij een verkeersongeluk’

MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about NRC reporting that one in nine Getir flash couriers was involved in a traffic accident, and about Labour Inspectorate checks and traffic safety measures for flash delivery. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, noted the inspectorate's 12 May 2023 checks with dozens of violations under further investigation, pointed to earlier enforcement and a planned ban for under-16s, and said SWOV research on road risks is still ongoing.
About companies that were or were not part of this check, and about any specific findings, the Labour Inspectorate makes no statements at this stage.
Over bedrijven die al dan niet onderdeel waren van deze controle, alsmede over eventuele specifieke bevindingen, doet de Arbeidsinspectie in dit stadium geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het recht op de arbeidskorting van mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering

An MP asks whether the government will follow a court ruling that the labour tax credit (arbeidskorting) should apply to disability benefits paid via employers, questions the size and justification of the difference, and asks for worked examples and historical figures. The Secretary of State answers that the government has appealed the ruling to the Supreme Court, provides calculations showing the net income gap, defends the policy aims in general terms, and says a cabinet response will follow in summer.
I have appealed against this ruling to the Supreme Court.
Tegen deze uitspraak ben ik in cassatie gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met verkeerd geloof aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafistis

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the salafist 'self-appointed police' in mosques and whether intelligence and counterterrorism gaps, imam recruitment from abroad, and information-sharing need tightening. The government answered at length: it says the NCTV lacks a legal basis to process personal data from social media, the bill on casus consultations is needed, soft signals cannot be shared with foreign countries under current law, and it is working on an imam training route and transparency rules, while declining a single legal definition of problematic behaviour.
The NCTV currently has no legal basis for processing personal data and therefore cannot consult social media sources, resulting in a more limited view.
De NCTV heeft op dit moment geen grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens, en kan derhalve geen sociale media-bronnen raadplegen en heeft dus ook beperkter zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Twee jaar wachttijd maakt 'verplichte AOV' uitvoerbaar en betaalbaar'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a self-organised cooperative of freelancers (SharePeople) shows that self-employed people can insure long-term disability without an insurer, and whether the minister will revisit her opposition to motion Van Houwelingen. The minister acknowledges private initiatives and says they can serve as an opt-out vehicle only if they match the public insurance premium and coverage, but argues non-insurers cannot reliably meet such long-term obligations, so she maintains her advice against the motion.
Therefore I consider it unlikely that a non-insurer can sufficiently reliably meet such long-term obligations.
Daardoor acht ik het onwaarschijnlijk dat een niet-verzekeraar dergelijke langjarige verplichtingen voldoende zeker kan nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de totstandkoming van de Kamerbrief 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs'

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked how the government letter 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs' on supervision of informal education was prepared, including ministry objections, the role of the Inspectorate, the complaint reporting point and a criminal complaint by Islamic organisations. The ministers answered that advice from officials was considered, that the Landsadvocaat's advice was sought, that the Inspectorate will do signal-based oversight, and that the reporting point operates with privacy safeguards, while noting that the Inspectorate still has concerns and that the Public Prosecutor saw no grounds for investigation.
The Minister for Primary and Secondary Education will take the Inspectorate's persistent concerns into account in further elaborating the bill.
De Minister voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs neemt de aanhoudende zorgen van de inspectie in de verdere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een waardevast minimumloon

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the development of the statutory minimum wage relative to inflation, international comparisons, and whether indexation should be changed to include a CPI floor. The Minister answers with data, says the evaluation and cabinet response on adequacy come in autumn, and rejects changing the indexation method, arguing it would raise public spending and risk job losses.
I will then send the evaluation to the House together with a cabinet response.
Ik zal de evaluatie dan samen met een reactie van het kabinet aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over uitsluitingsgronden van de vrijwillige arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor zelfstandigen

An MP asked whether insurers' health questionnaires for self-employed people's voluntary disability insurance unfairly exclude people who have seen a psychologist, and what the government will do about it. The minister said such a visit alone normally does not lead to exclusion, that insurers assess risk individually under professional and anti-discrimination rules, and that a planned mandatory disability insurance for self-employed people is intended to resolve the problem.
In general, the mere fact that someone has visited a psychologist will not lead to a medical exclusion or rejection of the insurance application.
In het algemeen geldt dat het enkele feit dat iemand een bezoek aan een psycholoog heeft gebracht, niet zal leiden tot een medische uitsluiting of afwijzing van de verzekeringsaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘UWV en ministerie van Sociale Zaken kwakzalven door met STAP-regeling’

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether the government and UWV had filtered pseudoscientific courses out of the STAP training subsidy scheme and whether the scheme should be refocused on shortage sectors. The ministers answered that filtering measures have been tightened and thousands of courses removed, that STAP funding is being ended from 2024, and that lessons will inform a future lifelong-learning approach to be reported around summer.
The cabinet will inform the House around the summer about the LLO future exploration, involving the Ministries of SZW, OCW and EZK.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer rond de zomer informeren over de toekomstverkenning LLO, waar de Ministeries van SZW, OCW en EZK bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘Aanzienlijk onbenut arbeidspotentieel onder gepensioneerden’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an ESB report on unused labour potential among retirees, including barriers for employers and flexibility in contracts. The minister answered that existing instruments already allow flexible retirement timing, that awareness campaigns will be launched, and that the zero-hours contract ban and basiscontract proposal will be monitored in consultation without new exemptions for older workers.
Given the information already known, I see no need for further research.
Gezien de reeds bekende informatie, zie ik geen noodzaak voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht 'UWV: geen zzp-verzekering voordat achterstanden zijn weggewerkt'

An MP asked whether an opt-out from the public UWV disability insurance for self-employed workers would reduce the burden on UWV, which faces capacity bottlenecks, and how the process could be made workable. The minister answered that an opt-out is meant to offer choice and tailored cover rather than to reduce UWV workload, that private insurers would assess disability, and that the government is consulting insurers and UWV and will publish a bill for consultation in summer 2023 that addresses ensuring equivalent cover and premium.
For insured persons who have chosen an opt-out, the relevant private insurer will be responsible for determining (the degree of) incapacity for work.
Voor verzekerden die hebben gekozen voor een opt-out zal de desbetreffende private verzekeraar verantwoordelijk zijn voor het vaststellen (van de mate) van arbeidsongeschiktheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over sociale verzekeringspremies in de binnenvaart

An MP asked how the SVB and Tax Authority decide whether Dutch social insurance premiums apply to inland shipping crew, and whether premiums paid elsewhere matter, plus questions on appeal rights and the 25% working-time test. The government explained the Rhine boatmen agreement and EU coordination rules, said appeals are possible against these decisions, and noted that a relief scheme and collection pause exist for affected crew.
Against both types of determinations, the possibility of objection and appeal is open.
Tegen beide soorten vaststellingen staat de mogelijkheid van bezwaar en beroep open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een toekomstige huisvestingslocatie voor arbeidsmigranten in Andel

An SP MP asked why a permit for housing 274 migrant workers in Andel proceeded despite over 900 objections, and whether local democracy and trust in politics are harmed. The minister replied that the permit is a municipal decision with no legal grounds for refusal, that the municipality added conditions and an impact analysis in response to objections, and that national support tools (a business-effect report, VNG programme) are being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over lonen en winsten

Opposition MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether wages will keep pace with profits, and whether profit-driven inflation is occurring in the Netherlands and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that wage-setting is primarily for employers and employees, that wages are now rising substantially, and that the government will review the cost-of-living and tax picture in August while the ACM monitors market competition.
Setting wages is in the first instance a matter for employers and employees.
Het vaststellen van lonen is in eerste instantie aan werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder het niveau van een bijstandsuitkering omdat de regelingen niet op elkaar aansluiten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about thousands of households living below the social assistance level because income schemes do not align, asking for structural fixes, the effects of the double general tax credit reduction, and compensation options. The ministers answered that a structural solution is urgently needed, that options are being explored with a report due before June 2023, and that the answers include detailed budget and income calculations for example households.
As promised in the letter of 29 March, we will inform the House before June 2023 about progress in searching for solution directions.
Zoals toegezegd in de brief van 29 maart 1 zullen wij de Kamer vóór juni 2023 informeren over de vorderingen van het zoeken naar oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over loondemping bij toename van het aantal vrouwen in beroepsgroepen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about wage depression in female-dominated occupations, including the Sullerot effect and a reported 7.7% starting-pay gap for female judges and prosecutors. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to the EU pay transparency directive and an upcoming report on labour-market discrimination, and said further research on wage depression is being explored without committing to specific new measures.
I am working on a swift implementation of this into Dutch laws and regulations.
Ik werk aan een spoedige implementatie hiervan in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over pesten op het werk naar aanleiding van de Nationale Enquête Arbeidsomstandigheden 2022

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about workplace bullying after the 2022 National Working Conditions Survey found 5% of workers affected, including its scale compared with Europe, employer sanctions, measures taken since 2015, and financial costs. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to RI&E obligations, inspection, tools, the Kenniskring and a proposed mandatory confidential counsellor law, and gave a non-evasive but largely policy-restating account with no new legal powers.
I will again bring these tools and aids to attention by sharing them with the social partners and via social media.
De komende tijd ga ik deze tools en hulpmiddelen opnieuw onder de aandacht brengen door ze te delen met de sociale partners en via sociale media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel 'Brancheorganisatie BMK wil prijsplafond voor kinderopvang in 2025'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a proposed price cap on childcare, the risk that prices rise above the reimbursed amount, costs, and alternatives to keep childcare affordable. The minister acknowledges risks to accessibility and market concentration, says tariff regulation will be explored and its costs and variants examined, and mentions a price monitor as an interim step.
That is why I announced in the progress report on the childcare financing reform that I will further explore tariff regulation.
Daarom heb ik in de Voortgangsrapportage herziening financieringsstelsel kinderopvang aangekondigd tariefregulering verder te gaan verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht "Bedrijf komt vaker uit bij zzp’er; In twee jaar tijd kwamen er in ons land bijna een miljoen nieuwe banen bij”

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rise of freelancers (zzp'ers) as employers hire them amid a tight labour market, including effects on temporary workers, young people and the balance with employees. The minister answered that the tight market drives hiring of freelancers, that some may be disguised self-employed, and that the government is working on a labour market package and measures to balance employee and self-employed contracts.
An important aim of the package of measures to reform the labour market is therefore to create a more level playing field between freelancers and employees.
Een belangrijke inzet van het pakket maatregelen om de arbeidsmarkt te hervormen is daarom het zorgen voor een gelijker speelveld tussen zzp'ers en werkenden in loondienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij 'De komst van Marokkaanse staatsimams naar Nederland'

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked whether the Moroccan state-funded Fondation Hassan II sends state imams to the Netherlands, what messages they spread, whether the government was informed in advance, and whether entry could be refused. The government answered that the imams provide religious support to the Moroccan diaspora during Ramadan within permitted diaspora policy and freedom of religion, that visas are assessed individually, that there is no current reason to refuse them, and that it will report on the revamped Taskforce later.
There is currently no reason to take action or to refuse the visa applications of the imams.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om op te treden of de visumaanvraag van de imams te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kwaliteit kinderopvang Caribisch Nederland moet omhoog, zegt Onderwijsinspectie'

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the minister about the Education Inspectorate's finding that childcare quality in the Caribbean Netherlands must improve, the sanctions imposed, how the findings feed into the pending childcare bill, and whether expanding capacity risks quality. The minister fully endorses the inspectorate's findings, explains the historical causes and the ongoing improvement programme, states that enforcement lies with the island authorities and no sanctions were needed so far, and says the bill will not be changed but will consult island authorities on a 'strict at the gate' approach.
If it is clear in advance that a childcare organisation cannot meet these requirements, it is undesirable to admit the organisation to the childcare system.
Als op voorhand duidelijk is dat een kinderopvangorganisatie niet in staat is om aan deze eisen te voldoen dan is het onwenselijk om de organisatie toe te laten tot het kinderopvangstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de indexatie van de kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the indexation of the childcare allowance, including the extra increase for 2023, its effect on households, the use of MEV versus CEP figures, and whether the indexation system should be changed. The Minister explained the additional 1.74% indexation, gave household examples, said she will evaluate the indexation system next year, and announced a smaller 2024 indexation to fund policy measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over het artikel 'Arbeidsinspectie: Veel ongelukken bij installatie zonnepanelen'

MP Strolenberg asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that many accidents, some fatal, occur during solar panel installation, asking about causes, unfair competition, sanctions and sector consultation. The minister agreed attention to safety is needed, attributed causes to a young sector with small subcontractors, said sanctions such as work stoppage are sufficient, and reported ongoing talks with the sector.
I consider the current sanctions far-reaching enough.
Ik vind de huidige sancties verstrekkend genoeg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Cowboy op dak levensgevaarlijk'; Populariteit zonnepanelen heeft keerzijde’

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of fatal and serious accidents among solar panel installers and about labour inspection of this sector. The minister acknowledged the violations found in a recent inspection of 200 construction sites, stressed that employers bear primary responsibility, and described inspection and sector measures without committing to new concrete steps.
Employers are primarily responsible for improving the safety of employees.
De werkgevers zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren van de veiligheid van de werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Strolenberg en Inge van Dijk over initiatieven van sportduikers

MPs Strolenberg and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would act so that volunteer sports divers searching for missing persons are no longer treated as occupational diving under the Working Conditions Act, after a court upheld a fine against Signi Zoekhonden. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the outcome is uncertain, points to a project group advising by autumn 2023, and outlines a possible timeline for amending regulations or introducing a transitional arrangement.
I will examine, within the Working Conditions Act and regulations and their objectives, whether and if so which amendments to the statutory provisions are possible and necessary.
Ik zal bezien binnen de Arbowet en -regelgeving en de doelstellingen daarvan of en zo ja welke aanpassingen in de wettelijke voorschriften mogelijk en nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de zorgelijke situatie omtrent de inzet van stagiairs en onervaren personeel bij de afhandeling op Schiphol

An MP asked ministers about the use of interns and inexperienced staff in Schiphol ground handling amid staff shortages and whether this threatens flight safety, pay levels and whether government can intervene. The minister answered that inexperienced staff must be properly supervised, that flight safety remains adequate per the ILT, and that wage disputes and the handling sector are for employers and unions, with government having limited options and monitoring talks.
It is up to employers and employees to jointly make agreements on terms of employment and working conditions.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om gezamenlijk afspraken te maken over arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van Campen en Sahla over het bericht “Veel vraag naar kinderopvang bij boer, maar regels belemmeren uitbreiding”

MPs Van den Hil, Van Campen and Sahla asked about reports that rules hinder agricultural childcare on farms, and about the obstacles raised by sector bodies, municipal zoning tied to farm turnover, staffing, health effects and next steps. The ministers answered that a 'Life event' regulatory review with VNG, LTO and the Chamber of Commerce is underway, that the Multifunctional Agriculture and Spatial Planning guidance is being updated, and that they see no evidence that agricultural childcare is disadvantaged on quality or staffing.
We are in discussion with the parties involved about the obstacles that have been raised.
Met de betrokken partijen zijn we in gesprek over de belemmeringen die zijn aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the government about calls to female genital mutilation in a religious setting, whether such statements incite violence, which legal or administrative tools exist, and how girls at risk abroad are protected. The government answered that incitement to violence is criminal regardless of context, that statements not amounting to crime cannot be countered administratively, and it outlined prevention measures, airport alertness indicators, and a planned bill on informal education.

Statements about female genital mutilation that do not constitute a criminal offence are protected by freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution and Article 10 of the European Convention on Human Rights.

Uitlatingen over vrouwelijke genitale verminking die geen strafbaar feit opleveren, worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting, hetgeen is vervat in artikel 7 van de Grondwet en artikel 10 van het Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over ‘Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden’

An MP asked why STAP training subsidies exclude jobs in shortage sectors such as boa and childcare, and raised concerns about dubious courses, pricing and the scope of the scheme. The minister answered that employers are responsible for mandatory training, promised to explore compensation options before summer, and described stricter measures and ongoing investigations by the Toetsingskamer.
The cabinet is exploring whether and how we can address this within the STAP scheme.
Het kabinet verkent of en zo ja hoe wij hieraan binnen de STAP-regeling tegemoet willen en kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een nieuwe ronde van het STAP-budget

An SP MP asked the ministers about a technical failure during the February 2023 STAP training-budget application round, about low-value courses (such as alternative-medicine and crypto courses) still listed on the scheme and promoted by influencers, and whether STAP is still the right instrument. The ministers acknowledged the outage and said the scheme is being tightened, that the Toetsingskamer STAP removed over 5,000 courses, and that the government stands by the STAP approach while promising a letter before summer.
During the past application periods the Toetsingskamer STAP investigated and, as a result, removed more than 5,000 courses from the offer, partly voluntarily and partly through exclusion decisions.
Tijdens de afgelopen tijdvakken heeft de Toetsingskamer STAP onderzoek gedaan en naar aanleiding daarvan meer dan 5.000 opleidingen uit het aanbod verwijderd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Smals over het bericht 'Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Smals asked why training to become a buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaar (boa) is excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme and whether this deters future boas. The ministers answered that the training is the employer's responsibility, that the government is exploring whether zij-instromers could be funded under STAP, and that recruitment and retention are the job of employers and municipalities.
The cabinet understands that funding boa training with STAP budget could add value for lateral entrants and is willing to examine this further.
Het kabinet begrijpt dat financiering van boa-opleidingen met STAP-budget voor zij-instromers een meerwaarde kan zijn en is bereid dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht 'Medewerkers op Schiphol krijgen deze zomer 840 euro per maand extra'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland (CDA) asked about reports that Schiphol staff would receive extra pay via a summer bonus and an allowance rather than a raised collective wage, and about how these payments affect net income, benefit entitlements and repayment risk. The government gave a detailed answer with example calculations showing high marginal tax burdens for some groups, and said it was in contact with Schiphol and the unions, with no new binding commitment beyond existing ones.
I have asked Schiphol whether it is aware of this.
Ik heb Schiphol gevraagd of hier oog voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Internationals massaal uitgebuit in Groninger horeca: 'We geven je al eten, wil je ook nog geld?''

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of exploitation of international students in Groningen hospitality, and what steps have been taken to protect them. The minister condemns the abuses, says the Labour Inspectorate has received no matching reports and needs concrete leads, and lists existing information, enforcement and municipal measures.
The Labour Inspectorate calls on anyone with concrete leads on the described labour abuses to report them to the Labour Inspectorate.
De Arbeidsinspectie roept een ieder die weet heeft van concrete aangrijpingspunten bij de beschreven arbeidsmisstanden, deze te melden bij de Arbeidsinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over eenverdieners en middeninkomens

An MP asks the Social Affairs and Finance ministers about single-earner households with middle incomes ending up with less net income than benefit recipients, and about the tax burden and purchasing-power support for them. The government acknowledges the problem, points to ongoing reviews of tax reliefs and the childcare and benefit reforms, and says it will return with a fuller letter on the single-earner benefit-interaction issue and results of its evaluations.
It is not good that in the seven years this problem has been known, no solution has been reached.
Het is niet goed dat er in de zeven jaar dat deze problematiek bekend is, niet tot een oplossing is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Wetgeving stratenmakers structureel overtreden: ‘Pakkans klein’’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that road-paving workers routinely violate rules requiring machine use over manual labour, and what the Labour Inspectorate does about it. The minister acknowledged the health risks, explained the employer's duty to mechanise where possible, described risk-based inspection priorities, and said the Inspectorate will study why physical strain persists, but did not provide inspection or violation counts.
Even though the Working Conditions Act requires machines to be used as much as possible and these machines are also available.
Dit terwijl op grond van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet zo veel als mogelijk machines gebruikt moeten worden en deze machines ook beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ontslaggolf bij PostNL

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Social Affairs about job cuts at PostNL, whether postal workers could be deployed as neighbourhood eyes to avert dismissals, and whether a loneliness-detection pilot like Rotterdam's could be launched elsewhere. The minister answered that the reorganisation does not affect parcel and post delivery staff, that PostNL is offering permanent contracts to postal workers, that UWV provides support for the unemployed, and that a PostNL loneliness-signalling pilot is expanding, while declining to impose such duties on companies.
It is not obvious that the government should impose an obligation on companies here: it is up to PostNL to weigh whether and how people are deployed.
Het ligt niet voor de hand hier vanuit de overheid een verplichting op te leggen aan bedrijven: het is aan PostNL om af te wegen of en hoe mensen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over een fatsoenlijk loon voor werknemers van sociale werkbedrijven

An MP asked the minister whether sheltered-workshop (SW) employees should be compensated for rising prices and why their pay lags behind other civil servants under the new municipal collective agreement. The minister answered that wage matters are primarily for municipalities, social workshops and unions, pointed to general cost-of-living measures, said the state is not party to the cao, and promised further talks with VNG and Cedris before informing the House.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de financiële situatie van gezinnen

An MP asked the ministers about child poverty and family financial support, citing Dutch rankings on family benefits and the rise in cost of living. The ministers answered that child poverty fell from 10.2% in 2013 to 6.8% in 2022, that the child benefit was substantially raised, that the government is committed to halving child poverty, and that a Commission on the social minimum and a study of family policy abroad are underway.
The cabinet remains firmly committed to achieving the target of halving child poverty.
Het kabinet blijft onverminderd gemotiveerd om de doelstelling om kinderarmoede te halveren te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen voor het huisvesten van arbeidsmigranten bij het dorp Riel

An SP MP asked the minister whether the plan to house 366 migrant workers next to the village of Riel, with 2,900 residents, was handled properly and whether it is excessive. The minister answered that the municipality of Tilburg must weigh local interests, that the neighbouring municipality of Goirle objects and a court case is likely, and that the government supports municipalities and is working on Roemer advice measures.
I am of the view that this is a consideration the municipality concerned must make.
Ik ben van mening dat dit een afweging is die de desbetreffende gemeente moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het in Nederland oprichten van zogenaamde Fatwa-units

An MP asked whether the Turkish government, via Diyanet and ISN, set up 'fatwa units' in the Netherlands, how they are financed, and what the government will do about foreign influence and vulnerable youth. The minister answered that ISN said it was unaware of such units, that the Dutch legal framework limits religious advice, and pointed to the pending transparency bill and the existing foreign-interference approach.
I am not aware whether this happens in an organised manner within the Islamic tradition in the Netherlands.
Het is mij niet bekend of dit binnen de islamitische traditie in Nederland in georganiseerd verband gebeurt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Becker over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met ‘verkeerd geloof’ aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafist

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Telegraaf report on self-appointed 'salafist police' intimidating mosques and imams, and about how the state can detect and act against salafist preachers. The government answered that intimidation is unacceptable and that the NCTV, police, municipalities and a taskforce have limited legal grounds, so some tools (data processing, Europol exchange, online removal) remain constrained, while promising legislation and a strategy on online radicalisation.

For the Taskforce on Problematic Behaviour and Undesirable Foreign Financing, and at the request of local authorities, the NCTV provided assessments of individual persons, including salafist preachers.

Ten behoeve van de Taskforce Problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering, alsmede op verzoek van lokale overheden, verstrekte de NCTV duidingen over individuele personen, ook over salafistische aanjagers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Strolenberg over het bericht dat honderden bagagemedewerkers zich melden voor een claimzaak tegen Schiphol en dat ook de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie ingrijpt

Two VVD MPs asked why Schiphol is not automating baggage handling sooner after the Labour Inspectorate found excessive physical strain and Arbo violations, and whether the minister would press Schiphol on timelines, lifting aids, worker surveys and international comparison. The minister answered that the inspectorate set binding deadlines of two years for automation and immediate use of aids, that Schiphol plans a new baggage cellar from 2026, and that the minister will raise timelines at the regular overleg with Schiphol and a bestuurlijk overleg in April, with an international comparison to follow after an outsourced study due before summer.
The Labour Inspectorate imposed these definitive requirements on the baggage handlers at Schiphol on 14 March.
Deze definitieve eisen heeft de Arbeidsinspectie op 14 maart jl. aan de bagage afhandelaars op Schiphol opgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.

Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Omtzigt over de LSI-verslagen, de uitspraak van het Europese Hof d.d. 12 januari 2023 over informatie over het verstrekken van data over persoonsgegevens, alsmede de uitspraak van de Raad va

An MP asks the government about GDPR access rights to recipients of personal data (CJEU ruling), whether a 'code 88' fraud-list marking is personal data, and whether individuals may access the reasons for fraud investigations (Council of State ruling), plus questions on LSI intervention-team records, risk lists, home-entry consent and related documents. The government largely answers that access rights are subject to limits and that code 88 becomes personal data only within a dataset, gives limited information where records no longer exist, and commits to a FSV letter and an LSI evaluation.
For that reason, the information provided to the data subject must be as precise as possible.
Daarom dient de verstrekte informatie aan de betrokkene zo nauwkeurig mogelijk te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de Uitvoeringsagenda Internationale Sociale Voorwaarden (ISV)

An MP asked why the government's International Social Conditions (ISV) implementation agenda lacks measurable targets, timelines and responsible departments for procurement, and whether it will impose stronger obligations. The minister answered that research on targets, sector scope and award criteria is underway with completion targeted for Q4 2023, and that the approach mixes support measures with an examination of mandatory use.
The aim is to complete this research in Q4 2023.
Het streven is dit onderzoek in Q4 2023 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de arbeidsomstandigheden van flitsbezorging

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions of quick-delivery couriers: sick-pay pressure, workload, low pay and demands from a petition. The minister says employers must keep work safe and fair, the Labour Inspectorate has acted on violations, and talks between unions and companies are ongoing, while no new minimum-wage increase is planned.
If quick-delivery workers have to keep working under unfair, unhealthy and/or unsafe conditions despite the talks, I call on them to report this to the Labour Inspectorate.
Indien flitsbezorgers ondanks de gesprekken onder oneerlijke, ongezonde en/of onveilige omstandigheden moeten blijven werken, roep ik hen op dit te melden bij de Arbeidsinspectie.
Antwoord op van het lid Palland over de berichten ‘Maak regels arbeidsmigratie snel strenger’ en ‘Duitse burgemeesters niet blij met arbeidsmigranten’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about reports that staffing agencies house Dutch-employed migrant workers across the German border and about German mayors' complaints, with eleven questions on scale, cooperation, housing rules and tighter policy. The minister answered that no precise data exist, pointed to ongoing Dutch-German cooperation and joint inspections, described progress on housing measures, and said a business impact assessment and a demographic commission are in preparation.
Precise figures on the number of migrant workers and which staffing agencies operate across the border do not exist.
Precieze cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten en welke uitzendbureaus grensoverschrijdend werken zijn er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht “Vrijwilligers in de knel door regels fiscus voor vergoeding: ‘Gedwongen om te stoppen’”

An MP asks the ministers about volunteers on benefits or allowances who must repay volunteer reimbursements above the tax-free threshold, calling the rules unclear and unfair and asking for clearer rules and support. The ministers acknowledge the communication problems, promise to work with the LCR and other ministries on clearer information, and explain the rules as an administrative-burden measure, but offer no change to the rules themselves.
The cabinet would like to work with the LCR to look at options to clarify, in particular, the communication about the rules.
Het kabinet wil graag samen met de LCR kijken naar mogelijkheden om met name de communicatie rond de regels te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Kennis in kinderopvang over wat te doen na misbruik en mishandeling schiet tekort’

An MP asked the minister how the sector and the Inspectorate can raise awareness of the duty to report, consult and report to police (MOA) in childcare, including among trainees and volunteers, and whether training covers abuse situations. The minister answered that an inspectorate flyer was distributed, GGD and sector cooperation is being strengthened, and targeted information for specific groups will be produced this year.
I will therefore have these produced and distributed this year.
Ik ga deze dan ook dit jaar laten maken en verspreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Smals, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sahla over het bericht ‘Werkgevers niet happig om mensen meer in te zetten, ondanks personeelstekort’

Four MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Long-Term Care about a news report that employers are reluctant to offer more hours despite staff shortages, and about measures to reduce involuntary part-time work. The government answered that it urges employers to talk with staff, points to the Flexible Working Act while saying it cannot oblige employers to offer full-time contracts, and describes ongoing studies and pilots on a multi-hours bonus and combination jobs.
The cabinet cannot, however, oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts or more working hours when employees ask for them, and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten of meer uren werk aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kathmann over de inkomenseffecten van het afschaffen van de IACK

MPs Maatoug and Kathmann asked what income effects abolishing the IACK has for parents, including new cohorts born from 2025 who lose the credit, and whether the government will compensate those with lower incomes. The minister answers that new cohorts face a negative effect (median about EUR 2,500 per year for single parents and EUR 2,400 for dual-earner couples in a simulation for 2023), that combined with minimum wage and childcare increases a net negative remains, and that there are no concrete plans to compensate, though income policy is reviewed annually.
At present there are no concrete plans to compensate this effect.
Op dit moment zijn er geen concrete plannen om dit effect te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Podt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie kreeg toch signalen over zwaar sjouwwerk Schiphol'

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate ignored several worker complaints about heavy physical work at Schiphol baggage handling, why its self-regulation approach and the handling of signals were not adequate, and what will be done so the Chamber receives correct information. The Minister acknowledged that seven complaints related to physical strain were judged not relevant, that the inspectorate is reviewing its approach, will give heavier weight to airside work, and will improve its complaint registration and transparency, reporting back in the 2024 annual plan.

At my request, the Labour Inspectorate is reviewing its working method and I will enter into further discussion with the Inspectorate on how the method can be further improved and made more transparent.
Op mijn verzoek houdt de Arbeidsinspectie haar werkwijze tegen het licht en ga ik met de Arbeidsinspectie nader in gesprek over hoe de werkwijze verder verbeterd en transparanter kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "Hoe een handvol slechtbetaalde flexwerkers een miljardenconcern op de knieën dwong"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on Mediahuis depot workers winning a court case establishing employment rather than false self-employment, and about which sectors have underpaid workers in sham self-employment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, said identifying sham self-employment requires individual investigation, pointed to pilot data and a SEO study flagging certain sectors as higher risk, and promised intensified enforcement, legal clarity and an accessible legal route for workers by summer 2023.
The cabinet intends to restore the balance and make the rules on working as a self-employed person and with self-employed persons more future-proof.
Het kabinet is van plan om de balans te herstellen en regels rondom het werken als zelfstandige en met zelfstandigen toekomstbestendiger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Westerveld over het STAP-budget

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about training-subsidy (STAP) budget being captured by course providers through price rises and marketing, and whether the budget should target labour shortages in energy, education and care. The government acknowledges misuse signals, promises price checks, a cap on subsidies per course, a gift/affiliate marketing review, and a study of prioritising shortage sectors, while declining to commit to specific price agreements or a fixed budget split.
Your House will be informed early next year about the outcome and the further approach to this.
Uw Kamer wordt begin volgend jaar geïnformeerd over uitkomst en de verdere aanpak hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de berichten ‘Studenten met STAP-budget niet tevreden over commerciële opleiders’ en ‘Stapbudget maakt meerjarige studie vaak juist duurder dan voorheen.’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that STAP-budget students are dissatisfied with commercial providers, that multi-year courses are not well covered and became more expensive, and about the lottery-like allocation of the budget. The ministers answered that quality safeguards are being tightened, that multi-year funding for follow-on years will be introduced around July 2023, that a transitional arrangement for students affected by the tax-deduction switch is being considered, and that the application process will be reviewed.
The cabinet considers it necessary that citizens must be able to trust the suitability and quality of the training offered through the STAP budget.
Het kabinet acht het noodzakelijk dat burgers moeten kunnen vertrouwen op de geschiktheid en de kwaliteit van de opleidingen die worden aangeboden middels het STAP-budget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Hoe jouw pakketje leidt tot onrust in het Brabantse dorpje Riel'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about local unrest in Riel over housing for hundreds of migrant workers, whether employment agencies were consulted, what action is taken, and data on migrant workers and homelessness. The minister acknowledges the tension, refers housing decisions to municipalities, promises an effect-assessment follow-up and a monitoring system, but says many figures are unavailable and does not commit to restricting EU labour mobility.
Moreover, the BRP registers only residents and non-residents (and therefore no separate category of migrant workers).
Bovendien worden in de BRP alleen ingezetenen en niet-ingezetenen geregistreerd (en dus geen speciale categorie arbeidsmigranten).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over het bericht dat er een burn-outgolf dreigt als gevolg van de arbeidsmarktkrapte

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a looming burn-out wave caused by tight labour markets, including prevention, employer risk assessments, after-hours reachability and inspection enforcement. The Minister answered that burn-out rates rose from 12% to 17% and pointed to existing programmes (BMS, RI&E programme, subsidy scheme), inspection figures showing enforcement at 22% and 16% of first inspections, and agreed to answer before the plenary debate on the reachability bill.
I will inform the House shortly about the progress of the BMS.
Ik informeer uw Kamer binnenkort over de voortgang van de BMS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht 'UWV ontdekt Slowaakse fraude met ziekte-uitkeringen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported fraud with sickness benefits by Slovak workers, including staffing shortages at UWV, recovery of overpaid benefits abroad, and enforcement of benefit exports. The minister answered that there is no established link to doctor shortages, that about 94 benefits (over EUR 200,000) are being reviewed and recovered, that cooperation with partner agencies exists and a Fraud Council was set up, and that enforcement of exported benefits is being pursued at EU level.
UWV contacted the benefit recipients concerned to request additional information and summon them for examination by a doctor.
UWV heeft met de desbetreffende uitkeringsgerechtigden contact gezocht om aanvullende informatie op te vragen en ze op te roepen voor controle door een arts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over het artikel 'Tien jaar stilstand reden recordkrapte'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Poverty, Participation and Pensions about labour shortages and how to get people with a distance from the labour market or older workers into work, including the no-risk policy, employer support points, the labour market infrastructure, dismissal and sick-pay rules, and cao provisions. The ministers answered that the government is pursuing employer incentives, a pilot for a no-risk policy, a regional 'Werkcentrum' plan due by summer 2023, and further reports on flexible contracts and sick-pay reform, while declining to give some figures yet.
In recent years, since the jobs agreement, there has been a lot of attention to the importance of hiring people with a disability.
Er is de afgelopen jaren, sinds de banenafspraak, veel aandacht geweest voor het belang van het aannemen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht ‘Stap-subsidieregeling blijkt funest voor kleine opleiders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small training providers being excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme because they lack quality marks, some of which impose turnover thresholds. The minister acknowledged the problem, said talks with the sector are underway, and committed to informing parliament on a plan to steer STAP funds toward shortage sectors in early 2023.
In consultation with the training sector and industry organisations, we are examining how to make access to the training register easier for small providers.
In overleg met het opleidingsveld en brancheorganisaties wordt bekeken hoe we de toegang tot het scholingsregister voor de kleine opleiders kunnen vergemakkelijken
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Maatoug, Westerveld en Ellemeet over de inhuur van externe arbeid in publieke sectoren

MPs Maatoug, Westerveld and Ellemeet asked ministers about the use of external and flexible labour in the public and semi-public sectors, its effect on care quality and costs, and government steps to curb it. The government answered that it is pursuing measures to make employment under contract more attractive, tighten rules on self-employment and monitor agency and tariff arrangements, while stating it cannot provide sector-level data on many questions.
Apart from the figures below on external hiring within central government, education and care and welfare, no data are kept for (semi-)public sub-sectors.
Behalve onderstaande cijfers over inhuur van externe arbeid binnen de Rijksoverheid, het onderwijs en zorg en welzijn, worden geen data bijgehouden voor (semi)-publieke (deel)sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kinderopvang fors duurder in 2023, ouders betalen tot 40 procent meer'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports that childcare costs would rise sharply in 2023, covering the indexation of maximum hourly rates, tracking of tariff increases, causes of cost increases and steps to address supply shortages. The minister explained the indexation method, committed to a Q1 2023 report on tariff development from microdata, and announced an extra price compensation of 0.94 percentage points for 2023 due to exceptional 2022 inflation.
I will send your House a report in the first quarter of 2023 on tariff developments in the sector, based on Toeslagen microdata.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2023 een rapportage sturen met de tariefontwikkeling in de sector, op basis van de microdata van Toeslagen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla, Belhaj en Kuzu over het artikel 'Racisme duwt medewerkers uit de ouderenzorg'

MPs Sahla, Belhaj and Kuzu asked ministers about a NRC article saying racism pushes care workers out of elderly care, and about the scale of discrimination, its effect on health and sickness absence, and what government and care providers are doing. The ministers answered that discrimination is recognised but insufficiently addressed by employers, cited survey data, described existing Arbo duties and support tools, and announced a national study in 2023 and a progress letter in autumn 2023.
The Ministry of VWS intends to start a nationwide study in 2023 into discrimination and equal opportunities in care, welfare and sport.
Het Ministerie van VWS wil in 2023 een landelijk onderzoek starten naar discriminatie en gelijk kansen in de zorg, welzijn en sport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Boswijk over wachtlijsten bij agrarische kinderopvang vanwege starre regelgeving

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether rigid rules cause long waiting lists for farm-based childcare and whether those rules block growth of this multifunctional farming activity. The government agreed that farm childcare has benefits, said it is working with LTO and VNG on municipal permit barriers and an updated handreiking, and committed to further talks and checking whether linking permits to farm turnover is a problem, without conceding that rules currently make growth impossible.
At present, LNV, together with VNG and LTO, is working on a proposal to update the 2011 'Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening'.
Op dit moment wordt vanuit LNV samen met VNG en LTO aan een voorstel gewerkt om de «Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening» uit 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen Van den Hil en Van Campen over het artikel ‘Populaire kinderopvang bij de boer gehinderd door starre regels’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rules hinder agricultural childcare (kinderopvang bij de boer), including limits on the side branch, fine-particulate norms, procedures, and relaxed staffing rules. The ministers answered that they are in talks with LTO, VAK and VNG about local permitting obstacles, but gave no concrete list of rules or a coulance scheme.
Unfortunately it was not possible to send the answers before the committee debate, because coordination with the various parties took more time.
Het is helaas niet gelukt de antwoorden voor het commissiedebat te versturen, omdat de afstemming met de verschillende partijen meer tijd vergde.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het gevaar dat er een Nederlands filiaal van de Londense shariarechtbank Al-Haddad wordt geopend en Nederlanders naar het VK afreizen om daar shariarecht te laten spreken

An MP asked the government whether a Dutch branch of the London sharia court Al-Haddad should be prevented, how many Dutch Muslims use sharia arbitration abroad, and what concrete steps will protect vulnerable women and neighbourhoods. The minister called religious courts overriding Dutch law unacceptable, said the Public Prosecution Service can act and that existing law allows dissolving organisations threatening public order, but said no data exists on use of foreign sharia courts and gave no new concrete measures.
I have no authority or legal basis to investigate this at the level of individuals.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid of grondslag om hier, op persoonsniveau, onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het artikel '40-urige werkweek botst met onze cultuur'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the Dutch part-time work culture, whether full-time contracts should be standard in shortage sectors, and whether a full-time bonus should be pursued. The minister answered that part-time work has benefits but limits women's economic independence, that employers cannot be forced to offer full-time contracts, and that a full-time/extra-hours bonus is being explored first in care and education.
However, the cabinet cannot oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts to employees who ask for them and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van Baarle over moslimdiscriminatie

MPs Belhaj and Van Baarle asked about a study finding Muslim women wearing headscarves are rejected far more often in job applications in the Netherlands, and about measures against labour market discrimination, including meldplicht and sanctions. The minister acknowledges the findings, outlines ongoing research, the Wetsvoorstel toezicht gelijke kansen, an action plan, and says the meldplicht advice will be sent to parliament by year end.
I aim to share this amendment note with your House shortly (before the end of the year), so that the treatment of this bill can be continued.
Ik streef ernaar deze nota van wijziging op korte termijn (voor het einde van het jaar) met uw Kamer te delen, zodat de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vervolgd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel 'Minister: ‘Versoepelingen kinderopvang gelden pas in 2024’, personeelstekort groeit'

An MP asks why loosening of childcare staffing rules only takes effect in 2024 and what obstacles exist, and asks for quicker measures, a temporary coulance scheme and faster work on modular training. The minister replies that most changes need a formal amendment procedure so cannot start before 1 January 2024, though two changes may start on 1 July 2023, and that a coulance scheme is not possible under current law, offering instead an agreement on inspection leniency and promised letters to parliament.
For that reason, most of the adjustments cannot take effect before 1 January 2024.
Om die reden kunnen de meeste aanpassingen niet eerder ingaan dan per 1 januari 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over naheffingen bij schijnzelfstandigheid

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs whether bogus self-employed workers face back-payment claims for social contributions and tax, whether these are used as a threat to deter claims, and whether employers may pass such costs on to workers. The government answers that enforcement against employers is under a moratorium, that individuals may still face income-tax assessments, that it cannot give general assurances, and that it will reinforce enforcement and send a progress letter this year.
In the cabinet response to the ARK and ADR reports, it was promised that enforcement on the classification of employment relationships for payroll taxes will be recalibrated and strengthened.
In de kabinetsreactie op de rapporten van ARK en ADR 3 is toegezegd de handhaving op de kwalificatie van de arbeidsrelatie voor de loonheffingen te herijken en versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga  over personeelstekorten overheid

An MP asked the government about staff shortages at implementing agencies such as the Tax Administration, UWV and IND, including longer waiting times, causes such as budget cuts and added tasks, recruitment plans, and technology use. The ministers acknowledged service pressure, listed measures (contact tool, callbacks, higher starting salaries, the Werk aan Uitvoering programme with 600 million per year, a recruitment campaign) and said technology cannot fully replace human work.
The cabinet has endorsed the conclusions of the TCU report and the WaU report.
Het kabinet heeft de conclusies uit het TCU-rapport en het WaU rapport onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over 'berekeningen van het toetsingsinkomen voor de kinderopvangtoeslag'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the childcare allowance calculation, which uses the income-test base aligned with taxable income, unfairly disadvantages tenants compared with homeowners, and whether the rules could be revised or simplified. The minister defended aligning the test income with taxable income, said the government plans to replace the income-dependent childcare allowance with an income-independent system, and noted that housing status is not recorded.
Housing status is not a criterion on which Toeslagen pays the childcare allowance.
De woonsituatie is geen criterium op basis waarvan Toeslagen de kinderopvangtoeslag uitkeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het korten van de uitkering van mensen in het buitenland
