MP Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefit reductions for recipients abroad caused by Turkish banks charging transaction fees after the Target-2 transition, and whether UWV had investigated, informed people, or engaged banks. The minister answered that UWV updated its communication with a general warning that banks may charge fees, that bank conditions are the banks' responsibility, that UWV does not negotiate with specific banks, and that UWV does not investigate fees but informs beneficiaries.
It is up to the banks themselves to determine which fees they charge for a foreign transfer.
Het is aan banken zelf om te bepalen welke kosten zij rekenen voor een buitenlandse overboeking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op zwaar werk Schiphol’

MPs Chris Simons and Koerhuis asked why the Labour Inspectorate conducted no Arbo Act checks on baggage handling at Schiphol after 2010, despite reported occupational illness, and how this fits risk-based supervision. The minister said she was surprised and shocked, that the inspectorate chose not to inspect for lack of triggers, has started an investigation, and will report back on inspections at Schiphol.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichtgeving omtrent arbeidsomstandigheden bagageafhandelaars Schiphol

An ChristenUnie MP asked ministers about reports that Schiphol baggage handlers exceeded occupational exposure limits for years while the Labour Inspectorate did not inspect them for about twelve years, and about how self-regulation and self-inspection tools work. The minister responded that the employer bears primary responsibility, that the inspectorate tests sector codes but not individual firms, that inspections are being carried out after recent media reports with results pending, and that the inspectorate's capacity allocation and the evaluation of self-regulation will be reviewed.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Arbonormen bagagepersoneel Schiphol jarenlang overschreden, deel heeft gezondheidsklachten'

MPs Palland and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Infrastructure and Finance about reports that baggage handling staff at Schiphol worked beyond Arbo limits for years and that the Labour Inspectorate had not inspected these firms for twelve years. The government replied that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate has started investigations and will report further, and that sector CAO, access restrictions on handlers and talks with Schiphol and KLM are underway.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible. Parliament will be informed further on this.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Hierover wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en De Hoop over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden bij bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

MPs Alkaya and De Hoop asked ministers whether baggage staff at Schiphol had for years been required to lift beyond health limits despite a 2009 inspection demand, and what the government would do. The ministers answered that the employers are primarily responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has launched inspections and will report, and that Schiphol and the ministries are pressing for structural improvements including limiting the number of handlers, though no independent new investigation will be set up.
The Minister of SZW sees no reason to set up a new independent investigation on top of everything already underway.
De Minister van SZW ziet geen aanleiding om naast alles wat nu al loopt een nieuw onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over de berichten 'Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op Schiphol' en 'Schiphol geeft toe: we hadden te weinig oog voor arbeidsomstandigheden'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about press reports that the labour inspectorate did not inspect physical workload at Schiphol baggage handling for twelve years and that many workers became incapacitated. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate has started an investigation and will report on its past inspections at Schiphol, and it committed to talks with Schiphol and KLM and to a site visit in November.
Following the press reports, the Labour Inspectorate has meanwhile started an investigation into the situation of baggage staff at Schiphol.
De Arbeidsinspectie is, naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving, inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de situatie bij het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht dat er steeds meer tijdelijke contracten worden gegeven in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that temporary contracts in education are increasing and whether this undermines retention amid teacher shortages. The ministers answered that permanent work should be the norm, outlined measures such as tightening rules on temporary contracts and strategic HRM legislation, and provided university and hogeschool contract ratios for 2015-2021.
The cabinet's starting point is that structural work is in principle organised on the basis of permanent employment contracts.
Het uitgangspunt van het kabinet is dat structureel werk in principe wordt georganiseerd op basis van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Maatoug over de arbonormen van het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

GroenLinks MPs Kröger and Maatoug asked the ministers about occupational health standards for Schiphol baggage handlers, why the labour inspectorate had not inspected since 2009, and whether Schiphol and the handling firms should compensate workers. The ministers answered that the inspectorate has started an investigation, that employers bear primary responsibility, that Schiphol should take a larger role and is pursuing a social accord, and that compensation is a matter between workers and employers.
The Minister of SZW has asked the Labour Inspectorate to consider whether improvements are possible.
De Minister van SZW heeft de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Meedoen zonder beperkingen’ van de Nationale ombudsman

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the government to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on young people with disabilities and the Participation Act, including whether expectations of self-reliance are realistic and whether the law should be changed. Minister Schouten answered that a reply to the report will follow, cited measures such as the Breed Offensief bill, the planned raise of earnings thresholds and a 10% minimum wage increase, but rejected a structural system change for this group.
This cabinet's coalition agreement does not provide for a systemic change of the kind referred to in question 6.
In het Coalitieakkoord van dit kabinet is niet voorzien in een stelselverandering zoals bedoeld in vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Chris Simons over het bericht 'Tientallen Deventenaren trekken witte pakken aan om asbest te verwijderen: 'Dat sjouwen wordt nog zwaar''

MPs Haverkort and Chris Simons asked about a Deventer initiative in which residents helped remove asbestos, the scale of remaining asbestos on private, business and government roofs and buildings, the cost of government asbestos removal, and why a foam-based removal method had not been approved by the VIP. The State Secretary answered that such initiatives exist via Milieu Centraal's asbestos-free shed week, that complete inventories of asbestos in government buildings are not feasible or efficient, that cost data are unavailable, and that foam methods have been approved in several cases while applicants are encouraged to submit requests.
This is unfortunately not possible. Research to find this out would cost a lot of time and money due to the large number of clients
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk. Een onderzoek om dit te achterhalen zou veel tijd en geld kosten vanwege het grote aantal opdrachtgevers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de bijdrage van de stichting Femmes for Freedom aan  emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond

MP Palland asked the ministers whether the 2020 Peters motion on a lasting role for Femmes for Freedom in the theme of self-determination had been carried out, and what concrete arrangements had been made. The minister answers that the foundation is a durable partner for the government on inclusion and emancipation, lists its involvement in consultations, awareness material, a bill on marital captivity and a funded alliance, while noting other parties may also apply for subsidies.
The Foundation Femmes for Freedom is a durable discussion partner of the national government on issues of inclusion and emancipation of girls and women with a bicultural background.

De Stichting Femmes for Freedom is een duurzame gesprekspartner van de rijksoverheid waar het gaat om vraagstukken op het gebied van inclusie en emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht Opleidingsinstituten profiteren massaal van royale subsidieregeling

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Hagen (D66) asked whether training providers inflating course prices to exhaust the STAP training budget is acceptable, how providers can circumvent rules, why public institutions offer little STAP-funded training, and how supervision can be strengthened. Minister Van Gennip answered that price inflation is unacceptable, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors and sanctions providers (removal from the register, reclaiming subsidy, possible criminal investigation), that four providers received intent-to-remove notices, and that the regulation will be reviewed.
Improper price increases are highly undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Podt over het bericht ‘Friese mbo's verliezen deel van inburgeraars’

MPs Hagen and Podt asked why Friese Poort and Friesland College declined to tender for the B1 and Z integration routes, citing non-cost-covering fees, and what consequences this has for newcomers and for the government's funding of the education route. The minister replied that court rulings found the regional bandwidths reasonable, that a contract for both routes has been secured in Friesland, and that additional funding and a structural solution are being prepared.
In view of these rulings, I see no reason to take further measures.
Met het oog op deze uitspraken zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht ‘Nederland verdient het geld en wij zitten met de problemen, zegt de Duitse burgemeester’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that Dutch temp agencies profit from labour migration while German border towns bear the housing problems, including workers living in Germany and working in the Netherlands to evade inspections. The minister confirms awareness, describes joint German-Dutch inspections, planned data exchange, and housing impact assessments, but gives no figures on the number of workers or agencies involved.
Precise figures on the number of labour migrants and/or which temp agencies work across the border do not exist; such data is not registered.
Precieze cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten en/of welke uitzendbureaus die grensoverschrijdend werken zijn er niet, dergelijke gegevens worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de ‘Uber Files’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 'Uber Files', alleging Uber's aggressive lobbying on bogus self-employment law, its disregard for the law, its contacts with ministry officials, pressure on officials, and enforcement of court rulings on driver employment status. The minister replied that stakeholder contact is normal and Uber is subject to the same law, listed several dated meetings with Uber on platform work, noted the Belastingdienst cannot discuss individual cases due to tax secrecy, and promised a broader letter on the zzp/bogus self-employment approach in autumn.

Because of the confidentiality obligation under article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot provide information about the Tax Authority's supervision and enforcement regarding individual companies.

Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet Rijksbelastingen kan ik over het toezicht en de handhaving door de Belastingdienst bij individuele bedrijven geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het onbenut laten van Bibob-toetsing bij subsidieverlening

MPs Sneller and Michon-Derkzen asked why national ministries, notably RVO and Uitvoering van Beleid SZW, rarely apply the Bibob integrity test when granting subsidies. The minister answers that the test is discretionary, that ministries are in talks to increase its use, that RVO and UVB rely on other controls, and promises an update by the first quarter of 2023.
The Ministry of Justice and Security is engaging with various departments to stimulate the use of the Bibob Act within central government.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) gaat met verschillende departementen in gesprek om het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij de rijksoverheid te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het actiever werk maken van werkervaring voor statushouders tijdens de inburgering, ook in tekortsectoren

The VVD MP Becker asks whether municipalities offer too few work-experience placements to asylum-status holders during integration, especially in shortage sectors, and what obstacles exist. Minister Van Gennip responds that she will discuss the issue with the Taskforce Werk en Integratie and branch organisations, that dual trajectories are being monitored, that she has received no signals of municipal reluctance, and that municipal autonomy under the Wi2021 is deliberate.
I will soon enter into discussion with the Taskforce Werk en Integratie.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met de Taskforce Werk en Integratie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Bent u geen acteur, liegt u niet’ Esmee (32) is chronisch ziek, maar krijgt geen uitkering van het UWV'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report in which a chronically ill WIA applicant was advised to find a partner to support her, and was judged able to work as a crane operator. The minister called such statements undesirable and not regular policy, said UWV should work from trust, pointed to the complaint procedure, and announced a review of the CBBS functie-duiding method and a commission on the future of the sickness and disability system.
Based on the report, it is not possible for UWV to proactively contact the person concerned because UWV does not have all the required personal data.
Het is voor UWV op basis van het bericht niet mogelijk proactief contact met betrokkene op te nemen omdat UWV niet over alle benodigde persoonsgegevens beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kröger over de doorwerking van groothandelprijzen in gas en energie bij huishoudens en de weerslag hiervan op koopkracht

MPs Maatoug and Kröger asked how the government monitors hardship from high energy prices, and why the CPB will not update its cost-of-living box or model uneven inflation across income groups. The minister points to CPB stress tests, a TNO energy-poverty programme, forthcoming CBS and Divosa monitors, and says the CPB judges such updates methodologically infeasible, with extra instruments promised in the Prinsjesdag purchasing-power letter; answers to questions 1-8 are deferred.
The request was to answer these questions before Prinsjesdag. Full answers are not yet possible within that timeframe.
Het verzoek was om deze vragen voor Prinsjesdag te beantwoorden. De volledige beantwoording van de vragen is nog niet mogelijk op die termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over de STAP-subsidie in relatie tot kwakzalverij en dropshopping

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether STAP training subsidies can fund therapeutic and dropshipping courses, and how the government verifies their labour-market relevance. The minister answered that such courses are not excluded if the provider is accredited and the training is legal, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors providers and has ordered the removal of over 2,000 courses, and that an evaluation will follow in early 2023.
The STAP budget is a learning scheme that is continually adjusted and further targeted.
Het STAP-budget is een lerende regeling, die gaande weg wordt aangepast en verder wordt gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht 'Jezelf ontdekken in Parijs? Het kan op kosten van de overheid'

MPs Paul and Smals (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that course providers misuse the STAP training budget, for example by offering free trips and overnight stays, and about quality control, value for money, and whether the scheme should be evaluated early and targeted at shortage sectors. The minister replied that non-necessary costs are excluded, that the Toetsingskamer has asked providers to remove over 2,000 courses and is pursuing four providers for non-compliance, and that an invoeringstoets and a full evaluation will follow, but declined to target the budget at shortage sectors for now.
If the STAP budget is used to fund unnecessary items, action will be taken.
Indien het STAP budget wordt aangewend voor het bekostigen van niet-noodzakelijke zaken, wordt actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over 'het bericht dat tienduizenden mensen die arbeidsongeschikt zijn door de WIA in armoede leven'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that tens of thousands of people unable to work due to disability fall into poverty under the WIA, including the 35% threshold, the restverdiencapaciteit rules and whether hardship will be addressed. The minister acknowledges the hardship, says the government is examining it, and commits to a broader review with social partners and an independent commission, but declines to commit extra funds or a specific timeline.
I take this problem seriously and am examining it as part of my approach to hardship in the WIA, as announced in the coalition agreement.
Ik neem dit probleem serieus en onderzoek het in het kader van mijn aanpak van hardheden in de WIA, zoals aangekondigd in het coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de Circulaire Samenloop vergoedingen raadsleden met een uitkering en het borgen van inclusiviteit in de lokale democratie

Two CDA MPs asked whether municipal councillors receiving WIA disability benefits must surrender 75% of their council allowance, how this compares with Participatiewet rules, and whether the 2015 circular should be updated to promote inclusiveness in local democracy. The ministers answered that the WIA offset rules apply to council allowances, outline the rules by benefit phase, confirm the circular is substantively correct but needs updating, and point to an action plan and a planned website expansion.

However, it indeed needs to be updated because, for example, the decision on the legal position of council and committee members was replaced by the Decision on the Legal Position of Decentralised Political Office Holders as of 2019.

Zij moet echter inderdaad geactualiseerd worden omdat bijvoorbeeld het rechtspositiebesluit raads- en commissieleden per 2019 is vervangen door het Rechtspositiebesluit decentrale politieke ambtsdragers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Becker over het artikel ‘Arbeidsmigranten profiteren van leefgeld voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: ‘Mogelijk misbruik’

MPs El Yassini and Becker asked whether Ukrainian labour migrants already resident in the Netherlands are wrongly receiving living allowance (leefgeld) under the refugee reception scheme, and whether municipalities can verify eligibility. The government says the scheme is deliberately broad, municipalities cannot refuse eligible applicants, data-sharing with UWV is being examined, and it will look into pressure on workers, with no firm numbers on the misuse.
No figures are available on the number of labour migrants who were already residing in the Netherlands and fall under the Temporary Protection Directive.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal arbeidsmigranten die al in Nederland verbleven en onder de Richtlijn Tijdelijke Bescherming (RTB) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de FNV uit de SER subcommissie Grenswaarden Stoffen op de Werkplek is gestapt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the FNV left the SER subcommittee on hazardous-substance limit values and what is being done about bad compliance and low inspection of dangerous substances. The minister regrets the FNV's departure, says compliance is still too low, reports 2021 inspection figures, and says she is still seeking the FNV's return while awaiting the SER's response.
However, I cannot meet the FNV's wish to have the SER give instructions to the NLA to inspect specific substances.
Ik kan echter niet tegemoet komen aan de wens van de FNV om de SER aanwijzingen aan de NLA te laten geven om specifieke stoffen te inspecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Vreemdelingen worden uitgebuit in horeca Groningen. 'En het treurige is dat ze nog blij zijn met 2 euro per uur'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that migrants are exploited in Groningen hospitality for around 2 euros an hour, asking about inspection signals, registration of victims, reception-centre protections and measures against undocumented former asylum seekers working illegally. The minister said the Labour Inspectorate found some Wav and minimum-wage violations in Groningen hospitality checks but no signs of serious disadvantage or exploitation, reported a few ongoing investigations, and described existing information and monitoring measures without announcing new ones.
I do not make statements about possible investigations by the Labour Inspectorate.
Over eventuele onderzoeken door de Arbeidsinspectie doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over ziekmakende cabinelucht in vliegtuigen

MP Van Esch asks the ministers whether toxic cabin air in aircraft is making crew ill, whether standards, sensors, bleed-air bans, Arbeidsinspectie action, and monitoring of occupational diseases are adequate, and questions the independence of the FACTS research. The ministers reply that the cause of the complaints is still unclear, that the NAC advises on the issue, that standards and follow-up research are underway with Dutch participation, and that the Arbeidsinspectie sees no current reason to intervene, while committing to no new concrete measures.
According to the NAC, the cause of the complaints is not clear.
De oorzaak van de klachten is volgens de NAC niet duidelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked the Ministers of SZW and the Prime Minister which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and their information management. The government answered that departments are inventorying harsh laws under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that independent research and a chat-message retention policy exist, and that further letters and action plans will follow.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department carries out an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'

MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het tijdelijke gedoogbesluit over gebruik van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen van het RIVM gedurende de coronacrisis in het voorjaar van 2020 toen duizenden mensen in verplee

An MP asked the Ministers of VWS and SZW about the temporary tolerance decision under which the Labour Inspectorate applied RIVM protective-equipment rules instead of the Working Conditions Act during the spring 2020 care crisis, and about related OMT advice and enforcement. The ministers answered that the tolerance was a deliberate, documented decision based on exceptional shortages, that the inspectorate periodically re-evaluated it, but declined or deferred several answers and postponed the full response.
The tolerance decision was made known to the House by letter of 15 April 2020.
Het gedoogbesluit is kenbaar gemaakt aan de Kamer bij brief van 15 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oneigenlijk gebruik leefgeld

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Ukrainian arbeidsmigranten who were already in the Netherlands before the war are claiming leefgeld, and how misuse of refugee facilities and exploitation of Ukrainians will be tackled. The government answered that such workers can fall within the temporary protection group and so be eligible, that municipalities get support and verification via the IND, and that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating possible labour-law violations and the Aanjaagteam recommendations are being implemented.

Persons who were already in the Netherlands as labour migrants before the Russian attack can therefore fall within the target group and in that case are also eligible for reception and the associated leefgeld.

Personen die voor de Russische aanval al in Nederland waren als arbeidsmigrant kunnen derhalve onder de doelgroep vallen en komen in dat geval ook in aanmerking voor opvang en het bijbehorende leefgeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en de Hoop over het bericht 'stagiair wordt ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether unpaid internships, which are widespread and may amount to cheap labour, are acceptable, and whether a fixed internship allowance or a reporting point for abuse should be introduced. The minister replied that internships are for learning, that employers are not legally obliged to pay, that he will discuss voluntary agreements with the education and labour sectors, and that the Labour Inspectorate handles complaints about unpaid work under the minimum wage act.
I will therefore enter into discussions with the education and labour sectors to make agreements on how more employers can be ensured to offer an appropriate internship allowance.
Ik zal daarom met het onderwijs- en werkveld in gesprek gaan om afspraken te maken hoe er gezorgd kan worden dat meer werkgevers een passende stagevergoeding bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de schrijnende situatie van EU-arbeidsmigranten

MP Marijnissen asks the government about the dire situation of EU labour migrants exploited by temp agencies and landlords, citing a newspaper series, and asks about enforcement, housing standards, EU free movement and inspectorate criticism. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to pending bills on temp agency certification and Goed Verhuurderschap, a plan for vulnerable EU citizens, and says data on overcrowding are not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Inspectie: Stop met aantrekken arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Stoffer and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Labour Inspectorate's warning that labour migration causes societal costs such as housing shortages and inequality, and about whether the government will curb population growth. The minister acknowledges downsides, stresses EU free movement, treats non-EU labour migration as a last resort, and says the implementation of the Roemer committee recommendations and the population study are ongoing.
The cabinet sees labour migration from outside the EU as the last resort in tackling labour market shortages.
Het kabinet ziet arbeidsmigratie van buiten de EU als sluitstuk van de aanpak van krapte op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Primark personeel wil ontslaan

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would stop Primark from dismissing staff and rehiring them on worse terms, and whether UWV would facilitate the layoffs. The minister said Primark had withdrawn the dismissal plan, that employers may decide on personnel strategy within the law, and that UWV independently tests redundancy dismissals.
For a legally valid redundancy dismissal there must be a structural loss of jobs.
Voor een rechtsgeldig bedrijfseconomisch ontslag moet sprake zijn van een structureel verval van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht dat statushouders en nieuwkomers van buiten de EU het personeelstekort in de hartzorg verkleinen

MPs Van den Hil and Becker asked about reports that refugees and non-EU newcomers are easing health-care staffing shortages, and how to speed up BIG registration and link newcomers with care jobs. The minister answered that the government supports win-win approaches, cites a pilot mentoring project and the TAZ programme, and says no overview of municipal arrangements exists nationally.
An overview of all ongoing agreements between municipalities and care institutions on job placement and work experience places does not exist at national level.
Een overzicht van alle lopende afspraken van gemeenten met zorginstellingen bij de bemiddeling naar werk en/of werkervaringsplekken is er niet op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘Rotterdam geeft statushouders baan: ‘Rijk moet ook bijspringen.’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Rotterdam's plan to give asylum-status holders (statushouders) jobs through learn-work tracks and whether the national government should contribute. The minister explains that Rotterdam's tracks give regular employment rather than subsidised jobs, that the 23 participants at the municipality all moved into jobs, and that funding and sector-matching options are being explored, while the ministry will share lessons and join local follow-up talks.
I agree that the learn-work tracks for asylum-status holders ideally lead to them standing on their own feet.
Ik ben het met u eens dat de leerwerktrajecten voor statushouders er idealiter toe leiden dat de statushouders op eigen benen komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het artikel 'Rotterdam geeft statushouders baan: 'Rijk moet ook bijspringen''

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Rotterdam's plan to offer statushouders learn-and-work tracks to speed their labour-market integration and whether such initiatives could be supported nationally. The minister welcomed the approach, pointed to existing pilots and funding streams for municipalities, and promised to share Rotterdam's lessons via a learning network.
I wholeheartedly encourage the approach that the municipality of Rotterdam has in mind.
Ik moedig de aanpak die de gemeente Rotterdam voor ogen heeft van harte aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Verkuijlen over het bericht dat mogelijk ook een Nederlandse moskee een rol speelt in constructies voor mensenhandel en prostitutie

MPs Becker and Verkuijlen asked the government about reports that Dutch mosques may be involved in sham 'pleasure marriages' linked to sex work and trafficking, and about possible investigation, prosecution and sanctions. The minister answered that no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands have been received, that no investigation is planned, that the OM sees no current signs of crimes, and that the Taskforce cannot investigate individuals, while pointing to the pending Wtmo amendment and other planned instruments.
The OM has indicated that there are currently no signals of criminal offences.
Het OM heeft laten weten dat er op dit moment geen signalen zijn van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over aandelenovername kinderopvangketen Partou

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sale of childcare chain Partou from private equity firm Onex to Waterland, including subsidy flows, worker and parent influence, and regulatory oversight. The minister answered that the deal's amount is undisclosed, that the effects are not yet known, and that a study on financing forms in childcare will be sent to parliament in Q1 2023, while explaining the roles of the ACM and AFM.
The amount involved in the takeover has not been disclosed.
Het bedrag dat met de overname is gemoeid, is niet bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over werving en behoud van pedagogisch medewerkers in de kinderopvang in relatie tot personeelsgebrek en opleiding

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about staff shortages in childcare, part-time hours, training, EVC recognition, VOG screening, administrative burden and GGD inspections. The minister acknowledged the shortages, outlined measures such as working-hours projects, combination jobs, the STAP budget and extended in-training staffing rules, and promised further studies and evaluation follow-up.
How many employees work part-time is not known.
Hoeveel medewerkers parttime werken is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kinderopvang in 'permanente crisis': 'Overal waar jonge gezinnen wonen, is het een probleem''

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a permanent crisis in childcare, including staff shortages, extending trainee staffing, relaxing the child-staff ratio, and the impact of the planned system reform and the Wet IKK evaluation. The minister answered that the trainee-staffing rule is extended to July 2024, that the IKK evaluation will be followed by a review of quality requirements, and that a labour market approach and a parliamentary letter are forthcoming.
This has already led to it being possible since 1 January 2022 for 50 percent (instead of 33 percent) of the staffing to consist of trainee childcare workers.
Dit heeft er reeds toe geleid dat het sinds 1 januari 2022 mogelijk is om 50 procent (in plaats van 33 procent) van de formatieve inzet te laten bestaan uit beroepskrachten in opleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het bericht ‘Menstruatie meteen melden bij de juf – straks ook in het Westland’

MPs Paul and Becker asked the Education and Social Affairs ministers about an Islamic school board's rule requiring girls to report menstruation to teachers before joining prayer, and about citizenship education and oversight of Islamic schools. The minister answered that the rule was unacceptable, that the Inspectorate contacted the board which agreed to remove it, and that the government will use the Inspectorate, the safety duty and a planned expansion of administrative powers, while stating the matter would be raised with the municipality.
In this case, the inspectorate discussed the entire identity policy, as it appeared on the website, with the board.
In dit geval heeft de inspectie het hele identiteitsbeleid zoals dat op de website stond besproken met het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het toezicht op werken op hoogte

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour inspectorate capacity, violations and fines for unsafe work at height in asbestos removal, construction and solar panel installation, and the effect of extra oversight. The minister answered with capacity splits, a share of violations and fines relating to work at height, and a case example, while saying the inspectorate focuses on outcomes rather than inspection counts.
In line with the motto 'from tallies to effect', the focus of the Labour Inspectorate is not on capacity or the number of inspections but on the effect to be achieved: healthy and safe work.
Overeenkomstig het adagium «van streepjes naar effect», ligt de focus van de Arbeidsinspectie niet op capaciteit of het aantal controles, maar op het te bereiken effect: gezond en veilig werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Mee op pad met de arbeidsinspectie: ‘Het deugt niet, maar jij wilt wel je pakketje morgen bezorgd hebben’'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a press report on harsh working conditions and possible exploitation in parcel delivery, and whether principal contractors such as PostNL bear responsibility for subcontractors. The minister answered that client liability for health and safety exists only in construction, that the SER is advising on redistributing responsibility, and that the Arbeidsinspectie targets the parcel sector through risk-based enforcement.
I see that, partly due to a changing labour market, this allocation of responsibility for prevention and for healthy and safe work does not always work (optimally).
Ik zie dat, mede door een veranderende arbeidsmarkt, deze verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling als het gaat om preventie en de zorg voor gezond en veilig werken, niet in alle gevallen (optimaal) werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Erdogans Trolle Schwören sich auf Wahlkampf ein'

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that Turkish influencers and trolls target Turkish-Dutch and German voters ahead of Turkey's 2023 elections, and whether this interference happens in the Netherlands, along with related questions on counter-strategies, UETD training of candidates, campaign rules and social media regulation. The government condemned unwanted foreign interference, said it has no signals that Turkey is interfering in the 2023 elections, pointed to its existing counter-interference approach, support for municipalities and the Digital Services Act, and did not provide figures on UETD-trained candidates.
These figures are not known to the central government.
Deze cijfers zijn niet bekend bij de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over long-Covid bij leraren en onderwijsondersteunend personeel

An MP asked the ministers about long covid among teachers and support staff, including WIA disability benefits, loss of wage continuation, medical costs, a possible third sick year, and a compensation fund like the one for care workers. The government answered that it does not register the reason for sick leave, provides no sector-specific data, applies the general sickness and disability rules, and that the care-sector subsidy is not planned for education.
During the period of sickness before a WIA application is made, the reason for sick leave is not registered.
Tijdens de periode van ziekte voordat er een WIA-aanvraag wordt gedaan, wordt de reden van ziekmelding niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de hoge werkdruk voor medewerkers in de burgerluchtvaart

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked ministers about high workload for air sector staff, the VNC's call for a baseline measurement, division of inspection responsibilities, under-reporting of incidents by cabin crew, and Schiphol congestion. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Arbeidsinspectie and ILT share oversight, that it will discuss concerns in the aviation safety and social issues platform and with Schiphol, and that existing EU rules already allow cabin crew to report safety risks.
Of course I consider it important that employers adhere to good employership.
Ik vind het uiteraard belangrijk dat werkgevers zich houden aan goed werkgeverschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Allemaal dezelfde stempel van de commerciële keuringsarts’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV's contracted psychiatrist agency Psyon issues near-uniform diagnoses favouring work capacity, and about the reliability of UWV's own assessments and court review. The minister replied that UWV found Psyon's quality adequate, that no steering on outcomes exists, that it sees insufficient reason to intervene or stop the contract, and that no re-assessment is planned.
UWV concluded that the content of the articles for the time being gives no reason to doubt the quality delivered by Psyon.
UWV heeft geconcludeerd dat de inhoud van de artikelen vooralsnog geen aanleiding geeft om te twijfelen aan de door Psyon geleverde kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie Becker c.s. over het structureel tegengaan van extremistische uitingen online

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked how the government will implement the amended Becker motion on structurally countering extremist online expression, including the role of the new terrorist content authority, cooperation with platforms, financing, and Taskforce casework. Minister Van Gennip answered that extremist but non-terrorist online content falls outside the new authority's mandate on proportionality grounds, that the DSA will be used to tighten notice-and-action procedures, and that the Justice Minister will map preventive and repressive instruments, while many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or not answered in time.

To consider what options exist to act against this kind of harmful content, the Minister of Justice and Security will map which preventive and repressive instruments other countries have and what these offer the Netherlands.

Om te bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om juist tegen dit soort schadelijke content op te treden zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in kaart brengen over wat voor preventief en repressief instrumentarium landen om ons heen beschikken en welke mogelijkheden dit biedt voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht dat veel gevaarlijk asbestschroot in illegaliteit verdwijnt

An MP asked whether the claim that over 50% of asbestos demolition is illegal, as reported by Omgevingsdienst NL, is correct, and how the government will respond to that body's letter. The state secretary says the illegality mostly concerns missing demolition notifications and asbestos inventories, that the VTH system has not failed given the difficulty of enforcing against private parties, and promises further consultation and a letter to provinces.
No, given a compliance shortfall that largely arises among private individuals, it cannot be said that the VTH system has failed.
Nee, op grond van een nalevingstekort dat voor een belangrijk deel speelt bij particulieren kan niet worden gesteld dat het VTH-stelsel heeft gefaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 'het bericht KLM stelt vaccinatieplicht in voor nieuwe piloten en stewardessen'

An MP asks the ministers whether KLM may require vaccination of new pilots and cabin crew and whether such refusal-based rejection constitutes unlawful discrimination, and how the government will enforce against employers demanding vaccination status. The minister answers that vaccination is voluntary and employers may not require it, notes a Amsterdam court ruled KLM may not ask candidates about vaccination status, and states no specific legal basis exists but existing labour law protects workers, while declining to create new legislation.
In the Netherlands vaccination is and remains voluntary.
In Nederland is en blijft vaccinatie vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de themarapportage maaltijd- en flitsbezorging van de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie

MPs Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Labour Inspectorate's thematic report on meal and flash delivery, including its conclusions on bogus self-employment, performance pressure, child labour and working conditions. The minister responded point by point, stressing employer responsibility, existing rules and the Inspectorate's enforcement, while committing to further enforcement steps, a broader ban consideration for flash delivery under 16, and a letter on the coalition's bogus self-employment measures.
I will send your House a outline letter before the summer on the elaboration of the coalition agreement.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer een hoofdlijnenbrief sturen over deze uitwerking van het coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Oekraïense arbeiders in Westland uitgebuit: ‘Verwerpelijk’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report of exploitation of Ukrainian workers in Westland, and whether the free movement of labour should be replaced by work permits. The minister condemned the situation, said the Labour Inspectorate has opened investigations and is handling reports via a special team, and pointed to measures such as a notification duty, while declining to give details on individual companies until investigations conclude.
As long as the investigation has not been concluded, further information can only be shared in a confidential setting.
Zolang het onderzoek niet is afgerond, kan nadere informatie alleen in een besloten kader worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de start en het effect van handhaving van de Wet DBA

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about signals that clients were already suspending or cancelling contracts with self-employed workers ahead of Wet DBA enforcement, and about the need for clearer criteria and a separate legal status for freelancers. The minister acknowledged the signals, said enforcement continues within existing frameworks and a labour market package including the position of freelancers is being prepared, and promised a letter before summer and engagement with freelancer representatives.
I will send your House a letter of main lines before the summer on the elaboration of the labour market package.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer een hoofdlijnenbrief sturen over de uitwerking van het arbeidsmarktpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het bericht “Schandalen PostNL bij ons niet minder erg dan in België”

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked ministers whether the abuses at PostNL in Belgium are a scandal, whether Dutch oversight of parcel delivery fails, what will be done to end such practices, what they think of Belgian plans to require firms to employ many couriers directly, and why Dutch postal workers still generate scandals. The minister declined to address the ongoing Belgian case, described Arbeidsinspectie and ILT enforcement and a multi-year strategy with large clients, said generic measures are preferred but sector-specific ones may be warranted, and noted the 80% employment rule applies only to letter delivery, not parcels.
I cannot go into an ongoing legal procedure such as the case in the article in your question, which moreover took place in a neighbouring country.
Op een lopende juridische procedure zoals de casus in het artikel uit uw vraag, die zich bovendien in een buurland heeft voorgedaan, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht "Rechter steunt grensondernemers over Tozo"

MPs Palland and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that cross-border entrepreneurs may be entitled to the Tozo support scheme, asking about the consequences, number of affected people, contact with neighbouring countries, and the status of earlier motions. The minister answered that officials are studying the ruling, the municipality of Maastricht intends to appeal, and no substantive answers on the scope, implications or motions can be given until legal proceedings are complete.
For this reason I cannot yet respond substantively to your questions concerning the municipality's operational framework.
Daarom kan ik op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk ingaan op uw vragen met betrekking tot het handelingskader van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over problemen die mensen met long Covid ervaren met onder andere het UWV

MPs Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about long-Covid patients being poorly assessed by UWV, inconsistent WIA outcomes, lack of a financial safety net for self-employed and other workers, UWV targets, case counts, and an information campaign. The Minister answered that UWV treats all claims equally and individually, that no separate long-Covid policy or instructions are planned, that no targets restrict WIA or Ziektewet inflow, and that some measures and registration steps are underway.
The number of awards or rejections plays no role in the steering and assessment of insurance physicians or their managers.
Het aantal toekenningen of afwijzingen speelt geen rol bij de aansturing en beoordeling van verzekeringsartsen of hun leidinggevenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de reiskostenvergoeding van jonge nieuwkomers

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked about differing municipal rules and amounts for travel-cost reimbursement for school-going newcomers over 12, the indicators used, and the availability of newcomer schools. Minister Wiersma answered that no statutory duty exists for newcomers with a status, that municipalities decide voluntarily, that the government has no overview of municipal schemes, and that around 120 ISK schools provide nationwide coverage.
However, I do not have an overview of which allowances municipalities provide and under which conditions.
Ik heb echter geen overzicht van welke vergoedingen gemeenten verstrekken en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het verbieden van mobiele telefoons door GXO

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether GXO's ban on workers bringing mobile phones into the warehouse, and reports of unsafe conditions and 'slave-like' treatment, were justified and whether the Labour Inspectorate would be asked to inspect. The minister replied that the employer may issue such a safety-based instruction, that phone use was later allowed when not used during work, that late cancellation of on-call shifts without pay is illegal, and that the Labour Inspectorate sets its own risk-based priorities, with the warehouse sector already in its focus.
The Netherlands Labour Authority works programmatically and on a risk basis, and is an independent supervisory body.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie werkt programmatisch en risicogericht, en is onafhankelijk toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over "achterblijvende reiskostenvergoeding voor werknemers"

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked the government about rising commuting costs, the non-indexed tax-free travel allowance, and low employer reimbursement in low-wage sectors. The minister answered that the cost effects vary by worker, data on employer practices is incomplete, a study on modernising the allowance is due in 2022, and temporary fuel excise cuts and a planned future increase of the allowance are pointed to.
The Ministry of Finance is conducting research into modernising the travel allowance, and this research will be delivered in 2022.
Het Ministerie van Financiën doet onderzoek naar een modernisering van de reiskostenvergoeding, dat onderzoek zal in 2022 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over de verschillen in wet- en regelgeving voor en de kwaliteit van kinderopvang en basisonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the differences in rules and quality between childcare and primary education, covering cooperation, staffing, screening (VOG), inspection by GGD and the Inspectorate, ventilation standards and curriculum. The minister's answers describe existing cooperation initiatives, separate screening profiles under review, shared GGD and Inspectorate oversight of early education, and commitments to explore joint guidance and better alignment.
The Ministries of OCW and SZW are examining the possibility and desirability of aligning the screening.
De Ministeries van OCW en SZW onderzoeken de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid om de screening op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over de rol van kinderopvang in het integraal huisvestingsplan van gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the growing cooperation between primary education and childcare, such as integrated child centres, and about aligning rules and housing for these shared buildings in municipal housing plans. The minister acknowledges the benefits, notes a handbook is being prepared with ministries and partners on overcoming legal and financial obstacles, and says childcare housing will be considered in municipal integrated housing plans.
My ministry is continuously in discussion with the parties to the housing handbook, including the municipalities.
Mijn ministerie is doorlopend in gesprek met de partijen van de handreiking over huisvesting, onder andere de gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en El Yassini over de uitzonderingsregeling die de internationale voetbalfederatie FIFA heeft uitgevaardigd betreffende spelers en coaches van Oekraïense voetbalclubs middel

MPs Heerema and El Yassini asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the FIFA exemption for Ukrainian footballers and coaches and whether they need work permits to join Dutch professional clubs. The minister answered that since 1 April 2022 (retroactive to 4 March) Ukrainians under the temporary protection directive are exempt from the work permit requirement, with only an employer notification duty to UWV, and that other cases would follow normal salary and quality criteria.
From 1 April 2022, with retroactive effect from 4 March 2022, an exemption from the work permit requirement applies to refugees from Ukraine who fall under the temporary protection directive.

Per 1 april 2022, met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 4 maart 2022, geldt een vrijstelling van de tewerkstellingsvergunningsplicht voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne die onder de richtlijn tijdelijke bescherming vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Investeerders vergroten hun greep op de kinderopvang'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity investors buying childcare organisations for profit, the consequences for quality and access, parents' rights to be informed of takeovers, and how to prevent property investors from dominating childcare. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says quality is what matters regardless of ownership, notes parents have oudercommissie advisory rights and takeovers preserve existing agreements, and announces a study of financing forms including possible profit caps.
That is why I have announced that I will investigate the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom heb ik aangekondigd dat ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang ga onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Maatoug over het bericht dat “investeerders hun greep op de kinderopvang vergroten"

Two MPs asked the minister whether investors' growing control over childcare is desirable, whether profit-focused ownership harms quality and equal opportunity, how decisions on takeovers and parental influence work, and what safeguards are needed before childcare becomes largely subsidised in 2025. The minister says quality is the primary concern, acknowledges worries about private equity, and promises a government study into financing forms, profit-taking and possible profit caps, but defers concrete measures until that study is complete.
That is why I announced, in answer to parliamentary questions from members Kathmann and Maatoug, that I will study the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom heb ik aangekondigd in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug dat ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang ga onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over private equity Bencis koopt in stilte weer kinderopvangverblijven op

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity firm Bencis buying back childcare centres, the Estro/Smallsteps history, lack of parent information on ownership, rising tariffs, interest payments and profit levels in childcare. The minister answered that ownership is public but parents should be proactively informed, that a study of financing forms (including possible profit or tariff limits) will be launched, and that tariff caps are not currently under consideration.
That is why I want to investigate the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom wil ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over de participatie van Oekraïense vluchtelingen in onze samenleving

MPs Becker and Brekelmans asked the government about the reception, municipal costs, income support, integration and work of Ukrainian refugees, including whether mayors could be made legally responsible for reception. The minister answered that the mayors were given a statutory reception duty from 1 April 2022, that municipal costs will be fully reimbursed by central government, that Ukrainians are not subject to the civic integration obligation, and that further proposals on language and work are still being developed.
Your House has been informed about this by letter of 30 March.
Uw Kamer is hierover per brief van 30 maart jl. geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over misbruik van coronasteun door Berts Animal Verhuur

Two MPs asked whether the government would reclaim NOW wage subsidy paid to an animal rental company that used it for building work, and how enforcement by the NVWA and municipalities failed despite repeated complaints since 1998. The minister said NOW subsidy is adjusted only if wage sums fell, that building and dog-keeping limits are municipal matters, and that the NVWA has acted regularly and the company is now under intensified supervision.
For information on building works that may conflict with the zoning plan or other building permits, I refer you to the municipality of West Maas en Waal.
Voor informatie over bouwwerken die eventueel strijdig zijn met het bestemmingsplan of andere bouwvergunningen verwijs ik u naar gemeente West Maas en Waal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat de overheidswebsite plat lag vanwege run op aanvraag duizend euro

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked why the STAP training-budget website crashed on opening, whether demand was foreseeable, how many people were blocked, why there was no transition rule for people who started retraining before 1 March 2022, and how training providers are admitted to the register. The ministers acknowledge technical problems and UWV's capacity shortfall, promise improvements and monthly monitoring, but do not give exact figures for blocked applicants and largely explain the existing selection and register procedures.
It is difficult to estimate how many people were unable to submit an application due to the technical problems and rapid exhaustion of the budget.
Het is lastig om in te schatten hoeveel mensen door de technische problemen en snelle uitputting geen aanvraag hebben kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over verlof bij vroeggeboorte

An MP asks whether the new birth leave under WIEG restricts partners' leave timing for premature babies and whether maternity leave is too short when babies stay in hospital. The minister confirms the partner definition was changed deliberately for administrability, explains the extended maternity leave for hospital stays, and provides an international comparison while stating the current arrangements are adequate.
This definition was deliberately changed in the WIEG.
Deze definitie is in de WIEG bewust aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het gebrek aan een planning rond afspraken over eergerelateerd geweld en zelfbeschikking uit het coalitieakkoord

The MP Becker asked the ministers whether the coalition agreement's commitments on honour-related violence, self-determination and female genital mutilation are adequately planned, and when proposals on penalties, reporting duties and protection orders will come. The government answers that a multi-year prevention programme on self-determination and a broader plan on harmful practices will be sent to the House before the summer recess, that existing law already allows prosecution of accomplices, and that no separate proposal will be sent on that point.
As indicated in the answer to question 5, the House will be further informed about the approach to harmful practices, including a multi-year programme to promote self-determination.

Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 5 aangegeven, wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de inzet op schadelijke praktijken waaronder ook over een meerjarig programma gericht op de bevordering van zelfbeschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het toekennen van een groot bedrag aan NOW-steun aan een meermaals veroordeeld bedrijf, dat weigert dwangsommen te betalen

Two MPs asked why a company that rents out animals, has repeated court-imposed penalties and enforcement history, received about 170,000 euro in NOW wage subsidy and remains an approved training company. The ministers answered that the NOW scheme does not test animal welfare, that subsidy amounts are advances pending final settlement, and that SBB and the NVWA are monitoring the company.
Animal welfare is not part of these conditions.
Dierenwelzijn is geen onderdeel van deze voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht ‘Meerderheid scholen weigert inzet zzp’ers ondanks lerarentekort’

MPs Paul and Smals asked the government about a report that most schools refuse to deploy freelancers (zzp'ers) despite teacher shortages, and about enforcement moratorium, the DBA web module and legal uncertainty over flexible contracts. The minister answered that there are no signs refusals worsen teacher shortages, that enforcement moratorium remains in force with exceptions for malicious cases and unfollowed instructions, that the web module is only indicative and a broader policy letter will follow before summer 2022.
Before the summer we will inform you further about the elaboration of this ambition in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer zullen wij u nader informeren over de uitwerking van deze in het coalitieakkoord opgenomen ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het krantenartikel ‘Invallen in grensregio: politie stuit op ‘Roemeense slaven’ die in Nederlandse slachthuizen werken’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of Romanian workers exploited in Dutch slaughterhouses, including whether temp agencies are involved, whether permanent contracts should be mandatory, and how housing across the border is used to evade Dutch wage deductions. The minister condemns the abuses, points to ongoing investigations and cross-border cooperation with Germany, but declines to name agencies or slaughterhouses and offers no binding new rules.
I cannot go into ongoing investigations.
Op lopende onderzoeken kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de politie is gestuit op ‘Roemeense slaven’

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of Romanian workers living in substandard housing in Dutch slaughterhouse-linked labour arrangements, asking about rent, minimum-wage deductions, agency accountability and tighter rules. The minister answered that enforcement is ongoing, cross-border cooperation with North Rhine-Westphalia is being used, a Good Landlordship bill is pending before the Council of State, and a certification scheme and the advisory team's recommendations are being implemented, though no sanctions have yet been imposed and details cannot be given on ongoing investigations.
I cannot go further into ongoing investigations.
Op lopende onderzoeken kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Tjeerd de Groot over de schrijnende situatie rondom arbeidsmigranten in de grensregio

MPs Podt and Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the poor housing of Romanian agency workers in a German border area working for a Dutch agency, and how cross-border enforcement and the separation of housing and work contracts would be addressed. The minister said cooperation with Germany and Belgium is being intensified, the Goed Verhuurderschap bill will require separate housing contracts, a ban on employers also acting as landlord was judged too far, and a certification regime for agencies will be informed later this year.
I hope to be able to inform the House in the coming autumn.
Ik hoop uw Kamer in het komende najaar te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over zorgwekkende cijfers uit achterstandswijken en armoede onder Syriërs

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alarming poverty figures among Syrian migrants, whether this calls for restricting immigration, and about inburgering exemptions, the link between poverty and integration, the VIA programme, and raising naturalisation language requirements. The minister said integration takes time, cited research showing that completing inburgering raises employment, outlined measures such as the new Inburgeringswet and the Werkagenda VIA, and promised further information on naturalisation language requirements after the summer.
Your House will be informed about this after the summer.
Uw Kamer wordt hier na de zomer over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de laatste stand van zaken van zorgmedewerkers met post-covidsyndroom

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the number of care workers with long COVID entering the WIA disability scheme per month, about agreements with social partners and UWV, and about a bridging arrangement. The minister replied that privacy rules prevent employers from recording the cause of sick leave, that UWV applies the same assessment to all WIA claims, and that a temporary support measure for employers is being offered while research continues.
Under privacy regulations, employers are not permitted to record the reason or cause of sick leave.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving is registratie van de reden of oorzaak van ziekteverzuim door werkgevers niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over het CEP 2022

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the 200 euro energy allowance is enough, what minimum wage indexation alternatives would do to purchasing power, whether a one-off healthcare allowance increase is possible, and for answers before the debate. The government raised the municipal energy allowance reference amount to 800 euro, declined to deviate from the statutory minimum wage indexation method or submit the decision to parliament, and said a one-off care allowance increase is costly and slow to implement.
The cabinet proposes raising the reference amount of the energy allowance to 800 euro and has made 480 million euro extra available for this.
Het kabinet stelt voor om het richtbedrag van de energietoeslag te verhogen naar 800 euro en heeft hier 480 miljoen euro extra voor beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
