I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry would join the national week without meat and dairy and adopt a 'plant-based by default' catering principle, citing climate and health benefits of plant-based diets. The minister answered that canteens follow government sustainable catering criteria and that the ministry participates in the week and the circular catering vision, but gave no commitment to a plant-based default.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Stoffer over "het bericht dat het UWV wachtlijsten op illegale wijze wegwerkt"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV granted WIA disability benefits to sick workers aged 60 and over without a medical assessment in a Zwolle pilot, and whether a larger pilot is planned in Hengelo, raising concerns about legality and inconsistent regional practice. The Minister confirms 19 people received benefits without an insurance physician's assessment, states that a uniform approach is desirable but that local pilots may be tested, accepts that the law requires a medical and labour assessment, and promises an evaluation and information to parliament by spring.

Article 6, first paragraph, of the WIA stipulates that the assessment of whether someone is fully and permanently incapacitated or partially fit for work is based on an insurance-medical and a labour-expert examination.

In artikel 6, eerste lid, van de WIA is bepaald dat de beoordeling of iemand volledig en duurzaam arbeidsongeschikt of gedeeltelijk arbeidsgeschikt is, gebaseerd wordt op een verzekeringsgeneeskundig en een arbeidskundig onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over mogelijke arbeidsongeschiktheid als gevolg van uitgestelde zorg vanwege corona

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked whether delayed care during the COVID-19 pandemic is causing workers to become unfit for work and move from sick pay into the WIA disability scheme, and what is done for them. Minister Van Gennip answered that re-integration is tailored to each worker, that no figures are kept on how many are affected, that wages or benefits continue when re-integration is blocked by external circumstances, and that the 104-week sick pay period can be voluntarily extended by up to one year.
This is not tracked or registered.
Dit wordt niet bijgehouden of geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Sahla en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Minister zet ventilatie op scholen op 1'

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about ventilation in schools, childcare, vve, mbo, hbo and universities, CO2 measurement, and whether the school helpline extends to these sectors. The government answered that ventilation responsibility lies primarily with providers and institutions, that existing rules and risk-based inspection apply, and that the helpline is not extended, pointing instead to RIVM guidance and an app.
The cabinet has no insight into the measures regarding ventilation at institution level in secondary vocational education (mbo) and higher education (ho).
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de maatregelen met betrekking tot ventilatie op instellingsniveau in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) en hoger onderwijs (ho).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Hoogvliet medewerkers een bonus geeft als ze zich niet ziek melden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether bonuses paid to supermarket staff for not reporting sick are dangerous and whether the government will act. The minister said employers are primarily responsible for healthy working conditions, that such bonuses must not pressure sick or COVID-infected staff to come to work, and that she sees no direct action needed beyond sectoral agreements.
I think it is important that employers commit in a positive way to keeping employees fit and healthy.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat werkgevers zich op een positieve manier inzetten om werknemers fit en gezond te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Kröger en Bouchallikh over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Climate and Education about labour shortages blocking climate ambitions, retraining routes, support for career changers and a proposed work-guarantee fund. The ministers answered that labour market shortages are broad, that government role is limited and employers and workers bear primary responsibility, that existing retraining schemes and a forthcoming Action Plan for Green Jobs are being developed, and they rejected a work-guarantee fund as not efficient.
The cabinet does not have an overview of all retraining routes for career changers aimed at the energy transition.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van alle opleidingstrajecten voor zij-instromers, die gericht zijn op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over werkgevers zetten personeel onder druk om quarantaineregels te ontwijken

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers pressuring staff to ignore quarantine rules, forced leave deductions, sick-day rules and compensation for employers. The minister acknowledged the problem, stated that quarantine must be observed and pay continued, pointed to the Labour Inspectorate complaint line and said compensation was not feasible.
Forcing employees in violation of these measures to still come to work is undesirable.
Werknemers in strijd met deze maatregelen toch dwingen te komen werken is ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Miljoenen voor omscholing komen nauwelijks in de sectoren terecht die het nodig hebben: 'Dit slaat de plank volledig mis''

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that only 30 percent of NL Leert Door subsidised training courses target jobs with good prospects, and whether the scheme reaches workers with low qualifications. The minister defended the broad crisis-era design, said UWV's list of promising occupations is the reference, noted that about 79 percent of completed short courses were at mbo-2 level, and promised an evaluation report around summer 2022 without changing the scheme.
The Overview of promising occupations dates from 20 December 2021.
Het Overzicht Kansrijke beroepen stamt van 20 december 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over transactiekosten die ten koste gaan van de uitkering van uitkeringsontvangers in het buitenland

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about bank transaction fees charged to UWV benefit recipients abroad, notably in Turkey, after UWV moved payments to the Target-2 system in November 2021, and whether the government would act. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the fees are set by banks and UWV has no influence over them, and pointed to G20 work on cross-border payments as the remedy.
It is up to the banks themselves to determine which fees they charge for a foreign transfer.
Het is aan banken zelf om te bepalen welke kosten zij rekenen voor een buitenlandse overboeking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over berichten omtrent de ineffectieve besteding van coronagerelateerde opleidingssubsidies

MPs Van den Hil and Bevers asked why COVID-era retraining subsidies were allocated first-come-first-served or by lottery rather than by assessed need, why shortage sectors like care had limited access, and how future subsidies such as STAP will reach those most in need. Minister Van Gennip explained the crisis-speed rationale for the allocation method, argued the broad regulation was open to shortage sectors, reported that most completed short courses were at lower vocational levels, and pointed to the STAP budget, evaluation and broader labour-market measures.
No substantive assessment of the applications was chosen at the time, because experience shows this takes a lot of time.
Voor een inhoudelijke beoordeling van de aanvragen is destijds niet gekozen, omdat de ervaring leert dat dit veel tijd kost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de staking van veerschippers bij de Maasveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would intervene when the Maasveren ferry company sidelines the FNV union in wage negotiations with striking ferry crews, and whether the ferries should be brought into public hands. The ministers replied that collective bargaining is a matter for social partners under freedom of contract, that ferry responsibility lies with municipalities and provinces, and that they would not take further action.
In the Netherlands the principle of freedom of contract applies. Social partners themselves decide with whom they sit down at the table and make agreements.
In Nederland geldt het principe van contractsvrijheid. Sociale partners bepalen zelf met wie ze om tafel gaan zitten en afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Romke de Jong, Tielen en Aartsen over de signalen die zij ontvangen m.b.t. de steunmaatregelen voor zzp’ers

MPs asked whether municipalities impose wealth and viability tests on self-employed applicants for support beyond what the government intends, and about income losses and reskilling. The minister acknowledges reports of excessive information requests, says municipalities have decentralised responsibility and are being asked to limit requests to what is necessary, and largely defends the simplified Bbz scheme without reinstating the earlier TOZO.

Where signals reach the ministry that municipalities are requesting too much information, this is investigated, and if unnecessary information is indeed requested, the VNG is asked to contact the municipality concerned.

Daar waar bij het ministerie signalen binnenkomen dat gemeenten (te)veel informatie zouden uitvragen, wordt dit uitgezocht en als blijkt dat er inderdaad onnodige informatie wordt uitgevraagd, wordt de VNG verzocht contact hierover op te nemen met de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “het bericht dat bijstandsgerechtigden in de knel komen door hoge terugvorderingen”

MPs asked the minister why benefit recipients face high recovery claims despite gemeente relaxations, why courts seem to review reasonableness weakly, and about a motion on a €1,200 gift exemption. The minister promised a policy plan with gemeenten and said the motion would be included, but gave no firm timeline and pointed to existing municipal discretion.

Within the Participatiewet process I explicitly seek solutions in which the judge can explicitly review decisions for their reasonableness, precisely to prevent situations like those that came to light in the childcare benefits affair.

In het kader van het traject rond de Participatiewet zoek ik wel nadrukkelijk naar oplossingen waarbij de rechter beslissingen expliciet op hun redelijkheid kan toetsen, juist om situaties zoals die bij de Toeslagenaffaire naar boven kwamen te voorkomen.
